title: Sr Analyst Insights, Strategy & Analysis
description:
About Sony Pictures Television

Sony Pictures Television Studios (SPTS) is one of the industry's leading content providers, producing programming worldwide across genres and platforms. As the largest independent television studio, SPTS produces beloved shows, including Jeopardy!, Wheel of Fortune, The Last of Us, Outlander, American Idol, Shark Tank, The Real Housewives of Beverly Hills, Vanderpump Rules, Platonic, and many more. SPTS is part of Sony Pictures Television, a division of Sony Pictures Entertainment and a subsidiary of Tokyo-based Sony Group Corporation.

Role Overview

The Insights, Strategy & Analytics Sr Analyst supports audience insights, research, analytics, and strategic planning across Sony Pictures Television Studios' Game Shows, Nonfiction, and Scripted series (specifically: superhero, science fiction, and fantasy genres), The Sr Analyst will also support ISA’s Strategy team.

As part of the ISA team, the Sr Analyst will support ISA Game Show leads and collaborate with partners across Development, Production, Marketing, PR, Franchise, and other teams. The role uses audience data, consumer research, social intelligence, and marketplace analysis to help answer key business questions and inform creative development, content strategy, marketing, and franchise growth.

The Sr Analyst will support series throughout their lifecycle—from development and concept testing through launch and ongoing performance—and help the team understand what audiences want, why content resonates, and where opportunities exist in the marketplace. Success in this role requires strong analytical skills, intellectual curiosity, attention to detail, clear communication, and a passion for television and audience behavior.

Responsibilities

Audience Insights, Research & Analytics

  • Analyze content performance and audience behavior across linear television, streaming, digital, and social platforms.
  • Produce regular performance reporting and custom analyses, identifying key trends, drivers, and implications for the business.
  • Support qualitative and quantitative primary research, including concept, pilot, episode, creative, and marketing testing.
  • Use syndicated research, audience measurement, and consumer data to answer questions about content, audiences, and the entertainment landscape.
  • Analyze social conversation, fandom, sentiment, and digital engagement to understand audience behaviors and identify emerging trends.
  • Partner with Data Analytics, Business Intelligence, and Data Science teams on larger-scale analyses, dashboards, and reporting.
  • Validate and reconcile multiple data sources to ensure accuracy and quality across analyses and reporting.

Content Strategy, Development & Marketplace Intelligence

  • Support ISA genre leads and cross-functional partners with insights that inform development, production, marketing, and franchise strategy.
  • Track the television and streaming landscape, genre trends, competitive programming, and changing audience behaviors to identify opportunities and areas of growth.
  • Support the evaluation of new series, concepts, formats, spin-offs, and franchise extensions through audience research, competitive analysis, and marketplace assessment.
  • Develop landscape analyses and case studies to identify audience trends, genre whitespace, and learnings from relevant programming and franchises.
  • Support launch and post-launch analyses to understand content performance and identify learnings for future programming and marketing decisions.
  • Maintain a strong understanding of trends across Game Shows.

Strategic Storytelling & Collaboration

  • Bring together audience data, consumer insights, social intelligence, and marketplace trends to develop clear, actionable insights.
  • Create strategic, succinct, and visually compelling presentations, dashboards, and other deliverables for internal stakeholders.
  • Translate complex data and research into clear narratives that explain what happened, why it matters, and what we can learn from it.
  • Collaborate with ISA genre leads and partners across Development, Production, Marketing, PR, Franchise Management, and other teams to address key business questions.
  • Proactively identify interesting patterns, emerging trends, and new questions within the data.
  • Approach assignments with curiosity and a consultative mindset, seeking to understand the business question behind the request rather than simply reporting data.

Qualifications

  • 4–6 years of experience in media and entertainment research, consumer insights, analytics, strategy, market research, consulting, or a related field.
  • Experience with Nielsen audience measurement tools such as NPower, NNTV, SVOD Content Ratings, Total Content Ratings, or similar platforms is preferred.
  • Experience with quantitative and/or qualitative consumer research methods.
  • Strong analytical skills and experience working with large datasets and multiple data sources.
  • Foundational understanding of the television and entertainment landscape, including linear, streaming, digital, and social platforms.
  • Familiarity with entertainment and consumer research tools such as Ampere, Luminate, MRI-Simmons, eMarketer, ePoll, or similar platforms is a plus.
  • Experience with social and digital measurement tools such as Talkwalker, ListenFirst, ViralMoment, Tubular, YouTube Analytics, TikTok Analytics, or similar platforms is a plus.
  • Proficiency in Excel and PowerPoint; experience with Tableau or other data visualization tools is preferred.
  • Strong data storytelling and presentation skills, with the ability to distill complex information into clear, concise, and visually compelling insights.
  • Excellent attention to detail, organization, and project management skills.
  • Curious, proactive, collaborative, and comfortable managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Bachelor's degree required, preferably in Marketing, Economics, Business, Social Sciences, Statistics, Data Science, Communications, or a related field.
  • Passion for television, audience behavior, and the entertainment business, with interest in Game Shows.

The anticipated base salary for this position is $90K to $110K. This role may also qualify for annual incentive and/or comprehensive benefits. The actual base salary offered will depend on a variety of factors, including without limitation, the qualifications of the individual applicant for the position, years of relevant experience, level of education attained, certifications or other professional licenses held, and if applicable, the location of the position.

Sony Pictures Entertainment is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, veteran status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, or other protected characteristics.

SPE will consider qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records in accordance with applicable law.

Sony Pictures does not allow audio recording, video recording or use of AI note-taking tools during interviews. Please be aware these tools may be enabled as a default and can be difficult to disable once the interview has started, so we recommend you check your device and disable these tools prior to the start of your interview. If recording or the use of the tools occurs during the interview and cannot be promptly turned off or disabled, the interviewer may end the interview.

To request an accommodation for purposes of participating in the hiring process, you may contact us at SPE_Accommodation_Assistance@spe.sony.com.

title: Data & Integration Engineer
description:
Experience : 3-9 Years
Role : Data & Integration Engineer

Key Skills

  • Data Engineering,
  • System Integrations,
  • Python, SQL, Informatica

Responsibilities

We are looking for a Data & Integration Engineer who operates effectively at the intersection of system analysis, enterprise integration and data engineering to support GenAI initiatives .

The successful candidate will:

  • Understand business and functional requirements
  • Translate them into data flows and integration designs
  • Work across upstream and downstream systems
  • Ensure reliable movement, transformation and availability of data for GenAI use cases
  • Develop scripts / programs to get data from different integration systems
  • Develop APIs to integrated with relevant systems.

The focus is on getting data into the right place, in the right format, reliably .

What Matters Most

  • Strong system thinking and ability to understand end to end flows
  • Ability to challenge bad designs and propose better ones
  • Strong stakeholder communication
  • Hands on enough to troubleshoot and implement, but not a pure coder
  • Experience navigating messy enterprise ecosystems

Key Responsibilities

  1. 1. System Analysis & Design

    • Analyse business/technical requirements and translate them into data flows and integration designs
    • Work with upstream and downstream teams to define data contracts and interfaces
    • Identify gaps, inefficiencies and risks in current data movement processes
    • Propose pragmatic solutions balancing speed, quality and maintainability

  2. 2. Integration & Data Movement

    • Design and implement data movement across systems using:
      • APIs
      • SFTP and file based transfers
      • Batch pipelines
    • Coordinate integrations across systems in the DataLake ecosystem (Informatica, Cloudera, etc.)
    • Ensure data is correctly transformed, mapped and delivered to target systems
    • Troubleshoot integration issues across environments

  3. 3. Data Preparation for GenAI

    • Support data ingestion and preparation for GenAI use cases:
      • document ingestion
      • data aggregation
      • enrichment and transformation
    • Work with structured and unstructured data
    • Ensure data is usable for downstream AI workflows (RAG, search, investigation flows)
    • You are not asking them to build models, just make data usable for them.

  4. 4. Delivery & Coordination

    • Work across multiple teams:
      • data platforms
      • application teams
      • infrastructure
      • security
    • Support SIT, UAT and production rollouts
    • Ensure integration reliability, error handling and monitoring
    • Document flows, mappings and interfaces clearly

Requirements

Key Requirements

Below are the key skillsets that will be required for all relevant tasks mentioned:

  • 5-10 years of experience in system analysis, integration engineering, data engineering or technical delivery roles.
  • Strong ability to translate requirements into system flows, data flows, interface specifications and implementation plans.
  • Experience working with upstream and downstream teams to define and deliver enterprise integrations.
  • Practical experience with REST APIs, SFTP, batch processing, file based integration and data pipeline orchestration.
  • Good understanding of data mapping, transformation, aggregation, reconciliation and data quality controls.
  • Good SQL skills and basic to moderate Python skills for data handling, scripting, automation and troubleshooting.
  • Exposure to Java
  • Exposure to Informatica, Cloudera or similar enterprise data platforms.
  • Working knowledge of Git , branching, pull requests, code reviews and controlled release practices.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD, Jira, Confluence and enterprise deployment processes.
  • Experience with Control M or equivalent scheduling tools.
  • Familiarity with logging (OTEL) and monitoring tools such as Splunk Elastic Stack.
  • Exposure to GenAI concepts such as document ingestion, RAG, embeddings and data preparation for AI workflows.
  • Working experience with Informatica is preferable.

Strong communication skills, with the ability to challenge weak designs and coordinate across business, application, data, infrastructure and security teams.

title: Software Engineer
description:

Why AirAsia?

title: Lead Full Stack Developer (IoT)
description:
About Innowave Tech

Innowave Tech is a leading AI solution provider in the semiconductor industry, specializing in developing cutting-edge technologies for innovation and efficiency. Our focus is on leveraging computer vision and large-scale data analytics to meet the complex needs of our clients.

Position Overview

We are looking for a Lead Full Stack Developer (IoT) to drive the end-to-end development of our IoT products. In this role, you will work across hardware, firmware, and software, while also contributing to full-stack development for cloud and web interfaces. You will lead a small team of engineers, collaborate closely with clients, and coordinate with product, operations, and manufacturing teams to deliver production-ready IoT solutions.

This is an ideal role for someone who is hands‑on technically, enjoys full‑stack software development, and can also contribute to the broader product lifecycle in a lean SME environment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead end‑to‑end development of IoT solutions, covering hardware, firmware, and software integration.

  • Develop full‑stack web or cloud applications to support IoT devices and services.

  • Manage the full product lifecycle: concept, prototyping, pilot, and production.

  • Provide technical leadership and mentorship for a small engineering team (2–3 engineers), including task allocation and code/design reviews.

  • Engage directly with clients for requirement gathering, solution presentations, and troubleshooting.

  • Oversee project management tasks: timelines, documentation, and risk tracking.

  • Collaborate with product managers, operations, suppliers, and manufacturing teams.

  • Support cloud integration, containerization, and backend services for IoT platforms.

Technical Skills

Hardware / Firmware:

  • PCB design, electronics fundamentals, sensors, microcontrollers (STM32, ESP32).

  • Industrial protocols (Modbus, CAN, RS485).

  • Firmware development in C/C++, RTOS, Linux device drivers, low‑level debugging.

Software / Full Stack:

  • Python, Node.js (or similar) for middleware and web services.

  • Front‑end web frameworks (React, Vue, Angular, or similar).

  • Cloud integration (AWS, Azure) and containerization (Docker, Kubernetes).

  • Networking: TCP/IP, MQTT, HTTP/REST APIs, and security protocols.

Tools & Processes:

  • Altium / KiCad, Git, Jira, CI/CD pipelines.

Qualification

  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical/Electronic Engineering, Computer Science, or related field.

  • 3+ years of experience in IoT, embedded systems, or full‑stack development.

  • Prior team leadership or project development experience preferred.

  • Experience in semiconductors, industrial IoT, automation, or product development preferred.

  • Comfortable working in a small team, taking initiative, and handling multiple responsibilities in an SME setting.

Why Join Us

  • Lead and shape IoT product development while building full‑stack applications.

  • Be part of a small, collaborative SME team where your contributions have a direct impact.

  • Gain exposure across hardware, firmware, software, and product lifecycle management.

  • Competitive salary package for the ideal candidate.

  • 13th month annual wage supplement (AWS)

  • Performance bonus and annual salary adjustment based on your contributions and company growth.

We are a growing company with exciting opportunities ahead, and we’re seeking passionate individuals to grow with us.

If you’re ready to be part of something meaningful, we’d be delighted to have you on board!

title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
We are looking for a Forward Deployed AI Engineer to join the Team at DataSnipper. You will embed with our customers to build and refine the AI agents that automate their audit and finance workflows, taking them from zero to live in daily use and turning what you learn on the ground into the signal that shapes our product. You sit at the exact point where our agent platform meets real assurance work, directly reducing manual effort and accelerating audit outcomes.

This is a hands-on, customer-facing role in a high-caliber team that moves fast and holds a high bar. You will design and build agents, debug their accuracy in front of a customer, make the feasibility calls, and then make sure engineering hears what you saw. The platform is still being shaped, so the role rewards people who are energized by building on something while making it better, not people who need fully stable tooling before they can deliver.

Why DataSnipper?

Audit and finance are still massively manual, and we're changing that.

DataSnipper is a $1B, bootstrapped unicorn with 600,000+ users across 180+ countries, already embedded in the daily workflows of top audit and accounting firms. Now we're taking things further with our agent platform, bringing AI directly into where the work actually happens.

Unlike generic AI tools, we don't sit on the sidelines. Our agents operate inside the customer's real workflows, with access to real documents and audit evidence, meaning they don't just generate answers, they do the work, with full traceability.

We're not just applying AI. We're redefining how audit gets done. If you want to build something category-defining at scale, and do it shoulder to shoulder with the firms using it, this is the place.

What You Will Do

Deployment & Delivery

  • Build and earn the credibility with senior stakeholders like top-firm audit partners, engagement leaders, and methodology owners ****earning the credibility to influence how an entire practice adopts AI

  • Design engagement programs that take a customer from zero to 20+ agents embedded directly into finance workflows and driving measurable impact

  • Run office hours and resolve remaining issues, then hand off agent know-how cleanly to the Customer Success Manager who owns ongoing account health

Agent Build & Quality

  • Build the more complex agents yourself, solving prompting and accuracy challenges against real audit evidence

  • Assess the feasibility of candidate agents, and make the call on what is achievable within an engagement

  • Produce robust agent configurations that anticipate edge cases and hold up under real customer use

Feedback & Impact

  • Operate a tight feedback loop between the customer and our product and engineering teams so issues and feature gaps reach the right people fast

  • Surface gaps with enough specificity that they can be prioritized rather than lost and work closely with product and engineering on ideation and prioritization

  • Foster documentation and knowledge sharing across delivery, product, engineering, and GTM teams

Professional Services leadership & Product Influence

  • Play a founding role in shaping DataSnipper's professional services offering, translating early deployment learnings into repeatable frameworks, engagement models, and delivery standards as the FDE function grows

  • Dedicate part of your time working directly with the product team to help design and develop new product capabilities, bringing the customer and deployment perspective into early-stage product thinking

  • Mentor incoming FDE team members as the function scales, sharing domain knowledge, delivery instincts, and agent-building craft

What You Will Bring

Must-Have

  • Strong technical aptitude and structured thinking, with the judgment to decompose a customer workflow into agents and decide quickly what is feasible and what is not

  • Domain expertise in audit and/or finance or strong interest w/ ability to learn

  • Technical literacy with data and documents, enough to configure them correctly and reason about what is going wrong

  • The ability to do this in front of customers, under time pressure, without losing their confidence when something breaks

  • Comfortable using a variety of AI tools like Claude in the build and test loop to move quickly

  • Excellent written and verbal communication, including the ability to make a customer need legible to engineering

  • Bias toward shipping and iterating rather than perfecting in isolation, and willingness to travel to customer sites when an engagement calls for it

Nice-to-Have

  • Prior Forward Deployed Engineer, solutions engineering, or implementation experience at an applied AI or enterprise software company

  • Experience with document processing and spreadsheet-heavy workflows

  • Familiarity with agent design patterns, evals, or AI observability

  • Hands-on experience building with LLMs in practice: writing and refining prompts, evaluating accuracy, and debugging non-deterministic behavior

What We Expect

  • Ownership: You take features from refinement to production and stay accountable through bug-bashing, on-call response, and follow-ups. You don't wait to be told what to fix.

  • Growth Mindset: You actively seek and give feedback, and treat reviews and pairing sessions as a chance to grow rather than to defend.

  • Collaboration: You build trust with product, design, QA, and fellow engineers; you ask good questions and share context generously.

  • Adaptability: You feel comfortable in a fast-changing scale-up environment, priorities shift, scope sharpens, and you help the team adjust.

  • Judgment: You balance speed and quality, know when to push back, when to ship pragmatically, and when to escalate.

What we offer

  • Being part of one of the fastest-growing scale-ups in the Netherlands

  • Make an impact by disrupting the audit industry with us

  • 28 vacation days

  • Excellent salary

  • Pension plan

  • Stock participation plan

  • Hybrid work (Amsterdam-based)

  • International team and environment

  • Daily lunch 🍽️

  • Mental health support (OpenUp)

  • Social events and team activities 🤩

title: Lead Software Development Engineer in Test (Remote, Anywhere in Pakistan, USD Salary)
description:
Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field.
  • 5+ years of experience in software testing, test automation, and software development.
  • Strong proficiency in one or more programming languages, including Java, C#, Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, Kotlin, or Swift.
  • Hands‑on experience with test automation frameworks such as Selenium WebDriver, Playwright, Cypress, Appium, or Robot Framework.
  • Experience in API testing using Rest Assured, Postman, Karate, Newman, or GraphQL testing.
  • Proficiency in unit testing frameworks such as JUnit, TestNG, NUnit, xUnit, or PyTest.
  • Experience with Behavior‑Driven Development (BDD) frameworks, including Cucumber, SpecFlow, or Behave.
  • Strong understanding of CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps, Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or GitLab CI.
  • Proficiency with version control systems, including Git, GitHub, Azure Repos, or Bitbucket.
  • Experience working with relational and NoSQL databases such as SQL Server, PostgreSQL, MySQL, Oracle, or MongoDB.
  • Hands‑on experience with cloud platforms and containerization technologies, including Microsoft Azure, AWS, Google Cloud Platform (GCP), Docker, and Kubernetes.
  • Experience with performance testing tools such as JMeter, k6, or Gatling.
  • Familiarity with test management and defect tracking tools, including Azure DevOps, Jira, TestRail, Zephyr, or Xray.

  • Familiarity with Infrastructure as Code (IaC), AI‑assisted testing tools, intelligent test automation, and secure software development practices is a plus.
  • Excellent analytical, debugging, troubleshooting, critical thinking, and problem‑solving skills.
  • Strong communication, collaboration, stakeholder management, and mentoring abilities.
  • Strong software engineering mindset with a passion for quality, continuous improvement, ownership, and accountability.
  • Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments with the ability to adapt in a fast‑paced development environment.

Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, maintain, and enhance scalable, reusable, and maintainable test automation frameworks, including data‑driven, keyword‑driven, hybrid, and BDD frameworks.
  • Improve test coverage and execution efficiency through robust automation framework design.
  • Develop and maintain automated test scripts for web, mobile, desktop, API, and microservices applications.
  • Write clean, maintainable, and production‑quality automation code. Develop reusable testing utilities and libraries.
  • Participate in code reviews and continuously improve code quality, maintainability, and scalability.
  • Design, develop, and execute automated RESTful and GraphQL API tests. Validate business logic, authentication, authorization, and request/response payloads.
  • Perform database validation using SQL and NoSQL databases to verify application data integrity.
  • Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins, Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, or GitLab CI.
  • Analyze pipeline failures, improve test reliability, and ensure stable automated test execution.
  • Participate in requirements analysis, design reviews, sprint planning, and other Agile ceremonies to identify quality risks early.
  • Ensure quality throughout the SDLC by collaborating with cross‑functional teams during Agile development.
  • Develop test strategies, test plans, and quality metrics to improve application quality and automation adoption.
  • Collaborate with development teams to improve application testability and drive automation best practices.
  • Support performance, load, stress, scalability, and basic security testing. Identify bottlenecks and recommend performance improvements.
  • Create and maintain reusable test data, manage test environments, and support service virtualization for reliable testing.
  • Collaborate with Product Owners, Developers, QA Engineers, DevOps Engineers, and Solution Architects to deliver high‑quality software.
  • Provide accurate effort estimates, mentor junior engineers, and promote quality engineering best practices across the team.
  • Monitor automation execution results, perform root cause analysis, maintain quality dashboards, and recommend process improvements to enhance product quality and delivery efficiency.

title: SOC Lead
description:
SOC Lead – UAE

Location: Dubai/Abu Dhabi
Department: Engineering
Reports To: CTO

Who We Are!

Back in 2019, spiderSilk was born with a bold idea: build regional, sovereign cybersecurity IP that could stand tall on the global stage.

Our mission? To shake up the way organizations protect their ever-changing digital worlds with continuous, intelligent, and autonomous security that doesn’t miss a beat.

We’re a global mix of curious minds, problem-solvers, and passionate builders, all united by one goal: making the internet a safer place for everyone. Around here, we thrive on vision, energy, and a strong sense of ownership.

If this feels like your kind of crew, you’ll probably fit right in.

About the Role:

Today, when SilkRunner investigates an alert, we largely rely on the agents themselves to tell us whether the investigation was good. We need a human with real SOC experience to own that judgement.

You will be the person who looks at an agent-generated investigation and says whether it holds up: is the conclusion valid, is the evidence sufficient, is it comprehensive enough that an L1 or L2 analyst could actually act on it, or does it need more. You will then hold that same conversation with customers, with the credibility of someone who has run these investigations themselves and seen what their own team produced.

This is a hands-on technical role, not a people management role. We are looking for the senior engineer or SOC lead who stayed close to the incidents, not someone who moved away from them.

Responsibilities:

  • Own corporate IT operations and infrastructure, including the endpoint fleet and the full onboarding and offboarding lifecycle

  • Run identity and access management: SSO, provisioning, joiner/mover/leaver flows, access reviews and least privilege

  • Manage the device estate through MDM, including enrolment, baseline configuration, patching and compliance policy

  • Administer our productivity and SaaS stack, including licensing, tenant configuration and app governance

  • Own networking and connectivity: firewalls, VPN, Wi-Fi and switching across our sites

  • Keep IT controls aligned to SOC 2 and ISO 27001, and work with security on endpoint protection and EDR coverage

  • Run the service desk: ticketing, SLAs, escalation paths and the reporting that shows where the recurring pain is

  • Lead and develop a small IT and helpdesk team, and manage vendors, contracts and IT budget

What you will bring

  • Proven experience owning corporate IT end to end, including endpoint fleet management and onboarding and offboarding at scale

  • Strong hands-on identity and access management: Okta, Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD), JumpCloud or Google Workspace

  • Device and endpoint management through MDM: Intune, Jamf, Kandji or Mosyle

title: Senior Bilingual (Spanish/English) Data Engineer (8+ years of experience) to design and implement cloud data pipelines using GCP, BigQuery, and ETL processes- 41529
description:
Senior Bilingual (Spanish/English) Data Engineer (8+ years of experience) to design and implement cloud data pipelines using GCP, BigQuery, and ETL processes- 41529

Our banking client is seeking a Senior Bilingual (Spanish/English) Data Engineer (8+ years of experience) to design and implement cloud data pipelines using GCP, BigQuery, and ETL processes- 41529

Location Address

Hybrid - Toronto – as of now, mandate is to come in 4x/week starting in September, this is subject to change for the team - want candidates in the GTA who are OK with this

Contract Duration

ASAP to Dec 31st (Possibility of Extension)

Schedule Hours

9am-5pm Monday-Friday; standard 37.5 hrs/week

Story Behind the Need

Business group: Technology Program Management & Transformation – team that manages cloud data integration and governance for IB, providing efficient and standardized solutions that enable different business areas to access and use data securely and effectively.

Project

International Banking – Data Migration and Transformation to Cloud

Mission

To develop and maintain a cloud platform that integrates data from various sources, standardizes processes, and facilitates data publication for consumers and producers, ensuring quality, security, and accessibility.

Scope

The primary objective of this project is to design and implement a unified cloud data platform for IB across different countries.

Impact: Efficient ingestion of data from multiple on-premises sources to the cloud.

Data transformation and standardization into organized layers (landing and standardization zones).

Rapid data delivery for bank teams requiring reports, indicators, or advanced analysis.

Incorporation of reusable data products for transversal consumption across the organization.

The project prioritizes agility in delivery, enabling tactical solutions (quick, connected to local sources) when necessary, while promoting progressive advancement toward fully cloud-based strategic solutions.

Typical Day in Role

  • Move data from on prem to cloud, working with Mexico Chile Peru as some of the main stakeholders.
  • There are multiple technologies in each country, so the goal is to build different data pipelines to ingest into cloud for each
  • Running processes from repositories into cloud including data management, connections, patterns, and ensure there is a clear vision for all the data sources; main challenge is to understand how data is managed in each country and working with them; internally to organize and standardize data within the repository
  • Design, develop, and maintain data pipelines and infrastructure on Google Cloud Platform (GCP) to support the creation of scalable data products. Reporting to the Senior Data Engineer, this role focuses on implementing robust and efficient data solutions to enable data-driven decision-making and support business objectives.
  • Migration is final goal
  • Receiving use cases from business – sometimes mortgage, AML, analytics and they will need to prioritize data pipeline accordingly
  • Data Modelling to connect different needs from the business
  • Standardize data from different sources and countries so that the Canadian banking stakeholders can understand
  • Translate local business processes into global business ones
  • Documentation and communication will be in English, though local communication with the remote teams for the respective countries will be in Spanish
  • Main tool will be GCP and BigQuery for data storage
  • Composer (AirFlow onPrem) will be used for data transformation
  • Build and maintain data pipelines and ETL/ELT processes on GCP to ensure reliable and efficient data flow for data products.
  • Collaborate with the Senior Data Engineer and cross-functional teams (e.g., Data Scientists, Product Managers) to understand requirements and deliver high-quality data solutions.
  • Implement data models, schemas, and transformations to support analytics and reporting needs.
  • Ensure data quality, integrity, and performance by monitoring and optimizing data pipelines.
  • Adhere to data governance, security, and compliance standards within GCP environments.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve issues in data pipelines to minimize downtime and ensure operational efficiency.
  • Contribute to the adoption of best practices and tools for data engineering, including documentation and testing.
  • Stay updated on GCP services and data engineering trends to enhance pipeline capabilities.

Candidate Requirements/Must Have Skills

  • 1) 8+ years of experience as a Data Engineer, with some recent experience working with ETL
  • 2) Bilingual in English and Spanish required (verbal / written professional proficiency in both)
  • 3) 3+ years of hands-on expertise in building data pipelines on cloud platforms, with a preference for Google Cloud Platform (GCP)
  • 4) 3+ years’ experience with GCP tools such as BigQuery, Dataflow, Pub/Sub, or Cloud Composer, AirFlow
  • 5) 5+ years’ experience in programming languages like Python or Java and advanced SQL for data processing

Nice-To-Have Skills

  • 1) 3+ years’ experience with data modeling, schema design, and data warehousing concepts.
  • 2) Familiarity with version control systems (e.g., Git) and basic CI/CD practices is a plus.
  • 3) Understanding of data governance and security practices in cloud environments.
  • 4) Experience from FI/banking
  • 5) Experience working in an Agile environment

Education

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field.

Best VS. Average Candidate

Ideal candidate needs to have solid knowledge of end-to-end pipeline processes and able to describe it in detail, how data is handled, cleaned, organized and built; bilingual in Spanish is crucial to deal with international stakeholders, Data modelling experience is important for at least 1 of the hires; experience with cloud technologies is very important.

Cloud data engineers, ETL data engineers

title: Product Manager, In-Person Giving
description:
Highlights:

Location: Poland

Language: Fluent in Russian and English (C1+)

About Fundraise Up

We’re Fundraise Up - a global fundraising platform built to make donating to nonprofits fast, seamless, and accessible to all. Every month, our technology powers tens of millions of dollars in donations across the globe. We focus on innovation that directly impacts results: faster load times, higher conversion rates, global payment support, and accessibility-first design.

Our platform is trusted by many of the world’s leading nonprofits, including UNICEF, the Alzheimer’s Association, and a wide range of global NGOs. With a 4.9/5 rating across top software review platforms, we’re recognized not just for our impact - but for the quality of the product we deliver.

A Truly Global Product

We operate in the enterprise segment, serving nonprofit organizations across North America, the United Kingdom, Australia, and Europe.

We’re building a large and complex product ecosystem that serves nonprofits, donors, and partners around the world. The platform includes a modern checkout experience and customizable widgets (each a standalone SPA), donor, organization, and partner portals, admin tools, and several internal apps.

The Team

We are a distributed team of 160+ product professionals. Our team members are mainly based across Spain, Poland, Portugal, Georgia, Armenia, Serbia, Turkey, and Cyprus.

Despite our scale, we operate like a focused team - where every task matters and every voice is heard. We value thoughtful collaboration, strong engineering practices, and a product mindset. You’ll be joining a team where quality, mentorship, and mutual respect come first.

About In-Person Giving at Fundraise Up

In-Person Giving brings the quality and connected data of Fundraise Up’s online donation experience into physical fundraising moments.

The product begins with Tap to Donate and Giving Station: staff-led and self-service experiences that let nonprofits accept contactless donations at events, in public spaces, and through other offline workflows. Every transaction should connect to the same campaigns, donor records, reporting, CRM integrations, and operational controls used across Fundraise Up.

The next product direction is Events & Commerce. It includes ticket sales, check-in, merchandise and food purchases, symbolic purchases, auctions, paddle raises, and additional donations before and during an event. These capabilities must work as one connected fundraising system rather than another isolated event tool.

About the Role

We are hiring a Product Manager to own Events & Commerce within the broader In-Person Giving product line.

This is a hands-on software product role covering discovery, definition, delivery, launch, and iteration. You will turn a large category into a focused product direction grounded in customer workflows, live usage, and commercial evidence.

You will work closely with the PM responsible for the broader In-Person Giving area so that event commerce builds on the same payment, campaign, donor-data, reporting, mobile, and operational foundations as Tap to Donate and Giving Station. You will also partner with the Peer-to-Peer team where ticketing and event capabilities should be shared rather than rebuilt separately.

This is not an event-planning, sales, or internal project-coordination role.

What You’ll Own

Define the product direction

  • Turn customer research, market evidence, and business context into a clear Events & Commerce product thesis and sequenced roadmap.
  • Choose a focused target segment and event scenario rather than trying to replace every event platform at once.
  • Decide which capabilities belong in the shared In-Person Giving foundation and which require an Events-specific model.
  • Make explicit decisions about what Fundraise Up should build, integrate, partner on, or deliberately exclude.
  • Keep assumptions, success metrics, scope, risks, and product decisions visible.

Lead discovery and product definition

  • Work directly with nonprofit fundraising teams, event operators, finance teams, volunteers, attendees, donors, design partners, and internal GTM teams.
  • Map the complete workflow before, during, and after an event—including purchase, donation, check-in, fulfillment, reconciliation, reporting, and follow-up.
  • Validate decisions through interviews, workflow observation, prototypes, and live product usage.
  • Separate true adoption blockers from feature requests and expectations created by incumbent event platforms.
  • Shape problems such as ticket sales, QR-based check-in, guest management, commerce catalogues, FMV and receipts, on-site purchases, auctions, paddle raises, refunds, attribution, reporting, and integrations. These are examples—not a pre-committed feature checklist.

Shape and deliver the product

  • Own the product from problem definition through requirements, delivery, launch, and iteration.
  • Write clear requirements, acceptance criteria, edge cases, state transitions, and decision records.
  • Make day-to-day scope and trade-off decisions with Engineering, Design, Analytics, Research, QA, and GTM partners.
  • Design for real event conditions: staff and volunteer operators, self-service flows, mobile devices, optional hardware, unreliable connectivity, high-volume moments, and operational recovery.
  • Ensure that event capabilities reuse Fundraise Up’s existing payments, campaign, donor, reporting, CRM, and identity infrastructure wherever possible.
  • Keep delivery predictable by surfacing dependencies, risks, and unresolved decisions early.

Launch, learn, and drive outcomes

  • Launch through EAPs with clear entry criteria, target workflows, success measures, readiness requirements, and out-of-scope areas.
  • Understand whether organizations can configure and run the target event workflows without heavy manual work or disconnected tools.
  • Measure whether attendees can purchase, check in, donate, and receive the right confirmation or receipt through a clear experience.
  • Partner with Product Marketing, Sales, CSM, Support, Finance, Legal, and Operations on positioning, commitments, enablement, and launch readiness.
  • Connect product evidence to activation, adoption, event completion, GPV, expansion, pipeline, retention, and operational cost.
  • Turn evidence into explicit recommendations: iterate, expand, change direction, partner, or stop.

Work AI-native

  • Use AI for research synthesis, workflow analysis, prototyping, specification quality, data exploration, and operational automation.
  • Build testable artifacts quickly without outsourcing product judgment.

Requirements

  • 4–7 years of Product Management or Product Ownership experience in a software product company.
  • End-to-end ownership of a customer-facing product area with Engineering and Design.
  • Strong judgment in reducing a large problem space to a focused release and explaining the trade-offs.
  • Experience turning customer evidence and product data into decisions.
  • Clear written communication across requirements, edge cases, metrics, and decision records.
  • Ability to work with transactional, multi-actor workflows involving permissions, states, money, and data relationships.
  • High ownership and independence, with fluent written and spoken English.

Strong plus

  • Experience with ticketing, event technology, commerce, POS, payments, marketplaces, registration, auctions, or other transaction-heavy products.
  • Experience with mobile applications, contactless payments, physical devices, or hardware-enabled workflows.
  • Experience with B2B SaaS, fundraising, nonprofits, or other operationally complex customer environments.
  • Experience launching a new product area through beta or EAP.
  • Knowledge of CRM integrations, financial reconciliation, reporting, transaction attribution, analytics, or SQL.
  • Practical use of AI for research, prototyping, analysis, or product operations.

This Role May Not Be a Fit If

  • You are looking for an event-planning or internal project-management role rather than software product ownership.
  • You prefer to receive a fully defined roadmap and requirements instead of helping determine what should be built.
  • You want to work only on strategy and avoid specifications, QA, delivery details, or post-launch iteration.
  • You treat every customer request as a roadmap commitment.
  • You need stable scope and certainty before moving forward.
  • You measure progress mainly by features shipped rather than customer and business outcomes.

Why work with us

  • Build a new product direction from research through live customer use.
  • Work in a large, proven fundraising category with clear customer demand and meaningful commercial potential.
  • Shape ticketing and event commerce as part of a broader fundraising platform rather than an isolated event tool.
  • Work with real nonprofit customers, rich product evidence, and experienced cross-functional partners.
  • Join a small team where product managers have meaningful ownership and direct access to Product leadership.
  • Help define an AI-native approach to product management in practice.
  • Build technology that helps nonprofits engage more supporters and raise more money for their missions.

Compensation

  • The compensation range for this role is €5,800 - €6,300 gross.
  • Final compensation will be determined based on relevant experience, skills, qualifications, alignment with the role’s requirements and location.

Benefits

  • 31 days off
  • 100% paid telemedicine plan
  • Home Office Setup Assistance: the company offers assistance with purchasing furniture (office chair, office desk, monitor) and other items to create a comfortable workspace.
  • English learning courses
  • Relevant professional education
  • Gym or swimming pool
  • Co-working
  • Remote working

Kirby Group Engineering is an international multi-disciplinary engineering services contractor and leading provider of high-value engineering services to a number of ‘blue chip’ companies. Operating across Ireland, the UK, Europe and South Africa, Kirby has become the engineering service provider of choice in growth segments such as pharmaceuticals, data centres and power transmission and distribution. Our culture is innovative, collaborative and performance focused. The successful candidate will have the opportunity to grow and develop in a company committed to developing talent and rewarding performance.

Mechanical Commissioning Lead – Data Centre Project
Location: Sweden

If you’re the kind of engineer who wants to take real ownership of commissioning — not just tick boxes — this should get your attention.

We’re delivering a major data centre project in Sweden. It’s fast‑paced, highly technical and full of the sort of moving parts where strong commissioning leadership makes or breaks the job. That’s why we’re looking for a Mechanical Commissioning Lead who knows how to bring systems online properly, manage multiple specialists, and keep both the quality and the momentum exactly where they need to be.

What You’ll Do
You’ll be the person who makes sure the commissioning doesn’t just happen — it happens in the right sequence, with the right documentation, and to the standard the client expects.

That includes:

  • Reviewing IFC drawings, specs and technical submittals
  • Working closely with the PM and QS on any commissioning‑related cost impacts
  • Mentoring junior engineers and supporting their development
  • Developing and implementing the commissioning plan
  • Coordinating commissioning with planners, package engineers and vendors
  • Attending client commissioning meetings and ensuring alignment

  • Managing snag lists and ensuring issues are closed out quickly

Quality & Risk
You’ll help define system boundaries, manage benchmarks, oversee test packs, and ensure everything is accurate, compliant and ready for inspection. You’ll also take a proactive role in identifying risks, reporting them clearly, and helping the project team stay ahead of possible delays.

Communication & Commercial Awareness
You’ll issue weekly commissioning and risk reports, advise on potential variations, and work closely with QS and PM teams to avoid surprises. Clear communication is essential — especially when something might impact programme.

Who This Suits
If you like being the person who brings systems to life, who spots issues early, and who knows how to manage commissioning in a structured but practical way — you’ll thrive here. Data centre experience is an advantage, but strong commissioning leadership and mechanical expertise matter most.

You’ll enjoy this role if you prefer action over bureaucracy, responsibility over hand‑holding, and clarity over chaos.

title: DFT Engineer
description:
Job Description:

Arm’s Solutions group DFT team implements DFT for test-chips and hard-macros to prove Arm's soft IP power, performance, area, and functionality within the context of a SoC using the latest DFT techniques and process technologies. We closely collaborate with RTL, Verification, Physical Implementation, and Test engineering teams throughout the life cycle of a project, from an early investigation stage all the way through tape-out and silicon test/characterization on ATE.

Architect, implement, and validate innovative DFT techniques on test chips as well as hard macros. Insert DFT logic into SoC style designs at the RTL level and at the Synthesis gate level, validate all features, and generate ATE targeted test patterns to be run on silicon.   • Bachelors or Master’s degree or equivalent experience in Electronic Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field

title: Technical Engineer - Fire Door
description:

The successful candidate will provide technical expertise and sales support across fire door systems, delivering compliant solutions to clients, supporting the commercial and project teams, and contributing to business growth. This role suits a customer‑focused professional with strong selling skills, sound technical knowledge of fire doors and associated hardware, excellent communication skills and a practical problem‑solving approach.

  • Act as the technical point of contact for enquiries, providing expert advice on fire door types, frame systems, ironmongery and installation methods to meet required fire performance and regulatory standards.

title: Infrastructure & DevSecOps Lead
description:
The Infrastructure and DevSecOps Lead is responsible for overseeing the activities of the DevOps and DevSecOps Engineers within the Technology Division. This role ensures that the Technology Division's software products and infrastructure are effectively developed, deployed, and maintained to meet the requirements of clients and end-users. The Infrastructure and DevSecOps Lead is responsible for establishing and maintaining DevOps and DevSecOps processes, standards, and best practices, with a strong emphasis on integrating security into every stage of the software development lifecycle. This role provides guidance and support to DevOps and DevSecOps Engineers, and is accountable for ensuring the security, compliance, and resilience of all infrastructure, applications, and related processes. The role also champions the adoption of AI-assisted tools and practices to drive productivity, quality, and innovation across the engineering team.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Developing, Implementing, and Maintaining DevOps & DevSecOps Processes:

    • Strong ability to work in a team-oriented environment, with effective communication and collaboration skills.

    • Establish and optimize DevOps and DevSecOps methodologies and standards.

    • Ensure effective collaboration and communication between development, operations, and security teams.

    • Integrate security tools (e.g., SonarQube, Trivy, Burp Suite) into CI/CD pipelines to automate security testing during build and deployment phases.

    • Leverage AI-assisted tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Antigravity, Claude) to accelerate automation, scripting, infrastructure-as-code authoring, and security analysis workflows.

  • Secure Development and Deployment:

    • Design and maintain secure configurations for cloud infrastructure using Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools such as Terraform or CloudFormation.

    • Implement security controls and standards for containerized applications in Kubernetes, ensuring security and compliance of container orchestration environments.

    • Maintain robust security policies and documentation, covering all aspects of data protection, access control, and incident response.

    • Utilize AI tools to assist in secure code review, threat modelling, and generation of hardening documentation.

  • Cloud Security and Infrastructure Management:

    • Implement and manage cloud security solutions, particularly within AWS, utilizing tools like AWS WAF, GuardDuty, and Macie.

    • Develop and enforce IAM policies and access controls to ensure proper identity and data management across environments.

    • Conduct regular audits and reviews of cloud security configurations to identify and remediate misconfigurations and potential vulnerabilities.

  • Coordinating and Monitoring Work:

    • Supervise the work of DevOps and DevSecOps Engineers to ensure timely and accurate deliveries.

    • Oversee development, deployment, and maintenance of software products and infrastructure.

    • Implement and support monitoring solutions to ensure system health, performance, and security.

  • Monitoring, Incident Management, and Vulnerability Assessment:

    • Establish and maintain a comprehensive security monitoring and alerting framework using ELK Stack, Prometheus, and other monitoring tools.

    • Conduct regular vulnerability scans, penetration tests, and security assessments to identify risks and vulnerabilities in applications and infrastructure.

    • Lead incident response efforts, including analysis, containment, eradication, and recovery, ensuring effective and timely resolution of security incidents.

    • Document and communicate post-incident reports and security findings to relevant stakeholders.

    • Apply AI-powered tools (e.g., Claude) for log analysis, anomaly triage, and drafting incident post-mortems to accelerate response times.

  • Identifying and Addressing Issues:

    • Proactively identify and resolve infrastructure and deployment issues, inefficiencies, and inconsistencies.

    • Implement automation to improve efficiency and reduce manual intervention.

    • Address security vulnerabilities and ensure compliance with security standards.

  • Security Governance and Compliance:

    • Ensure adherence to industry standards and regulatory compliance (e.g., GDPR, CCPA, SOC-2, ISO/IEC 27001) through continuous review and implementation of security controls.

    • Create and maintain security guidelines, hardening checklists, and compliance documentation to support secure system development and operation.

    • Coordinate with internal teams and external auditors during security assessments and compliance reviews.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration:

    • Participate alongside other Team Leads (Back-End, Front-End, Mobile App Development, QA Automation, System Analyst) and Software Architects and Head of Engineering to form a product development strategy in their area of expertise and responsibility.

    • Suggest, recommend, and implement new technologies and systems, including evaluating and standardising AI developer tools across the engineering organisation.

  • Guidance and Mentorship:

    • Provide guidance, mentorship, and support to DevOps and DevSecOps Engineers to enable their professional growth and development.

    • Foster a culture of continuous improvement, security-first mindset, and collaboration within the team.

    • Promote and enforce security best practices among team members.

    • Conduct security training sessions and workshops for development teams to promote secure coding and operational practices.

    • Champion the effective and responsible adoption of AI coding assistants (GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Antigravity, Claude) within the team, establishing guidelines for their use in infrastructure and security contexts.

Skills and Qualifications:

  • Technical Expertise:

    • 10+ Years of experience.

    • Strong experience in DevOps tools and technologies such as Docker, Kubernetes, Jenkins, Git, and cloud platforms, OCI is MUST.

    • Deep understanding of DevSecOps methodologies and practices, with hands-on experience in securing containerized and cloud-based infrastructure.

    • Previous experience in a DevOps or DevSecOps role, particularly in environments that prioritize continuous delivery, automation, and security.

    • Experience leading a DevOps or DevSecOps team.

    • Proficiency in security tools and platforms such as SonarQube, Trivy, Burp Suite, GuardDuty, AWS WAF, and ELK Stack.

    • Familiarity with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools (Terraform, CloudFormation) for managing secure and scalable infrastructure.

    • Practical experience with AI-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot, Cursor, or Antigravity for accelerating infrastructure automation, scripting, and code quality workflows.

  • AI Tools & Productivity:

    • Proficiency in using AI coding assistants including GitHub Copilot, Cursor, and Antigravity to accelerate IaC authoring, script generation, and security policy documentation.

    • Ability to integrate AI tools into CI/CD and developer workflows in a governed, security-conscious manner, ensuring sensitive data and credentials are handled appropriately.

    • Experience evaluating and selecting AI tools appropriate to DevSecOps and infrastructure use cases, and defining team-wide standards for their adoption.

    • Hands-on experience with Claude (Anthropic) for tasks such as threat modelling assistance, incident post-mortem drafting, compliance documentation generation, log and alert analysis, and infrastructure review — experience with Claude is a significant plus for this role.

  • Security Skills:

    • Hands-on experience with security analysis tools for SAST, DAST, and SCA.

    • Expertise in penetration testing, incident response, and cloud security auditing.

    • Strong understanding of cryptography, identity management, and secure access control.

    • Advanced knowledge of application security, secure coding practices, and vulnerability management.

  • Programming Skills:

    • Proficiency in scripting languages like Python, Bash, or PowerShell.

  • Problem-Solving:

    • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to troubleshoot complex issues in a dynamic environment.

    • Ability to perform threat modeling and risk assessment to identify potential security gaps and solutions.

  • Communication:

    • Excellent communication skills with the ability to work collaboratively across technical and non-technical teams.

    • Strong documentation skills to support security policy development and incident response procedures.

  • Soft Skills:

    • Excellent problem-solving and decision-making skills.

    • Advanced English proficiency, both written and spoken, is mandatory for effective communication with partners and clients.

  • Preferred Qualifications:

    • Experience in obtaining certifications such as SOC-2/ISO/IEC 27001.

    • Experience with agile methodologies and practices.

    • Relevant security certifications (e.g., CISSP, CEH, AWS Security Specialty) are a plus.

    • Demonstrated hands-on experience with Claude (Anthropic) in a DevSecOps, infrastructure, or engineering context is a significant advantage.

    • Experience establishing AI tool governance policies and usage guidelines for engineering teams.

Company Description

NCS is a leading AI Tech Services company. With a 15,000-strong team across the Asia Pacific, NCS scales its platforms and capabilities to provide clients with greater agility and AI expertise across a range of Industries. Embracing a strong ecosystem of global partners, NCS transforms technology services delivery combining AI with digital resilience to drive real business impact. NCS is a subsidiary of the Singtel Group.

Job Description

This is a Senior Data Engineer role within NCS AI Central’s Forward Deployed Engineering model, focused on preparing client data for production-grade AI, ML, and RAG systems.

The role owns the design and delivery of AI-ready data pipelines, including ingestion, cleaning, transformation, data quality checks, batch and streaming workflows, and production-scale operations. A key focus is building reliable data foundations for RAG and vector search, covering document ingestion, chunking, embeddings, hybrid search, and vector databases such as pgvector, Pinecone, Weaviate, OpenSearch, or Azure AI Search.

You will also handle data governance and compliance, including PII redaction, access controls, data residency, metadata, and lineage, especially for regulated sectors such as Healthcare, Government, and Transport. They will work closely with AI Engineers and AI Architects to define what “AI-ready” data means for each engagement, from fast POC/POV work through to hardened production systems.

What will you do?

1. Data Pipeline Engineering & AI-Readiness

  • Design and build ingestion, cleaning, and transformation pipelines that turn messy, real-world client data into AI-ready datasets.
  • Build batch and streaming pipelines (Airflow/Prefect/Kafka) that keep data flowing reliably into AI systems without manual intervention.
  • Own data quality — deduplication, schema validation, completeness checks — upstream of any model or RAG pipeline.
  • Proactively flag data gaps or quality issues that would degrade model/RAG performance downstream, before they surface as an AI Engineer's problem in testing.

2. RAG & Vector Store Architecture

  • Architect document/data ingestion and indexing pipelines for Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems — chunking strategy, embeddings, hybrid/vector search.
  • Design and operate vector database and search infrastructure (pgvector/Pinecone/OpenSearch) at production scale and query volume.

3. Data Governance & Compliance

  • Implement PII redaction, data residency, and access-control patterns aligned to PDPA and sector-specific requirements (Healthcare, Government, Transport).
  • Maintain clear data lineage and metadata governance so engagement teams and auditors can trace how client data flows into AI outputs.

4. FDE & Development/Maintenance Coverage

  • During FDE engagements: rapidly assess and prepare a client's data landscape during Discover/POC, identifying data-readiness gaps early.
  • During system development & maintenance engagements: build and operate production-scale data pipelines handling the full volume and complexity of live client systems (e.g., Healthcare or Transport data at scale).
  • Contribute reusable ingestion/indexing patterns back into the shared internal asset library to accelerate future engagements.

5. Collaboration & Leadership

  • Partner closely and continuously with AI Engineers and AI Architects — understanding what a given model, RAG pipeline, or agent actually needs from the data layer, and translating that into concrete pipeline and schema design decisions.
  • Own the definition of "AI-ready" data for each engagement jointly with AI Engineers — agreeing on chunking strategy, metadata, freshness, and quality thresholds before pipelines are built, not after retrieval quality suffers.
  • Sit in solution design conversations alongside AI Engineers and AI Architects, so data architecture and model/RAG architecture are designed together rather than data being treated as a downstream dependency.
  • Mentor junior data engineers and set data engineering standards across engagements.

Qualifications

  • 5+ years in data engineering, including production-scale pipeline design (not just analytics/reporting pipelines).
  • Strong SQL and at least one systems language (Python/Scala/Java); hands-on with batch and streaming frameworks (Airflow, Spark, Kafka).
  • Experience building data pipelines for AI/ML or RAG use cases — embeddings, vector indexing, hybrid search.
  • Solid understanding of data governance, PII handling, and access-control patterns in regulated environments.
  • Comfortable moving between fast, exploratory data assessment (FDE/POC) and disciplined, high-volume production pipeline engineering (system development & maintenance).
  • Working understanding of core AI/LLM concepts — tokenization, embeddings, chunking strategy, context windows, RAG, and agentic workflows — sufficient to hold a real technical conversation with AI Engineers and AI Architects about what "AI-ready" data means for a given use case, not just how to move and clean it.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with vector databases (pgvector, Pinecone, Weaviate) and search platforms (OpenSearch/Azure AI Search).
  • Exposure to Singapore Government data environments (GCC/HCC) and compliance regimes (IM8, PDPA).
  • Experience with sector-specific data complexity — Healthcare (clinical data governance) or Transport/Aviation systems.
  • Familiarity with data cataloguing and lineage tooling.
  • Prior experience embedded within an AI/ML delivery team (not just a data platform team) — i.e., has sat alongside AI Engineers day-to-day and adjusted pipeline/schema design based on model or RAG performance feedback.

Tech Stack (Illustrative)

  • Languages: Python, SQL (Scala/Java a plus)
  • Pipelines: Airflow/Prefect, Spark, Kafka/Debezium
  • Storage/Search: Postgres, S3/Blob, pgvector/Pinecone/Weaviate, OpenSearch/Azure AI Search
  • Governance: Presidio (PII redaction), data catalogue/lineage tooling
  • Cloud: AWS/Azure/GCP; GCC/HCC exposure a plus

Additional Information

Why Join NCS?

Grow with Us

  • Work on cutting-edge AI products that shape the future of technology
  • Collaborate with talented, passionate teams across research, engineering, and design
  • Access continuous learning opportunities and career development pathways

Make an Impact

  • Transform AI research into products that solve real problems for clients and users
  • Drive innovation in a leading Technology Services Firm with regional presence
  • Contribute to building a better future through responsible, human-centred AI

Thrive in Our Culture

  • Experience a human-to-human approach where relationships and collaboration matter
  • Be part of Team NCS, where bold ideas meet practical execution
  • Enjoy a supportive environment that values diversity, inclusion, and respect

We are driven by our AEIOU beliefs—Adventure, Excellence, Integrity, Ownership, and Unity—and we seek individuals who embody these values in both their professional and personal lives. We are committed to our Impact: Valuing our clients, Growing our people, and Creating our future.

Together, we make the extraordinary happen.

Learn more about us at ncs.co and visit our LinkedIn career site.

title: Infrastructure Strategy Analyst & Delivery Strategy Lead
description:
About us

At National Grid, we light up the world by harnessing the unique strengths of our people. The Infrastructure Strategy team is hiring two strategic thinking individuals to be part of a team that's driving forward the energy transition, creating a brighter, more sustainable future for all. Unleash your superpower and bring energy to life.

National Grid is hiring an Infrastructure Strategy Analyst and a Delivery Strategy Lead – Both positions are based from our Warwick office however we offer flexible hybrid working options

Job Purpose

We are seeking highly motivated and pragmatic professionals who thrives in complex and evolving environments. Successful candidates will be able to independently manage projects from concept through to delivery, balancing competing priorities while identifying practical, effective solutions.

You will be passionate about shaping the future energy system and supporting the UK's Net Zero ambitions, bringing a proactive mindset and a commitment to continuous improvement. With strong strategic thinking skills, you will be able to translate long-term objectives into tangible outcomes, whilst maintaining attention to detail when addressing specific challenges and opportunities.

A collaborative approach and excellent communication skills are essential, enabling you to build effective relationships with a broad range of stakeholders both internally and externally. You will also demonstrate resilience and adaptability, confidently navigating ambiguity and driving progress within a fast-paced organisation and an industry undergoing significant transformation.

What You'll Do

You will have the opportunity to work on a wide variety of projects including but not limited to:

  • Supporting / leading cross-functional workstreams and engaging with colleagues across the business to refine and activate our ‘world-class early development strategy’ and ensure that strategy aligns with National Grid’s strategic priorities and other function-led strategies and plans
  • Addressing gaps between our current activities and our early development strategy, collaborating with accountable owners across the business to recommend and activate change
  • Developing and implementing a portfolio deliverability framework
  • Contribute to option or portfolio reviews to ensure a consistent approach to delivery strategies is applied which include wider strategic business drivers
  • Providing deliverability assurance for investment cases
  • Helping to shape the industry’s future strategic network planning processes, including by coordinating with internal stakeholders of varying seniority levels to define our objectives and build consensus, and supporting engagement with external stakeholders to influence and shape the process and methodologies that will identify the network of the future and accelerate the delivery of critical transmission infrastructure
  • Contributing to horizon scanning and tracking of macro-trends that impact future strategic network planning processes and early project development, and working on internal briefings and summaries for relevant audiences
  • Supporting / leading on ad hoc strategic projects that are of importance to the business, helping to frame key strategic questions, collect and analyse supporting data and information and shape recommendations

About You

  • Assisting in the development of / developing strategic and operational workstreams and the activation and implementation of change to improve NGET’s performance
  • Supporting with defining / defining the problem statement or purpose of workstreams, developing and activating plans, identifying and flagging risks and opportunities, delivering outputs of a high standard.
  • Working with direction to identify / Identifying appropriate stakeholders and support engagement activities, maintaining a helpful and responsive approach or coordinating smaller stakeholder touchpoints (e.g., scheduling meetings, preparing pre‑reads, summarising discussion points) to support broader engagement
  • Structuring problems in a logical way, breaking problems down into manageable components and suggesting steps to support hypothesis development and testing
  • Identifying the appropriate method of data collection and analysis to undertake robust qualitative and quantitative research to test hypotheses, prepare summaries which outline findings, recommendations and where deeper analysis or further stakeholder input may be required
  • Checking assumptions and data reliability, raising concerns about data quality gaps with leads and building well-structured exhibits or charts with insights identified.
  • Drafting clear and concise internal documents (e.g., briefing notes, slides), ensuring accuracy of information and correct formatting; incorporating feedback to refine clarity and tone
  • Identifying and tracking relevant macro-trends that may influence our early project development strategy and future network plans, sharing insightful analysis on the potential impact to NGET
  • Supporting the identification of / identifying opportunities for continuous improvement and innovation in processes and strategies, developing best practices that can be endorsed and activated across the organisation

What You'll Get

A competitive salary between £47,000 – £63,000 dependent on capability

As well as your base salary, you will receive

  • 26 days holiday, plus eight statutory days, an option to buy extra holiday days, and the option to holiday swap up to 3 bank holiday days
  • An annual performance incentive
  • A generous pension scheme, double matched up to 6% of your salary each month. For every £1 you contribute we’ll put in another £2, so if you put in 6%, we’ll add 12% giving a total of 18% to your pension pot
  • Life insurance at 10 times basic salary
  • Employer funding towards a portion of your Private Medical Insurance.
  • You will also have access to a number of flexible benefits such as a share incentive plan, salary sacrifice car and technology schemes, support via employee assistance lines and matched charity giving to name a few.

More Information

The closing date for this vacancy is 17th September. However, we encourage candidates to submit their applications as early as possible and not to wait until the published closing date. National Grid’s recruitment periods can and may vary. We reserve the right to remove this advert or close it to further applications at any point during the recruitment process.

In NGET we are passionate about both operating our network safely and providing highly reliable quality of supply for our customers. At the heart of achieving these outcomes is the effective control and operation of our network.

To find out more about us, please follow the link below:

DE & I statement

At National Grid, we work towards the highest standards in everything we do, including how we support, value and develop our people. Our aim is to encourage and support employees to thrive and be the best they can be. We celebrate the difference people can bring into our organisation, and welcome and encourage applicants with diverse experiences and backgrounds, and offer flexible and tailored support, at home and in the office.

Our goal is to drive, develop and operate our business in a way that results in a more inclusive culture. All employment is decided on the basis of qualifications, the innovation from diverse teams & perspectives and business need. We are committed to building a workforce so we can represent the communities we serve and have a working environment in which each individual feels valued, respected, fairly treated, and able to reach their full potential.

Please note that in most cases, National Grid is unable to offer sponsorship for employment under the UK points-based immigration system. As such, applicants must have the legal right to work in the UK without requiring sponsorship now or in the future under the UK points-based immigration system. However, in exceptional circumstances where there is a clear and demonstrable need for specialist skills that cannot be sourced from the local labour market, National Grid may consider offering sponsorship. All applications are welcome from candidates who meet these requirements, regardless of race, nationality, or ethnic origin.

title: Controller
description:
Job Description: Controller

Reports to: Founder & CEO

Location: Enfield, CT (Hybrid)

Type: Full-Time, Exempt

Travel: Occasional (<10%)


About Louth Callan

Louth Callan (LCR EPC, LLC) is a full-service power infrastructure EPC contractor specializing in utility-scale solar, battery energy storage (BESS), substations, and high-voltage transmission. We self-perform the majority of our work with in-house engineering and construction capabilities, delivering tough projects East of the Mississippi that others won’t touch. We are scaling rapidly and building the financial foundation to support aggressive growth while maintaining discipline, accountability, and best-in-class project delivery.

Our core values guide how we operate: Build Strong. Build Right. Build Ahead. • People Power Performance • Work Hard, Live Well • Resilient Solutions. Innovative Results.


Role Overview

The Controller is a critical leadership hire responsible for owning the company’s financial infrastructure as we scale. This role goes beyond traditional accounting — you will build and run the systems, controls, and reporting that give leadership real-time visibility into job cost, cash, working capital, and profitability across a growing portfolio of EPC projects.

You will partner directly with the Founder & CEO and project leadership to ensure accurate percentage-of-completion accounting, tight job cost control, clean financial statements, strong internal controls, and proactive cash and working capital management. This is a hands-on, builder role for someone who thrives in a high-growth construction environment and wants ownership of the entire finance function.


Key Responsibilities


Financial Accounting & Reporting

• Own the full general ledger, month-end and year-end close process, and preparation of accurate, timely GAAP financial statements.

• Lead percentage-of-completion (POC) revenue recognition, WIP schedules, over/under billing analysis, and job cost-to-complete forecasting across all active projects.

• Produce clear management reporting packages (P&L by project and company, cash flow, backlog, working capital, KPI dashboards) for the CEO and leadership team.

• Coordinate external audits, tax filings, and any surety/bank reporting requirements.

Job Costing, Project Controls & Construction Accounting

• Partner with Project Controls, Estimating, and Project Managers to maintain accurate job cost codes, committed costs, and forecast-at-completion (FAC) processes.

• Ensure seamless integration between field/project systems (e.g., Trimble HeavyJob/HeavyBid or equivalent) and the general ledger.

• Drive discipline around change order accounting, cost coding accuracy, and timely cost recognition.

• Support preconstruction and estimating with historical cost data, unit rates, and margin analysis.

Cash, Working Capital & Treasury

• Own cash forecasting, daily/weekly cash positioning, and working capital optimization (AR, AP, retainage, inventory/materials).

• Manage banking relationships, construction lines of credit, and compliance with existing debt facility covenants and reporting.

• Oversee accounts receivable (including progress billing, retainage release) and accounts payable processes to protect cash and vendor relationships.

• Support bonding/surety submissions and related financial package preparation.


Internal Controls, Compliance & Systems

• Design, implement, and continuously improve internal controls appropriate for a growing construction company (segregation of duties, approval matrices, job cost controls).

• Select, implement, and optimize accounting and ERP systems as the company scales; own data integrity and process documentation.

• Ensure compliance with tax, multi-state, prevailing wage/PWA (where applicable), and other regulatory requirements.

• Build scalable processes and eventually lead/mentor accounting staff as the team grows.


Strategic Partnership

• Serve as a trusted advisor to the CEO on financial strategy, capital structure, pricing discipline, and risk.

• Support M&A diligence, financing transactions, and long-term planning as the company pursues its growth and valuation goals.

• Foster a culture of financial accountability and transparency across project and operations teams.


*The Key Job Responsibilities described are not a comprehensive list. Additional duties may be assigned as business needs evolve, and the scope of the position may change accordingly
