title: Staff Software Engineer
description:
Why Sony Interactive Entertainment?

Sony Interactive Entertainment isn’t just the Best Place to Play — it’s also the Best Place to Work. Sony Interactive Entertainment (SIE) is the company behind the PlayStation brand. As a subsidiary of Sony Group Corporation, we’re part of a proud legacy of innovation and excellence. SIE is a dynamic technology company, delivering cutting-edge hardware and network services to more than 100 million people and an entertainment leader, home to some of the most beloved and recognizable intellectual properties (IP) in the world. Our role at SIE is to create and nurture the experiences under the PlayStation brand, a name synonymous with entertainment excellence and creativity.

Staff Software Engineer, Adaptive Experiences Platform

Waterloo, ON

About the Role

The DTIS Nurture organization is building the next generation of adaptive experiences for PlayStation. Our vision is to make every customer touchpoint more relevant, useful, and joyful by combining reusable experience capabilities with personalization, merchandising, experimentation, and intelligent decisioning.

We are looking for a Staff Software Engineer to help lead the evolution of our Dynamic Experience Management, allowing teams to create and optimize experiences without requiring bespoke implementation for every client or a client release for every layout change.

You will be a hands‑on technical leader working across the experience stack. You will also shape the architecture needed to extend capabilities beyond PS5, across web, mobile, and other PlayStation devices. This is an opportunity to define foundational technology that will change how PlayStation builds, delivers, experiments with, and learns from customer experiences at scale.

Responsibilities

  • Define and drive the technical direction for our experiances SDK, translating the adaptive-experiences vision into an incremental, production-ready architecture.
  • Lead the modernization of the PS5 Store experience runtime, including migration from legacy EMS SDK and client‑specific rendering paths to schema-driven DXM experiences rendered through Content SDK.
  • Design and evolve the platform‑independent composition layer, public TypeScript APIs, versioned schemas, content adapters, component model, data bindings, and platform renderer contracts.
  • Build reusable experience primitives and native rendering capabilities that support responsive layouts, personalization, experimentation, telemetry, accessibility, localization, and platform‑specific interaction models.
  • Establish safe coexistence and migration patterns, including backward compatibility, capability negotiation, validation, feature flags, fallbacks, rollback, and observability.
  • Profile and optimize bundle size, startup and time‑to‑interactive performance, memory usage, rendering behavior, and runtime reliability on resource‑constrained client platforms.
  • Improve developer experience through clear interfaces, reference integrations, test harnesses, preview and debugging tools, automated compatibility testing, and high‑quality documentation.
  • Help establish governed, agent‑assisted authoring and validation workflows that can translate design and business intent into trusted artifacts, supported by policy checks and evaluation suites.
  • Partner with client, design system, merchandising, content, personalization, experimentation, and platform service teams to align contracts and deliver end‑to‑end capabilities.
  • Provide technical leadership across team boundaries, mentor engineers, make sound trade‑offs in ambiguous problem spaces, and communicate architecture and decisions to technical and non‑technical stakeholders.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 8+ years of professional software engineering experience, including significant experience designing and delivering production client platforms, SDKs, frameworks, or shared libraries.
  • Expert‑level proficiency with TypeScript or JavaScript and strong experience with React, React Native, or a comparable component‑based client framework.
  • Strong software architecture and API design skills, including modularity, dependency management, versioning, backward compatibility, and incremental migration of large production systems.
  • Experience building data‑driven or server‑driven user interfaces, reusable component systems, or runtime composition frameworks.
  • Demonstrated ability to diagnose and improve client performance and reliability using profiling, telemetry, automated testing, and production observability.
  • Experience designing for more than one client environment, such as console, mobile, web, TV, or embedded platforms, with a practical understanding of platform‑specific constraints.
  • Proven track record of solving ambiguous, cross‑functional problems with minimal direction and driving alignment without relying on formal authority.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to document architecture and explain complex technical decisions clearly.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with console development, living‑room interfaces, focus‑based navigation, or performance‑constrained native clients.
  • Experience with schema‑backed declarative UI, domain‑specific languages, JSON Schema, component expansion, data binding, hydration, or client‑side rendering engines.
  • Experience building or integrating client SDKs, content management or merchandising systems, personalization platforms, experimentation frameworks, or design systems.
  • Experience migrating a large client application away from a legacy rendering or content‑delivery framework using staged rollout, compatibility layers, and measurable exit criteria.
  • Experience developing platform adapters or renderers for iOS, Android, web, or other native client environments.
  • Familiarity with content and layout separation, runtime content sources, telemetry provenance, accessibility, localization, and safe fallback behavior.
  • Experience with developer tooling, visual preview systems, contract testing, schema validation, or automated cross‑platform regression testing.
  • Experience applying generative AI or agentic workflows to software or content creation, including evaluation, governance, and deterministic output constraints.
  • A track record of technical leadership and mentoring across multiple teams.

Additional Skills

  • Motivated self‑starter who combines long‑term architectural thinking with pragmatic, incremental delivery.
  • Customer‑focused and attentive to developer experience, operational usability, and measurable product outcomes.
  • Comfortable working in a fast‑paced, collaborative environment with partners across product, design, engineering, and operations.

Job Description:

Lead the creation of comprehensive end-to-end detailed solutions for projects and platforms with overall accountability for the technical design and delivery of a specific technical solution based on requirements from stakeholders. Develop and maintain technical solutions, ensuring adherence to engineering and architectural design principles while meeting business requirements. Provide technical expertise with a focus on efficiency, reliability, scalability, and security; includes planning, evaluating, recommending, designing, operationalizing, and supporting solutions in compliance with enterprise and industry standards. Ultimately, providing expert advice and lead in system / application administration, installation, configuration / provisioning, platform planning and design, integration and release / deployment management.

CUSTOMER

Execute on Engineering strategy as it relates to the introduction of tools and the automation of build, test, release and configure activities across Application, Platform and Infrastructure Lead the creation of solution options and ultimately a comprehensive end-to-end solution and coordinate relevant stakeholders, as required to support development initiatives; following a "build it, break it, fix it" mentality. Responsible for developing and documenting detailed solution design and act as an application SME through the design and development lifecycle ensuring alignment with Architecture Accountable for complex applications/systems development, programming /coding Develop functional, technical and user interface designs for an application / system that meets the defined requirements (business, enterprise architecture direction, system performance and development standards) Consult on development of requirements and specifications and apply functional knowledge of business functions to design optimal software / systems Review technical deliverables throughout detailed design and development phase to ensure quality adherence and identify gaps or redesign requirements as needed Identify, recommend, source, negotiate and implement improvements/solutions (buy/build/reuse) to enhance customer experience, availability, and/or reduce cost in support of client needs Work with Technology partners to define metrics and performance goals for the application Identify and address application and data issues and cross-capability and cross-release issues that affect application integrity Research/analyze business requirements to evaluate and recommend optimal solutions within business technology architecture; collect environment requirements for infrastructure implementation by analyzing the current system environment, using technical tools and utilities Work with Architects to ensure that environment modifications interact appropriately, data conversion impacts are considered, and other areas of impact are addressed and meet performance requirements of the project Contribute to the advancement of the TD engineering practice through strong collaboration, research, analytic, and problem-solving skills.

SHAREHOLDER

Adhere to enterprise frameworks or methodologies that relate to software engineering activities Ensure respective programs/ policies/practices are well managed, meets business needs, complies with internal and external requirements, and aligns with business priorities Collaboratively engage with relevant stakeholders at all levels, both internal and external, to shift from finding defects to proactively preventing defects Actively seek and support continuous improvement and automation opportunities within the engineering practice Conduct meaningful analysis at the functional or enterprise level using results to draw conclusions, make recommendations, assess the effectiveness of programs/ policies/ practices Identify opportunities to minimize cost, provide recommendations and/or deliver corresponding strategic solutions to support cost effectiveness and to enhance stakeholder experience Conduct code reviews to ensure adherence to quality, standards compliance, reusability and ease of maintenance, Operational Readiness Reviews, and supporting gating and review sign-offs for solution design Monitor service, productivity and assess efficiency levels within own function and implement continuous process / performance improvements where opportunities exists Lead / facilitate and/or implement actions / remediation plans to address performance / risk /governance issues Actively manage relationships within and across various business lines, corporate and/or control functions and ensure alignment with enterprise and/or regulatory requirements Protect the interests of the organization – identify and manage risks, and elevate non-standard, high risk activities as necessary Keep abreast of emerging issues, trends, and evolving regulatory requirements and assess potential impacts Maintain a culture of risk management and control, supported by effective processes in alignment with risk appetite.

EMPLOYEE / TEAM

Participate fully as a member of the team, support a positive work environment that promotes service to the business, quality, innovation and teamwork and ensure timely communication of issues/ points of interest Provide thought leadership and/ or industry knowledge for quality engineering best practices and participate in knowledge transfer within the team and business unit Keep current on emerging trends/ developments and grow knowledge of the business, related tools and techniques Participate in personal performance management and development activities, including cross training within own team Keep others informed and up-to-date about the status / progress of projects and / or all relevant or useful information related to day-to-day activities Actively mentors and enables team members by sharing knowledge and leveraging engineering best practices. Supports the team by providing guidance and proactively identifying and resolving issues Lead, motivate and develop relationships with internal and external business partners / stakeholders to develop productive working relationships. Contribute to a fair, positive and equitable environment that supports a diverse workforce Act as a brand ambassador for your business area/function and the bank, both internally and/or externally.

BREADTH & DEPTH

Expert knowledge of the business, the broader organization, technical environment, processes, procedures, tools and other relevant technology areas (e.g. Architecture, Infrastructure, Security etc.) from a design / support / solutions perspective Primary subject matter expert in multiple areas and consults with clients/or project teams with respect to all aspects of research, analysis, design, hardware / software support Expert knowledge of specific domain or range of engineering frameworks, technology, tools, processes and procedures, as well as organization issues Works independently and/or autonomously as a senior/ lead on a diverse range of tasks / operational support of solutions Generally reports to a Practice Lead.

EXPERIENCE AND / OR EDUCATION

Undergraduate degree, Post Graduate degree or Technical Certificate Strong academic background (e.g., computer science, engineering) Graduate degree nice to have 5-7 years relevant experience Preferred Qualifications: 7+ years of experience with Java 2+ years of experience Angular 16+ (good with similar UI technology like react.js) 3+ years of experience with Spring framework (Spring Core with Annotation, Spring Boot Spring Rest docs), with a good understanding of Spring Security & Authorization. 3+ years of AngularJS 1.x and Angular 6 & above 2+ years of experience with deployment automation tools : Jenkins or similar products 2+ years of experience with logging frameworks SLF4J, Logback or similar products 2+ years of experience in writing unit test cases with Junit 4. title: Senior AI Enabled Product Engineer — Frontend Focus (f/m/d)
description:
You will own the part of nebenan.de that neighbors actually see and touch. This is a frontend-focused role on a full-stack product team: your depth is in the browser and on mobile web, and you follow a feature all the way through the API and into production. You will work with React and TypeScript on the frontend. Ruby on Rails on the backend, PostgreSQL, and AWS.


Concretely, you will:

Own your product area

  • Own a product area end to end. From prototype through production to iteration, mobile-first. You decide from usage data what to improve next and keep the area healthy on an ongoing basis.

  • Run what you build. Set and meet performance and reliability targets for your area, instrument before shipping, and handle incidents in your own work.

  • Challenge the plan. You work with a product lead who owns the outcome and a product analyst who designs and validates experiments. If a piece of work won't move the metric it's meant to move, say so early.


Build the interface

  • Build React features are accessible, fast, and consistent with our design system.

  • Own and extend the design system. Components, tokens, and patterns that other engineers reuse. You push generic work into shared components early.

  • Work across the client–server boundary. Shape the APIs your screens depend on; make deliberate choices about data fetching, caching, loading, and error states; and understand what's happening on the network.


Work with AI and evidence

  • Direct AI and be accountable for what it writes. You set intent, review what comes back, and own everything that ships under your name.

  • Replace manual QA with evidence. Automated tests, visual regression, and instrumentation ground your confidence in data.


What this role is not

  • Not a ticket taker. You own working software in production, not merged pull requests.

  • Not pixel-pushing behind a designer. Design and validation of the experience sit with product and design; building it into production software and pushing back on it are yours.

  • Not frontend-only in practice. Depth in the frontend, contribution across the stack.

  • Strong React in production: component design, state management, rendering behaviour

  • A real grasp of client–server architecture: how the browser and the backend actually talk, what that costs, and how it fails

  • Craft in the fundamentals: modern CSS and layout, semantic HTML, accessibility, web performance, responsive and mobile-first work

  • Solid command of TypeScript

  • Experience building or maintaining a design system, or at least a clear opinion about what makes one work

  • Comfortable owning outcomes, working day to day with non-engineers

  • Uses AI deliberately as leverage: directs and reviews generated code to production quality

  • A maker: ships, validates, then refines on what the evidence shows

  • Cares that the thing works for the person using it, on their phone, on their network

  • A plus: enough backend familiarity (Ruby, or any server-side language) to change an endpoint yourself

  • A plus: data-informed product work, with decisions grounded in data

  • English skills for working in our international team; German is a plus

  • Hybrid work model combining office and remote days

  • A meaningful job – we're creating a great product with real added value for the community

  • Work in a cheerful and experienced team that exchanges ideas and learns from each other

  • Insights into the entire work process of our social startup and the nebenan.de foundation

  • Responsibility and great opportunities to actively contribute

  • Your nebenan.de SpenditCard – you'll receive an additional income of 35 Euros per month, which you can use for things of your choice

  • 30 days of vacation per year – we also offer the possibility of workation models and a sabbatical

  • A workplace in Berlin-Kreuzberg and regular events like yoga or Lunch & Learn sessions.

If we’ve captured your interest, apply now and let us know why you’re the perfect fit for the job!

title: Assistant Account Handler
description:
Who are we?

Howden is a global insurance group with employee ownership at its heart. Together, we have pushed the boundaries of insurance. We are united by a shared passion and no-limits mindset, and our strength lies in our ability to collaborate as a powerful international team comprised of 24,000 employees spanning over 56 countries.

People join Howden for many different reasons, but they stay for the same one: our culture. It’s what sets us apart, and the reason our employees have been turning down headhunters for years. Whatever your priorities – work / life balance, career progression, sustainability, volunteering – you’ll find like-minded people driving change at Howden.

Howden is a group of talented insurance experts who have the freedom to deliver for clients and the support to do what they do best. Our people are our biggest asset and our largest shareholder group, and everything that makes us unique – our culture, the quality service we offer our clients, and our continued growth – all come from this employee-owned model.

All our people, whether they hold shares or not, are driven to create a business to be proud of. That’s because we’re all united by a shared passion and no-limits mindset, which means we take our work personally. Our people have delivered groceries to elderly clients, invented whole new products to meet clients’ needs, and even been invited to clients’ weddings. We’re not about cookie-cutter, off-the-shelf, one-size-fits-all insurance. We do people-first insurance.

This no-limits approach means that we can rise to any challenge. Whatever the question, the concern, or the risk, we can get the right people in a room and find the right answer. Our collective power is also helping us to change the insurance narrative, doing right by our clients while using insurance as a tool to build resilience for individuals, businesses and communities. From pro bono work to insuring COVID-19 vaccine development to de-risking the carbon market, we’re using our skills, knowledge and networks to make a difference and speed positive change in the world around us.

We are actively looking for an Assistant Account Handler to join our growing team. The role will be office based, with hybrid working options available. This is a great opportunity to join a highly successful team and develop your experience and career within a specialist insurance environment.

About you:

  • You will enjoy having conversations with people, listening and building relationships as it’s important that we really get to know our clients and understand their requirements.

  • You have awesome problem-solving skills. All of our clients are unique, so we need to come up with tailored solutions as we don’t have a "one size fits all" approach.

  • You may currently be working in a sales, customer service or insurance role and are now looking to build a long-term career. We don’t require previous insurance experience as we offer on-site training, workshops, coaching and support towards industry qualifications.

  • You will have a passion and entrepreneurial mindset. Many of our most successful business opportunities have come from team members with a genuine interest in the products and clients they support. Whether that’s equine, campervans, motorhomes, classic cars, motorbikes, marine, fine art or other specialist insurance areas, you'll enjoy building knowledge, developing relationships and helping clients find the right solution.

  • You will be ambitious. We promote within, and many of our leaders started their careers in entry-level roles. We give you all the tools; all we ask from you is the desire to succeed.

Rewards:

25 days holiday (plus bank holidays), increasing through length of service

A set of core benefits, designed with your health and financial protection in mind:

  • Life Assurance up to 4x salary, protecting your loved ones in case the worst should happen
  • Income protection, guaranteeing an income for up to 5 years in the event of an illness or injury
  • Contributory pension scheme – 4% employer contribution and 5% employee contribution, rising to 5% & 5%
  • Access to a Healthcare Cashplan, which gives you access to a variety of health-related benefits

Access to a host of lifestyle and financial benefits that you can choose from:

  • Discounts on gym membership across the UK
  • Salary sacrifice schemes – Travel Insurance, Cycle to Work, Car Leasing, Technology Purchase
  • Access to a range of personal insurance products at discounted rates
  • Access to hundreds of high-street retailer discounts
  • Employee Assistance Programme (EAP) to support employees outside of work

What do we offer in return?

A career that you define. At Howden, we value diversity – there is no one Howden type. Instead, we’re looking for individuals who share the same values as us:

  • Our successes have all come from someone brave enough to try something new

  • We support each other in the small everyday moments and the bigger challenges

  • We are determined to make a positive difference at work and beyond

Reasonable adjustments

We're committed to providing reasonable accommodations at Howden to ensure that our positions align well with your needs. Besides the usual adjustments such as software, IT, and office setups, we can also accommodate other changes such as flexible hours* or hybrid working*.

If you're excited by this role but have some doubts about whether it’s the right fit for you, send us your application – if your profile fits the role’s criteria, we will be in touch to assist in helping to get you set up with any reasonable adjustments you may require.

*Not all positions can accommodate changes to working hours or locations. Reach out to your Recruitment Partner if you want to know more.

Permanent

title: Sampler - Part Time - Horsley Cross
description:
Affinity Water has an exciting opportunity to join our Stevenage Water Quality Sampling Team as a Sampler on a Part Time basis.

Everyone has an idea of what a water company does. At Affinity Water, we make sure that over 3.89 million customers can rely on our services, and have clean and safe drinking water on tap, But for us, it’s so much more than this.

What you'll be doing:

New environmental legislation, unprecedented levels of investment and changing expectations from customers means that this is an exciting time to discover opportunities within the water industry.

You’ll spend most of your time out and about visiting water treatment works, reservoirs, and other Affinity Water sites in and around Stevenage and collecting water samples across our operational areas.

You’ll perform routine, non-routine and random sampling across our supply area, working independently to complete your daily schedule.

There will be a level of interacting with our customers to gain access to residential properties to take water quality samples, and so you'll be comfortable with entering customer properties and engaging with the public.

There’s lots of autonomy in this role as you’ll plan your sampling schedule each day. You’ll be excellent at managing your time, meeting deadlines and be comfortable working alone.

When you’re not outdoors collecting samples, you’ll be based at our site in Stevenage, completing key administration tasks such as data input and recording samples into our internal systems. You’ll be comfortable using core IT programs such as MS Excel.

What you'll need:

  • Full UK Clean/Manual UK Driving Licence

  • 3 GCSEs with a grade 4 (C) or above(Desirable)

  • Ability to perform manual handling activities safely and competently such as operating valves and lifting lids.

  • Competent in use of Microsoft Office applications

  • Keen interest in the environment and water industry

  • Develops and maintains effective internal relationships, has a good teamwork focus and customer relations.

  • Strong desire for career progression and passion for continual learning

    Advert Closing Date: 18/09/26


Benefits:

  • Salary: £14,839

  • Hours of work: Saturday–Sunday: 4.5-hour days, 6:00am–10:30am. Monday–Tuesday: 5.5-hour days, 8:00am–1:30pm

  • Company Van

  • Learning and development opportunities, including mentoring and a range of formal courses and open learning resources.

  • Entry into the company annual bonus scheme.

  • Annual leave from 23-27 rising with length of service, and the option to purchase up to 5 extra days.

  • A ‘Celebration Day’ in addition to public holidays that people can use to celebrate a religious festival or other occasion that is important to them.

  • A generous 'double match pension scheme' that doubles the contributions you make (company contribution capped at 12%)

  • We offer a range of family benefits including enhanced Maternity, Adoption, Paternity, Shared Parental Leave, Fertility Support Leave and up to 5 full or 10 half days of paid Carers Leave.

  • Menopause policy and Reasonable Adjustment policy to help everyone perform at their best.

  • Access to our Wellbeing Centre with support for looking after your physical and mental health.

  • Discounts at a Range of Retail Outlets through our Tap4Perks scheme

  • Discounts on Dental and Medical Insurance through our Tap4Perks scheme through salary sacrifice

  • Up to 4 Affinity days a year to volunteer in the community.

  • Life Assurance.

Disability Confident

As a Disability Confident employer, we’re committed to offering interviews to disabled candidates who meet the essential criteria and opt in on the application form. Ask the Talent Acquisition lead for the full job description to see all the criteria. If we have a very high volume of applicants and we’re not able to offer interviews to all, we’ll take a fair and proportionate number of disabled candidates through.

Affinity Water recognises the benefits of greater diversity in our workforce to better reflect the communities we serve. We are committed to building a more inclusive culture where every member of our workforce can thrive.

title: Network Development Project Manager​ (6-months contract/freelance)
description:
The Company

We are Zeekr, built on a decade of European experience. We are a premium electric vehicle and technology solutions brand from Geely Holding Group, one of world’s largest automotive companies. Our goal and vision is to accelerate the shift to fully electrified mobility. We are committed to driving the future of transportation with cutting-edge technology and a customer-centric approach.

The role
As a Network Development Project Manager, you will provide temporary support to Zeekr's European network development team during a period of dealer network expansion.

Based at Zeekr's European headquarters in Amsterdam, you will work closely with local NSC’s (National Sales Companies) and cross-functional teams to coordinate dealer network rollout activities, track progress, manage dependencies, and ensure successful execution of network development projects.

This is a hands-on 6-month contract opportunity suited for an experienced Project Manager or PMO professional with an automotive background who can quickly take ownership and drive results in a fast-paced environment.


This is what you will do:

  • Coordinate dealer network expansion projects in Europe, with a strong focus on Germany and France.

  • Support NSC’s in executing network development and dealer onboarding activities.

  • Monitor project progress and proactively resolve issues and dependencies.

  • Prepare and provide regular management reporting on project progress, risks, milestones, and key deliverables.

  • Drive alignment between Network Development, Retail Operations, Sales, Aftersales, Training, Finance, IT, and Logistics teams.

  • Support continuous improvement of network development processes, tools, and governance.

To be successful in the role you will demonstrate:

  • 5+ years of experience in Project Management, PMO, Business Operations, or Network Development.

  • Experience in the automotive industry, working with OEMs, dealer networks, distributors, or importer organizations.

  • Dealer network setup or onboarding experience is a plus, but not required.

  • Proactive, hands-on, and self-starting mindset with a strong delivery focus.

  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

  • Fluent English is required.

To thrive at Zeekr we believe that you have the courage to lead with trust and care and you don’t mind getting your hands dirty. You are highly innovative and have a great ability to adapt and perform in a constantly changing, fast-paced, highly demanding work environment. Like us, you believe it’s important to have a passion to work in an international and multicultural environment with the desire and ability to embrace the diversity of people, perspectives, and styles.

Apply today, we will perform ongoing selection during the application period. We look forward to hearing from you.

title: Customer Advisor - 6 Hours
description:
Your role in the JoJo story…

Do you dream of a role where you can make meaningful contributions that finish in days well spent? If you're ready to begin a fabulous adventure and you're passionate about retail, we have the perfect role for you!

Each JoJo store is unique whether that’s trading over two floors, having a quirky layout or being situated in an interesting place. They have a life of their own. Our Unique Selling Point (USP) in this ever-changing retail world is the relationship we build with our customers, many of them loyal to our brand and to their local store team. This is where you come in - you’ll be the face of JoJo providing a fantastic level of customer care and service that we are renowned for and one we pride ourselves in upholding always. You’ll be guiding, informing, and assisting our customers in the correct purchase of our huge range of clothing and products. This could be an expectant parent, an excited grandparent or other friends or family.

Our B Corp principles are so important, and every member of our teams will always uphold them. As we move into a digital retail world, offering an Omni-Channel customer service is expected as this builds on customer loyalty. As such most of our stores offer Ship from Store or Click and Collect options, you will take ownership of preparing and shipping all such orders daily.

A peek into your daily adventures:

  • Assisting our customers in many different and sometimes diverse situations, from bra measuring or discussing our maternity wear, to demonstrating a baby carrier to an intrigued parent.

  • Preparing Omni-Channel orders.

  • Liaising with customers in store or via the phone on Omni-Channel orders.

  • Using our digital or virtual learning platforms to continuously develop your knowledge and retail skills.

  • Embracing new product knowledge or learning to increase sales opportunities.

  • Actively listening to our customers’ needs and working out what the best solution is for them.

  • Taking pride in keeping your store looking immaculate.

A typical week would be 1 x 6 hour shifts however, flexibility is required in line with store requirements.

Skills that make you shine:

  • Previous retail, customer service and sales experience

  • Competent IT skills and excellent systems ability, with an aptitude to pick up new systems quickly.

  • The ability to learn and retain a high level of product information and be able to communicate this effectively to our customers.

  • You’ll need a self-developing mentality and a curiosity to learn new products independently.

  • We don’t like hard sales techniques, but you’ll need to demonstrate a level of sales ability, which includes active listening skills, empathy, and an understanding of our customers’ needs.

  • You’ll be working within a small team; therefore, the ability to work harmoniously and respectfully is important.

  • Working in a retail environment requires a level of flexibility, most of our stores are open 7 days a week.

  • We like to keep our stores looking tip-top, so you’ll have a keen eye for detail and play a key role in maintaining our standard.

Please note: We will only recruit individuals who are over the school leaver's age. To find out more about the school leaver age for England, Wales, Scotland and Northern Ireland- Please click the following link:

Just to give you a taste of our culture, we’ll be looking for you to:

  • Be a brand ambassador, safeguarding our values and ethos.

  • Demonstrate honesty and respect in every interaction.

  • Foster collaboration and open, active listening

  • Take ownership of all aspects of the role.

Perks and Benefits:

  • Extra day of annual leave for each year you’re with us, up to 38 days.

  • Is it your birthday? Take it off and celebrate!

  • Let’s celebrate JoJo doing well – non-contractual bonus scheme.

  • Helping plan for the future - enhanced pension scheme.

  • Get on the move - cycle to work scheme.

  • Financial wellbeing app - pay yourself 40% of your earned wages whenever you want.

  • Saving scheme with Smart Money Cymru – You do not need to live in Wales!

  • Flexible work options.

  • Enjoy fabulous social events.

  • Give back with volunteer days to support our communities.

  • Prioritise your well-being with our Health and Wellbeing hub.

  • Specsavers voucher – Get a free sight test and contribution towards glasses (T & C’s) apply.

  • We love our products! Enjoy:

    • 40% off JoJo branded lines

    • 25% off full-price NEXT products

    • 10% off NEXT Beauty products

    • Up to 10% off most branded products

  • Embrace an “It’s up to you” learning environment with ongoing training and development opportunities.

Want to know more about JoJo?

We make happy and helpful clothes and products that let children be children – in all their silly, messy, adventurous, noisy, imaginative joy. But we’re not just about selling products; we’re about creating a warm, community-centric environment for our employees and our customers. From 39 locations across the UK and Ireland and a thriving e-commerce platform, we offer a meticulously designed collection of children’s clothing, toys, and essentials designed with love and care: always with children at the forefront of our minds.

As a B Corp, our commitment goes beyond commerce, we strive for a sustainable future and take pride in our responsibilities to the planet and our communities. At JoJo, every role, every task and every day is an opportunity to support, inspire and contribute to the well-being of our teams and our customers.

We embrace and openly welcome people from different cultures, perspectives, and experiences to create a diverse and enriched environment. We work hard to recruit, develop, and retain the most talented people, regardless of background to make sure we grow our company sustainably and with different cultural influences. By encouraging a diverse and inclusive workforce, we aim to create an environment where everyone can thrive and reach their full potential.

About Kirby Group Engineering

Kirby Group Engineering is an international multi-disciplinary engineering services contractor and leading provider of high-value engineering services to a number of ‘blue chip’ companies. Operating across Ireland, the UK and Europe, Kirby has become the engineering service provider of choice in growth segments such as pharmaceuticals, data centres and power transmission and distribution. Our culture is innovative, collaborative and performance focused. The successful candidate will have the opportunity to grow and develop in a company committed to developing talent and rewarding performance.

Role Purpose
The role of the EHS Advisor is to provide Environment, Health and Safety guidance working with the project team. You will implement and maintain the Kirby management system for the project. The role is to coordinate all EHS Matters within various Project Management Teams and to report constructively all EHS matters to Project Manager. Under the direction of the EHS Manager, the EHS Advisor will be responsible for providing support to the Project Managers, supervisors and workers. This position will provide leadership and coordination of the day-to-day EHS requirements of the assigned project(s). The role may require to be positioned on a project full time or working on various projects. This role requires frequent travel between projects and may require overnight stays.

Key Functions of the EHS Advisor
  • Provide advice, guidance, support and instruction in all EHS matters to management, safety representatives and employees (including where applicable to sub-contractors, suppliers and visitors to sites).
  • Provide leadership through good example. Be proactive in all matters concerning the role.
  • Identify training needs, report requirements to project team and carry out training as required.
  • Audit and inspect projects, agree and prepare achievable corrective and preventive action plans towards compliance to and continual improvement of the EHS on the project.
  • Report on business EHS risks, KPIs and trends accurately with data and recommend constructive actions towards continuous improvements.
  • Ensure incidents are reported and investigations are carried out in a thorough and professional manner in order to identify root causes and corrective and preventive action plans.
  • Ensure that Site EHS Plans, RAMS and other associated site documents are updated and compliant with statutory and other requirements and that they are reviewed on a continuous basis.

EHS Advisor Responsibilities
  • Reports to EHS Manager, Site Managers/Supervisors and Project Manager.
  • Is conversant with the contents of the Kirby safety statement, environment manual, risk assessments, aspects & impacts, legislation and procedures.
  • Provides advice, guidance, instruction and training in all EHS matters to management, safety representatives and employees (including where applicable to sub-contractors, suppliers and visitors to sites).
  • Carries out internal audits and site inspections in conjunction with Site Management, recommends corrective actions, improvements and document findings.
  • Prepares in conjunction with site management team a project specific EHS Plan, induction and Risk Assessment Method Statements (RAMS). These shall be compiled and agreed prior to work commencing and ongoing through lookaheads.
  • Ensures that the project specific EHS Plan, induction and RAMS are up to date, reviewed periodically and communicated to all relevant persons (including clients, Main Contractor, other contractors, visitors and others who may be affected by that work).
  • Visits each new project, sets up the necessary site safety files (Series 500 & 600), registers, abstracts of regulations, posters, SEOR program, etc., and ensures that site establishment complies with the legislation, client regulations and company regulations as a minimum.
  • Reviews Contractor Appointments and ensures that correct appointment is carried out and that only competent contractors are used on projects.
  • Introduces and implements effective measures aimed at the prevention of incidents at work.
  • Reports on incidents and/or dangerous occurrences should they occur to the EHS Manager, Project Manager and Site Managers as required.
  • Reports on areas of concern to the relevant party for correction. Persistent and serious areas of concern are to be reported immediately to line management as per (1) above. Retains evidence of communications with relevant parties.
  • Carries out incident investigation in conjunction with site management, establishes cause of incident or dangerous occurrence and recommends method for future avoidance.
  • Audits the company site safety file, (Series 500 & 600), makes sure that hazards/risks are regularly assessed, that control measures are implemented, that inspections are carried out and that all incidents are reported, investigated and closed out.
  • Prepares Monthly KPI Report for their projects, issues monthly return of Site Visit Schedule, SEORs, KPIs, violations to the EHS Manager and the Business Unit Manager. Issues new SDS to EHS Manager.
  • Provides training and information to the workforce using appropriate training aids and media as required. Issues records of training to HR to update the training matrix.
  • Attends the regional EHS Coordination Meeting.
  • Attends the EHS meeting with the Business Unit Manager, as required (1 per region).
  • Attends internal and external site meetings as required – safety meetings, coordination meetings etc...
  • Implements and promotes the company Incentive Scheme on all projects.
  • Arranges distribution and maintenance of fully stocked first aid boxes on site.
  • Monitors P.P.E usage and advises site management on type of protective equipment required.
  • Issues non-conformances, commendations and disciplinary warnings both written and verbal if required or instructed to do so.

Necessary requirement of the EHS Advisor

  • 5+ Years’ Experience in similar industry. Knowledge of Electrical, Mechanical and CSA preferably.
  • Diploma to NFQ 8 in Occupational H&S. Certificate to NFQ 6 Environmental Management. Safe Pass, (CSCS (UK)), Train the Trainer, First Aid, Training Instructor.
  • Internal ISO14000 and ISO45000 system auditor.
  • Experience with the Construction Regulations and CDM roles, with experience working with sub-contractors.
  • Experience with EHS Management Systems, safety schemes and tendering e.g. ISOs, Achilles, SSiPs etc.
  • Excellent communication skills, through presentations, reports, written and verbal.
  • Ability to work with Kirby / client / main contractor Safety and Project teams.
  • Ability to work well within strict deadlines.
  • Ability to be able to prepare Audits and EHS reports, to a high standard.
  • Up to date with Legislation, Standards, Guidance, Advice and Compliance.
  • Proactive in identifying positive and negative acts, ability to follow through with realistic corrective and preventive actions.
  • Ability to lead and coordinate incident investigations and utilise root cause analysis.
  • IOSH Member or Equivalent.

title: Engineering Senior Consultant
description:
Oxford

Engineering Senior Consultant

CHALLENGED BY MAKING A DIFFERENCE TO SUPPLY CHAINS?

We are the Miebach Consulting Group.

One of the world’s largest consulting and engineering firms in the design and implementation of state-of-the-art supply chain solutions.

Major international and national enterprises around the world confide in our capability of creating top and bottom-line impact by driving large-scale Supply Chain Transformations in response to challenges such as growth, sustainability, omnichannel or new business models. We transform supply chain challenges into actionable plans to succeed. Our team analyses operational challenges from manufacturing through to distribution, finding strategic opportunities to automate; supporting from design through to implementation.

If you are looking for a career with unparalleled global impact, then we invite you to get in touch.

We are currently looking for an Engineering Senior Consultant to enhance our team. You will start your career at Miebach by collaborating with Clients and Project Teams to enhance supply chain efficiency. You will play a part in assessing current processes and shaping the optimal design for the future.

This role presents an excellent career opportunity to develop supply chain modelling and design skills in multiple industries in an international environment. This position requires domestic travel depending on project requirements.

Mission:

To leverage your extensive expertise in warehouse management guiding clients in optimising their warehouse operations, taking responsibility for understanding client challenges, conducting in-depth assessments, and developing customised solutions. You will provide thought leadership and employ data-driven insights to enhance efficiency and reduce costs in the warehouse. Your mission is to ensure that clients achieve their warehouse objectives while aligning with industry best practices and emerging trends.

Duties / Responsibilities:

· Analysis: Conduct in-depth data analysis and warehouse assessments, utilising data to identify inefficiencies, bottlenecks, and opportunities for improvement.

· Solution Design: Collaborate with clients to design customised warehouse solutions, which may include process optimisation, technology integration, and workflow redesign.

· Client Presentation: Present solutions and recommendations to clients in a clear, compelling manner, tailored to their specific needs and challenges. Communicate complex ideas in a straightforward and compelling way.

· Change Management: Assist clients in managing organisational change, helping teams adapt to new processes and technologies.

· Documentation: Create detailed project documentation, reports, and action plans for clients and internal teams.

· Quality Check: Validate analysis and documentation created by consultants, analysts and draftspersons.

· Offer Preparation: Create attractive collaboration proposals for clients and calculate the corresponding team effort.

· Training: Provide guidance and instruction to enhance the skills and knowledge of individuals in a specific field, ensuring they acquire the necessary competencies to analyse data, make informed decisions, and contribute effectively to goals.

· Management of internal projects: overseeing the planning, execution, and completion of initiatives within an organisation, such as the development of tools or the implementation of in-house training programs, to achieve specific internal objectives and enhance overall efficiency.

· Management of customer meetings: coordinating, guiding, and ensuring smooth interactions with clients to enhance communication, address their needs, and build strong business relationships for a positive and mutually beneficial engagement.

· Business Development: contribute to brand awareness and sales activities to help grow the market footprint of Miebach

Qualifications and Skills / Experience:

· Bachelors or Master’s Degree in Engineering, Supply Chain Management, or Logistics and a minimum of 5+ years of relevant engineering supply chain industry experience is required.

· 3-7 years of relevant Supply Chain Engineering Consulting or Logistic integrator experience. Knowledge and expertise in the areas of warehouse automation, distribution centre design, production logistics, tendering, implementation and go-live.

· Excellent written/oral communication skills in the English language, strong problem solving and project management skills.

· Evidence of stakeholder management at all levels

· Team player with ability to work in cross functional and multinational teams.

· Advanced skill with MS Office suite, especially PowerBI, Excel, Access, and PowerPoint.

· Interpersonal, communication, leadership and problem-solving skills.

· Desirable: consulting experience, experience working cross-functionally among the entire supply chain, AutoCAD experience or additional languages (besides English).

What’s in it for you:

· You will participate in large-scale Supply Chain decisions for significant improvements in Service, Inventory, Cost, Investments and Carbon Emissions for our customers.

· You will be in direct contact with relevant key supply chain stakeholders and decision makers and help them deciding on their sourcing, industrial, distribution, transportation, inventory, and route to market strategic decisions.

· You will learn from our unrivalled experience, working alongside talented colleagues and using state of the art modelling technologies.

· You will have a challenging and rewarding career where the variety of opportunities and projects allows you to develop your potential and grow professionally every day.

· You will be part of an international team working with colleagues from various offices around the world.

· We offer a competitive salary, learning opportunities and much more!

We are unable to provide sponsorship for this role.

title: Ungarbejder under 18 år - dagtimer
description:
Holder du sabbatår og er nysgerrig på at arbejde i butik? Så er du måske lige den, vi mangler!

Vi søger en ungarbejder, der har lyst til at arbejde i vores butik i dagtimerne, typisk mellem 08:00-16:00 mandag til fredag. Det er derfor vigtigt, at du har mulighed for at arbejde i dette tidsrum.

Du skal primært betjene vores kunder ved kassen og hjælpe med at fylde butikkens varer op. Du bliver en del af et team, hvor vi hjælper hinanden – for sammen skaber vi den bedste oplevelse for vores kunder.

Hvem er du?

Da vi har travlt i butikken, skal du være frisk på at give den gas sammen med resten af teamet. Du trives i et job med fart på, og det falder dig naturligt at give en hjælpende hånd til dine kolleger og arbejde med dine opgaver, indtil du er helt i mål. Vi forventer, at du kommer til tiden og overholder dine aftaler, så vi sammen kan skabe et godt team og lykkes i butikken.

Har du derudover et godt humør og bidrager til den gode stemning – så er vi nok et godt match!

OBS: Du skal have afsluttet folkeskolens 9. klasse, og du skal kunne fremvise en straffeattest.

Er du interesseret?

Send os din ansøgning ved at trykke "søg her". Grundet persondataloven behandler vi ikke ansøgninger på mail.

Vi anbefaler, at du bekræfter SMS-kommunikation, så vi nemt kan komme i kontakt med dig i rekrutteringsprocessen.

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen er du velkommen til at kontakte os.

Vi glæder os til at modtage din ansøgning.

  • You’ll have a keen interest in IT and must be able to work as part of a busy support team

  • Working closely with other departments you will need to build relationships with both internal and external customers

Entry requirements:

  • 3 GCSEs (or equivalent) at grades 4+ (A-C) in any subject

  • GCSE Maths and English (or equivalents) at grades 3+ (D or above)

  • Prospective apprentices must not hold an existing qualification at the same or higher level as this apprenticeship is in a similar subject

You may also have a combination of qualifications and experience which demonstrate the minimum foundation needed for the programme. In this instance you could still be considered for the programme.

If you hold international equivalents of the above qualifications, at the time of your application you must be able to provide an official document that states how your international qualifications compare to the UK qualifications.

For more information please visit the UK ENIC website.

Benefits:

Learning is not just a service we provide, it’s a way of life at QA, and we try to ensure that everyone has the opportunity to take advantage of our huge and varied range of learning and development options, so everyone is eligible for 3 Training Days every year, to focus on subjects they’re interested in.

We also know that many people like to “give back” and so we offer 2 paid Charity Days each year to support your chosen charity in whatever way you choose. And if you get involved in charity fundraising, QA will also double any sponsorship money raised, up to £250. This is over and above the charitable activities that we encourage through our annual QA fundraising drives – you can get involved with this as much or as little as you like. We see it as a great way to foster team building too.

We all need to take time out to recharge our batteries from time to time and enjoy some down time, so we provide a fairly generous 25 days’ holiday per annum (rising to 28 days after 5 years) – with the option to buy more if you wish.

It’s important, too, to plan for the future and ensure we are able to maintain the lifestyle we have worked so hard to achieve, once we retire from the hurly burly and slow down to enjoy our later years, so we offer a defined contribution pension plan and will match your contributions up to a maximum of 4% of your basic salary.

Then there are two of our core benefit offerings, not the most exciting, but we consider it important to ensure everyone has the peace of mind provided by Life Assurance (4x your basic salary) and Permanent Health Insurance (after a qualifying period) in the event that ill health, or worse, disrupts our plans.

And finally, a few fringe benefits to assist with travel and lifestyle choices:

  • Season ticket loan

  • Corporate gym membership

  • Cycle to work scheme

Future prospects:

90% of QA apprentices secure permanent employment after completing: this is 20% higher than the national average.

About QA:

Our apprenticeships are the perfect way to gain new skills, earn while you learn, and launch yourself into an exciting future. With over 50,000 successful apprenticeship graduates, we're a top 50 training provider, dedicated to helping you succeed.

Interested? Apply now!

title: Customer Journey & Lifecycle Specialist
description:
If you are motivated by shaping the future customer experience through strategic lifecycle marketing, designing impactful customer journeys, and turning data and insights into personalized omnichannel programs for a global MedTech company, then this could be your next professional challenge. Success in this role requires strong stakeholder collaboration skills, proactivity and the ability to turn ambitious commercial objectives into actionable lifecycle initiatives.

The role

3Shape offers you the opportunity to become Customer Journey & Lifecycle Specialist in our Omnichannel & Lifecycle team within Global Marketing.

In this role, you will take the lead in defining and evolving the customer journey and lifecycle marketing strategy for our Lab segment. You will be responsible for identifying opportunities across the customer lifecycle, designing future-state journeys, and translating strategic ambitions into impactful omnichannel programs that drive engagement, adoption, retention, and commercial growth.

The role combines strategic ownership with hands-on execution. You will work closely with stakeholders across Marketing, Commercial, Data Analytics, and local markets to ensure that customer journeys are built on a solid understanding of customer needs, business objectives, and data-driven insights. Together with the team, you will turn lifecycle strategies into scalable, automated, and personalized customer experiences across channels.

You will become part of a team of highly skilled and experienced colleagues driving omnichannel activation and lifecycle marketing globally. We foster a collaborative, ambitious, and open environment where testing, learning, and continuous improvement are the drivers for commercial success and delivering business value.

We are looking for a candidate who can take ownership of the strategic development, implementation, and optimization of customer journeys and lifecycle programs for our Lab customers.

The primary responsibilities in the role are:

  • Define, develop, and continuously evolve customer journey and lifecycle marketing strategies across the customer lifecycle

  • Map, visualize, and optimize customer journeys, ensuring a seamless and coherent experience across digital and human touchpoints

  • Translate customer insights, business priorities, and commercial objectives into scalable lifecycle programs and customer experiences

  • Develop, implement, and optimize end-to-end personalized omnichannel programs across onboarding, adoption, retention, and lead nurturing activities

  • Build and maintain advanced audiences, triggers, personalization logic, and customer programs in our omnichannel platforms

  • Develop and continuously optimize lead scoring models and nurture programs that convert marketing leads into qualified sales opportunities

  • Specify, validate, and test customer and lead data required to support effective segmentation, personalization, and automation

  • Drive A/B testing and experimentation, leveraging learnings to continuously improve customer engagement, conversion, and retention

  • Analyze customer behaviour, lifecycle performance, and digital engagement patterns to identify new opportunities and optimize customer experiences

  • Define requirements for omnichannel capabilities, reporting, and automation to support a scalable and future-proof marketing ecosystem

  • Establish strong stakeholder collaboration across Global Marketing, Commercial teams, Data Analytics, Group IT, and local markets to ensure alignment and successful execution

  • Contribute to the continued development of omnichannel journeys and personalization capabilities across additional customer segments.

ideal profile

For this role, we are looking for someone who is equally comfortable thinking strategically and executing operationally. You excel in understanding customer needs, identifying opportunities throughout the customer lifecycle, and translating these insights into meaningful customer experiences that support business growth. You are capable of taking a step back to define the overall journey strategy while also being hands-on in building, testing, and optimizing the programs that bring the strategy to life.

You possess strong analytical skills and are experienced in transforming complex data and business insights into actionable lifecycle initiatives. You understand how customer data, segmentation, automation, and personalization work together in a modern omnichannel setup and have a genuine curiosity for how new technologies can further improve customer experiences. It is a requirement that you have hands-on experience working in marketing automation and omnichannel tools.

As a person, you are proactive, structured, and commercially minded. You thrive in a dynamic environment with multiple stakeholders and are comfortable navigating changing priorities. You build relationships easily and enjoy collaborating across functions and cultures to create solutions that deliver measurable value. Your diligent and structured ways of working ensure that everything you do – from designing journeys, creating audiences, development and documentation of lifecycle programs, specification of data and integration requirements - are thoroughly tested and verified before handing over or launched.

We expect that you have:

  • A bachelor's or master's degree in Marketing, Business, or a related field, or equivalent experience

  • Experience in developing customer journey strategies and lifecycle marketing programs

  • Strong analytical skills and the ability to turn insights into actionable customer engagement initiatives

  • Experience working hands-on with marketing automation and omnichannel orchestration, customer data, audiences, and channel activation

  • Experience with lead scoring, nurture programs, audience development, and personalization strategies

  • A strong understanding of customer data, data models, and technical requirements supporting modern marketing automation

  • Proven ability to monitor, analyze, and optimize lifecycle program performance across channels for reporting and leveraging data and insights to continuously improve customer engagement, conversion, and business results

  • Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills

  • A commercial mindset with a strong focus on business impact

What 3shape offers:

  • A vibrant and international environment with social, diverse, and highly skilled and cooperative colleagues - we are more than 40 nationalities in our DK based office

  • An attractive healthcare package to keep you fit and well.

  • Breakfast every day, and delicious and healthy lunch cooked by our private chefs.

  • We provide a great social work environment with many optional activities and social clubs, ranging from wine & beer, board games, running to bicycle clubs.

  • Good work/life balance e.g., an office-first policy with up to 1 day of working from home per week.

  • Attractive offices and R&D lab spaces in downtown Copenhagen close to Kgs. Nytorv, Nyhavn, and the Copenhagen Canals.

  • Purpose: Help improve dental patients on a global scale.

We encourage all relevant applicants to apply. We are committed to celebrating human diversity, and we trust that the best way to reach outstanding business results, is by welcoming diverse people into our community.

About us

3Shape started with a simple idea - to make 3D scanning better. First, we applied it to the hearing industry, then we succeeded in dentistry. Twenty years later, 3Shape has 2,000+ employees globally. With the help of dental professionals and amazing colleagues we’re creating award-winning scanning and CAD/CAM solutions to change dentistry together! Together, we contribute to a better world. Experience the everyday #lifeat3Shape across the globe on LinkedIn.

title: Research Scientist, Paradigms of Intelligence
location: Montreal, QC, Canada; Toronto, ON, Canada; Cambridge, MA, USA; New York, NY, USA
description:
As an organization, Google maintains a portfolio of research projects driven by fundamental research, new product innovation, product contribution and infrastructure goals, while providing individuals and teams the freedom to emphasize specific types of work. As a Research Scientist, you'll setup large-scale tests and deploy promising ideas quickly and broadly, managing deadlines and deliverables while applying the latest theories to develop new and improved products, processes, or technologies. From creating experiments and prototyping implementations to designing new architectures, our research scientists work on real-world problems that span the breadth of computer science, such as machine (and deep) learning, data mining, natural language processing, hardware and software performance analysis, improving compilers for mobile platforms, as well as core search and much more.

As a Research Scientist, you'll also actively contribute to the wider research community by sharing and publishing your findings, with ideas inspired by internal projects as well as from collaborations with research programs at partner universities and technical institutes all over the world.

Our team conducts basic research into alternative AI paradigms beyond those currently trending. Our goal is to discover novel AI algorithms that can be efficient to run on typical or alternate computing substrates, using a mix of automated, hand-designed, and hybrid methods—specifically focusing on how advancing Large Language Model (LLM)-related techniques can accelerate this process.

In this role, you will research, develop, and publish breakthroughs in both algorithm discovery methods and the resulting algorithms themselves.

The Technology & Society organization connects research, people, and ideas across Google and Alphabet to help shape and advance our most ambitious technology innovations and initiatives and their impact on users and society for the better, and responsibly. In addition, we also aim to share perspectives, engage, and collaborate with others externally on technology related issues and opportunities for society.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

Canada: $150000 - $153000 (CAD) + 15% bonus target + equity + benefits
US: $147000 - $210000 (USD) + 15% bonus target + equity + benefits

Learn more about benefits at Google.
  • Carry out sustained exploratory research. Apply the results of your research. Implement and share research findings with researchers and engineers.
  • Review literature, identify key questions, design experiments, and interpret results.
  • Collaborate in person and remotely; maintain a respectful work environment.
  • Share ideas verbally and in writing; publish and present work at journals or scientific conferences.

Minimum qualifications:

  • PhD degree in Computer Science, a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Recent and repeated evidence of independent research, shown through two or more first-authored scientific publications at the main track of the machine learning conferences (NeurIPS, ICML, or ICLR), or of the natural language processing conferences (ACL, NAACL, or EMNLP), published since 2021.
  • Recent and repeated evidence of experience in large language model research (LLMs, agents, foundation models, LLM training or fine-tuning, transformers, or strongly related), shown through two or more scientific publications, published since 2021. The same papers can satisfy more than one minimum qualification.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Post-doctoral experience.
  • Experience in the use of LLMs in fields of program synthesis, automated code discovery, AutoML, or automated science.
  • Experience in training and fine-tuning LLMs.
  • Experience in programming with C++.
  • Excellent Python programming expertise, including machine learning Python libraries such as JAX, TensorFlow or PyTorch.

description:
