title: Midweight Producer
description:
We are Wiser, an award-winning Employer Branding & Early Talent agency. We build employer brands to guide the best in the biz into their dream career with our clients.

We’re a home for people who think big and expect more; where creative and recruitment meet to change the way people think about work — not to mention having the only rainforest in Farringdon.

Our creatives use design, product, film, strategy and marketing to capture what makes companies great and showcase it in the market. Our recruitment teams introduce the right people at the beginning of their career to set these companies apart.

We believe that people will do their best work when they're in a space that enables it. And that's what we've shaped at Wiser — a culture where everyone can be real and back themselves, surrounded by high performers who take ownership of their career and make moves, no matter what their background.

To find out more about us, take a look at our website wearewiser.com or check us out on Instagram @wearewiser.

WHAT'S THIS ROLE ALL ABOUT?

We’re looking for an organised, detail-obsessed Creative Producer to join our Films team.

You’ll help bring our films to life, taking productions from initial brief and creative development through pre-production, shoot, post-production and final delivery. Working across multiple fast-moving projects, you’ll coordinate internal teams, manage production schedules and make sure everyone has what they need to deliver brilliant work.

Reporting to the Head of Films, you’ll support the planning and delivery of our larger productions while taking full ownership of projects of your own. This includes managing logistics, timelines, budgets, production documentation, crews and communication with internal teams and external contractors.

The ideal candidate will have a strong background in commercial production—either gained within an agency or production company—along with hands-on shoot experience and a solid understanding of production protocols. You’ll be confident running a set, comfortable juggling competing priorities and excited by the challenge of taking a brief from idea to delivery.

WHAT WILL YOU SPEND YOUR TIME DOING?
Production Support & Project Ownership:

  • Support the Head of Films in overseeing and delivering production processes.

  • Assist with production planning, timelines, budgets and logistics.

  • Take ownership of projects and shoots when required, from brief through to final delivery.

  • Manage multiple production schedules, balancing deadlines and changing priorities.

  • Lead responses to internal production requests, coordinating schedules and communicating availability.

  • Manage resource requests and team capacity planning, coordinating holds, confirmed bookings and team availability to ensure projects are appropriately staffed.

  • Ensure all necessary production documentation is prepared and shared with key crew and stakeholders.

  • Communicate clearly between creative, production and account teams to ensure seamless project delivery.

Pre-Production:

  • Create and manage essential production documentation, including:

    • Call sheets

    • Risk assessments

    • Crew and talent contracts

    • Production declaration forms

    • Permits and location agreements

    • Kit hire and bookings

    • Pre-production and post-production meeting notes

  • Secure and organise shoot locations, permits, and compliance requirements.

  • Book and coordinate crew, ensuring all roles are filled appropriately.

  • Source and coordinate international fixers when required.

On-Set & Post-Production Support:

  • Act as the key point of contact during shoots, supporting the Head of Films or independently overseeing operations when required.

  • Communicate confidently with clients, crew and talent throughout the production.

  • Troubleshoot and resolve on-set challenges calmly and efficiently.

  • Work with post-production teams to ensure the seamless delivery of projects.

Collaboration with Head of Films:

  • Support the Head of Films in maintaining and organising a database of production documentation.

  • Help maintain consistent production processes and ways of working across the Films team.

  • Ensure productions comply with relevant legal requirements and industry standards.

WHAT ARE WE LOOKING FOR?

  • Experience: 3-5 years of proven experience in commercial production, ideally within a fast-paced creative or integrated agency.

  • On-Set Knowledge: Strong understanding of on-set roles, logistics and workflows, with the confidence to run a set independently.

  • Organisational Skills: Ability to manage multiple projects, coordinate team schedules and respond calmly to changing priorities.

  • Industry Knowledge: Strong working knowledge of film and media production standards, contracts, risk assessments and compliance requirements.

  • Software Proficiency: IConfident using production management tools, spreadsheets and scheduling software.

  • Strong Communication: Ability to communicate confidently with crew, clients and internal teams, with no dramas.

  • Comfort with the Uncomfortable: Sometimes we get 8 weeks to produce a hero campaign. Other times we get 8 hours to bring together an edit. You need to be comfortable with both

  • Passion: A love for film and a drive to create best-in-class work

A FINAL NOTE

This isn’t a role where every day is spent on set. Much of your time will be spent managing multiple briefs, schedules and changing priorities. But when it’s time to shoot, we need someone with the experience and confidence to take the lead. With clients around the world, there will also be plenty of opportunities to travel. You’ll enjoy both sides of production: creating order behind the scenes and bringing brilliant creative work to life.

WORKING RHYTHM

  • Monday to Friday, 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM.

  • Office-based from Monday to Thursday, with remote work on Friday if needed.

WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU?

  • A high performance company culture that will help you to progress quickly and grow with us

  • Breakfast and snacks provided in our award-winning* HQ in Farringdon, central London (yep, our office won an interior design award)

  • Regular events and socials - from black tie in the Gherkin to barbecue in the park, there’s something to suit everyone

  • Support from our Happiness team who keep our wellbeing at the top of the agenda.

  • Kitted out with a full suite of Apple goodies and any additional tech you may need, with our very own in-house Apple Genius

  • An office environment and team dynamic that will bring the very best out of you

  • Additional wellness support in the form of our performance coach, therapy budget and vitality health insurance

We know that true creativity and innovation thrive when diversity is celebrated and everyone is given equal access to opportunities. That’s why we welcome applicants from all backgrounds, regardless of race, ethnicity, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, religion, ability, or socioeconomic status.

We believe that everyone should feel comfortable and be able to back themselves in an inclusive environment where individuality is celebrated. We’re building a team as diverse as the brands we work with, and our aim is to change the way people think about work.

title: Product Manager, In-Person Giving
description:
Highlights:

Location: Georgia

Language: Fluent in Russian and English (C1+)

About Fundraise Up

We’re Fundraise Up - a global fundraising platform built to make donating to nonprofits fast, seamless, and accessible to all. Every month, our technology powers tens of millions of dollars in donations across the globe. We focus on innovation that directly impacts results: faster load times, higher conversion rates, global payment support, and accessibility-first design.

Our platform is trusted by many of the world’s leading nonprofits, including UNICEF, the Alzheimer’s Association, and a wide range of global NGOs. With a 4.9/5 rating across top software review platforms, we’re recognized not just for our impact - but for the quality of the product we deliver.

A Truly Global Product

We operate in the enterprise segment, serving nonprofit organizations across North America, the United Kingdom, Australia, and Europe.

We’re building a large and complex product ecosystem that serves nonprofits, donors, and partners around the world. The platform includes a modern checkout experience and customizable widgets (each a standalone SPA), donor, organization, and partner portals, admin tools, and several internal apps.

The Team

We are a distributed team of 160+ product professionals. Our team members are mainly based across Spain, Poland, Portugal, Georgia, Armenia, Serbia, Turkey, and Cyprus.

Despite our scale, we operate like a focused team - where every task matters and every voice is heard. We value thoughtful collaboration, strong engineering practices, and a product mindset. You’ll be joining a team where quality, mentorship, and mutual respect come first.

About In-Person Giving at Fundraise Up

In-Person Giving brings the quality and connected data of Fundraise Up’s online donation experience into physical fundraising moments.

The product begins with Tap to Donate and Giving Station: staff-led and self-service experiences that let nonprofits accept contactless donations at events, in public spaces, and through other offline workflows. Every transaction should connect to the same campaigns, donor records, reporting, CRM integrations, and operational controls used across Fundraise Up.

The next product direction is Events & Commerce. It includes ticket sales, check-in, merchandise and food purchases, symbolic purchases, auctions, paddle raises, and additional donations before and during an event. These capabilities must work as one connected fundraising system rather than another isolated event tool.

About the Role

We are hiring a Product Manager to own Events & Commerce within the broader In-Person Giving product line.

This is a hands-on software product role covering discovery, definition, delivery, launch, and iteration. You will turn a large category into a focused product direction grounded in customer workflows, live usage, and commercial evidence.

You will work closely with the PM responsible for the broader In-Person Giving area so that event commerce builds on the same payment, campaign, donor-data, reporting, mobile, and operational foundations as Tap to Donate and Giving Station. You will also partner with the Peer-to-Peer team where ticketing and event capabilities should be shared rather than rebuilt separately.

This is not an event-planning, sales, or internal project-coordination role.

What You’ll Own

Define the product direction

  • Turn customer research, market evidence, and business context into a clear Events & Commerce product thesis and sequenced roadmap.
  • Choose a focused target segment and event scenario rather than trying to replace every event platform at once.
  • Decide which capabilities belong in the shared In-Person Giving foundation and which require an Events-specific model.
  • Make explicit decisions about what Fundraise Up should build, integrate, partner on, or deliberately exclude.
  • Keep assumptions, success metrics, scope, risks, and product decisions visible.

Lead discovery and product definition

  • Work directly with nonprofit fundraising teams, event operators, finance teams, volunteers, attendees, donors, design partners, and internal GTM teams.
  • Map the complete workflow before, during, and after an event—including purchase, donation, check-in, fulfillment, reconciliation, reporting, and follow-up.
  • Validate decisions through interviews, workflow observation, prototypes, and live product usage.
  • Separate true adoption blockers from feature requests and expectations created by incumbent event platforms.
  • Shape problems such as ticket sales, QR-based check-in, guest management, commerce catalogues, FMV and receipts, on-site purchases, auctions, paddle raises, refunds, attribution, reporting, and integrations. These are examples—not a pre-committed feature checklist.

Shape and deliver the product

  • Own the product from problem definition through requirements, delivery, launch, and iteration.
  • Write clear requirements, acceptance criteria, edge cases, state transitions, and decision records.
  • Make day-to-day scope and trade-off decisions with Engineering, Design, Analytics, Research, QA, and GTM partners.
  • Design for real event conditions: staff and volunteer operators, self-service flows, mobile devices, optional hardware, unreliable connectivity, high-volume moments, and operational recovery.
  • Ensure that event capabilities reuse Fundraise Up’s existing payments, campaign, donor, reporting, CRM, and identity infrastructure wherever possible.
  • Keep delivery predictable by surfacing dependencies, risks, and unresolved decisions early.

Launch, learn, and drive outcomes

  • Launch through EAPs with clear entry criteria, target workflows, success measures, readiness requirements, and out-of-scope areas.
  • Understand whether organizations can configure and run the target event workflows without heavy manual work or disconnected tools.
  • Measure whether attendees can purchase, check in, donate, and receive the right confirmation or receipt through a clear experience.
  • Partner with Product Marketing, Sales, CSM, Support, Finance, Legal, and Operations on positioning, commitments, enablement, and launch readiness.
  • Connect product evidence to activation, adoption, event completion, GPV, expansion, pipeline, retention, and operational cost.
  • Turn evidence into explicit recommendations: iterate, expand, change direction, partner, or stop.

Work AI-native

  • Use AI for research synthesis, workflow analysis, prototyping, specification quality, data exploration, and operational automation.
  • Build testable artifacts quickly without outsourcing product judgment.

Requirements

  • 4–7 years of Product Management or Product Ownership experience in a software product company.
  • End-to-end ownership of a customer-facing product area with Engineering and Design.
  • Strong judgment in reducing a large problem space to a focused release and explaining the trade-offs.
  • Experience turning customer evidence and product data into decisions.
  • Clear written communication across requirements, edge cases, metrics, and decision records.
  • Ability to work with transactional, multi-actor workflows involving permissions, states, money, and data relationships.
  • High ownership and independence, with fluent written and spoken English.

Strong plus

  • Experience with ticketing, event technology, commerce, POS, payments, marketplaces, registration, auctions, or other transaction-heavy products.
  • Experience with mobile applications, contactless payments, physical devices, or hardware-enabled workflows.
  • Experience with B2B SaaS, fundraising, nonprofits, or other operationally complex customer environments.
  • Experience launching a new product area through beta or EAP.
  • Knowledge of CRM integrations, financial reconciliation, reporting, transaction attribution, analytics, or SQL.
  • Practical use of AI for research, prototyping, analysis, or product operations.

This Role May Not Be a Fit If

  • You are looking for an event-planning or internal project-management role rather than software product ownership.
  • You prefer to receive a fully defined roadmap and requirements instead of helping determine what should be built.
  • You want to work only on strategy and avoid specifications, QA, delivery details, or post-launch iteration.
  • You treat every customer request as a roadmap commitment.
  • You need stable scope and certainty before moving forward.
  • You measure progress mainly by features shipped rather than customer and business outcomes.

Why work with us

  • Build a new product direction from research through live customer use.
  • Work in a large, proven fundraising category with clear customer demand and meaningful commercial potential.
  • Shape ticketing and event commerce as part of a broader fundraising platform rather than an isolated event tool.
  • Work with real nonprofit customers, rich product evidence, and experienced cross-functional partners.
  • Join a small team where product managers have meaningful ownership and direct access to Product leadership.
  • Help define an AI-native approach to product management in practice.
  • Build technology that helps nonprofits engage more supporters and raise more money for their missions.

Compensation

  • The compensation range for this role is GEL12,650 - GEL13,500 gross.
  • Final compensation will be determined based on relevant experience, skills, qualifications, alignment with the role’s requirements and location.

Benefits

  • Private medical insurance for the employee and their family
  • 24 paid vacation days per year
  • 18 paid public holidays per year
  • English learning courses.
  • Relevant professional education.
  • Gym or swimming pool.
  • Home Office Setup Assistance: the company offers assistance with purchasing furniture (office chair, office desk, monitor) and other items to create a comfortable workspace.
  • Co-working.
  • Remote working.

**Please note: All official correspondence from Fundraise Up will exclusively originate from the @fundraiseup.com domain. Exercise caution and ensure the authenticity of emails claiming to be from our company.

We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, national origin, disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law in the countries where we operate.

title: Lead System Analyst/ITBA
description:

title: Senior Full-Stack Software Developer (Python/React)
description:
Our employees are at the heart of everything we do. Together, we help people, businesses, and society prosper in good times and be resilient in bad times.

Our employee promise represents Intact’s commitment to you in exchange for living our Values, striving to do your best work, being open to change and investing in your career.   • Flexible work arrangements and a hybrid work model
  • Possibility to purchase up to 5 extra days off per year
  • Multiple benefits offered to support physical and mental wellbeing, including telemedicine, Wellness account and much more
  • Share plan & other savings: up to 12% of salary or even more (ask how you could earn guaranteed income for life)

Salary range (but not limited to):

118,700 - 145,100

Annual bonus target, based on the base salary, with a potential payout of up to double the target (subject to personal and company performance):

12%

As part of our commitment to Win As A Team, we share our success with employees through our annual bonus plan and Employee Share Purchase Plan (ESPP) – with Intact matching 50% of your net shares.

Our pension offerings provide flexibility and long-term security for our employees beyond their careers. We are one of the few companies offering the opportunity to receive guaranteed income for life via our defined benefit pension plan.

Salary for the candidate will be determined taking into consideration a number of factors including: experience, skills, qualifications, anticipated contribution to role, internal equity, etc. The salary range presented above is based on a 35-hour workweek and would represent a majority of different candidate profiles. However, we encourage candidates who may fall outside of this range to apply as well.

About the role

We’re looking for a Senior Full-Stack Software Developer (Python/React) to join our growing AI Engineering team and build reliable, scalable AI-powered products across distributed systems, frontend and backend development, cloud infrastructure, information extraction, and LLM services.

What you’ll do here:

  • Design and evolve event-driven, distributed systems using queue-based pipelines, fan-out/fan-in, backpressure, idempotency, and reliable failure and retry handling.
  • Develop and maintain frontend and backend components that support our algorithms and AI-powered features.
  • Build production LLM solutions, including cloud model integration and optimization of quality, latency, and cost.
  • Develop information extraction pipelines covering classification, OCR, document layout analysis, model-based extraction, prompt design, refinement, and validation.
  • Own frontend foundations, including monorepo package management, build orchestration, shared React components, TypeScript architecture, and build performance.
  • Design and maintain Terraform infrastructure, including reusable modules, remote state, provider pinning, and multi-environment layouts.
  • Contribute to AWS architecture, including networking, load balancing, API gateways, IAM, encryption and key management, and log and metric delivery.
  • Design CI/CD workflows with reusable pipelines, environment matrices, and production approval gates.
  • Support component, integration, and automated UI testing, including local test environments using emulated cloud services.
  • Establish observability through structured logging, custom metrics, and queries that trace failures across distributed pipelines.
  • Optimize containerized services for performance and cost through appropriate sizing, concurrency tuning, and bottleneck analysis.
  • Define development standards and technical strategies that promote quality, efficiency, resilience, maintainability, and sustainability.
  • Collaborate on prioritization, resolve technical issues, improve team productivity, and mentor Squad members as a Technical Leader.

What you bring to the table:

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer engineering, computer science, or a related field—or equivalent education and experience.
  • At least five years of significant software development experience.
  • Strong proficiency in Python, TypeScript, React, AWS, and REST APIs using Swagger/OpenAPI.
  • Experience with distributed systems and event-driven architectures, including asynchronous processing, retries, idempotency, backpressure, and failure recovery.
  • Experience with frontend architecture, monorepos, shared React component libraries, TypeScript type design, and build and bundle optimization.
  • Experience with Terraform, including module design, remote state, provider pinning, and multi-environment infrastructure.
  • Broad AWS knowledge covering networking, load balancing, API gateways, IAM, encryption, key management, logging, and metrics.
  • Experience designing CI/CD systems with reusable workflows, environment matrices, and production approval processes.
  • Production experience taking LLM- or model-backed features from prototype to reliable service, including cloud model integration and quality, latency, and cost management.
  • Knowledge of AI, generative AI, RAG, MLOps, prompt design, OCR, document layout analysis, and information extraction.
  • Experience with component, integration, and automated UI testing.
  • Strong observability and troubleshooting skills, including structured logging, custom metrics, and tracing failures through distributed systems.
  • Strong documentation and communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts clearly.
  • No Canadian work experience required however must be eligible to work in Canada.
  • For candidates located in Quebec, bilingualism is required considering the necessity to interact on a regular basis with English-speaking colleagues across the country

Nice-to-have:

  • Experience leading migrations involving a dependency manager, CI platform, or infrastructure layout.
  • Experience designing local development and integration-test environments using emulated cloud services.
  • Experience optimizing containerized services for cost and performance, including workload sizing, concurrency tuning, and bottleneck analysis.
  • Experience mentoring developers or serving as a Technical Lead.

title: Junior Project Manager
description:
Hey there!
We’re Fever, the world’s leading tech platform for culture and live entertainment.

Our mission? To democratize access to culture and entertainment. With our proprietary cutting-edge technology and data-driven approach, we’re revolutionizing the way people engage with live entertainment.

Every month, our platform inspires over 300 million people in +55 countries (and counting) to discover unforgettable experiences while also empowering event creators with our data and technology, helping them scale, innovate, and enhance their events to reach new audiences.

Our results? We’ve teamed up with major industry leaders like Netflix, F.C. Barcelona, and Primavera Sound, presented international award-winning experiences, and are backed by several leading global investors! Impressive, right?

To achieve our mission, we are looking for bar-raisers with a hands-on mindset who are eager to help shape the future of entertainment!

Ready to be part of the experience?

Now, let’s discuss this role and what you will do to help achieve Fever’s mission.

As part of the Fever Originals team, you will use data and insights to create one-of-a-kind events and experiences that allow people to have unforgettable moments.

Who you'll work with

You will join our office in Lisbon to work with the teams and directly interact with our partners, providers, and venues.

In this role you will help Fever grow its pipeline of original events. To do so, you will interact with all departments of Fever, from Marketing to Operations.

The team you’re about to join consists of people that are motivated, young, and fun. On top of having multicultural backgrounds, people in the team are all top profiles: McKinsey, Amazon, Google, KKR, Cirque du Soleil, PSG, and Roland Garros.

Employees are expected to work from the office 2x per week, according to local office policy. This is typically Tuesday and Thursday, but subject to change.

What you'll do

As a Junior Project Manager, you will work with your team lead to develop, launch and manage your events, from A to Z. Together with the other departments, you will define the way to scale this event to all our other markets. You will be responsible for owning the strategic planning, execution, and reporting for our key strategic experiences. A significant part of your work will involve identifying, developing, and negotiating partnerships with venues and external stakeholders

When you join Fever, you are joining a company that will invest in your professional development. You will receive training and coaching on how to:

  • Provide a detailed analysis of business opportunities and inefficiencies; proposing changes to operational processes; driving a high standard in customer satisfaction; ensuring high-quality experiences are delivered.
  • Manage events from conception to delivery, working with existing partners and developing new relationships
  • Lead venue sourcing and contract negotiations, securing optimal terms and building long-term partnerships with strategic venues
  • Help to scale the experiences across the x.
  • Coordinate with the different internal teams at Fever
  • Work with the Fever marketing team to make sure events make an impact both in terms of ticket sales and coverage
  • Manage, report on, and grow revenue from our events and experiences.
  • Represent the Fever brand at events
  • Make informed decisions based on data (including P&L analysis)
  • Work with the global events team on the various brands in other markets

Preferred Qualifications

  • 2+ years in a project management role or consulting background. This is not a position for an events background.
  • Experience in venue sourcing / negotiations, and/or partnership development and management highly appreciated
  • Fluent English and Portuguese with excellent communication skills (both oral and written). Spanish is a plus.
  • Huge appetite for learning and the ability to pick up new skills quickly. You will also have strong analytical, relationship management, and organizational skills.
  • You'll be solution-focused, identifying problem areas and then creating plans to find resolutions.
  • Strong negotiation and networking skills, with the ability to build meaningful partnerships: you’re not afraid of picking up the phone and pitching to potential new partners
  • Highly organized and efficient
  • Curious and keen to push boundaries and try new concepts
  • Great networking skills and the ability to make smart partnerships happen
  • Able to communicate with events partners, brands, agencies, and talent on efforts
  • Manage of excel and PowerPoint is essential.
  • Able to handle large amounts of work and parallel work-streams
  • Collaborative and willing to get hands dirty and work on all required events tasks
  • Knowledge of promotional tools such as Facebook and Instagram is a plus
  • Strong academic background is a plus

You can expect to join a group of diverse, hardworking team players, where a cultural fit is someone willing to stay humble and learn and can work nimbly. We welcome applications with unusual backgrounds with the expectation that the applicant will have acquired hard or soft skills and maturity throughout their experiences.

What you'll get

  • Attractive compensation package and the potential to earn a significant bonus for top performance.
  • Opportunity to have a real impact in a high-growth global category leader
  • 40% discount on all Fever events and experiences
  • Health insurance
  • Meal tickets
  • Wellhub membership
  • English lessons
  • Work in the heart of the city, with possible travel across our markets
  • Responsibility from day one and professional and personal growth
  • Great work environment with a young, international team of talented people to work with!

Our hiring process

  • A 30 min video call with one of our Talent Acquisition Managers, to better understand your career plan, assess cultural fit and answer any questions you may have
  • A 60 min online test with three topics: logic, analytics and written understanding
  • A 30 min conversation with your future manager
  • A 45 min video call with your future manager, including questions about your profile and a business case presentation (to be prepared in advance)


On average our process lasts 20 working days and offers usually follow within a week.

title: Software Engineer
description:
About Dialpad

Dialpad is the AI platform for customer experience, built to resolve customer problems in real time across voice and digital. Our AI agents learn from your best human agents and improve with every interaction, helping organizations understand their customers, deliver better experiences, increase operational efficiencies, and build a lasting competitive advantage.

Unlike legacy systems built to route and answer, or standalone agentic bot vendors built to deflect, Dialpad was built to resolve. Our AI agents and human agents operate on a single platform with shared context, allowing Agentic AI to resolve issues, advance deals, and eliminate busywork through automation while seamlessly handing conversations to humans when needed, with full context preserved.

Market-leading brands, including Randstad, Motorola Solutions, Netflix, the San Diego Padres, the Colorado Rockies Baseball Club, and Cal Athletics, trust Dialpad. Dialpad is backed by Andreessen Horowitz, GV, ICONIQ Capital, and T-Mobile.

Being a Dialer

At Dialpad, AI isn’t just a feature; it’s how our teams do their best work every day. We put powerful AI tools in every employee’s hands so they can move faster, think bigger, and achieve more.

We believe every conversation matters. And we’ve built the platform that turns those conversations into insight and action, for our customers and ourselves.

We look for people who are intensely curious and hold themselves to a high bar. Our ambition is significant, and achieving it requires a team that operates at the highest level. We seek individuals who embody our core traits: Scrappy, Curious, Optimistic, Persistent, and Empathetic.

Your role

We are seeking a talented, experienced Full-Stack Engineer passionate about building high-quality, scalable web applications with modern frontend and backend technologies. You will own significant features end-to-end, tackle technical hurdles, and enrich the team with your engineering experience, including mentoring junior engineers. You will guide projects in which multiple engineers collaborate to deliver major features. You will work jointly in a cross-functional team, including close collaboration with Product Managers to advocate for technical initiatives for the team.

This position reports to our Engineering Manager, who is based in North America, and is looking for the person to join the team in our Vancouver, Canada Office.

What you’ll do

  • Develop and maintain Dialpad's web & desktop applications using modern technologies.
  • Collaborate with the data science team to build a world-class Agentic AI framework.
  • Able to use AI tools like Claude, Gemini, etc., to build world class features quickly.
  • Write clean, modular, and maintainable code using best practices along with unit tests.
  • Participate in code reviews to ensure code quality, maintainability, and scalability.
  • Ensure that features are shipped on time and with the highest quality.
  • Take on on‑call activities to support and resolve issues from QA and Customers.
  • Be responsible for deploying the new releases on a weekly release cadence
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams (e.g., DevOps, QA, Product, UX) to build and use common components and practices across Dialpad products
  • Mentor junior engineers and help them grow their skills and expertise.
  • Communicate technical concepts effectively to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Skills you’ll bring

  • 5+ years of experience in Full-stack software engineering.
  • Strong experience with writing high-performance, reusable, and reliable Python code.
  • Strong experience with RESTful APIs.
  • Strong experience in modern cloud platforms like GCP or other cloud infrastructures, etc.
  • Strong experience in documentation for architectural designs, technical decisions, and best practices.
  • Experience with modern frontend frameworks such as Vue/React, as well as HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and TypeScript.
  • Experience with databases, SQL/NoSQL.
  • Experience with mentoring junior engineers and helping them grow their skills.
  • Experience with Agile development methodologies.
  • Strong debugging and troubleshooting skills.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills.

Salary

The range displayed on each job posting reflects the target range for new hire salaries for the position. Within the range, individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Please note that the compensation details listed in British Columbia role postings reflect the base salary only, and do not include bonus, equity, or benefits.

British Columbia, Canada Salary Range

$147,000—$174,000 CAD

Why Join Dialpad

  • Work at the center of the AI transformation in business communications
  • Build and ship agentic AI products that are redefining how companies operate
  • Join a team where AI amplifies every employee’s impact
  • Competitive salary, comprehensive benefits, and real opportunities for growth

We believe in investing in our people. Dialpad offers competitive benefits and perks, cutting-edge AI tools, and a robust training program that help you reach your full potential. Mitä tarjoamme sinulle?

  • 💸 Kilpailukykyinen palkkaus: Pohjapalkka + myyntiprovisiot, takuupalkka 13,76 €/h ICT-alan työehtosopimuksen mukaan. Pystyt omalla myynnillisellä otteellasi vaikuttamaan tuntuvasti omaan ansaintaasi. Keskiansio myyjillä on ollut 2800 euroa/kk.

Meille hakeminen on helppoa, voit hakea myös ilman CV:tä ja tietojen täyttö vie enintään muutaman minuutin aikaasi – älä siis mieti, vaan toimi heti!

Miksi juuri DNA?

DNA:lla pääset kehittymään myyntityön ammattilaiseksi turvallisessa ja kannustavassa ympäristössä. Lisäksi arjessa tukenasi on kokeneita esihenkilöitä sekä innostava tiimi. Vauhtia ja fiilistä lisäävät energiset myyntikilpailut ja onnistumisten juhlistaminen. 🏆

Mitä työ pitää sisällään?

Myyjänä DNA kaupassa palvelet asiakkaita kasvotusten ja chat-ympäristössä. DNA kaupan myyjänä vastaat niin DNA:n tuotteiden myynnistä, esillepanosta kuin myymälän perustehtävistäkin. Myymälässä tehtäväsi on välittää sujuvaa palveluasennetta, tehokkuutta ja mieleenpainuvaa asiakaskokemusta. Pääsetkin tekemään aktiivista myyntityötä huomioiden asiakkaiden yksilölliset tarpeet.

Kenelle työ sopii?

Haemme innostuneita ja tavoitteellisia henkilöitä, jotka haluavat oppia uutta ja menestyä myynnin parissa. Meille tärkeintä on motivaatio ja rohkeus tarttua uusiin haasteisiin, sinua tuetaan joka askeleella. Aikaisempi kokemus myyntityöstä katsotaan eduksi, mutta kokemustakin tärkeämpää on oikea asenne, sillä perehdytyksemme varmistaa, että sinulla on kaikki työssä tarvittavat taidot.

Tehtävä edellyttää täysi-ikäisyyttä, hyvää suomen kielen taitoa ja valittavalta henkilöltä tullaan tarkistamaan luottotiedot.

Hae mukaan helposti ilman CV:tä!

Paikkakunta: Salo & Halikko
Työsopimus: Toistaiseksi voimassa oleva
Työaika: 30-37,5 h/vko myymälän aukioloaikojen mukaisesti

title: Safety & PV Coordinator
description:
Safety & PV Coordinator

Syneos Health® is a leading fully-integrated life sciences services organization built to accelerate customer success. We partner with innovators at every point across the drug development and commercialization continuum, helping them navigate complexity, anticipate change and accelerate progress.

Our Clinical Solutions team members act with a drug development mindset, applying their years of experience and deep expertise to truly understand customer needs and represent those in the solutions we shape.

Whether you join us in a Functional Service Provider partnership or a Full-Service environment, you’ll collaborate with passionate problem solvers, innovating as a team to help our customers achieve their goals. We are agile and driven to deliver – for one another, our customers, and, most importantly, for those in need.

Discover what your 25,000 future colleagues already know:

Why Syneos Health
• We are passionate about developing our people, through career development and progression; supportive and engaged line management; technical and therapeutic area training; peer recognition and total rewards program.
• We are committed to building an inclusive culture – where you can authentically be yourself. Central to this is our purpose – Driven to Deliver – which captures the passion of our colleagues to show up each day and shape solutions that have the ability to dramatically impact someone’s life.
• We are continuously building the company we all want to work for and our customers want to work with. Why? Because we know that when we bring together smart colleagues from across the world, we can shape the future of healthcare, driving impact for customers and defining the pace of patient progress.

Job Responsibilities

- Enter information into PVG quality and tracking systems for receipt and tracking ICSR as required.

- Assists in the processing of ICSRs according to Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and project/program-specific safety plans as required.

- Triages ICSRs, evaluates ICSR data for completeness, accuracy, and regulatory report ability.

- Enters data into safety database.

- Codes events, medical history, concomitant medications, and tests.

- Compiles complete narrative summaries.

- Identifies information to be queried and follows up until information is obtained and queries are satisfactorily resolved.

- Assists in the generation of timely, consistent, and accurate reporting of expedited reports in accordance with applicable regulatory requirements.

- Maintains safety tracking for assigned activities.

- Performs literature screening and review for safety, drug coding, maintenance of drug dictionary, MedDRA coding as required.

- Validation and Submission of xEVMPD product records, including appropriate coding of indication terms using MedDRA.

- Manual recoding of un-recoded product and substance terms arises from ICSRs.

- Identification and management of duplicate ICSRs.

description:
About the Role

This team builds and maintains the applications and platforms that put real capital to work for clients across one of the world's largest financial institutions. This is a hands‑on engineering role. You will design, develop, and ship full-stack solutions while helping shape how the team builds software - embedding AI into the engineering craft as a natural and practical part of daily work, not as an afterthought. If you are a senior engineer who writes excellent code, thinks clearly about systems, and wants to work on problems that matter - this role was written for you.

  • Full-Stack Design and Delivery: Design, develop, and deliver full-stack applications using Java and Spring Boot on the backend and Angular on the frontend, with meaningful input into technical direction and architectural decisions.

Establish shared standards for prompt engineering, code review, and quality guardrails so that AI-augmented development becomes the team's natural practice, not the exception.

You know enough about what is happening under the hood to use these tools with intention, not just habit

What Success Looks Like

You have personally delivered features that are in production, trusted by the business, and cited as examples of how good engineering is done here. Stakeholders - technical and non‑technical - come to you with hard problems because they trust your judgement and your ability to translate complexity into a clear, actionable direction. The engineers around you are measurably better for working alongside you. Not because you ran workshops, but because your code, your reviews, and your approach set a standard worth following. You have shaped how AI is used on this team - not by mandating tools, but by demonstrating what thoughtful, effective AI‑augmented engineering actually looks like in practice. Problems that previously stalled the team get solved. You are the person who unblocks things - through technical depth, clear thinking, and the confidence to make a call.

title: Undersköterska till Polhemsgården
description:
Nu söker vi på Polhemsgården i Solna undersköterska . Vi erbjuder utbildning och flera förmåner.

Det här får du hos oss:

  • Utbildning som gör ditt arbete enklare, till exempel vårdhygien, bemötande vid demenssjukdom och ergonomi.

  • Förmånsportal med rabatter och erbjudanden. Till exempel kan du köpa biobiljetter och resor med kollektivtrafik till bra pris.

  • En coachande och stöttande chef som jobbar tillsammans med dig i vardagen.

  • Tydliga arbetssätt och rutiner som förenklar ditt jobb.

  • Karriär- och utvecklingsmöjligheter. Till exempel kan du bli gruppchef med personalansvar eller få ett specifikt ämnesansvar som demensansvarig eller hygienombud.

Om Polhemsgården

Polhemsgården i Solna består av 80 lägenheter med demensinriktning, varav fem platser är korttids-och växelplatser. Polhemsgården har natur och trädgård som profil. Utevistelse och aktiviteter i natur, park och trädgård är naturliga delar av vår vardag. Vi arbetar utifrån olika naturtema året om. Vi har sjuksköterskor i tjänst dygnet runt, året runt.

Vi är ett demenscertifierat boende, vilket betyder att alla vi som arbetar här är utbildade i demens och bemötande via Silvia hemmet.

Vi har ett samarbete med företaget Ung Omsorg.Det innebär att ett team av ungdomar i åldrarna 14–18 år besöker oss på helger och lov. Ung Omsorg gör olika aktiviteter för att sätta guldkant på tillvaron för våra boende.

Du har en gruppchef som större delen av sin tid arbetar nära dig i verksamheten. Att bli gruppchef kan även vara en karriärmöjlighet för dig som undersköterska.

Som undersköterska är du oerhört viktig!

Din uppgift är att ge livskvalitet. Med hjälp av dig kan våra boende behålla sitt levnadssätt och sina vanor. Du ser varje person och tolkar vad de behöver. Samtidigt lär du dig mycket om omvårdnad, åldrande och hur man bemöter människor.

”Det handlar framför allt om möten med människor, att kunna anpassa och läsa vad människor behöver. Du får kollegor och lär dig mycket om samarbete! Det händer ofta mycket roliga saker, aktiviteter och utflykter. Det är ett jobb med mycket skratt.” Jirapinya Muangsiri

Du står närmast den boende och har därmed en nyckelroll i teamet med sjuksköterska, arbetsterapeut och fysioterapeut. Du medverkar också vid vårdplanering och skriver social dokumentation.

Med hjärtat på rätta stället

Hos oss får du arbeta i en stark kultur där vi drivs av vår vision: Vi gör världen lite bättre, en människa i taget. Det är oerhört viktigt att du delar vår vision och våra fyra värderingar:

Respekt: Hos oss har alla rätt till ett värdigt liv med såväl fysiskt, psykiskt som socialt välbefinnande.

Ansvar: Hos oss har vi medarbetare som vågar och vill och chefer som lyssnar och leder.

Enkelhet: Hos oss är det enkelt att påverka och att vara medarbetare eller kund.

Kunskap: Hos oss reflekterar vi, lär av varandra och tar tillvara allas kompetens

Tillsammans jobbar vi kontinuerligt med att säkra att värdegrunden genomsyrar vårt bemötande, både till varandra och alla som bor hos oss.

”Här finns bra och tydliga värderingar och mål som har guidat mig hela vägen för att kunna utföra mitt arbete på bästa sätt.” Raquel Castaneda

Din erfarenhet och kunskap

Utbildad undersköterska med skydda titel är ett krav och att du har arbetat några år inom äldreomsorgen. Du har god datorvana samt erfarenhet av dokumentation. Goda kunskaper i det svenska språket i tal och skrift är ett krav, men i övrigt är inte ditt CV det viktigaste. Om du delar våra värderingar och har rätt egenskaper, ger vi dig stöd och möjlighet att växa.

Vi tror att du:

- lockas av ett varierat arbete och tycker om att möta människor i olika situationer.

- är en kreativ person som vågar tänka själv och ta ansvar.

- trivs med att jobba i team och stötta dina kollegor.

Övrigt

Lön: Vi tillämpar individuell lönesättning
Tillträdesdatum: Enligt överenskommelse
Sista ansökningsdag: 2026-10-31
Registerkontroll: Utdrag ur belastningsregister skall uppvisas vid en eventuell anställning.

title: Senior Software Engineer - AI Evaluation
description:
Role Context

The Senior Software Engineer will complete realistic development and technical evaluation assignments used to train advanced AI systems. Work may involve backend services, full-stack applications, infrastructure, databases, APIs, cloud platforms, testing strategies, integrations, deployment pipelines, and production troubleshooting. Each assignment requires more than generating working code. The engineer must evaluate whether a solution is secure, maintainable, scalable, reliable, efficient, and appropriate for the stated requirements. Written explanations should show why an approach works, which tradeoffs were considered, and how the implementation could be improved.

Core Duties

  • Complete advanced software engineering tasks across backend, full-stack, systems, and infrastructure environments.
  • Read and understand unfamiliar codebases, technical specifications, dependencies, and application workflows.
  • Review code for correctness, readability, maintainability, security, performance, and production suitability.
  • Debug application failures, integration issues, database errors, deployment problems, and unexpected runtime behavior.
  • Refactor existing implementations to improve structure, modularity, testability, and developer experience.
  • Design or evaluate APIs, databases, services, integrations, and distributed application components.
  • Analyze architecture decisions and identify their operational and technical consequences.
  • Compare alternative solutions and explain tradeoffs involving scalability, reliability, cost, security, and complexity.
  • Assess whether implementations meet stated functional and non-functional requirements.
  • Review unit tests, integration tests, end-to-end tests, and quality assurance strategies.
  • Examine database schemas, queries, indexes, transactions, and data access patterns.
  • Evaluate CI-CD pipelines, containers, monitoring, logging, and production operations.
  • Identify technical debt, hidden dependencies, edge cases, and failure modes.
  • Produce clear documentation covering assumptions, risks, limitations, and recommended improvements.
  • Collaborate with the customer 's team on code reviews, architecture discussions, and problem-solving exercises.
  • Adapt quickly to new languages, frameworks, libraries, and development environments.
  • Contribute realistic engineering examples that strengthen AI coding and reasoning capabilities.
  • Complete assigned work within the agreed 10-12 hours of weekly availability.

Ideal Profile

  • Minimum 5 years of professional software engineering experience.
  • Strong expertise in at least one backend or full-stack engineering environment.
  • Proficiency in Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, Node.js, Java, C#, .NET, C , Go, Ruby, PHP, or a comparable language.
  • Proven experience developing, maintaining, debugging, or reviewing production applications.
  • Strong understanding of APIs, databases, services, integrations, and application architecture.
  • Practical knowledge of debugging, testing, version control, and code quality practices.
  • Ability to identify technical tradeoffs and explain decisions objectively.
  • Comfortable reading unfamiliar code and determining how it behaves.
  • Experience assessing scalability, performance, security, reliability, and maintainability.
  • Strong written English for documenting technical analysis and engineering recommendations.
  • Ability to work independently within a remote and deadline-focused environment.
  • Experience collaborating with distributed engineering teams.
  • Careful attention to implementation details, edge cases, and operational risks.
  • Previous AI training or model evaluation experience is helpful but not required.

title: Elektricien Industrial Automation
description:
Als Elektricien Industrial Automation bij VMA sta je in voor de elektrische installatie, bekabeling, indienststelling en het onderhoud van industriële automatiseringsinstallaties. Je werkt mee aan uitdagende projecten in industriële omgevingen en zorgt ervoor dat elektrische systemen, schakelkasten en automatiseringscomponenten veilig, correct en efficiënt functioneren.

Binnen VMA werk je samen met projectleiders, engineers en techniekers aan de realisatie en het onderhoud van multitechnische installaties. Je voert elektrische werkzaamheden uit op maat van de klant en draagt bij aan de succesvolle oplevering van industriële automatiseringsprojecten.

  • Sensoren, motoren, frequentieregelaars, actuatoren en andere automatiseringscomponenten installeren

  • Preventief en curatief onderhoud uitvoeren

  • Werkzaamheden nauwkeurig rapporteren en technische documentatie actualiseren

  • Veilig, ordelijk en kwaliteitsvol werken volgens de geldende voorschriften en procedures

  • Nauw samenwerken met collega’s, klanten en andere technische disciplines

Wat verwachten we van jou?

  • Je hebt een technisch diploma elektriciteit, elektromechanica, industriële automatisering of gelijkwaardig door ervaring

  • Je hebt relevante ervaring als industrieel elektricien, bordenbouwer of technieker industriële automatisering

  • Je kan elektrische schema’s en technische plannen lezen en interpreteren

  • Je hebt kennis van industriële elektrische installaties en automatiseringscomponenten

  • Kennis van PLC-technieken, frequentieregelaars en industriële netwerken is een troef

  • Je werkt nauwkeurig, zelfstandig en veiligheidsbewust

  • Je bent klantgericht, communicatief en flexibel ingesteld

  • Je bent bereid om op verschillende industriële werven en projecten te werken

Hiermee laat VMA jouw motor draaien:

  • Je komt terecht in een internationaal, multitechnologisch bedrijf dat veel ambitie heeft om met jou te groeien.

  • Een motiverend loon dat afgestemd is op jouw competenties en ervaring.

  • Een mooi pakket aan extralegale voordelen zoals maaltijdcheques, hospitalisatieverzekering en ecocheques.

  • Een contract van onbepaalde duur in een 40-urenweek. Je hebt recht op 20 wettelijke vakantiedagen, aangevuld met 12 ADV-dagen.

  • Opleidings- en ontwikkelingsmogelijkheden binnen elektrische installaties en industriële automatisering.

  • Werkplezier en op tijd en stond de nodige waardering van je positief geladen collega’s!

  • Diverse VMA- en CFE-evenementen waarbij we als collega’s graag samenkomen.

  • We appreciëren eerlijke, directe communicatie. Vooruitgaan en oplossingen vinden is teamwork. Daarom vinden we het belangrijk dat je je mening durft te delen en problemen op tijd meldt.
    Ben je iemand die graag initiatief neemt en energie krijgt van technische uitdagingen? Dan zal je je goed voelen bij de vrijheid en verantwoordelijkheid die je krijgt in je job. We kijken uit naar iemand met drive die wil meegroeien met ons. Tot snel?

title: Global Head of Change Management
description:
For a quarter of a century, the Jellycat family have brought joy, wonder and playful fun to people of all ages, in every part of the world. Utterly original and in a class of their own, they are currently among the most loved and collected toys of their kind. How has this gentle tribe endeared themselves to so many? Perhaps it is their whimsical expressions. Or the deliciously soft fabrics. Or the beautiful way in which they sit in your hand. Whatever it is, there is something magical and unmistakeable about each one of them.

The Global Head of Change Management leads Jellycat's global change control function, building and running a robust change management capability across the business. Reporting to the Global Business Transformation Director, this role leads and develops a multidisciplinary team of Business Analysts, System Administrators and Testers, and owns the end to end change control process - from inception, through impact assessment, build, testing and documentation, to delivery - ensuring change is delivered safely, on time and aligned with Jellycat's strategic priorities.

You'll be:

Global Change Control Process

  • Owning and maintaining Jellycat's global change control process end to end, covering intake, impact assessment, prioritisation, build, testing, release and post implementation review.

  • Partnering with the Global Business Transformation Director and senior stakeholders to define and continuously improve the change management framework, ensuring it scales with the pace and complexity of the business.

  • Establishing and maintaining change pipeline reporting, dashboards and KPIs that give leadership a clear, real time view of change volume, risk and throughput across systems and functions.

  • Identifying interdependencies and conflicts across concurrent changes, and proactively managing trade offs in scope, timeline and system impact.

  • Leading regular Change Advisory Board (CAB) forums with senior stakeholders, recommending decisions on prioritisation, sequencing and go/no go for release.

Team Leadership & Management

  • Leading, managing and developing a multidisciplinary team of Business Analysts, System Administrators and Testers, setting clear objectives and creating a culture of accountability, quality and continuous improvement.

  • Allocating Business Analysts, System Administrators and Testers to changes and initiatives based on skills, capacity and business priority, balancing workload and development opportunities across the team.

  • Building team capability through coaching, structured development plans and access to relevant training and certifications.

  • Leading the recruitment and onboarding of change management talent as the team and change portfolio grow.

  • Fostering strong, collaborative working relationships between the change team and functional and business teams across Jellycat.

Testing, Quality & Documentation

  • Designing, implementing and continuously improving a consistent global change control methodology, covering impact and risk assessment, approval, build, testing and release.

  • Establishing clear governance structures and escalation routes, including change approval authorities and emergency change routes.

  • Ensuring every change has a clear scope, justification, risk assessment, test plan and sign-off, together with complete documentation from inception through to closure and post-implementation review.

  • Embedding rigorous risk and issue management practices, ensuring risks identified during testing are owned and mitigated prior to release.

  • Championing consistent use of change, test and documentation management tools and systems, driving standardisation, quality and audit-readiness across the team.

  • Monitoring compliance with governance standards and taking corrective action where changes deviate from agreed processes.

Stakeholder Communication & Engagement

  • Building strong, trusted relationships with senior stakeholders and system and process owners across Jellycat, acting as a key point of contact for change delivery.

  • Designing and delivering clear, tailored communications for different audiences, from working-level updates through to Executive Committee reporting.

  • Ensuring stakeholders are engaged early and appropriately throughout the change lifecycle, managing expectations and building buy-in for change.

  • Representing the change management function in senior forums, presenting change pipeline status, risks and recommendations with clarity and confidence.

  • Acting as an escalation point for change-related issues, working with sponsors and the Global Business Transformation Director to resolve blockers quickly.

You'll have:

Essential

  • 10+ years' experience in change management, business analysis or IT delivery, including significant experience owning a global change control process across multiple systems and functions.

  • 5+ years' proven experience leading and developing multidisciplinary teams, including Business Analysts, System Administrators and Testers, with strong people leadership and coaching skills.

  • Deep expertise in change management and control frameworks (e.g. ITIL Change Management, ISO 20000, Agile/DevOps change practices), with the ability to tailor frameworks pragmatically to organisational needs.

  • A formal change, IT service management or testing qualification (e.g. ITIL, ISTQB, PRINCE2 or Agile/Scrum certifications).

  • A strong background in software and system testing practices and methodologies, with the ability to establish and enforce quality and testing standards across a testing function.

  • Excellent stakeholder management skills, with a track record of building credibility and influence at senior and Executive level.

  • A strong track record of establishing or significantly improving a change control or change management function.

  • Outstanding written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate complex technical or process information into clear, actionable insights for different audiences.

  • Experience operating within a fast-paced, international organisation.

Desirable

  • Experience within retail, FMCG, licensing or a global consumer brand.

  • Experience using change, test and documentation management tools such as ServiceNow, Jira, Zephyr or Confluence.

  • Experience supporting broader business transformation or organisational change initiatives.

title: Automechanik/ Automechanička osobných vozidiel Mercedes-Benz
description:
Pre náš autorizovaný servis vozidiel značky Mercedes-Benz v Hedin Automotive Slovakia (Nitra) hľadáme nového kolegu/kolegyňu na pozíciu Automechanik/Systémový technik.

Ak ste skúsený mechanik, ktorého práca s autami baví, radi sa učíte nové oblasti z "mechaničiny", alebo máte sen stať sa perfektným diagnostikom, poďte medzi nás.

U nás vás čaká motivujúce ohodnotenie, možnosť vzdelávania sa v odbore, zaujímavé benefity, výborná partia kolegov a skvelý šéf.

Vašou úlohou bude:

  • vykonávať garančný a pozáručný servis

  • diagnostikovať súlad a odchýlky od predpísaných hodnôt

  • vykonávať montáže, demontáže, kalibrácie

  • inštalovať komponenty a systémy do vozidla, vykonávať ich prepojenie (zosieťovanie) a odborne ich uvádzať do prevádzky

  • vykonávať komplexné opravy, ktoré sú potrebné pre obnovenie funkčnosti systémov, s využitím všetkých k dispozícii stojacich dielenských informačných systémov

  • samostatne vykonávať záverečné kontroly a kontroly funkčnosti po všetkých komplexných opravách

  • zlepšovať systém práce, aby sme sa aj vďaka vašim návrhom ďalej rozvíjali

Ponúkame vám zaujímavé benefity

  • moderné pracovné prostredie a profesionálne vybavenie na prácu v dielni s najmodernejšími technológiami

  • vlastné oddelené odkladacie priestory na osobné veci, kvalitné pracovné oblečenie o ktorého čistotu sa staráme my

  • pravidelné školenia a odborné vzdelávanie v danom obore

  • prispejeme vám aj na doplnkové dôchodkové sporenie

  • využijete Multisport kartu na voľnočasové aktivity

K pozícii budete potrebovať :

  • vzdelanie v odbore Automechanik (výučný list)

  • min. 3 roky skúsenosť s opravou vozidiel v mechanickej dielni

  • poctivý a zodpovedný prístup

  • dôslednosť, chuť a schopnosť vzdelávať sa v obore

  • zručnosť, fyzická zdatnosť, pracovitosť

  • výhodou je elektrotechnické vzdelanie a skúsenosť v odbore automechanik - elektrikár

Informácie o výberovom konaní
Ak sme vás zaujali, radi vás spoznáme osobne. Pošlite nám svoj životopis prostredníctvom tejto aplikácie a my sa vám ozveme.

Vopred by sme radi upozornili kandidátov, že aj napriek tomu, že si vážime každého kandidáta, ktorý prejaví záujem o túto prácu, na osobný pohovor budeme pozývať len kandidátov, ktorí svojím zameraním a skúsenosťami zodpovedajú požiadavkám pozície.

title: Head of Group HR - Saferoad
description:

title: Trader
description:

Grasshopper is a quantitative trading technology provider based in Singapore, and is the holding company of Grasshopper Asset Management. Our state-of-the-art technology, built from the ground up in-house, puts us at the forefront of developments in electronic trading. An unbroken record of consistency and profitability is underpinned by firm values of curiosity, empowerment and flexibility.

About Grasshopper Asset Management

Grasshopper Asset Management, a subsidiary of Grasshopper, is a Licensed Fund Management Company (LFMC) regulated by the Monetary Authority of Singapore. title: Deal Desk Lead
description:
The Opportunity

ESW is seeking a Deal Desk Lead to own and continuously improve our Deal Desk governance framework, ensuring commercial proposals are structured consistently, approvals are timely and auditable, and complex opportunities are evaluated with clear analysis and sound commercial judgement.
This role partners closely with Sales, Finance, Product, Solution Engineering, Legal, and other cross-functional stakeholders to bring structure, discipline, and transparency to deal approvals. The Deal Desk Lead will challenge assumptions, clarify trade-offs, coordinate stakeholder input, and help ensure approved deals are commercially sound, operationally deliverable, and aligned with ESW’s pricing and governance standards. This is a senior individual contributor role requiring strong commercial acumen, analytical capability, and the ability to influence stakeholders across the business without direct line management responsibility.

This is a hybrid role and based from our office at North Wall Quay, Dublin 1.

What You'll Own

  • Own, operate, and continuously improve ESW’s Deal Desk governance framework, ensuring approvals are consistent, appropriately authorized, clearly documented, and easy for stakeholders to navigate.
  • Review commercial proposals and business cases to ensure pricing, terms, assumptions, risks, and non-standard requirements are fully understood before approval decisions are made.
  • Exercise delegated authority within agreed parameters and coordinate escalation of exceptions to the appropriate approvers.
  • Maintain and update approval thresholds, approval matrices, and Deal Desk operating guidance, recommending improvements where process gaps or recurring exceptions emerge.
  • Partner with Sales and Solution Engineering on complex or strategically important opportunities, helping structure proposals within ESW’s approved commercial framework.
  • Coordinate cross-functional input from Finance, Product, Legal, and other subject matter experts, ensuring assumptions, dependencies, and ownership are clear.
  • Evaluate pricing scenarios, margin impact, commercial trade-offs, and material deal risks to support informed negotiation and approval decisions.
  • Support Sales in developing commercially credible proposals while maintaining clear ownership of customer negotiations and sales strategy within the Sales organization.
  • Model commercial scenarios using cost and pricing inputs to support deal evaluation and client-facing forecasting, developing proficiency in ESW’s forecasting and customer review tools.
  • Work with Finance, Product, and relevant stakeholders to define and maintain pricing standards, commercial guardrails, and clear definitions of standard services, chargeable add-ons, and non-standard requirements.
  • Partner with Finance and Product teams on pricing models for new products and services, ensuring they can be applied effectively within the Deal Desk process.
  • Identify areas where unclear, inconsistent, or missing pricing creates deal friction and drive scalable improvements through stakeholder alignment.
  • Ensure contracts, order forms, and commercial handovers align with approved deal structures and that assumptions and obligations are communicated effectively to downstream teams, including Legal, Delivery, and Customer Success.
  • Partner with RevOps and Enablement teams to embed approved Deal Desk standards into Salesforce, reporting, onboarding, and sales guidance.
  • Monitor Deal Desk performance, approval turnaround times, commercial trends, and recurring rework, providing insights and recommendations to commercial leadership and coordinating agreed improvement initiatives through implementation.

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of experience in Deal Desk, Commercial Operations, Sales Finance, Pricing, or a similar commercial governance role.
  • Degree in Business, Finance, Economics, or a related discipline is desirable.
  • Experience owning or significantly improving deal approval frameworks, commercial guardrails, and cross-functional governance processes.
  • Strong commercial judgement with the ability to evaluate pricing, margin, contractual terms, commercial risk, and operational implications.
  • Ability to challenge proposals constructively, influence senior stakeholders, and uphold agreed governance standards.
  • Advanced Excel skills with experience modelling commercial scenarios using cost and pricing inputs and translating findings into clear recommendations.
  • Strong analytical, organizational, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Ability to work effectively across cross-functional teams in a fast-paced environment.
  • Experience supporting pricing frameworks and commercial governance in a global or high-growth technology environment is desirable.

About ESW

Our purpose is simple: to create moments that matter between people and the brands they cherish. We enable brands to expand their global reach, facilitating simple and seamless ecommerce experiences for consumers worldwide. Through our integration solutions, we deliver a complete international checkout experience, including local duties, taxes, fulfilment, delivery management, and global returns and payment processing capabilities.
Guided by our values - Own It, Champion Simplicity, Win as One, and Debate then Commit—we strive to foster innovation, accountability, and teamwork, creating solutions that inspire trust and drive impactful results.

Why join us

  • Competitive salary and benefits: Your financial well being is important to us. Join ESW and experience the satisfaction of being rewarded for your hard work, dedication and commitment.
  • Professional and personal development: Find your spark and leave your mark. We will ensure your talent is nurtured and cultivated for growth and success throughout your career with ESW.
  • Hybrid Working: Our Hybrid Working Model empowers you to embrace the flexibility of hybrid working and enjoy the best of office and remote work.
  • Diversity, Belonging & Inclusion: When we win, we win together. You'll be part of a culture that values every individual for who they are, fostering an environment where uniqueness is encouraged.

ESW is an equal opportunity employer, and we’re proud of our ongoing efforts to foster diversity, equity, & inclusion in the workplace. Individuals seeking employment and employees at ESW are considered without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, marital status, medical condition, ancestry, disability, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

title: Full-Stack Engineer, ML Tooling and Infrastructure
description:
About Mecka AI

Mecka AI is building the data infrastructure layer for robotics and embodied AI.
We design and operate global systems for data capture, data labeling, and hardware-enabled workflows used by leading AI labs and robotics companies to train and validate humanoid and embodied AI systems.


We work closely with frontier robotics teams to bridge real-world data, simulation, learning-based systems, and deployed hardware.

The Role

This role exists as a high-leverage force multiplier for our core Computer Vision Machine Learning (CVML) team. You are not building the foundational models for our robotics systems; rather, you own the critical infrastructure, internal tooling, and targeted ML services that enable the CVML team to move fast.

You will own the internal annotation platform used by our labeling team and develop lightweight, high-reliability ML services like our Personal Identifiable Information (PII) blurring pipeline. This is a true hybrid engineering role demanding competence in both deploying practical ML models and writing robust, user-facing full-stack applications.

Responsibilities

Internal Tooling & Infrastructure

  • Own the Annotation Platform (CVA): Build and maintain the web application our labeling team uses daily. You will ship new task types, review workflows, keyboard-driven UI features, and progress dashboards.

  • Data Pipelines: Write the glue code to efficiently move video frames, metadata, and JSON payloads between cloud storage, databases, and the client application.

  • Quality Measurement: Build tools to track inter-annotator agreement, audit sampling, and dataset health.

Targeted ML Services

  • PII Blur as a Service: Own the pipeline that detects and blurs faces, screens, and license plates in delivered footage. This is a strict, customer-facing system that must perfectly balance privacy compliance with data preservation.

  • Model-Assisted Labeling: Deploy and optimize lightweight detection and segmentation models (e.g., bounding box assists) so annotators correct rather than create from scratch.

  • Inference Optimization: Take off-the-shelf or provided PyTorch models, optimize them (e.g., TensorRT, ONNX), and wrap them in fast, concurrent APIs to serve the tooling UI.

Who You Are

Required Skills (The Hard Bar)

  • Heavy Frontend Engineering: You can confidently build and ship interactive web applications (React, Vue, or modern JS/TS). You understand how to handle complex state, canvas-based rendering, or video playback in the browser without tanking performance.

  • Production-Grade Python: You know how to build fast, concurrent APIs (FastAPI, gRPC) that don't choke on high-volume media requests.

  • Practical Applied ML: You have experience fine-tuning and deploying detection, segmentation, or tracking models on messy, real-world data. You know how to take a model out of a Jupyter notebook and make it run reliably in a pipeline.

Strong Signals

  • You have built or heavily customized an annotation UI (handling bounding boxes, polygons, keypoints) and understand the pain points of human-in-the-loop workflows.

  • Deep familiarity with video processing pipelines (FFmpeg, frame extraction, codec handling, latency optimization).

  • Familiarity with active learning workflows or mining hard negatives to iteratively improve datasets.

  • You care deeply about UI/UX and measure your success by the workflow speed of the end-user.

Who Will Not Enjoy This Role

  • Core ML Architects: If your primary goal is designing novel neural network architectures or working on frontier foundation models, this is the wrong fit. Your ML work here uses established architectures to solve practical pipeline problems (like PII detection).

  • Backend-Only Engineers: If you dislike writing TypeScript, debugging CSS, or thinking about UI workflows, you will struggle. You own the frontend annotation product just as much as the ML services.

  • Data-Allergic Engineers: If you expect a perfectly clean, balanced dataset handed to you, this isn't the role. You are building the systems that create and sanitize that data.

Inclusive Hiring at Mecka

We are committed to creating an inclusive and supportive candidate experience. Should you require any accommodation whatsoever during the interview process, please inform us without any hesitation. Mecka is dedicated to ensuring equal treatment and opportunity in all phases of recruitment, selection, and employment, in compliance with employment law. We do not discriminate based on gender, race, religion, national origin, ethnicity, disability, gender identity/expression, sexual orientation, veteran or military status, or any other protected category. Mecka is proud to be an equal opportunity employer, fostering a culture of inclusivity and maintaining a work environment that is free from discrimination, harassment, and retaliation.

Use of Artificial Intelligence in Recruitment

Mecka uses artificial intelligence (AI) responsibly to support administrative and efficiency-focused aspects of our recruitment process. This includes activities such as drafting job descriptions, generating interview questions, note-taking and recordings, and supporting sourcing and scheduling workflows. All candidate evaluations, interviews, and hiring decisions are made by members of the Mecka team. While AI tools may assist with screening and assessment, they do not replace human judgment in selection decisions. Our use of AI is intended to streamline routine tasks, improve consistency, and enhance the overall candidate experience. We are committed to upholding principles of fairness, transparency, and accountability in all hiring activities. Mecka regularly reviews its recruitment practices to mitigate bias and to ensure alignment with applicable laws and evolving best practices.
