title: DevOps Engineer
description:
We are seeking an experienced DevOps Engineer with strong DevSecOps experience to design, implement, automate, and maintain secure, scalable, and reliable cloud infrastructure and CI/CD pipelines. The successful candidate will work closely with development, infrastructure, operations, data, and security teams to automate software delivery, improve infrastructure reliability, and integrate security practices throughout the software development lifecycle. The role involves supporting cloud-based data platforms, implementing Infrastructure-as-Code, managing CI/CD pipelines, deploying containerized workloads, and ensuring appropriate security, compliance, and governance controls are embedded within the DevOps environment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, maintain, and optimize CI/CD pipelines using GitLab CI/CD and related DevOps tools.
  • Automate application build, testing, deployment, and release processes.
  • Implement and manage Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) using Terraform .
  • Deploy, configure, and maintain cloud infrastructure and containerized workloads on AWS .
  • Manage and optimize cloud infrastructure for reliability, scalability, performance, and availability.
  • Integrate DevSecOps practices into CI/CD pipelines, including automated security, vulnerability, dependency, and code-quality checks.
  • Configure and maintain security and code-quality tools such as SonarQube, Fortify, and Nexus IQ .
  • Perform vulnerability scanning, security assessment, system hardening, remediation, and patching activities.
  • Implement appropriate access controls, secrets management, encryption, and key-management practices.
  • Monitor infrastructure, applications, deployment pipelines, and security events to identify and resolve issues.
  • Support security incident investigation, vulnerability management, and remediation activities.
  • Coordinate security assessments, penetration testing, compliance scanning, and remediation of identified findings.
  • Develop and maintain scripts and automation using Python, Bash, PowerShell , or similar technologies.
  • Deploy and manage containerized applications using Docker and Kubernetes .
  • Troubleshoot infrastructure, deployment, application, cloud, and security-related issues.
  • Collaborate with development, data, infrastructure, security, and operations teams to deliver reliable and secure solutions.
  • Maintain technical documentation, deployment procedures, configuration standards, and operational runbooks.
  • Participate in Agile practices, continuous improvement, and automation initiatives.

Required Qualifications & Experience

  • Degree or Diploma in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline.
  • Minimum 3 years of relevant experience in DevOps, Cloud Engineering, Infrastructure Engineering, or related roles.
  • Strong hands-on experience in DevOps engineering, including CI/CD, infrastructure automation, cloud deployment, and operational support.
  • Hands-on experience with AWS cloud services and cloud infrastructure.
  • Strong experience with GitLab CI/CD and automated deployment pipelines.
  • Hands-on experience with Terraform or other Infrastructure-as-Code technologies.
  • Experience with DevSecOps practices, including integrating security controls and automated security testing into CI/CD pipelines.
  • Experience with tools such as SonarQube, Fortify, Nexus IQ, or equivalent security and code-quality platforms.
  • Experience with vulnerability assessment, security scanning, system hardening, and remediation.
  • Experience with Docker and Kubernetes or similar containerization and orchestration technologies.
  • Strong scripting and automation skills using Python, Bash, PowerShell, or similar languages.
  • Understanding of cloud security, IAM/access controls, encryption, secrets management, and key management.
  • Experience with infrastructure and application monitoring, troubleshooting, and incident management.
  • Good understanding of DevOps and DevSecOps principles and secure software development practices.
  • Experience working in Agile development environments.

Preferred Skills

  • Experience with AWS Government Commercial Cloud (GCC) or similar regulated cloud environments.
  • Familiarity with security and compliance frameworks such as NIST, ISO 27001, or CIS Benchmarks.
  • Experience with security assessments, compliance scanning, security acceptance testing, and remediation.
  • Familiarity with tools and platforms such as SHIP-HATS, CloudSCAPE, ABLR, GCSOC, CAM, VMS, or SSAT.
  • AWS, DevOps, or relevant cloud/security certifications.

Personal Attributes

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Good communication and collaboration abilities.
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to security best practices.
  • Proactive approach to automation, monitoring, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement.

title: VP, Market Intelligence, EMEA
description:
About Nscale

At Nscale, we are building the infrastructure for the AI revolution. Nscale are developing cutting-edge sovereign generative AI solutions, powered by a new generation of high-performance, sustainable data centres and GPUs built specifically for AI workloads.

The growth of artificial intelligence is driving unprecedented global demand for compute and GPU infrastructure. Nscale is positioned at the heart of this transformation, building the platforms that will enable superintelligence.

Nscale are working closely with the world’s most advanced AI technology providers, integrating next-gen compute hardware and GPU clusters in both partner and Nscale built facilities. This is an opportunity to join Nscale’s journey, play a key role in delivering transformative AI infrastructure, and help shape a company designed to scale rapidly across Europe and beyond.

The Role

We’re looking for a well-connected, highly capablle VP, Market Intelligence, to own Nscale’s view of the data centre market and act as our first point of contact for third-party DC capacity, and in many cases for land and power opportunities, across EMEA.

Reporting to the SVP Development, EMEA, and a senior member of the DCI team, you will drive our expansion strategy in existing and new markets and build the supplier relationships that give Nscale the best pool of supply options. You will qualify options and work with our Development Directors to secure capacity for realisation by the Nscale Delivery team. You will be hands-on, building a team around you, and will carry a strong external profile for Nscale in the markets that matter to us.

Key Responsibilities

  • Market Intelligence: Own Nscale’s view of the data centre industry, providing leading insight on industry-wide and individual market trends, the development pipeline by market and operator, and competitor capacity, contracts and strategy.
  • Expansion: Drive Nscale’s expansion strategy across existing and new markets and provide market briefings that guide where and when we grow and deploy.
  • Regional Alignment: Work hand in glove with the regional MDs to align market strategy with local targets and priorities.
  • Capacity Planning: Track capacity options and DC inventory timelines across self-build and third-party opportunities, so we know what can be secured, where, at what cost, and by when.
  • Demand Matching: Match end-user requirements to our development and delivery pipeline, so capacity is secured against real demand.
  • External Relationships: Build and maintain relationships with a broad group of capacity providers in key markets, acting as Nscale’s initial point of contact and ensuring access to supply options as needed.
  • Power & Land: Track grid connection timelines, power pricing and land availability across target markets, acting as initial point of contact with landowners, developers and utilities before handover to Development.
  • Benchmarking: Maintain cost and pricing benchmarks, and a rolling view of AI compute demand that sizes our pipeline.
  • Governance & Reporting: Provide regular market reporting to leadership and the board as a single agreed source of truth, plus rapid deep dives as needed.
  • Team Building & Leadership: Help build, establish and lead a high-performing market intelligence team, fostering collaboration with Development, Delivery, and Strategy & Corporate Development teams.
  • Industry Profile: Maintain a strong industry profile through conferences, networking and published insight.

Who You Are

  • Experienced – 10+ years in data centre or infrastructure research, market strategy, development or capacity sourcing, with an operator, developer, advisory firm or investor.
  • Culture – align with Nscale’s mission statement, objectives and work culture. We are a fast paced, collaborative team, who provide autonomy, but require accountability.
  • Well Connected – an established network across European data centre operators, developers and capacity providers, and the credibility to represent Nscale publicly.
  • A Builder – proven track record establishing a research or intelligence capability, and its data, from scratch, with the modelling skills to back it up.
  • Commercially Astute – fluent in power, land and capacity markets, and able to judge whether an option is genuinely deliverable and good value.
  • Collaborative – comfortable across regions, time zones and disciplines, partnering closely with Development, Delivery and Strategy & Corporate Development.
  • Startup / Scaleup Ready – Flexible, proactive, and ready to help build world-leading AI systems, culture, and scale.

Why Join Nscale?

  • Join at the point where Nscale’s European growth programme is being set, your insight and network will shape where we go next.
  • Build the Market Intelligence team from the ground up, with a mandate to build a best-in-class function.
  • Own the market view and the relationships that turn insight into secured capacity.
  • Be part of a fast-moving, high-growth company built on autonomy, accountability, and technical excellence.

What we offer:

We believe that embracing diverse perspectives and experiences helps us build a stronger community and achieve better business results.

Join us and help shape the future of audio healthcare solutions at scale.

We encourage all relevant applicants to apply. We are committed to celebrating human diversity, and we trust that the best way to reach outstanding business results, is by welcoming diverse people into our community.

About us

3Shape started with a simple idea - to make 3D scanning better. First, we applied it to the hearing industry, then we succeeded in dentistry. Twenty years later, 3Shape has 2,000+ employees globally. With the help of dental professionals and amazing colleagues we’re creating award-winning scanning and CAD/CAM solutions to change dentistry together! Together, we contribute to a better world. Please apply on-line and provide a resume & cover letter that best demonstrate your motivation and ability to meet the requirements of this role.

title: Legal Advisor - Glasgow
description:
Join Leyton's Growing Legal & Compliance Team

Are you a commercially minded legal professional looking for an opportunity to make a real impact within a fast-growing international business?

At Leyton, we're looking for a Legal Advisor to join our expanding Legal & Compliance team. Working closely with our Head of Legal & Compliance and Legal Assistant, you'll play a key role in supporting the business across a broad range of legal and regulatory matters.

This is an exciting opportunity for someone who enjoys balancing technical legal expertise with commercial thinking, whilst helping shape and improve legal processes within a collaborative and forward-thinking environment.

The Role

As Legal Advisor, you'll provide practical, commercially focused legal support across the business, helping to manage contractual, compliance and regulatory matters while building strong relationships with stakeholders across multiple departments.

You'll be involved in reviewing and negotiating contracts, advising on compliance matters, supporting data protection initiatives and contributing to the continued development of Leyton's Legal & Compliance function.

Key Responsibilities

Contract Management

  • Draft, review and negotiate client agreements, consultancy agreements and supplier contracts.

  • Advise on contractual risk and provide pragmatic commercial solutions.

  • Support the management of post-signature contractual matters.

  • Assist in developing contract playbooks and standard documentation.

Legal & Compliance

  • Support anti-money laundering (AML) processes and wider compliance initiatives.

  • Assist with GDPR and data protection compliance, including maintaining relevant records.

  • Contribute to policy reviews and internal risk assessments.

Business Partnering

  • Act as a trusted advisor to colleagues across Sales, Consulting, Finance and Operations.

  • Provide clear, practical legal advice tailored to non-legal stakeholders.

  • Deliver legal and compliance guidance in a responsive and approachable manner.

Continuous Improvement

  • Help improve legal processes through automation, AI and smarter ways of working.

  • Support the delivery of legal and compliance training across the business.

  • Contribute to the ongoing growth and development of the Legal & Compliance function.

About You

We're looking for someone who combines strong legal knowledge with commercial awareness and enjoys working in a collaborative, fast-paced environment.

You'll ideally have:

  • A minimum of 2–3 years' post-qualified experience (PQE).

  • An LLB (or equivalent), together with the Diploma in Professional Legal Practice (DPLP), Solicitors Qualifying Examination (SQE), or equivalent qualification.

  • Strong experience reviewing and negotiating commercial contracts.

  • A good understanding of contract law, GDPR and anti-money laundering requirements.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain legal concepts clearly.

  • Exceptional organisational skills and attention to detail.

  • The confidence to manage multiple priorities and work independently where required.

  • A proactive mindset with an interest in improving processes and embracing technology.

Why Join Leyton?

Leyton is an international consultancy that helps businesses innovate, grow and maximise opportunities through specialist funding and advisory services. As our Legal & Compliance function continues to evolve, you'll have the opportunity to influence how legal support is delivered across the business and help shape best practice.

In return, we offer:

  • Competitive salary and benefits package.

  • Ongoing professional development.

  • A supportive and collaborative working environment.

  • The opportunity to work on varied, commercially focused legal matters.

  • The chance to contribute to process innovation and the adoption of new legal technologies.

If you're looking for a role where your legal expertise will have genuine business impact and where you'll be encouraged to innovate, collaborate and grow, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Myymäläpäällikkö Kuopioon
description:
Etsimme nyt Kuopion myymälään

Myymäläpäällikköä

Myymäläpäällikkönä Puuilossa

  • Myymäläpäällikkö toimii koko myymälän henkilökunnan hallinnollisena sekä operatiivisena lähiesihenkilönä. Työpäivät kuluvat myymälässä yhdessä henkilökunnan kanssa ja lisäksi työtehtäviin kuuluu muun muassa myynnin ja tunnuslukujen seuranta, tiimin perehdyttäminen ja valmentaminen, rekrytoinnit sekä myymälän työvuorojen suunnittelu.

  • Myymäläpäällikön tehtävänä on kasvattaa myymälän myyntiä sekä johtaa ja organisoida kaikkia myymälän toimintoja siten, että jokainen tiimiläinen on motivoitunut ja sitoutunut tekemään parhaansa. Johtaminen tapahtuu myymälän arjessa. Myymäläpäällikkö ohjaa, tukee ja varmistaa sujuvan arjen toteutumisen.

  • Meillä johdetaan empaattisesti sekä ongelmanratkaisukeskeisesti, jotta tiimiläiset voivat kehittyä omassa työssään. Vuorovaikutteinen palautekulttuuri on osa meidän arkeamme. Huomioimme toistemme onnistumiset ja uskallamme puhua myös asioista, joita voimme tehdä paremmin. Arjessa annetaan palautetta, jonka avulla henkilökunnan ammattitaito kasvaa ja tiimin työskentely tehostuu. Myymäläpäällikkö kehittää myös omaa toimintaansa saamansa palautteen avulla.

Mitä Puuilo tarjoaa Sinulle?

  • Monipuolisen ja vastuullisen tehtävän Tässä tehtävässä sinulla on mahdollisuus käyttää ja kehittää laajasti omaa osaamistasi.

  • Kasvuyhtiön tarjoamat mahdollisuudet Meillä pääset osaksi menestyvää ja nopeasti kasvavaa yritystä, joten pääset omalla toiminnallasi vaikuttamaan yhtiön kehitykseen ja kasvuun.

  • Kattavan perehdytyksen Saat perusteellisen perehdytyksen tehtävääsi, jotta voit aloittaa työskentelyn vahvalla pohjalla. Panostamme siihen, että tunnet olosi tervetulleeksi ja saat tukemme uusiin haasteisiin.

  • Ammatillista valmennusta ja kouluttautumismahdollisuuden Panostamme henkilöstömme ammatilliseen kehittymiseen tarjoamalla erilaisia kouluttautumismahdollisuuksia. Lisäksi valmennamme esihenkilöitämme säännöllisesti, jotta jokaisella olisi parhaat työkalut johtaa omaa tiimiä onnistumaan.

  • Mahdollisuuden kehittyä vaativampiin tehtäviin Olet merkittävässä roolissa organisaatiossamme ja haluamme tukea sinua urallasi tarjoamalla monipuolisia mahdollisuuksia edetä vaativampiin tehtäviin.

Yksi meidän tärkeimmistä arvoistamme on ILO ja meillä pääset osaksi positiivista ja kannustavaa työilmapiiriä, missä jokainen voi tuntea olonsa arvostetuksi.

Mitä odotamme Sinulta?

  • Kokemusta kaupan alan esihenkilötyöstä Ymmärrät kaupan alan toimintaympäristöä, ja sinulla on kykyä johtaa tiimiäsi menestyksekkäästi kohti yhteisiä tavoitteita.

  • Vahva kaupallinen näkemys Sinulla on vahvaa kaupallista näkemystä ja kykyä tehdä päätöksiä, jotka tukevat liiketoiminnan kasvua ja kannattavuutta.

  • Halu kehittyä omassa työssä sekä esihenkilönä Olet motivoitunut oppimaan uutta ja haluat jatkuvasti kehittää itseäsi esihenkilönä. Pyrit myös tukemaan tiimisi jäsenten kehittymistä ja auttamaan heitä saavuttamaan omat tavoitteensa.

  • Modernia ja valmentavaa johtamisotetta Uskot valmentavaan johtamiseen ja osaat valmentaa tiimisi jäsenet parhaisiin suorituksiin. Luot avoimen ja kannustavan ilmapiirin, jossa jokaisella on mahdollisuus onnistua.

  • Kykyä johtaa muuttuvassa toimintaympäristössä Olet sopeutumiskykyinen ja osaat johtaa tiimiäsi tehokkaasti myös kasvuyhtiön muutosten keskellä. Näet muutokset mahdollisuuksina ja luotsaat tiimiäsi kohti yhteisiä tavoitteita.

  • Kokemusta työvuorosuunnittelusta ja TES tuntemusta Ymmärrät miten, työvuorosuunnittelun avulla varmistetaan sujuva ja tehokas työskentely myymälässä sekä optimoidaan resurssien käyttö oikeudenmukaisesti ja tasapuolisesti.

Myymälämme ovat täynnä vauhtia sekä radiopuhelimen rätinää ja se onkin olennainen osa Puuilon ainutlaatuista kulttuuria. Meillä olet valmis ajamaan trukkia ja avustamaan peräkärryjen kasaamisessa. Työskentely vaatii heittäytymistä monenlaisiin tilanteisiin ja kykyä johtaa kasvuyhtiön nopeatempoisessa ja muuttuvassa työympäristössä.

Tuemme tavoitetta savuttomasta Suomesta 2030, emmekä käytä työaikana mitään tupakkatuotteita.

title: Product Manager, In-Person Giving
description:
Highlights:

Location: Spain

Language: Fluent in Russian and English (C1+)

About Fundraise Up

We’re Fundraise Up - a global fundraising platform built to make donating to nonprofits fast, seamless, and accessible to all. Every month, our technology powers tens of millions of dollars in donations across the globe. We focus on innovation that directly impacts results: faster load times, higher conversion rates, global payment support, and accessibility-first design.

Our platform is trusted by many of the world’s leading nonprofits, including UNICEF, the Alzheimer’s Association, and a wide range of global NGOs. With a 4.9/5 rating across top software review platforms, we’re recognized not just for our impact - but for the quality of the product we deliver.

A Truly Global Product

We operate in the enterprise segment, serving nonprofit organizations across North America, the United Kingdom, Australia, and Europe.

We’re building a large and complex product ecosystem that serves nonprofits, donors, and partners around the world. The platform includes a modern checkout experience and customizable widgets (each a standalone SPA), donor, organization, and partner portals, admin tools, and several internal apps.

The Team

We are a distributed team of 160+ product professionals. Our team members are mainly based across Spain, Poland, Portugal, Georgia, Armenia, Serbia, Turkey, and Cyprus.

Despite our scale, we operate like a focused team - where every task matters and every voice is heard. We value thoughtful collaboration, strong engineering practices, and a product mindset. You’ll be joining a team where quality, mentorship, and mutual respect come first.

About In-Person Giving at Fundraise Up

In-Person Giving brings the quality and connected data of Fundraise Up’s online donation experience into physical fundraising moments.

The product begins with Tap to Donate and Giving Station: staff-led and self-service experiences that let nonprofits accept contactless donations at events, in public spaces, and through other offline workflows. Every transaction should connect to the same campaigns, donor records, reporting, CRM integrations, and operational controls used across Fundraise Up.

The next product direction is Events & Commerce. It includes ticket sales, check-in, merchandise and food purchases, symbolic purchases, auctions, paddle raises, and additional donations before and during an event. These capabilities must work as one connected fundraising system rather than another isolated event tool.

About the Role

We are hiring a Product Manager to own Events & Commerce within the broader In-Person Giving product line.

This is a hands-on software product role covering discovery, definition, delivery, launch, and iteration. You will turn a large category into a focused product direction grounded in customer workflows, live usage, and commercial evidence.

You will work closely with the PM responsible for the broader In-Person Giving area so that event commerce builds on the same payment, campaign, donor-data, reporting, mobile, and operational foundations as Tap to Donate and Giving Station. You will also partner with the Peer-to-Peer team where ticketing and event capabilities should be shared rather than rebuilt separately.

This is not an event-planning, sales, or internal project-coordination role.

What You’ll Own

Define the product direction

  • Turn customer research, market evidence, and business context into a clear Events & Commerce product thesis and sequenced roadmap.
  • Choose a focused target segment and event scenario rather than trying to replace every event platform at once.
  • Decide which capabilities belong in the shared In-Person Giving foundation and which require an Events-specific model.
  • Make explicit decisions about what Fundraise Up should build, integrate, partner on, or deliberately exclude.
  • Keep assumptions, success metrics, scope, risks, and product decisions visible.

Lead discovery and product definition

  • Work directly with nonprofit fundraising teams, event operators, finance teams, volunteers, attendees, donors, design partners, and internal GTM teams.
  • Map the complete workflow before, during, and after an event—including purchase, donation, check-in, fulfillment, reconciliation, reporting, and follow-up.
  • Validate decisions through interviews, workflow observation, prototypes, and live product usage.
  • Separate true adoption blockers from feature requests and expectations created by incumbent event platforms.
  • Shape problems such as ticket sales, QR-based check-in, guest management, commerce catalogues, FMV and receipts, on-site purchases, auctions, paddle raises, refunds, attribution, reporting, and integrations. These are examples—not a pre-committed feature checklist.

Shape and deliver the product

  • Own the product from problem definition through requirements, delivery, launch, and iteration.
  • Write clear requirements, acceptance criteria, edge cases, state transitions, and decision records.
  • Make day-to-day scope and trade-off decisions with Engineering, Design, Analytics, Research, QA, and GTM partners.
  • Design for real event conditions: staff and volunteer operators, self-service flows, mobile devices, optional hardware, unreliable connectivity, high-volume moments, and operational recovery.
  • Ensure that event capabilities reuse Fundraise Up’s existing payments, campaign, donor, reporting, CRM, and identity infrastructure wherever possible.
  • Keep delivery predictable by surfacing dependencies, risks, and unresolved decisions early.

Launch, learn, and drive outcomes

  • Launch through EAPs with clear entry criteria, target workflows, success measures, readiness requirements, and out-of-scope areas.
  • Understand whether organizations can configure and run the target event workflows without heavy manual work or disconnected tools.
  • Measure whether attendees can purchase, check in, donate, and receive the right confirmation or receipt through a clear experience.
  • Partner with Product Marketing, Sales, CSM, Support, Finance, Legal, and Operations on positioning, commitments, enablement, and launch readiness.
  • Connect product evidence to activation, adoption, event completion, GPV, expansion, pipeline, retention, and operational cost.
  • Turn evidence into explicit recommendations: iterate, expand, change direction, partner, or stop.

Work AI-native

  • Use AI for research synthesis, workflow analysis, prototyping, specification quality, data exploration, and operational automation.
  • Build testable artifacts quickly without outsourcing product judgment.

Requirements

  • 4–7 years of Product Management or Product Ownership experience in a software product company.
  • End-to-end ownership of a customer-facing product area with Engineering and Design.
  • Strong judgment in reducing a large problem space to a focused release and explaining the trade-offs.
  • Experience turning customer evidence and product data into decisions.
  • Clear written communication across requirements, edge cases, metrics, and decision records.
  • Ability to work with transactional, multi-actor workflows involving permissions, states, money, and data relationships.
  • High ownership and independence, with fluent written and spoken English.

Strong plus

  • Experience with ticketing, event technology, commerce, POS, payments, marketplaces, registration, auctions, or other transaction-heavy products.
  • Experience with mobile applications, contactless payments, physical devices, or hardware-enabled workflows.
  • Experience with B2B SaaS, fundraising, nonprofits, or other operationally complex customer environments.
  • Experience launching a new product area through beta or EAP.
  • Knowledge of CRM integrations, financial reconciliation, reporting, transaction attribution, analytics, or SQL.
  • Practical use of AI for research, prototyping, analysis, or product operations.

This Role May Not Be a Fit If

  • You are looking for an event-planning or internal project-management role rather than software product ownership.
  • You prefer to receive a fully defined roadmap and requirements instead of helping determine what should be built.
  • You want to work only on strategy and avoid specifications, QA, delivery details, or post-launch iteration.
  • You treat every customer request as a roadmap commitment.
  • You need stable scope and certainty before moving forward.
  • You measure progress mainly by features shipped rather than customer and business outcomes.

Why work with us

  • Build a new product direction from research through live customer use.
  • Work in a large, proven fundraising category with clear customer demand and meaningful commercial potential.
  • Shape ticketing and event commerce as part of a broader fundraising platform rather than an isolated event tool.
  • Work with real nonprofit customers, rich product evidence, and experienced cross-functional partners.
  • Join a small team where product managers have meaningful ownership and direct access to Product leadership.
  • Help define an AI-native approach to product management in practice.
  • Build technology that helps nonprofits engage more supporters and raise more money for their missions.

Compensation

  • The compensation range for this role is €5,600 - €6,100 gross.
  • Final compensation will be determined based on relevant experience, skills, qualifications, alignment with the role’s requirements and location.

Benefits

  • Private medical insurance for the employee and their family
  • 23 paid vacation days per year
  • 11 paid public holidays per year
  • 5 company-paid sick leave days
  • English learning courses
  • Relevant professional education
  • Gym or swimming pool
  • Home Office Setup Assistance: the company offers assistance with purchasing furniture (office chair, office desk, monitor) and other items to create a comfortable workspace
  • Co-working
  • Remote working

**Please note: All official correspondence from Fundraise Up will exclusively originate from the @fundraiseup.com domain. Exercise caution and ensure the authenticity of emails claiming to be from our company.

We are an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, national origin, disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law in the countries where we operate.

title: QA Automation Engineer
description:
We’re looking for a QA Engineer to join our Data and AI Engineering team. This is a mid-senior role for someone who can own test planning and execution independently for designing test strategies, building automated regression coverage, and safeguarding release quality without needing close supervision.

You'll work across our applications and platforms to test features end-to-end, build and maintain automated test suites, and dig into bugs at the browser and API level. We're a life sciences consultancy, so documentation and traceability matter as much as catching the bug itself .
We welcome QA engineers who take as much pride in rigorous, well-documented testing as in finding the edge cases. What You’ll Do
  • Own test strategy end-to-end for features and releases as defining scope from specs and user stories, designing test plans, and executing them systematically with minimal oversight.
  • Build and maintain automated regression suites (Selenium, Playwright, or Cypress) integrated into CI, plus API-level tests (Postman, pytest + requests) that validate endpoints independently of the UI.
  • Reproduce and document bugs at the request/response level using browser developer tools (Network, Console, Elements), including issues tied to sessions, tokens, and cookies in authenticated flows.
  • Raise, triage, and track defects with clear severity classification, and drive them through to resolution.
  • Coordinate regression testing cycles and UAT with business stakeholders ahead of releases.
  • Produce clear documentation like process runbooks, incident reports (root cause, impact, timeline, resolution), and test strategy/spec documents ready for stakeholder sign-off.
  • Collaborate with developers, product, and business stakeholders to translate requirements into testable, traceable acceptance criteria.
  • Apply the traceability and version-control discipline expected of QA work in a regulated environment.
What We’re Looking For
We’re committed to building a skilled and diverse engineering team. If you care deeply about writing clean code, delivering resilient systems, and collaborating across disciplines then this role is for you.

Core Experience & Skills
  • Test Planning & Execution: proven ability to own a test strategy end-to-end from a spec or user story with minimal guidance such as scope definition, traceable test cases, systematic execution, and release sign-off.
  • Test Automation & Browser Scripting: hands-on experience with Selenium, Playwright, or Cypress, building and maintaining a regression suite that runs as part of CI.
  • API Testing: comfortable validating endpoints independently of the UI using tools such as Postman or pytest + requests.
  • Advanced Web Application Usage & Browser Tooling: proficient with browser developer tools (Network, Console, Elements) to reproduce and document bugs at the request/response level; understanding of sessions, tokens, and cookies in authenticated applications.
  • Documentation: strong written communication across process docs, incident reports, and test strategy/spec documents, with attention to traceability and version control.
  • Demonstrated track record owning test plans across multiple projects to be able to point to real examples of taking a feature or release from requirements to test sign-off with minimal guidance.
  • Team-first mindset and experience in agile environments (Scrum or Kanban).
  • SQL for querying a database to verify backend state and test results.
  • Domain knowledge of clinical trial data, healthcare analytics, or other regulated industry datasets.
  • Computer System Validation (CSV): familiarity with IQ/OQ/PQ validation protocols, 21 CFR Part 11 considerations, and deviation/CAPA processes in a regulated software environment.
  • Knowledge of Git/version control for collaborative development projects.
  • Experience with cloud platforms (Azure, AWS, or GCP).
  • Understanding of GxP compliance, or other regulated industry standards.
  • Middle / Senior.
  • Professional working proficiency in English (our internal and client-facing working language).
  • Spanish and/or Catalan language skills are nice to have.
  • Hybrid work model and flexible working schedule that would suit night owls and early birds.
  • 25 holiday days per year.
  • Opportunities for career development and to shape the company future.
  • An employee-centric culture directly inspired by employee feedback - your voice is heard, and your perspective encouraged.
  • Different training programs to support your personal and professional development.
  • Work in a fast growing, international company.
  • Friendly atmosphere and supportive Management team.

title: Full Stack Developer (Web/Mobile)
description:
Summary

We’re looking for a Full Stack Developer with experience across web (Angular), backend (C#/.NET), and mobile (Flutter), along with hands‑on CMS and SEO know‑how. Beyond technical skill, we want someone with the right mindset, attitude, and passion. The kind of person who instinctively does things the right way, takes ownership, and cares about the craft. You’ll build and maintain scalable, high‑quality applications, collaborate closely with cross‑functional teams, and contribute to architectural and technical decisions across the squad.

Job Description

Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, test, and deploy web, backend, and mobile applications across multiple platforms.
  • Translate business and functional requirements into robust, maintainable technical solutions.
  • Contribute to system architecture, technical design, and integration approaches across web, mobile, and backend layers.
  • Build and maintain CMS‑driven websites, ensuring content workflows are efficient, flexible, and scalable.
  • Implement SEO best practices across web properties, including technical SEO, structured data, performance, and Core Web Vitals.
  • Collaborate with UI/UX, Product and Delivery teams to deliver intuitive and consistent user experiences.
  • Participate actively in Agile ceremonies, including sprint planning, backlog refinement, and retrospectives.
  • Identify opportunities for technical improvement, performance optimisation, and long‑term maintainability.
  • Stay current with evolving technologies and frameworks relevant to web, backend, and mobile development.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field.
  • 3-5 years of professional experience as a Full Stack Developer delivering production‑grade applications.
  • Strong experience in Angular for web application development.
  • Solid backend development experience using C# / .NET (ASP.NET Core), including RESTful APIs and integrations.
  • Hands‑on experience developing mobile applications using Flutter.
  • Experience working with CMS platforms (e.g. Sitefinity, Sitecore, Strapi, WordPress, or similar)
  • Strong understanding of SEO fundamentals: on‑page optimisation, structured data, sitemaps, canonicalisation, page performance, and accessibility as it relates to discoverability.
  • Experience designing and delivering multi‑platform, enterprise‑scale solutions.
  • Good understanding of modern application architectures and design patterns.
  • Experience working in Agile development environments.
  • Proficiency with Git‑based version control and collaboration tools (e.g. GitLab, Confluence, JIRA).
  • Strong problem‑solving skills and the ability to work independently as well as collaboratively.
  • Clear communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with both technical and non‑technical stakeholders.

title: Senior Technician, Facilities
location: Paranaque City, National Capital Region (Manila), Philippines
description:
The Allegro team is united by a clear purpose—advancing technologies that make the world safer, more efficient, and more sustainable. With over 30 years of experience in semiconductor innovation, we bring that purpose to life across every part of the business—from breakthrough product development and customer success to how we show up for each other and the communities we serve.

Job Summary:
The Senior Technician is a highly skilled trades professional who troubleshoots and repairs the most complex equipment issues and may lead maintenance projects. This role requires broad and comprehensive experience and knowledge of electronic, mechanical, and automated systems. Working with a high degree of autonomy, this individual is a proactive partner in improving equipment reliability and performance.

Key Responsibilities:
- Diagnoses and resolves the most complex equipment failures, often involving intermittent or system-level problems.
- Leads complex repair, overhaul, or installation projects for key manufacturing equipment.
- Trains and mentors other technicians on advanced troubleshooting techniques and new equipment.
- Analyzes equipment performance data to identify trends and recommend and implement improvements to maintenance procedures.

Qualifications:
- Typically requires a High School diploma or equivalent and 2-4 years of experience in a technical support role, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
- An Associate's degree or advanced technical certification is highly preferred.
- Advanced knowledge of complex electromechanical systems, robotics, and PLCs.
- Exceptional troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
- Proven ability to work independently and lead technical projects.

Why Allegro?

Join Allegro and become part of a team where your contributions truly matter.

We foster a culture of Real Innovation, empowering you to push boundaries, develop cutting-edge solutions, and drive continuous improvement.
Your work will create a Real Impact by solving complex real-world challenges that fuel our success and shape the future of technology.
You’ll experience Real Connection, collaborating with talented colleagues around the globe in an environment built on trust, respect, and a shared purpose.
Join us—and help build what’s next.

title: Product Manager, In-Person Giving
description:
Highlights:

Location: Turkey

Language: Fluent in Russian and English (C1+)

About Fundraise Up

We’re Fundraise Up - a global fundraising platform built to make donating to nonprofits fast, seamless, and accessible to all. Every month, our technology powers tens of millions of dollars in donations across the globe. We focus on innovation that directly impacts results: faster load times, higher conversion rates, global payment support, and accessibility-first design.

Our platform is trusted by many of the world’s leading nonprofits, including UNICEF, the Alzheimer’s Association, and a wide range of global NGOs. With a 4.9/5 rating across top software review platforms, we’re recognized not just for our impact - but for the quality of the product we deliver.

A Truly Global Product

We operate in the enterprise segment, serving nonprofit organizations across North America, the United Kingdom, Australia, and Europe.

We’re building a large and complex product ecosystem that serves nonprofits, donors, and partners around the world. The platform includes a modern checkout experience and customizable widgets (each a standalone SPA), donor, organization, and partner portals, admin tools, and several internal apps.

The Team

We are a distributed team of 160+ product professionals. Our team members are mainly based across Spain, Poland, Portugal, Georgia, Armenia, Serbia, Turkey, and Cyprus.

Despite our scale, we operate like a focused team - where every task matters and every voice is heard. We value thoughtful collaboration, strong engineering practices, and a product mindset. You’ll be joining a team where quality, mentorship, and mutual respect come first.

About In-Person Giving at Fundraise Up

In-Person Giving brings the quality and connected data of Fundraise Up’s online donation experience into physical fundraising moments.

The product begins with Tap to Donate and Giving Station: staff-led and self-service experiences that let nonprofits accept contactless donations at events, in public spaces, and through other offline workflows. Every transaction should connect to the same campaigns, donor records, reporting, CRM integrations, and operational controls used across Fundraise Up.

The next product direction is Events & Commerce. It includes ticket sales, check-in, merchandise and food purchases, symbolic purchases, auctions, paddle raises, and additional donations before and during an event. These capabilities must work as one connected fundraising system rather than another isolated event tool.

About the Role

We are hiring a Product Manager to own Events & Commerce within the broader In-Person Giving product line.

This is a hands-on software product role covering discovery, definition, delivery, launch, and iteration. You will turn a large category into a focused product direction grounded in customer workflows, live usage, and commercial evidence.

You will work closely with the PM responsible for the broader In-Person Giving area so that event commerce builds on the same payment, campaign, donor-data, reporting, mobile, and operational foundations as Tap to Donate and Giving Station. You will also partner with the Peer-to-Peer team where ticketing and event capabilities should be shared rather than rebuilt separately.

This is not an event-planning, sales, or internal project-coordination role.

What You’ll Own

Define the product direction

  • Turn customer research, market evidence, and business context into a clear Events & Commerce product thesis and sequenced roadmap.
  • Choose a focused target segment and event scenario rather than trying to replace every event platform at once.
  • Decide which capabilities belong in the shared In-Person Giving foundation and which require an Events-specific model.
  • Make explicit decisions about what Fundraise Up should build, integrate, partner on, or deliberately exclude.
  • Keep assumptions, success metrics, scope, risks, and product decisions visible.

Lead discovery and product definition

  • Work directly with nonprofit fundraising teams, event operators, finance teams, volunteers, attendees, donors, design partners, and internal GTM teams.
  • Map the complete workflow before, during, and after an event—including purchase, donation, check-in, fulfillment, reconciliation, reporting, and follow-up.
  • Validate decisions through interviews, workflow observation, prototypes, and live product usage.
  • Separate true adoption blockers from feature requests and expectations created by incumbent event platforms.
  • Shape problems such as ticket sales, QR-based check-in, guest management, commerce catalogues, FMV and receipts, on-site purchases, auctions, paddle raises, refunds, attribution, reporting, and integrations. These are examples—not a pre-committed feature checklist.

Shape and deliver the product

  • Own the product from problem definition through requirements, delivery, launch, and iteration.
  • Write clear requirements, acceptance criteria, edge cases, state transitions, and decision records.
  • Make day-to-day scope and trade-off decisions with Engineering, Design, Analytics, Research, QA, and GTM partners.
  • Design for real event conditions: staff and volunteer operators, self-service flows, mobile devices, optional hardware, unreliable connectivity, high-volume moments, and operational recovery.
  • Ensure that event capabilities reuse Fundraise Up’s existing payments, campaign, donor, reporting, CRM, and identity infrastructure wherever possible.
  • Keep delivery predictable by surfacing dependencies, risks, and unresolved decisions early.

Launch, learn, and drive outcomes

  • Launch through EAPs with clear entry criteria, target workflows, success measures, readiness requirements, and out-of-scope areas.
  • Understand whether organizations can configure and run the target event workflows without heavy manual work or disconnected tools.
  • Measure whether attendees can purchase, check in, donate, and receive the right confirmation or receipt through a clear experience.
  • Partner with Product Marketing, Sales, CSM, Support, Finance, Legal, and Operations on positioning, commitments, enablement, and launch readiness.
  • Connect product evidence to activation, adoption, event completion, GPV, expansion, pipeline, retention, and operational cost.
  • Turn evidence into explicit recommendations: iterate, expand, change direction, partner, or stop.

Work AI-native

  • Use AI for research synthesis, workflow analysis, prototyping, specification quality, data exploration, and operational automation.
  • Build testable artifacts quickly without outsourcing product judgment.

Requirements

  • 4–7 years of Product Management or Product Ownership experience in a software product company.
  • End-to-end ownership of a customer-facing product area with Engineering and Design.
  • Strong judgment in reducing a large problem space to a focused release and explaining the trade-offs.
  • Experience turning customer evidence and product data into decisions.
  • Clear written communication across requirements, edge cases, metrics, and decision records.
  • Ability to work with transactional, multi-actor workflows involving permissions, states, money, and data relationships.
  • High ownership and independence, with fluent written and spoken English.

Strong plus

  • Experience with ticketing, event technology, commerce, POS, payments, marketplaces, registration, auctions, or other transaction-heavy products.
  • Experience with mobile applications, contactless payments, physical devices, or hardware-enabled workflows.
  • Experience with B2B SaaS, fundraising, nonprofits, or other operationally complex customer environments.
  • Experience launching a new product area through beta or EAP.
  • Knowledge of CRM integrations, financial reconciliation, reporting, transaction attribution, analytics, or SQL.
  • Practical use of AI for research, prototyping, analysis, or product operations.

This Role May Not Be a Fit If

  • You are looking for an event-planning or internal project-management role rather than software product ownership.
  • You prefer to receive a fully defined roadmap and requirements instead of helping determine what should be built.
  • You want to work only on strategy and avoid specifications, QA, delivery details, or post-launch iteration.
  • You treat every customer request as a roadmap commitment.
  • You need stable scope and certainty before moving forward.
  • You measure progress mainly by features shipped rather than customer and business outcomes.

Why work with us

  • Build a new product direction from research through live customer use.
  • Work in a large, proven fundraising category with clear customer demand and meaningful commercial potential.
  • Shape ticketing and event commerce as part of a broader fundraising platform rather than an isolated event tool.
  • Work with real nonprofit customers, rich product evidence, and experienced cross-functional partners.
  • Join a small team where product managers have meaningful ownership and direct access to Product leadership.
  • Help define an AI-native approach to product management in practice.
  • Build technology that helps nonprofits engage more supporters and raise more money for their missions.

Compensation

  • The compensation range for this role is $4,600 - $5,000 gross.
  • Final compensation will be determined based on relevant experience, skills, qualifications, alignment with the role’s requirements and location.

Benefits

  • 31 days off
  • 100% paid telemedicine plan
  • Home Office Setup Assistance: the company offers assistance with purchasing furniture (office chair, office desk, monitor) and other items to create a comfortable workspace.
  • English learning courses
  • Relevant professional education
  • Gym or swimming pool
  • Co-working
  • Remote working

We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, national origin, disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law in the countries where we operate.

Du bör därför trivas med att vara självständig i ditt arbete, men bör också tycka om att sprida din kompetens och att arbeta tillsammans med andra. Hos oss kommer du alltid att ha ett nätverk av riktigt kompetenta kollegor att utbyta erfarenheter med!

title: Senior Staff Machine Learning Engineer (all gender)
description:
At HelloFresh, our mission is simple: to change the way people eat, forever. As a global digital-native FMCG company and the world's leading mealkit provider, we are transforming the traditional food supply chain through a data-driven, on-demand model that enables scalable and more sustainable food delivery. The HelloFresh Group includes eight brands serving customers across multiple meal occasions, including HelloFresh, Green Chef, EveryPlate, and Chefs Plate, as well as ready-to-eat meals from Factor and YouFoodz, meat and seafood subscriptions through Good Chop, and pet nutrition with The Pets Table. Through technology, data, and culinary innovation, we deliver personalized food experiences to millions of households worldwide.

## About HelloFresh

At HelloFresh, we want to change the way people eat forever by offering our customers high-quality food and recipes for different meal occasions. Even after celebrating our 10-year anniversary, we continue to see this mission spread around the world and beyond our wildest dreams. Now, we are a global food solutions group and the world's leading meal kit company, active in 18 countries across 3 continents. So, how did we do it? Our weekly boxes full of exciting recipes and fresh ingredients have blossomed into a community of customers looking for delicious, healthy and sustainable options. The HelloFresh Group now includes our core brand, HelloFresh, as well as: Green Chef, EveryPlate, Chefs Plate, Factor\_, YouFoodz, The Pets Table and GoodChop.

## About the Team

Menu Personalization decides what millions of customers see when they open HelloFresh each week. The team owns the recommender systems that match customers to recipes across our global markets, and brings together Data Scientists, Backend Engineers, Data Engineers, ML Engineers, and Product to take ideas from experiment to production. The work directly shapes customer experience and business growth: when personalization gets better, customers find recipes they love faster, and HelloFresh becomes a stronger weekly habit.

At HelloFresh we are moving away from a model where software developers just execute tickets toward one where engineers are trusted to own customer problems. You take a problem, form a point of view, validate it with customers and data, and ship it using AI as a force multiplier.

## About the Role

We are looking for a technical leader for the Menu Personalization ML systems, someone who owns the recommender stack that runs in production. You will set the direction for how we design, build, and operate the ML systems behind menu personalization, while staying hands-on across feature pipelines, training workflows, model serving, experimentation tooling, and the infrastructure underneath. The decisions you make here shape the platform for years, not quarters, and you will be expected to hold a point of view on where personalization at HelloFresh should go and to back it with data and user evidence. You will partner with Data Scientists to take models from notebook to production, with Data Engineers on features and pipelines, with Backend Engineers on online inference paths, and with Product on what to build next. Your influence will reach well beyond Menu Personalization: through the standards you set, the architectural decisions you make, the engineers you grow around you, and the company-wide initiatives you drive to advance ML and data engineering craft across HelloFresh.

## What you'll do

  • Set the technical direction for the ML systems behind menu personalization, owning the end-to-end stack: feature pipelines, training workflows, model serving, experimentation tooling, and infrastructure.
  • Take research and experiments to reliable production systems, partnering with Data Scientists on services that meet real latency, scalability, and observability requirements.
  • Shape the personalization roadmap with Product and Engineering leadership, backing your point of view with data and user evidence.
  • Operate what you build, instrumenting and improving your systems in production because shipping is the beginning of the learning cycle, not the end of it.
  • Raise the technical bar across the team through architecture reviews, mentorship, and the example you set on production ML craft.
  • Shape long-term architecture and make platform decisions whose payoff plays out over years rather than quarters.
  • Drive engineering excellence beyond Menu Personalization by setting standards other ML and data teams adopt.
  • Sync with peers across HelloFresh on best practices and contribute to company-wide engineering initiatives that move the broader ML and data craft forward.

## What you'll bring

  • 8+ years building and operating production ML systems, with a track record of technical leadership at scale.
  • Architectural decisions in your past that held up over multiple years and influenced teams beyond your own.
  • Production experience with recommender systems or large-scale personalization is a strong plus.
  • Fluency across our data and ML stack (Python, Spark) and our backend and platform stack (Go, Kafka, Kubernetes), with hands-on experience across pipelines, model serving, and observability at scale.
  • Statistical literacy to design honest experiments and the judgment to know when a model is actually better versus when the metrics are lying to you.
  • Operational judgment to diagnose system misbehavior, find root causes, and ship systems you can debug under real load.
  • Hands-on experience with AI tooling (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot) beyond casual experimentation; you use AI agents every day and have a practical sense of how the context you provide shapes output quality.
  • Product sense: opinionated about what should be built and why, with the ability to back it with evidence and translate it into business value.
  • A bias to ship; you take full ownership and finish the last twenty percent.

## **Let’s cut to the cheese, this is why you'll love it here**

  • **Shape the future of food:** Play a key role in transforming how millions of people eat as we grow into a global food solutions company.
  • **Drive transformational change:** Your decisions will have a direct and immediate impact, helping to shape strategy, scale teams, and redefine leadership in a rapidly evolving business.
  • **Build a global brand:** Create deeper, more sustainable connections with our customers, putting them at the heart of every decision.
  • **Benefit from long-term wealth creation:** Your compensation is heavily weighted toward equity, directly aligning your personal success with the company's future through our Virtual Stock Option (VSO) and Restricted Stock Unit (RSU) plans.
  • **Thrive in a high-performance environment:** Work with ambitious, intellectually curious peers on a global scale, enjoying an environment built for empowerment and speed.
  • **Enjoy a discount:** on HelloFresh meal kits, delivered straight to your door.

**Flexible Hybrid Approach**

At HelloFresh, we know that flexible work arrangements are essential in enabling you to do your best work, while balancing your personal and life needs. Offering remote work flexibility, along with the opportunity to interact and collaborate in the office are all a part of creating a great employee experience.

To meet these needs, we are pleased to provide Flexible Hybrid work. Flexible Hybrid is a people-first approach that is based on choice, trust, personalization, and empowers teams to choose when and how often they work from the office and work from home, in addition to team days and company days. This means a minimum of 2 days in office per week, with most teams in office between 2-3 days a week.

description:

This role combines application development (AI-assisted programming) with hands-on ownership of cloud infrastructure, ensuring reliable, secure, and scalable systems on Azure. The engineer would be working on PUB's gen-AI assisted procurement-related web application as part of PUB's AI initiative. Key responsibilities User Engagement & Requirements Gathering: Conduct user testing sessions to gather valuable feedback on application functionality and user experience.

Actively engage with stakeholders and end-users to gather, refine, and translate product functionality requirements into technical specifications/ testable artifacts.

AI-Assisted Development & Code Quality: Own end-to-end application delivery (frontend, backend, and cloud), leveraging AI coding assistants to accelerate development while ensuring quality, scalability, and maintainability (DRY, modular design, separation of concerns).

Build responsive, accessible, and performant web interfaces, using AI to speed up development while retaining full ownership of architecture and reusability.

Design and operate secure, reliable, and observable backend services and APIs, guiding AI for boilerplate and tests while owning API contracts and data models.

Review and validate all AI-generated code, identifying hallucinations, logic flaws, and maintainability issues before integration.

Cloud Architecture & Infrastructure: Own the end-to-end design, implementation, and operation of Azure infrastructure, ensuring solutions are secure, scalable, highly available, and compliant by design.

Translate application and security requirements into well-architected Azure reference architectures, balancing performance, cost, and operational complexity.

Compute: Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS)

Integration: API Management (APIM)

Security: Key Vault, Managed Identities, Entra ID integration

Edge & Protection: Application Gateway, WAF

Storage: Azure Blob Storage, Azure PostgreSQL Flexible Server

Implement secure-by-default infrastructure patterns, including secret management and end-to-end encryption (in transit and at rest)

DevOps: Design, implement, and maintain full-stack CI/CD deployment strategies and pipelines, ensuring automated, compliant, and efficient release processes.

Testing & Quality Assurance: Establish comprehensive automated test strategies, including unit, integration, and end-to-end testing, ensuring high code coverage.

Resolve all identified software defects, bugs to maintain application stability and integrity.

Security & Compliance: Ensure adherence to IM8 compliance requirements and any other emerging organizational compliance mandates.

Implement and maintain comprehensive full-stack security measures, including robust authentication, authorization, API security, and frontend security best practices.

Establish regular SAST, SCA, container image, vulnerability scans and other regular security related scans and resolve identified security vulnerabilities according to compliance timeline.

Experience with Git and modern branching workflows (GitFlow, trunk-based development).

Strong proficiency in both frontend and backend development.

Strong understanding of software engineering best practices (DRY, single responsibility principle, meaningful abstraction, testability) and the ability to enforce these standards within an AI-augmented development workflow.

Strong code review instincts - can catch hallucinations, logic errors, and security issues in AI output

Working in an agile release model, engineers must be adaptable and proactive to evolving requirements and user feedback.

Technologies: Next.js, TypeScript, React.js, UI component libraries (e.g., ShadCN, Tailwind CSS).

Experience with relational databases

Security & Compliance: Experience with IM8 compliance and system commissioning for government projects

Strong knowledge of frontend security (CSP, CORS, XSS prevention).

Experience with backend security (OAuth, JWT, API rate limiting, encryption).

Familiarity with cloud security (IAM, Secrets Management, OWASP Top 10).

DevOps & Infrastructure: Proven experience setting up and managing Azure infrastructure (refer to Azure services listed in the Cloud Architecture & Infrastructure of Key Responsibilities).

Experience with CI/CD pipelines using GitLab CI

Experience with containerization and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes).

Software Quality & Testing: Experience with unit and integration testing (Jest, Cypress, Playwright, Pact).

Backend testing using Postman, Supertest, contract testing.

Observability & Monitoring: Experience implementing application performance monitoring (APM) tools (Prometheus, OpenTelemetry).

Knowledge of logging frameworks (ELK Stack, Loki, Fluentd) to track and debug issues across distributed systems.

Backend Scalability & API Design: Strong experience in API design principles

Knowledge of API rate limiting, caching strategies (Redis, Varnish), and performance optimizations.

title: Native Plant Nursery Assistant
description:
Seasonal Position: Apply now! Work starts in the Spring


Join Metroparks Toledo as a Seasonal Native Plant Nursery Assistant. In this role, you help care for our native plants. You’ll help conserve our natural resources at parks that thousands of people enjoy every day. You play a big role in ensuring we maintain our “Clean, Safe, and Natural” promise.


Day in the Life?

Every day is different. You may be working in the propagation fields, greenhouse, or shop to propagate, care, or harvest our native plants. You may be helping with controlled burns to bring our native plants back to life. You may spend the day at the shop keeping our equipment in good condition.


Here’s why we think you’ll love working at Metroparks

  • Field experience in natural resources helps bring your degree to life.
  • Monthly set schedule so you can plan your life.
  • Competitive pay, health care, and retirement benefits. Read more here.
  • Grow your career by advancing to a Native Plant Nursery Specialist.

You’ll love this job if

  • You are pursuing a Natural Resources-related degree and want to get field experience.
  • You like working in a greenhouse and outdoors.
  • You enjoy hands-on work with a wide variety of native plants.

--------------------------------------

Job Summary

Advance Metroparks Toledo’s core conservation mission by assisting with the production of native herbaceous and woody plants for use in Metroparks Toledo’s seed production fields, plant sales, restoration projects, and landscaping within Metroparks’ boundaries. Work closely with co-workers and volunteers to grow and plant native plants, and harvest and process seed.


Duties and Responsibilities

  • Field maintenance and seed production, including plant propagation, weeding, irrigation, seed collection, seed processing, harvesting and storage.
  • Perform native plant bed maintenance work including removal of noxious or unwanted weeds or plants.
  • Control noxious and unwanted plant species by applying pesticides and herbicides to specific identified plant species under the supervision of a licensed applicator.
  • Perform daily maintenance of greenhouse and care of woody and herbaceous plants.
  • Assist in wild seed collection, when requested.
  • Work as a burn crew member on ecological prescribed burns, assisting in prescribed fire operations, as needed.
  • Perform routine maintenance and minor repairs on small equipment, power equipment, and mowers.
  • Safely and respectfully work with volunteers on various projects such as seedling transplant, seed collection and seed processing.
  • Respond to customer questions, comments and suggestions in a courteous and timely manner.
  • Other Park District duties as assigned.

Equipment Used

  • General office equipment
  • Software & Apps: Microsoft Office Suite
  • Maintenance Equipment: lawn equipment, mowers, tillers, woodchippers, chainsaws, herbicide application equipment, power and hand tools, safety equipment
  • Vehicles: on & off-road trucks, UTVs, Tractors, Trailers
  • Biological survey tools and equipment: fanning mill, hammer mill, shredder, irrigation systems

Physical Requirements and Working Conditions

  • Length of employment varies based on need. Generally, March – December. Employment will not exceed 1,480 hours in a calendar year.
  • Schedule: 40-hour workweek that may require work in the evenings, weekends, and/or holidays.
  • Home Work Location: Blue Creek Native Nursery.
  • May require business use of personal vehicle to travel between Metroparks locations.
  • Extensive outdoor physical labor exposed to climate extremes, inclement weather, stinging insects, dust and pollen, prescription fires and herbicides forest fires and herbicides.
  • Requires frequent lifting and carrying of up to 75 pounds and occasional lifting over 75 pounds with assistance.
  • Requires ability to walk and work outdoors for extended periods of time in all types of weather including extreme heat and cold. Must be able to move about off trail over uneven ground and in wooded areas while carrying equipment.

title: Data and Reporting Analyst
description:
Who we are

As the global pioneer for digital twins of urban forests, we provide very detailed digital copies of each individual tree in a city. With our solution we support the digital transformation of smart cities world-wide. Combining the latest laser scanning technology with the most advanced AI & machine learning methods, greehill enables cities to be radically more productive in their daily operations and to improve the well-being of citizens through a greener, healthier, and more resilient urban environment. We currently operate offices in Budapest (HQ, R&D), Hannover, Singapore, San Francisco and Paris.

We are looking for an experienced Data Analyst to help us to search, collect and turn complex data into clear, actionable insight and present them to stakeholders to support strategic decision-making as well as performance tracking.

Your contribution will be

· Search, collect, consolidate, and validate financial and non-financial data across departments and systems.

· Design, build, maintain, and automate dashboards and underlying data pipelines to provide timely, accurate insights to stakeholders.

· Perform in-depth data analysis and present them to stakeholders to support strategic decision-making and performance tracking.

· Collaborate with different teams across the organization to understand reporting needs and identify data-driven opportunities.

· Own data quality for your area — identifying gaps or inconsistencies, defining validation checks, and working with engineering to improve data infrastructure, contribute to improvements in back-end code (Python).

· Support the adoption of data-driven practices across the organization.

· Leverage AI tools/agents, stay current on industry trends, tools, and best practices in analytics, and proactively suggest improvements in data consolidation and reporting processes.

We need you to have

· 3+ years of experience in a data analyst, business analyst, or related quantitative role

· Experience with SQL, Python

· Familiarity with version control (Git)

· Strong analytical and problem solving skills

· Proactivity, being comfortable to work alone

· Flexibility and adaptibility to work in a dynamic, frequently changing environment

· Excellent communication skills in English, with experience presenting findings to senior stakeholders and influencing decisions.

· Advanced level MS Excel, MS Power Point

We value if you have

· Experience with ETL Pipeline

· Background in Agile methodologies

· Experience with AI Agents

· Bachelor's degree in a quantitative field (e.g. Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Computer Science) or equivalent practical experience; advanced degree a plus.

We offer

· Opportunity to join a dynamically growing startup team at an early stage

· Possibility to work and learn in an international, open-minded team of passionate (green-)tech experts

· End to end ownership and impact

· Contribution to urban sustainability and climate resilience

How we work – We believe the best ideas happen when people spend time together. That’s why we work 4 days a week from the office, with 1 day from home, creating space for collaboration while still keeping some freedom.

title: Lead Engineer, Packaging Project
location: Paranaque City, National Capital Region (Manila), Philippines
description:
The Allegro team is united by a clear purpose—advancing technologies that make the world safer, more efficient, and more sustainable. With over 30 years of experience in semiconductor innovation, we bring that purpose to life across every part of the business—from breakthrough product development and customer success to how we show up for each other and the communities we serve.

The Opportunity

This role requires the ability to make critical decisions regarding package design, lead assembly process engineering efforts, and drive problem-solving and optimization. The Senior Project Engineer will ensure projects adhere to scope, schedule, budget, and quality requirements, collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams, proactively manage risks, and ensure all deliverables meet Allegro's internal procedures and stringent quality standards. This level also contributes to the management and updating of package design rules.

What You Will Do

  • Independently manage and execute assigned packaging projects, ensuring completion on time, within budget, and within scope.

  • Serve as a packaging and assembly expert, making informed decisions on package design and actively contributing to assembly process engineering activities, including problem identification and resolution.

  • Create and refine bonding diagrams, ensuring adherence to and contributing to the evolution of Allegro's design rules.

  • Lead bill of material selection, optimizing for performance, cost, and manufacturability.

  • Develop, execute, and oversee comprehensive qualification planning and execution.

  • Perform in-depth assembly data review and qualification data review, driving corrective actions and continuous improvement.

  • Proactively track critical tasks and milestones, identifying potential delays or issues and implementing corrective actions.

  • Identify, document, and escalate project risks and resource conflicts to the Technical Project Manager, proposing solutions.

  • Collaborate extensively with cross-functional teams, including design, product lines, manufacturing, and quality, to drive seamless project execution and achieve project goals.

  • Ensure all project deliverables adhere to Advanced Quality Planning (AQP) requirements and internal documentation procedures, maintaining thorough project records.

  • Lead or actively participate in problem-solving activities, such as Ishikawa (Fishbone) or 8D analyses, when project issues or quality deviations arise.

  • Demonstrate strong proficiency in utilizing quality tools such as DFMEA, PFMEA, Ishikawa, DRBFM, Design for Manufacturability, Design for Quality, and Design for Cost.

  • Contribute to the management and updating of Allegro's package design rules.

  • Maintain comprehensive project documentation, including detailed schedules, budget tracking, and technical specifications.

  • Interface with Business Units and product lines for project updates and strategic alignment on project progress and resource needs.

  • May mentor junior engineers, providing technical guidance and support.

What You Will Bring

  • Bachelor's degree (BS) in an engineering field such as Mechanical Engineering, Chemical Engineering, or Electrical Engineering.

  • Minimum of three (3) to five (5) years of experience in semiconductor packaging and assembly engineering, with a proven track record of technical project management and decision-making.

  • Demonstrated expertise in semiconductor packaging and assembly processes, with the ability to make design and process engineering decisions.

  • Strong understanding and practical application of project management principles, with an emphasis on technical leadership.

  • Proven proficiency in utilizing quality tools such as DFMEA, PFMEA, Ishikawa, DRBFM, Design for Manufacturability, Design for Quality, and Design for Cost.

  • Highly organized with exceptional attention to detail and strong problem-solving skills.

  • Excellent written and spoken English language fluency, with strong communication and interpersonal skills.

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and Microsoft PowerPoint.

Why Allegro?

Join Allegro and become part of a team where your contributions truly matter.

We foster a culture of Real Innovation, empowering you to push boundaries, develop cutting-edge solutions, and drive continuous improvement.
Your work will create a Real Impact by solving complex real-world challenges that fuel our success and shape the future of technology.
You’ll experience Real Connection, collaborating with talented colleagues around the globe in an environment built on trust, respect, and a shared purpose.
Join us—and help build what’s next.

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:

If you're passionate about building high‑quality mobile experiences that scale and love creating seamless app ecosystems that power gaming, virtual currency, and digital commerce experiences, we would love to hear from you!

ABOUT US

From indie to AAA, companies partner with Xsolla to help them fund, distribute, market, and monetize their games. Grounded in the belief in the future of video games, Xsolla is resolute in the mission to bring opportunities together, and continually make new resources available to creators. Headquartered and incorporated in Los Angeles, California, Xsolla operates as the merchant of record and has helped over 1,500+ game developers to reach more players and grow their businesses around the world. With more paths to profits and ways to win, developers have all the things needed to enjoy the game. For more information, visit xsolla.com.

Responsibilities

  • Implement best practices for mobile development, including code review, testing strategies, and CI/CD processes
  • Build scalable and maintainable features within the existing application architecture
  • Collaborate with product and design teams to implement technical solutions that meet business goals
  • Integrate mini‑apps and virtual currency systems with the Xsolla App ecosystem
  • Work with cross‑functional teams, including developers, QA engineers, and project managers

  • Deliver high‑quality features on time throughout the development lifecycle

Architecture & Design

Component Ecosystem & Code Sharing

Development & Delivery

End-to-End Testing & Quality Assurance

  • Build test infrastructure for critical user flows, edge cases, and platform‑specific behaviors
  • Implement visual regression testing and snapshot testing where appropriate
  • Define testing standards and best practices for the team, including when to use unit, integration, and E2E tests

Collaboration & Mentorship

  • Collaborate with web developers to identify opportunities for code sharing and architectural alignment
  • Mentor junior and mid‑level developers on React Native best practices and monorepo patterns
  • Conduct thorough code reviews with focus on architecture, patterns, and maintainability
  • Work closely with product, design, and backend teams to deliver cohesive user experiences

Qualifications & Skills

  • Proven track record of delivering commercial mobile applications from concept to launch
  • Proficiency in React Native and JavaScript/TypeScript, with knowledge of native modules (Swift/Kotlin) as a plus
  • Strong understanding of mobile architecture patterns and state management
  • Experience with third‑party integrations and APIs

Operating across Ireland, the UK, Europe and South Africa, Kirby has become the engineering service provider of choice in growth segments such as pharmaceuticals, data centres and power transmission and distribution. The successful candidate will have the opportunity to grow and develop in a company committed to developing talent and rewarding performance.

The HR Administrator provides efficient, accurate administrative support throughout the employee lifecycle. The role ensures compliance with legal and internal requirements, maintains reliable HR data, and coordinates key processes such as onboarding, offboarding, subcontractor compliance, and ID06 administration. By acting as a central support function for employees, managers, payroll, and other stakeholders, the HR Administrator contributes to smooth daily operations and a positive employee experience.

Roles & Responsibilities

Onboarding & Offboarding Administration

Onboarding
