  • Create new hire profiles in HRIS, payroll, and access systems.
  • Coordinate with IT to ensure timely setup of equipment and system access.
  • Ensure all onboarding tasks, checklists, and compliance requirements are completed.
  • Serve as the primary administrative contact for new employees.

Offboarding

  • Process resignations and handle all required administrative steps.
  • Prepare offboarding documents, including exit letters and certificates of employment when needed.
  • Coordinate system access removal and equipment return with the site administrator.
  • Schedule or conduct exit interviews.
  • Update records and notify relevant departments of end dates.

ID06 Administration

  • Submit applications, track production and delivery, and distribute cards.
  • Deactivate ID06 cards for offboarded employees.
  • Act as the main contact for ID06-related questions.

Compliance Oversight of Subcontractors

  • Approve or reject submissions based on validity and completeness.
  • Request corrections or additional documents when needed.
  • Maintain an up-to-date compliance register.
  • Escalate non‑compliant subcontractors to the manager or relevant stakeholders.

Work Placement & Job Fairs

  • Act as the first contact for student work placement inquiries.
  • Coordinate communication between students, site administrators, and managers.
  • Maintain an overview of ongoing and upcoming placements to ensure smooth coordination.
  • Support logistics, materials, and representation for university job fairs.

Additional Tasks & Cross-Functional Support

  • Carry out administrative or analytical tasks requested by HR Leadership or other stakeholders.
  • Provide HR data and reports to support decision‑making.

title: Purifications Chemical Technician
description:
The Chemical Technician is responsible for the safe, efficient, and compliant operation, cleaning, and setup, of the Purification division’s chromatography columns and associated process equipment and facilities. This position supports chemical and pharmaceutical manufacturing operations by executing chromatography processes according to approved batch records, standard operating procedures (SOPs), safety requirements, and Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP), where applicable. The technician will monitor process parameters, perform column packing and unpacking activities, execute cleaning and sanitization procedures, troubleshoot routine operating issues, and accurately document all activities. The ideal candidate has strong attention to detail, mechanical aptitude, chemical-processing experience, and a commitment to safety and quality.

Key Responsibilities

• Operate the chromatography columns (currently, a Novasep LC150 and LC1000) and associated pumps, valves, piping, instrumentation, and process equipment in accordance with approved SOPs and batch documentation.

• Perform column preparation, packing, equilibration, loading, washing, elution, regeneration, and other chromatography operations as required by the manufacturing process.

• Clean and sanitize the column and associated process equipment using approved cleaning procedures and chemical solutions.

• Perform column unpacking, resin removal, inspection, cleaning, and preparation for subsequent campaigns.

• Prepare and handle process chemicals, buffers, cleaning solutions, and other materials in accordance with established procedures and chemical-safety requirements.

• Monitor operating parameters such as pressure, flow rate, temperature, conductivity, pH, and other applicable process indicators.

• Recognize abnormal operating conditions and take appropriate corrective action within established procedures; escalate equipment or process issues when required.

• Perform equipment setup, line connections, valve alignments, hose changes, and other routine equipment preparations.

• Conduct pre-use and post-use inspections of the chromatography system and associated equipment.

• Verify equipment cleanliness and readiness before and after processing.

• Complete batch records, equipment logs, cleaning records, checklists, and other required documentation accurately and in a timely manner and according to ALCOA+ principals

• Perform routine cleaning and sanitization of the production facilities

• Maintain accurate material identification, labeling, and traceability throughout the process.

• Follow GMP, OSHA, environmental, health and safety, and site-specific requirements as applicable.

• Use appropriate personal protective equipment (PPE) and follow procedures for the safe handling of chemicals and process materials.

• Assist with investigations, deviations, corrective actions, and continuous-improvement activities related to chromatography operations.

• Communicate effectively with Quality, Engineering, Maintenance, and other support groups.

title: Senior Mesh Network and MAC Engineer (All Genders)
description:
STARK is a defence technology company redefining the engineering and deployment of autonomous platforms. Our core mission is to deliver fully operational unmanned systems, integrating the critical subsystems, including Electronic Warfare, necessary for NATO forces to maintain a decisive advantage in contested environments. We do whatever is required to achieve platform autonomy, grounded in precision, responsibility, and uncompromising engineering discipline. We are a lean, agile group with a strong systems-minded focus. We operate without silos, looking for proactive engineers who are excited to take mathematical models off the whiteboard and deploy them onto physical hardware. On our Electronic Warfare algorithms team, you will bridge the gap between theoretical signal processing and real-world hardware execution, taking direct ownership of key software and firmware modules. At STARK, we are building the next generation of autonomous platforms capable of navigating the world's most contested environments. As a Senior Mesh Network and MAC Engineer you will solve the critical challenges of directional wireless communication in highly dynamic networks. You will design and implement the medium access control (MAC) and routing layers that allow our platforms to form robust, self-healing networks under demanding tactical conditions.
  • Architect and implement MAC protocols and routing algorithms tailored for directional multi-node systems, directly tackling the challenge of neighbour discovery under highly focused, narrow beams.
  • Build dynamic TDMA schedules and beam coordination mechanisms in lockstep with the physical layer (PHY) and antenna steering systems, ensuring routing decisions are grounded in real-time RF characteristics rather than simple hop counts.
  • Deliver resilient multi-hop relay capabilities that sustain high-bandwidth video and control links between mobile platforms over tactical distances, routing back seamlessly to ground control stations under dynamic conditions.
  • Build and maintain multi-node Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) testbeds alongside automated logging pipelines to quantitatively evaluate and verify network join times and topology reform behaviours.
  • Mesh networking in a product that shipped — sim work alone does not qualify — plus Linux networking at kernel and packet level with live debugging.
  • Radio-literate and has designed a medium-access scheme or TDMA schedule.
  • You have successfully designed and shipped mesh networking protocols in commercial or defence products.
  • Deep, practical familiarity with the Linux networking stack at the kernel and packet levels, coupled with strong live-debugging skills on embedded systems.
  • Strong understanding of wireless propagation and physical layer realities, with hands-on experience designing medium-access control schemes or TDMA schedulers.
  • Active contributions to open-source routing protocols (e.g., batman-adv, olsrd, Babel).
  • A professional background at tactical mesh vendors (such as Silvus, Persistent Systems, TrellisWare, Saab, or Bittium).
  • Experience with mmWave backhaul systems or other technologies where directional beamforming is the default mode of operation.
  • Batman-adv / olsrd / Babel contributor; tactical mesh vendor background (Silvus, Persistent, TrellisWare, Saab, Bittium); mmWave backhaul — already thinks in beams.

title: Senior Waveform Architect (All Genders)
description:
STARK is a defence technology company redefining the engineering and deployment of autonomous platforms. Our core mission is to deliver fully operational unmanned systems, integrating the critical subsystems, including Electronic Warfare, necessary for NATO forces to maintain a decisive advantage in contested environments. We do whatever is required to achieve platform autonomy, grounded in precision, responsibility, and uncompromising engineering discipline. We are a lean, agile group with a strong systems-minded focus. We operate without silos, seeking visionary technical leaders who can define long-term technology roadmaps while remaining deeply hands-on with complex engineering problems. On the Electronic Warfare team, you will hold the highest level of technical authority for our attack and countermeasure capabilities, driving multi-domain architectures directly onto the modern battlefield. At STARK, we are building the next generation of autonomous platforms capable of navigating the world's most contested environments. As a Senior Waveform Architect, you will own the entire development, architecture, and implementation of the waveform for our tactical anti-jam radio. In this critical role, you will ensure our communication links remain highly robust and operational under severe electronic countermeasure conditions.
  • Lead the design and implementation of the physical layer (PHY)—waveform, modulation, coding, framing, and synchronisation—from initial architecture to real-time execution.
  • Engineer solutions specifically tailored for challenging jamming scenarios and complex, multi-node long-range link budgets.
  • Own the PHY-side specifications and expose the critical IQ, phase, and timing observables required by the Direction Finding (DF) strand.
  • Define the development guidelines for the strand—including HDL and verification conventions, as well as FPGA build flows.
  • You have successfully designed a PHY and brought it onto FPGA/SoC hardware in real time.
  • You are quantitatively sure-footed on synchronisation, estimation, FEC (Forward Error Correction), and link budgets.
  • You have practical experience debugging real radio links against physical hardware.
  • Experience with anti-jamming and LPI/LPD (Low Probability of Intercept/Detection) in a tactical context.
  • A professional background at industry leaders.
  • Publicly verifiable PHY implementation evidence (e.g., custom GNU Radio OOT modules or contributions to the RFSoC toolchain).

title: Staff AI Engineer, AI DLC Platform
description:
Job Description

What is the opportunity?

The Enterprise Architecture team is undertaking multiple complex enterprise-wide initiatives as part of RBC’s ongoing plan to improve technology management and architectural governance across the organization. In this role you will be responsible for strategically planning and managing successful implementation of the initiatives.

This role will own the platform layer that takes AI-generated code from the Harness and makes it production-grade, safe, and deployable into RBC AI platforms. It will define and enforce the boundary between code that runs in production and agents that run in production — a distinction that has real risk, governance, and architectural consequences for the bank. This role will build pipelines, the runtime, and the standards that make AI delivery trustworthy at scale across RBC.

What will you do?

  • Build and own the code promotion pipeline from Harness validation output through to Helios deployment.
  • Ensure AI-generated code is auditable and reproducible — not a black box that worked once; code that can be reviewed, rolled back, and explained.
  • Establish coding standards for AI-assisted development — the guidelines engineers follow so that what AI generates is structurally sound before it reaches you.
  • Work with risk, governance, and engineering teams to codify this boundary into policy that the Harness and delivery teams can test against.
  • Build and operate the runtime infrastructure that both AI-generated code and sanctioned agents run on within the RBC AI Platforms.
  • Own the deployment platform — containerization, orchestration, secrets management, scaling, and observability.
  • Engineer reliability into the platform — circuit breakers, graceful degradation, rollback mechanisms, and zero-downtime deployments.
  • Build monitoring and alerting that distinguishes between a bad model, bad code, and a bad platform — different failure modes need different responses.

What do you need to succeed?

Must-have

  • Agent Frameworks:Experience with orchestration tools like LangGraph, CrewAI, or AutoGen to build multi-agent workflows.
  • Data & Tool Integration:Ability to design tool contracts, APIs (FastAPI/gRPC), and Model Context Protocol (MCP) connections.
  • CI/CD & Infrastructure:Managing pipelines, container orchestration (Docker/Kubernetes), and infrastructure-as-code.
  • Automated Testing & QA:Using AI to auto-generate test cases, analyze logs, and run validation checks.
  • Spec-Driven Development:Translating user stories and Jira tickets into precise technical specifications that AI agents can execute safely, including spec-kit, open spec.
  • Governance & Security:Setting up human-in-the-loop validation, access controls, and audit trails for automated code

Nice-to-have

  • Demonstrated ability in written and oral communication skills along with strong presentation skills. Ability to determine the information and communication needs of the stakeholders and project.
  • Strong organizational, project management and time management capabilities.
  • A strong understanding of technology and/or financial services industry.

What’s in it for you?

We thrive on the challenge to be our best, progressive thinking to keep growing, and working together to deliver trusted advice to help our clients thrive and communities prosper. We care about each other, reaching our potential, making a difference to our communities, and achieving success that is mutual.

title: Data Center Technician

Please note that information provided to the Canadian Government in connection with the screening is not affiliated/shared with Google. The level of security screening required may change during employment to meet Google’s current business needs. Failure to obtain or maintain the appropriate clearance and/or customer screening requirements will make you ineligible for the position, which may result in the frustration of your employment and action up to and including termination.

Behind everything our users see online is the architecture built by the Technical Infrastructure team to keep it running. From developing and maintaining our data centers to building the next generation of Google platforms, we make Google's product portfolio possible. We're proud to be our software developers, developers and love voiding warranties by taking things apart so we can rebuild them. We keep our networks up and running, ensuring our users have the best and fastest experience possible.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

Canada: $100000 - $102000 (CAD) + 15% bonus target + equity + benefits

Learn more about benefits at Google.

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:

Senior Data Engineer

We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated Senior Data Engineer with expertise in cloud-native data engineering on any major cloud platform. The ideal candidate will have hands‑on experience with Spark, PySpark, Iceberg, streaming systems, and open data catalogue/governance frameworks. This role is suitable for individuals with minimum 3 years of relevant industry experience and have strong fundamentals, high learning agility, and a passion for building modern data systems.

Key Responsibilities

Cloud‑Native Data Engineering – Design and build scalable, reliable data pipelines using native services provided by the chosen cloud platform. Implement data lakehouse solutions using Apache Iceberg and open, interoperable metadata/catalogue frameworks. Modernize existing data processing pipelines with cloud‑first architectural principles.

Streaming & Real‑Time Processing – Develop and maintain real‑time streaming pipelines using the platform’s native streaming, messaging, and event ingestion services. Build structured streaming logic using Spark Structured Streaming or equivalent cloud‑native stream processing tools.

Migration & Modernization – Participate in the migration of complex SQL workloads and legacy processing systems into a cloud‑native architecture. Optimize SQL and transformation logic to leverage cloud‑scalable compute and storage.

Data Engineering & Automation – Build end‑to‑end ETL/ELT workflows using Python and Unix/Linux shell scripting. Write efficient SQL for complex data transformations and analytics. Develop automated data quality checks, validation processes, and operational monitoring.

Data Governance & Catalogue – Leverage open‑source catalogue/governance solutions (e.g., Open Data Catalogue, OpenMetadata, DataHub) to ensure lineage, metadata capture, and data accessibility. Support data governance practices across domains and teams.

Collaboration & Delivery – Work closely with analysts, data scientists, and stakeholders to deliver robust, scalable data solutions. Troubleshoot pipeline issues, ensure data reliability, and optimize processing performance. Continuously explore new technologies and best practices within the data engineering ecosystem.

Why Join

Imagine being part of a team that builds innovative digital solutions for one of Asia's leading banks. As a Software Engineer at OCBC, you'll have the opportunity to work on cutting‑edge projects that transform the way we deliver financial services. You'll be part of a collaborative team that values creativity, innovation, and continuous learning.

Your ability to collaborate, innovate, and adapt to changing requirements will be key to your success.

  • Collaborate with business stakeholders to understand requirements and develop solutions that meet their needs
  • Work with cross‑functional teams to ensure seamless integration with existing systems
  • Participate in code reviews and contribute to the improvement of the overall code quality
  • Troubleshoot and resolve technical issues in a timely and efficient manner

Who you are

  • A degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field
  • At least 3 years of experience in software development, preferably in a banking or financial services environment
  • Proficient in one or more programming languages, such as Java, Python, or C++
  • Experience with Agile development methodologies and version control systems such as Git
  • Strong problem‑solving skills, with the ability to analyze complex technical issues and develop creative solutions
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively with cross‑functional teams

What we offer

  • Competitive base salary.
  • A suite of holistic, flexible benefits to suit every lifestyle.
  • Community initiatives.
  • Industry‑leading learning and professional development opportunities.

Your wellbeing, growth and aspirations are every bit as cared for as the needs of our customers. Let’s build the bank we need for the future we want. Find the best version of yourself in a friendly, supportive team. Build lasting value in your community. Help people grow their assets, business, and investments. Take your learning as far as you can. Or simply enjoy a vibrant, future-ready career. Your Opportunity Starts Here.

As the longest established Singapore bank, formed in 1932 from the merger of three local banks, we have grown from strength to strength to become a regional financial services group. With a deep history in Asia, we offer the most comprehensive coverage across ASEAN and Greater China, complemented with a presence in the leading economies of New York, London and Sydney. title: Senior Backend Engineer
description:
The Opportunity

Manufacturing powers the global economy at $50T a year and it relies heavily on human dexterity and skill to produce the goods we rely on every day. Yet manufacturers have little visibility when issues arise at manual assembly stations, impacting productivity and quality.

Assembler AI is changing that.

We use computer vision and artificial intelligence to help manufacturers improve quality, reduce waste, increase throughput, and enable frontline employees to perform at their best.

Backed by Diagram Ventures, we're building a category-defining company at the intersection of AI, manufacturing, and operational excellence.

The role

As a Senior Backend Software Developer, you'll architect, design, build, deploy, operate and scale the backend platform that turns thousands of real-time video feeds into insights operators and engineers can act on immediately. You'll work closely with our Head of Engineering as well as our AI R&D team to architect the Operator Vision SaaS platform, harden the services, APIs and infrastructure. You take pride in building and delivering high quality and highly scalable code with high velocity? This is for you!

What you'll do

  • Participate in the platform's architecture definition, working closely with the Head of Engineering, and taking into consideration the tradeoffs that let us scale from pilot to full production.
  • Design and implement the cloud-based backend platform — services, APIs and data pipelines — including auto-scaling and failover recovery capabilities that keep the platform available for live production lines.
  • Contribute to building the infrastructure that ingests and processes thousands of real-time video streams, working closely with the AI R&D team.
  • Contribute to defining and putting in place development conventions — code standards, testing practices, and how the team uses agentic coding tools to move faster without cutting corners.
  • Contribute to building the CI/CD pipelines and deployment practices enabling the team to ship fast, safely and often.
  • Contribute to operating the service — instrumenting logging, metrics and alerting, and taking part in incident response when things don't work as expected.
  • Partner with product and AI R&D to translate customer needs into technical solutions.

What we're looking for

  • Seasoned backend engineer with deep, demonstrated expertise in Python or another high-level backend language such as Go or Rust, and you're comfortable working across multiple languages and stacks as the problem demands.
  • 7+ years of professional backend software development experience.
  • Demonstrated expertise designing and shipping highly scalable, resilient and cost-effective cloud-based backend solutions in production, not just in theory.
  • Strong experience with AWS cloud infrastructure, containerization (Docker/Kubernetes), and modern continuous deployment practices.
  • Demonstrated experience designing and implementing REST APIs. GraphQL APIs is a nice to have.
  • Experience with the stack we leverage in our platform, or equivalent:
    • Python
    • FastAPI, Strawberry
    • SQLAlchemy
    • Alembic
    • Postgres
  • Demonstrated experience working as part of a startup, owning outcomes end-to-end, moving fast with limited resources, and building scale before scale is guaranteed.
  • Demonstrated experience leveraging agentic coding tools such as Claude Code, Cursor or GitHub Copilot to meaningfully accelerate development velocity.
  • Strong instincts for data modeling and building systems that stay reliable under real-world production load.
  • Experience implementing and evolving infrastructure as code, e.g. with Terraform.
  • Experience with high-volume data ingestion pipelines, such as video, audio or streaming data (nice to have).
  • Experience with Test driven development methodology (nice to have).

Why join

  • The chance to build the platform that carries thousands of real-time video streams, serving live production lines at a real manufacturing scale.
  • Direct collaboration with our Head of Engineering and founders.
  • Real influence over the architecture, engineering standards, tooling, and how we use AI in our own development process.

Compensation & Benefits

  • Competitive salary and stock options
  • Competitive health benefits
  • Health and wellness spending account, from $500 to $1,000 annually
  • Latest MacBook and modern tooling
  • Opportunity to grow as the company scales


L'occasion

Le secteur manufacturier fait rouler l'économie mondiale, avec 50 000 milliards de dollars par année, et il repose largement sur la dextérité et le savoir-faire des gens pour produire les biens dont nous dépendons tous les jours. Pourtant, les manufacturiers ont peu de visibilité quand un problème survient aux postes d'assemblage manuel, ce qui nuit à la productivité et à la qualité.

Assembler AI change la donne.

Nous utilisons la vision par ordinateur et l'intelligence artificielle pour aider les manufacturiers à améliorer la qualité, à réduire le gaspillage, à augmenter la cadence de production et à permettre aux employés de plancher de donner leur pleine mesure.

Appuyés par Diagram Ventures, nous bâtissons une entreprise qui définit sa catégorie, à la croisée de l'IA, de la fabrication et de l'excellence opérationnelle.

Le poste

À titre de développeur logiciel backend senior, vous architecturerez, concevrez, construirez, déploierez, opérerez et ferez évoluer la plateforme backend qui transforme des milliers de flux vidéo en temps réel en informations exploitables immédiatement par les opérateurs et les ingénieurs. Vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec notre chef de l'ingénierie ainsi qu'avec notre équipe d'IA R&D afin d'architecturer la plateforme SaaS Operator Vision, de renforcer les services, les API et l'infrastructure. Vous êtes fier de bâtir et de livrer du code de grande qualité, hautement évolutif, à grande vélocité ? Ce poste est pour vous!

Ce que vous ferez

  • Participer à la définition de l'architecture de la plateforme, en travaillant étroitement avec le chef de l'ingénierie et en tenant compte des compromis qui nous permettront de passer du projet pilote à la production complète.
  • Concevoir et mettre en œuvre la plateforme backend infonuagique — services, API et pipelines de données — y compris les capacités d'auto-mise à l'échelle et de reprise après défaillance qui maintiennent la plateforme disponible pour les lignes de production en direct.
  • Contribuer à bâtir l'infrastructure qui ingère et traite des milliers de flux vidéo en temps réel, en travaillant étroitement avec l'équipe d'IA R&D.
  • Contribuer à définir et à mettre en place les conventions de développement — normes de code, pratiques de test et façon dont l'équipe utilise les outils de codage agentique pour aller plus vite sans couper les coins ronds.
  • Contribuer à bâtir les pipelines CI/CD et les pratiques de déploiement permettant à l'équipe de livrer rapidement, de manière sécuritaire et fréquemment.
  • Contribuer à l'exploitation du service — instrumentation des journaux, des métriques et des alertes, et participation à la réponse aux incidents lorsque les choses ne fonctionnent pas comme prévu.
  • Collaborer avec les équipes produit et IA R&D pour traduire les besoins des clients en solutions techniques.

Ce que nous recherchons

  • Ingénieur backend chevronné possédant une expertise approfondie et démontrée en Python ou dans un autre langage backend de haut niveau comme Go ou Rust, et à l'aise de travailler avec plusieurs langages et piles technologiques selon les besoins du problème.
  • Plus de 7 ans d'expérience professionnelle en développement logiciel backend.
  • Expertise démontrée dans la conception et la livraison de solutions backend infonuagiques hautement évolutives, résilientes et rentables en production, pas seulement en théorie.
  • Solide expérience avec l'infrastructure infonuagique AWS, la conteneurisation (Docker/Kubernetes) et les pratiques modernes de déploiement continu.
  • Expérience démontrée dans la conception et la mise en œuvre d'API REST. Les API GraphQL sont un atout.
  • Expérience avec la pile technologique que nous utilisons dans notre plateforme, ou l'équivalent :
    • Python
    • FastAPI, Strawberry
    • SQLAlchemy
    • Alembic
    • Postgres
  • Expérience démontrée dans un environnement de startup, avec la capacité de prendre en charge des résultats de bout en bout, d'avancer rapidement avec des ressources limitées et de bâtir pour l'échelle avant que l'échelle ne soit garantie.
  • Expérience démontrée dans l'utilisation d'outils de codage agentique comme Claude Code, Cursor ou GitHub Copilot afin d'accélérer significativement la vélocité de développement.
  • Excellents réflexes en modélisation de données et en conception de systèmes qui demeurent fiables sous une charge de production réelle.
  • Expérience dans la mise en œuvre et l'évolution de l'infrastructure comme code, p. ex. avec Terraform.
  • Expérience avec des pipelines d'ingestion de données à haut volume, comme la vidéo, l'audio ou les données en continu (un atout).
  • Expérience avec la méthodologie de développement piloté par les tests (un atout).

Pourquoi vous joindre à nous

  • La chance de bâtir la plateforme sur laquelle roulent des milliers de flux vidéo en temps réel, au service de lignes de production actives à l'échelle manufacturière réelle.
  • Une collaboration directe avec notre chef de l'ingénierie et les fondateurs.
  • Une influence réelle sur l'architecture, les normes d'ingénierie, l'outillage et la façon dont nous utilisons l'IA dans notre propre processus de développement.

Rémunération et avantages sociaux

  • Salaire concurrentiel et options d'achat d'actions
  • Assurance collective concurrentielle
  • Compte de dépenses santé et mieux-être, de 500 $ à 1 000 $ par année
  • MacBook récent et outils de travail modernes
  • Occasion de grandir avec l'entreprise

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
Project description

We've been engaged by an Investment Banking client in the FM potfolio . PTS app is an inhouse build system which is silver source of all settlement information originated from GPTM. PTS app is in CDP (Cloudera data platform) platform which bag data ecosystem. It will be migrated to a different datacentre and CDP will be decommissioned . Hence PTS application, we need to rewrite code approx. 40% to rebuild from scratch like develop data ingestion framework, extraction frame work and migration of existing components to new data centre from west to East.

Responsibilities

  • Create and maintain optimal data pipeline architecture, assemble large, complex data sets that meet functional / non-functional business requirements.
  • Identify, design, and implement internal process improvements: automating manual processes, optimizing data delivery, re-designing infrastructure for greater scalability, etc.
  • Build the infrastructure required for optimal extraction, transformation, and loading of data from a wide variety of data sources using SQL and Hadoop technologies.
  • Build analytics tools that utilize the data pipeline to provide actionable insights into customer acquisition, operational efficiency and other key business performance metrics.
  • Work with project team including the Executive, Product, Data and Design teams to assist with data-related technical issues and support their data infrastructure needs.
  • Create data tools for analytics and data scientist team members that assist them in building and optimizing our product into an innovative industry leader.
  • Work with data and analytics experts to strive for greater functionality in our data systems.

SKILLS

Must have

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, or a related technical field
  • 8+ years of experience in data engineering (or equivalent hands on experience with large scale data platforms)
  • Strong programming skills in Python for data processing, automation, and tooling
  • Hands on experience with Minio, Iceberg and DuckDB for large scale data processing
  • Advanced SQL skills, including complex queries, performance tuning, and working with large relational datasets
  • Experience building and maintaining ETL/ELT pipelines and working with structured and semi structured data
  • Understanding of data modelling concepts (e.g. relational, dimensional, and/or big data modelling)
  • Strong understanding of DevOps/CI/CD concepts and tooling (e.g. Docker, Kubernetes, Git)

Nice to have

• Experience of Unix/Linux environments is plus • Experience of Agile/Scrum development methodologies is a plus • Be nice, respectful, able to work in a team • Willingness to learn

title: Junior/Senior Data Engineer
description:
We are seeking a Senior Data Engineer that supports the design, implementation and maintenance of data flow channels and data processing systems that support the collection, storage, batch and real-time processing, and analysis of information in a scalable, repeatable and secure manner. The Senior Data Engineer focuses on defining optimal solutions to data collection, processing and warehousing. He / She designs, codes and tests data systems and works on implementing those into the internal infrastructure.

Job Responsibilities:

  • Design, develop, document, manage and maintain data models, ETL processes, data warehouse, data management and pipeline solutions for large volume of structured/unstructured data from disparate sources and with different latencies (e.g. on-demand, batch, real-time, near-real-time);

  • Experience in multiple data source support (flat files, SQL database, SAP database, PostgreSQL database, unstructured data not limited to text, documents, images, digitalized video, digitalised audio, sensor data) would be advantageous.

title: Sales Engineer
description:
Be a part of something bigger...

Our Story

Be a part of something bigger...

Radar Healthcare is dedicated to improving patient safety by bringing together the expertise of healthcare professionals and the power of intuitive software. Our innovative platform has been developed in partnership with industry experts to ensure organisations always meet regulatory standards – making it easier than ever for healthcare providers to deliver top-quality care to their patients.

We’re on a mission to become a world-leading health-tech pioneer, and we know that we can only achieve this with the help of talented individuals like you. If you’re passionate about improving healthcare outcomes and want to work in a team of like-minded individuals, we invite you to join us on our journey.

So if you’re up for an exciting challenge and want to be part of a team that’s making a real impact, we’d love to hear from you!

Our Values

At Radar Healthcare, we are all proud of our values-led, open, supportive and inclusive culture. It's just as important that anyone joining our friendly team share the same values as us, to ensure we're all on the same page from day one, so we're looking for people who feel aligned to the following:

🤝🏽 Customer focused with a partnership approach

📖 Open, honest and transparent

🧠 Innovative

🫶🏼 Ethical, trustworthy and caring

Our People & Culture

At Radar Healthcare, we understand and celebrate the fact that our people are our best assets! We are proud to showcase our diverse and passionate talent that encapsulates our vision, purpose and values in our shared mission of innovation in healthcare. We’re an ambitious but caring team, and so supporting our colleagues and partners is always a top priority. Not to mention, we’re not all work and no play – we love getting together to celebrate our achievements together in various settings, whether it be our winter and summer socials, our people-led full company days, team get togethers or simply just interacting and supporting one another over coffee breaks either remotely or in person at our amazing Leeds office.

"We're also super proud to be Great Place to Work-Certified, based on outstanding feedback directly from our team earlier this year, with 91% of the team agreeing that they "would strongly endorse my company to friends and family as a great place to work" Not to mention Radar Healthcare has been named one of the UK’s Top 100 Companies to Work For 2025, one of the Top 20 Tech Companies to Work For, and has received a Two Star Accreditation from Best Companies, recognising ‘Outstanding’ levels of workplace engagement."" 🫶🏼

The Opportunity

Radar Healthcare's new ⭐Sales Engineer⭐

As we continue to grow across the UK and US markets, we're looking for an experienced Sales Engineer to join our commercial team.

This is an exciting opportunity for someone who loves engaging with customers, demonstrating software solutions and translating complex challenges into meaningful outcomes. You'll be the product expert within our Sales team, helping prospective customers understand the value of Radar Healthcare through compelling demonstrations, consultative discussions and expert product guidance.

What you’ll be doing to make a difference:

As our Sales Engineer, you'll work closely with Sales Leads throughout the sales cycle, partnering with prospective customers and showcasing how Radar Healthcare can help solve their challenges.

Sales demonstration and opportunity progression

  • Lead engaging, outcome-focused product demonstrations for prospective customers across the UK and US markets.

  • Tailor demonstrations to the customer’s priorities, buying criteria, workflows, challenges and desired outcomes.

  • Support discovery, qualification, sales meetings, workshops and solution discussions throughout the sales cycle.

  • Clearly communicate product value, differentiation, functionality and use cases to technical, clinical, operational and executive audiences.

  • Partner with Sales Leads to define the sales objective, demonstration strategy, stakeholder needs, risks and agreed next steps for each opportunity.

Sales engineering and solution expertise

  • Develop and maintain expert knowledge of the Radar Healthcare platform, product portfolio, value proposition and key customer use cases.

  • Maintain a strong understanding of product functionality, approved roadmap developments, integrations, configuration options and solution dependencies.

  • Manage high-quality demonstration environments, sales scenarios and supporting data that reflect priority markets and buyer needs.

  • Provide accurate and timely responses to product, technical and solution questions raised during live opportunities.

  • Keep up to date with healthcare market developments, competitor positioning and customer expectations, using insight to strengthen sales messaging and differentiation.

Support complex sales opportunities

  • Work alongside Sales Leads to understand customer requirements and recommend the most appropriate solution approach.

  • Help qualify opportunities and identify requirements, dependencies and potential solution gaps.

  • Contribute to proposals, tenders, presentations and customer responses.

  • Provide product insight during commercial discussions while ensuring commitments align with current product capability and roadmap plans.

  • Work alongside Sales Leads to qualify customer requirements, buying drivers and success criteria, and identify the most relevant solution approach.

  • Assess product fit, technical requirements, dependencies, risks and potential solution gaps early in the sales cycle.

  • Contribute solution expertise and persuasive, customer-specific content to proposals, tenders, presentations and written responses.

  • Support commercial discussions with clear solution input, ensuring proposed commitments remain aligned with current product capability and the approved roadmap.

Buyer and stakeholder engagement

  • Build credibility and trusted-adviser relationships with clinical, quality, governance, operational, technical, procurement and executive stakeholders.

  • Facilitate consultative conversations that uncover customer challenges, decision criteria, priorities and intended outcomes.

  • Adapt sales messaging, discovery and demonstrations to suit UK and US healthcare contexts, stakeholder expectations and stages of the buying journey.

  • Represent Radar Healthcare at prospect meetings, webinars, conferences and industry events where sales engineering expertise is required.

  • Capture prospect feedback, competitive insight and recurring requirements, sharing them with Sales, Product and relevant internal teams.

Enable internal success

  • Support the onboarding and ongoing product, solution and demonstration capability of sales colleagues across the UK and US.

  • Create and maintain demo scripts, discovery guides, FAQs, objection-handling content, competitive messaging and other sales enablement resources.

Your journey so far...

  • Strong previous experience working in a Sales Engineer, Pre-Sales Consultant or similar role within a comparable sales environment.

  • Strong experience delivering software of SaaS product demonstrations to a range of stakeholder audiences.

  • Ability to understand customer needs and translate them into relevant solution capabilities and business outcomes.

  • Experience supporting complex, multi-stakeholder sales opportunities and working as part of a sales team.

  • Strong presentation, facilitation, and written communication skills.

  • Ability to work flexibly across UK and US sales activity, including occasional travel and meetings across different time zones.

Even better if you…

  • Experience within HealthTech, healthcare software or a SaaS environment.

  • Knowledge of NHS, private healthcare, social care or US healthcare markets.

  • Clinical background or previous experience working in a clinical healthcare setting.

  • Understanding of quality, risk, compliance, patient safety or clinical governance processes.

  • Experience contributing to bids, tenders, proposals or formal customer evaluations.

The Bigger Picture

Whilst we value professional experiences and qualifications, we’re committed to maintaining a culture of growth and development here at Radar Healthcare. We take into account each candidates demonstrable skillset, drive and ethos so even if you don’t feel 100% qualified for the role – we welcome you to connect with us. We’d love to hear from passionate candidates from all backgrounds that align themselves with our company values and are excited to make a difference in healthcare!

What we offer in return...

💜 Values-led culture - we’re extremely proud of our culture. Learn more about what makes it special here

🏢 Flexible working – We believe in empowering our team to work in a way that suits them best. Whether you’re an early bird or prefer working from home most of the time, we trust you to get the job done around our core hours. We have a base expectation of 1 day per month in the office but outside of this, although we have a fantastic office in the heart of Leeds (complete with a rooftop bar for the summer months), the choice is yours!

🏝️ 25 days holiday (+ Bank holidays) continually increasing with service, plus the option to buy up to a week to suit whatever exotic adventures or big life events you have planned for the year ahead

🎂 Birthdays off and a surprise through the letterbox - we love to make a song and dance about every year around the sun!

🤝🏽 Charity leave – giving back is important to us, so we empower all our team members to support charity every year on company time

🧠 Mental healthcare - Face to face counselling support, an app, and an Employee Assistance Program and many colleagues trained in mental health first aid

👩🏾‍⚕️ Healthcare - Cover with Medicash, you get money back when you spend on health appointments e.g. physio, dental, optician, prescriptions, private GP + more

💛 Life cover – a pay-out of 3x your salary to support your beneficiaries if the worst happened

💐 Compassionate leave of up to 5 days time off if you lose a loved one

🤕 Paid sick leave - Enhanced sick pay after 6 months (increasing with service)

🍼 Enhanced family leave - Primary caregivers (maternity/adoption); 16 weeks full pay, 10 weeks half pay & secondary caregivers (paternity); 2 weeks full pay and another 2 weeks full pay to take in your new arrivals first year of life (once you have been with us for 1 year)

💵 Pension - We’re invested in your future, we contribute 3% of your salary to your pension pot, helping you save up for those golden years!
🚙Electric vehicle scheme - Save up to 60% on the cost of an Electric Car

👶Workplace Nursery Scheme - Save up to 41% on nursery fees while accessing a growing network of nursery partners across the UK

🚲Cycle, Tech & Home schemes - Save on home and tech purchases by spreading the cost through interest-free salary deductions, with access to products from leading retailers.

💻 Technology – Rest assured, we'll have a laptop all set up and ready for you on your first day. Additionally, in your first week, we’ll conduct a WFH risk assessment to ensure you have everything you need, including a second screen, keyboard, mouse, and any other goodies!

🐶 Dog friendly office

🎈 Socials – we get together as a full company at least four times per year, plus at least once a quarter in individual teams, too. Not including all the fun activities being planned by our newly formed social committee.

🧩 Discounts on cinema, vouchers, gym memberships, days out and much much more

✨ PLUS a monthly £36 allowance on our flexible benefits platform Radar Rewards to spend on whatever else you might be after (private medical insurance, dental insurance, critical illness cover, or upgrade any of the covers above) with the ability to top up from salary if desired. We’re all different, after all!

Accessibility

If you require any special considerations or adjustments to our application and interviewing process, please don't hesitate to let us know. We understand and celebrate the fact that every person that we connect with is different and therefore requires different starting points on their journey with us. If you have a medical condition or disability we are committed to ensuring that our process is inclusive and accessible for all, let us know how we can best support you.

Connect with us!

We'd love to hear from you! If this role isn't quite right for you but you feel like Radar Healthcare could be, click the Connect button on our careers site and we'll keep you in the loop of new opportunities as they arise. You can also find out more about our mission, values and culture by checking out our various channels:

🎧 Listen to Our What the HealthTech podcast

🔗 Connect with us on Linkedin

💚 Discover why Radar Healthcare is a fantastic place to work from our very own people on Glassdoor!

Connect with us on our journey and get to know the people who make us shine!

title: Kokoonpanija, Koja Oy
description:
Koja Group on yli 90-vuotias suomalainen kasvava perheyritys, joka tarjoaa asiakkailleen ilmankäsittelyratkaisuja kiinteistöihin ja laivoihin sekä puhallinratkaisuja teollisuuteen. Tuotamme innovatiivisia teknologiaratkaisuja tehokkaasti ja turvallisesti, tavoitteenamme auttaa asiakkaita saavuttamaan heidän omat energia- ja ympäristötavoitteensa. Konserniin kuuluu emoyhtiö Koja-Yhtiöt Oy:n lisäksi Koja Oy ja Chiller Oy sekä näiden tytäryhtiöt ja toiminnot Suomessa, Ruotsissa, Saksassa ja USA:ssa. Työllistämme yhteensä yli 500 henkilöä. Tutustu meihin tarkemmin:

Haluatko työn, jossa näet konkreettisesti oman kädenjälkesi ja pääset osaksi suomalaisen perheyrityksen kasvutarinaa? Etsimme nyt Koja Oy:n Jalasjärven tehtaalle kokoonpanotyöntekijöitä ilmanvaihtokoneiden valmistukseen vakituisiin sekä määräaikaisiin työsuhteisiin.

Mitä tulisit tekemään?
Pääset mukaan valmistamaan laadukkaita ilmanvaihtokoneita osana ammattitaitoista tuotantotiimiä. Jalasjärven tehtaalle on keskitetty Kojan ilmanvaihtokone- ja lämmönvaihdintuotanto. Työsi koostuu monipuolisista kokoonpanotehtävistä, ja pääset seuraamaan tuotteen valmistumista vaihe vaiheelta valmiiksi tuotteeksi saakka.

Työ on kokoaikainen ja sitä tehdään arkipäivisin kahdessa vuorossa.

Mitä etsimme?
Etsimme motivoitunutta ja yhteistyökykyistä tekijää, jolla on oma-aloitteinen työote ja aitoa kiinnostusta tuotanto- ja kokoonpanotyötä kohtaan. Arvostamme halua oppia uutta ja kehittyä työssäsi. Tehtävään soveltuva koulutus tai aiempi kokemus kokoonpanosta, tuotannosta tai teollisuuden työtehtävistä katsotaan eduksi, mutta meillä asenne ja oppimishalukkuus ratkaisevat eniten. Työssä tarvitaan sujuvaa suomen kielen taitoa työohjeiden, perehdytyksen ja päivittäisen kommunikoinnin vuoksi.

Mitä tarjoamme?
Tarjoamme monipuolisen ja kiinnostavan työn vakavaraisessa, kasvavassa ja kotimaisessa yrityksessä. Koja investoi vahvasti kotimaiseen tuotantoon ja kehittää toimintaansa pitkäjänteisesti tulevaisuuteen katsoen. Jalasjärven tehtaalla on parhaillaan tehdaslaajennusprojekti käynnissä kasvustrategiaa mukaillen.

Koja on perheyritys, joka tarjoaa erinomaiset mahdollisuudet ammatilliseen kasvuun ja kehittymiseen. Rinnallasi on mukavat työkaverit ja työyhteisön tuki. Saat tehtävään kattavan perehdytyksen, jonka avulla pääset sujuvasti kiinni työtehtäviisi.

Tarjoamme mahdollisuuden työllistyä vakituiseen tai määräaikaiseen työsuhteeseen Kojan tuotannon tarpeiden mukaan. Töitä on tarjolla vähintään vuoden loppuun saakka.

Koja on savuton työpaikka.

Kiinnostuitko?
Laitahan hakemusta tulemaan! Hakuaika tehtävään päättyy 20.9.2026, mutta käsittelemme hakemuksia jo hakuaikana ja paikat täytetään heti sopivien henkilöiden löydyttyä, joten kannattaa hakea mahdollisimman pian.

Rekrytointiprosessi toteutetaan yhteistyössä Biisonin kanssa, ja valitut henkilöt työllistyvät Biisonin työntekijöiksi vuokratyösuhteeseen työskennellen Kojalla Jalasjärven tehtaalla.

Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa Johanna Paloneva, Biisoni, johanna.paloneva@biisoni.fi.

title: Senior Data Analyst (Marketing_CRM)

Coupang is reimagining the shopping experience with the goal of wowing each customer from the instant they open the Coupang app to the moment an order is delivered to their door.

Our services in Taiwan include “Rocket Delivery” which offers next-day delivery for a wide selection of items at affordable prices, “Rocket Overseas” which offers free international delivery on millions of best-selling products from Korea, the U.S., and beyond.

We are looking for talents to help us lead Coupang’s expansion in Taiwan. This is an exceptional opportunity to become a part of Coupang’s growth in Taiwan and create a world where our customers wonder, “How did I ever live without Coupang?”

title: Head of Partnerships

WE ARE HIRING A HEAD OF PARTNERSHIPS

Ever opened a new bank account and got a weekend away? Spent on fashion and received a personal styling session? Picked up groceries and walked away with cinema tickets?

If so, you’ve probably experienced a TLC Worldwide campaign - without even knowing it.

At TLC, we help the world’s biggest brands drive customer acquisition, loyalty and engagement with emotionally engaging, experience-led rewards. From global banks to high street retailers, our programs are designed shift behaviour, boost ROI and build genuine brand love – at the fraction of the cost of discounting and cash offers. We’ve spent 30 years mastering what moves customers; combining deep consumer insight, a global network of 100,000+ rewards, and a unique ability to drive measurable ROI for brands.

We’re 400+ people strong, across 15 global hubs. A collective of marketers, creatives and strategists who care about doing great work - and having fun while we do it. We celebrate bold thinking, empower growth, and champion the kind of culture that helps people thrive.

Here are a few things that we've got to offer:

  • Dynamic & collaborative team in a creative environment with exposure to global clients & colleagues - Check out our clients

  • Annual TLC Wellness Week and programmes throughout the year

  • TLC Culture Club - including seasonal social events, tasty lunches & more

This is an opportunity to shape the future of TLC's partner ecosystem, unlock new revenue opportunities, and build strategic relationships that directly contribute to client growth around the world.

As Head of Partnerships, you'll lead the strategy, growth and performance of our global partner network.

You'll be responsible for identifying new opportunities, negotiating commercially valuable agreements, developing long-term strategic relationships, and leading a talented partnerships team to deliver exceptional results.

What you'll be doing:

Grow and evolve our partner network

  • Define and deliver TLC's global partnership strategy.

  • Identify and secure high-value strategic partners.

  • Expand our rewards portfolio to support existing and future client needs.

  • Spot emerging trends and opportunities before our competitors do.

  • Ensure our partner offering remains innovative, relevant and commercially competitive.

Drive commercial impact

  • Lead complex negotiations and secure commercially advantageous agreements.

  • Support new business pitches with compelling partner propositions.

  • Collaborate with Sales and Client Growth teams on account expansion opportunities.

  • Create new revenue streams through strategic partnerships.

  • Ensure partnerships directly contribute to campaign performance and client success.

Lead and inspire

  • Build, coach and develop a high-performing partnerships team.

  • Set clear objectives, KPIs and development plans.

  • Create a culture of accountability, collaboration and continuous improvement.

  • Champion knowledge sharing and cross-functional working.

Deliver operational excellence

  • Ensure strong governance, reporting and contract management.

  • Monitor partnership performance and ROI.

  • Improve processes and ways of working to support future growth.

  • Maintain exceptional service standards across the partnership lifecycle.

Who we're looking for:
Essential

  • Significant experience in partnerships, business development, commercial leadership or sales.

  • Proven success securing and growing strategic commercial partnerships.

  • Experience leading high-performing teams.

  • Strong commercial negotiation and stakeholder management skills.

  • Ability to influence senior leaders and external partners.

  • Experience operating in a fast-paced, client-focused environment.

Nice to have

  • Experience within loyalty, rewards, customer engagement, marketing or promotional industries.

  • Experience working with international partners and global markets.

  • Knowledge of retail, hospitality, leisure, travel or digital rewards sectors.

Who you are

You're someone who naturally spots opportunities where others see obstacles.

You thrive on building relationships, negotiating win-win outcomes, and turning ideas into commercial results. You're equally comfortable developing long-term strategy and rolling up your sleeves to make things happen.

You lead with energy, curiosity and ambition, and you love helping others succeed.

Being a people-led business, we hire upon values and believe that our people are what make the beloved TLC culture so unique.

At TLC we aim to create a ‘world within the world’ that is free from prejudice, bias and inequity.

A world where diversity is valued and celebrated, and where we work hard to ensure all our wonderful people are given equal opportunity to succeed.

If you're excited by everything we've told you, then it's time to apply!

title: Planner & Scheduler
description:
Studies show that women and underrepresented groups often hesitate to apply unless they meet every requirement. At Stegra, we’re building an impact-driven, sustainable company - and we need a diverse, inclusive team to make it happen.

If you share our passion but don’t meet every qualification, we encourage you to apply anyway. You might be the perfect fit for this role, or another as we grow.

At Stegra, we’re not just building a plant, we’re proving that sustainable industry is possible. And to do that, we need people like you.

Join a team where safety comes first. Where we support each other, learn as we go, and make space for everyone to grow and contribute. This is your chance to be part of something big - while being closer to nature and leading a balanced, purposeful life.

Employment: Temporary, 12-24 months

Location: Boden

What you’ll do

Right now, we are looking for a Planner & Scheduler for our Planning & Scheduling team. In this role you will sit within our Project Delivery function and support planning and scheduling activities for an assigned project area.

As Planner & Scheduler, you will work closely with Construction, Engineering, Commissioning, Project Controls, EPCM partners, and contractors to maintain realistic and integrated schedules. You will help track progress, identify constraints and schedule risks, and provide reliable planning information to support project execution and decision-making.

Specific to this role, the day-to-day tasks will include the following but as we are a growing company with very little silos between teams, other tasks might be included as well.

  • Develop, update, and maintain project schedules in line with project planning standards

  • Support the maintenance and integration of the Integrated Master Schedule (IMS) for your assigned area

  • Review EPCM and contractor schedules and identify inconsistencies, missing logic, constraints, and potential impacts

  • Integrate schedule information from contractors, EPCM partners, and internal stakeholders

  • Monitor actual progress against planned activities and support schedule updates and forecasting

  • Analyze schedules to identify delays, trends, risks, constraints, and opportunities

  • Support mitigation and recovery planning when schedule challenges arise

  • Participate in site reviews, coordination meetings, planning workshops, and weekly and monthly reporting

What you’ll bring

You’re curious and believe that real progress happens when we work together. You’re not afraid to challenge old ways of thinking and you treat others with respect while doing it. At Stegra, we value people who take initiative, build trust, and help create a workplace where everyone can do their best.

Specific to this role, we would like to see that you can tick off a fair amount of the boxes below

  • 3+ years of relevant experience in project planning and scheduling or similar roles, preferably within industrial, construction, infrastructure, or EPCM projects

  • Relevant degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Project Management, Project Controls, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience

  • Good understanding of project planning and scheduling methodologies

  • Experience developing, updating, and analyzing project schedules

  • Understanding of Integrated Master Schedules (IMS), schedule integration, progress measurement, and forecasting

  • Ability to review contractor and EPCM schedules and identify constraints, risks, and inconsistencies

  • Experience using relevant planning and scheduling tools

  • Strong analytical, organizational, and communication skills, with fluency in English

Benefits at Stegra

At Stegra, you’ll join a company where your work has real impact on the climate, the industry, and future generations. We’re building a culture rooted in safety, trust, and inclusion, where people feel supported to grow and thrive.

You’ll receive fair, competitive compensation aligned with collective agreements, along with benefits like up to 30 days of paid vacation, occupational pension, parental benefits, and insurance. If you need support with relocation or immigration, our relocation department will help guide you through the process, whether it’s permits, housing or other practical matters. You can also enjoy perks like subsidized gym memberships and bike leases, plus the everyday benefits of life closer to nature.

Read more about Benefits at Stegra here.

This is Stegra

Stegra is on a mission to change the global steel industry by producing green hydrogen, iron, and steel - with the goal of eliminating CO₂ emissions. Instead of coal, we use green hydrogen and fossil-free electricity, meaning our primary emissions will be water and heat.

By 2030, our ambition is to produce 5 million tonnes of green steel annually in our fully integrated, digitized, and sustainable plant in Boden, Northern Sweden - currently under construction. But this is just the beginning. Our expertise in green hydrogen will enable us to decarbonize industries beyond steel, paving the way for a cleaner future.

Our Boden Site

Our Boden site is located just west of Boden City, right in the heart of a growing green industrial hub in Northern Sweden. It’s where we’re building one of the world’s most modern, sustainable steel plants—designed with safety, efficiency, and people in mind. With just a 10-minute commute from town, you'll be close to both cutting-edge technology and the everyday convenience of living near nature, schools, and community life.

Boden Video

title: Information Technology - Lead Data Engineer
description:

The lead data engineer is a senior software developer with strong software engineering skills who is responsible for building custom open‑source‑based data ingestion and MLOps platforms.   • Design and develop MLOps production pipelines; provide technical support to data scientists/ML engineers by getting their ML/DL models deployed at scale and meeting SLAs on both cloud and on‑premises GPU and CPU instances.
  • Design data models for mission‑critical, high‑volume, near‑real‑time/batch data; build idempotent/atomic production data pipelines to make data ingestion more fault tolerant.
  • Design and develop intuitive, highly automated, self‑service data platform functions for business users.
  • Design, build, and operate scalable and reliable data pipelines on the Databricks platform.
  • Explore, evaluate and champion the introduction of next‑generation technologies in the data‑ingestion workflow. Participate in project planning and provide technical guidance on cloud architecture for data projects.

Requirements

  • BS in Computer Science or other related discipline is required. Advanced degrees in Computer Science (PhD, MS) are highly desirable.

  • Advanced programming skills in Python. Conversant with data structures and algorithm design.
  • Experience in building data pipelines (including data collection, warehousing, processing, analysis, monitoring, and governance) using open‑source data ingestion platforms.
  • Intermediate‑level knowledge and experience with AWS cloud components and best practices. Good understanding in deploying data stores such as S3, RedShift, Elasticache, PostgreSQL, and EMR.
  • Hands‑on experience with Databricks workspace, cluster management, AI Agent capabilities, and job orchestration.
  • Prior experience in modern software development is required (such as web frontend UI, backend API microservices, understanding of CI/CD and Scrum/Kanban agile development). Strong grasp on object‑oriented or functional programming (using e.g. Python, Java, Scala, or C#).

description:

That means the terms and conditions of your employment are governed by university policy (including the Staff Personnel Policies Manual) and any collective bargaining agreement entered into between American University and SEIU Local 500 - Provost & Enrollment Division.

Job Description:

Summary:

The Industry Engagement Specialist (IES) spearheads establishing and maintaining robust partnerships with key players in [specific industry, e.g., finance, technology, healthcare, sustainability, consulting, media, entertainment, hospitality, real estate] to cultivate new employer relationships for the purpose of enhancing career outcomes for Kogod undergraduate and graduate students. The IES will expand internship and job opportunities for Kogod students by establishing strong relationships with key employers, recruiters, and alumni in order to develop important networks, identify quality internship and career programs and opportunities, and keep abreast of employer needs. The IES will identify and build relationships with target employers within the specified key industry sector with strong internship and full-time job opportunities that align with Kogod students’ interests and strengths, and to increase opportunities for students to interview with these companies by effectively marketing the Kogod School of Business. The successful candidate will be responsible for identifying potential corporate partners, developing engagement strategies, coordinating recruitment events, and ensuring a continuous presence of industry opportunities available to our students. This position demands a proactive approach, excellent relationship-building skills, and a deep understanding of industry trends to effectively match our students' skills with employer needs. The IES will act as a bridge between the business school and industry, enhancing the school's reputation as a prime source of top-tier talent.

Essential Functions:

1.) Outreach and Engagement

  • Develop a strategic vision and plan for ongoing engagement with external partners, including employers and alumni, and oversee execution of that plan throughout the calendar year.

  • Understand Needs of Employer: Conduct research to understand the industries, sectors, and types of organizations that are of interest to students. Gather feedback from employers about their recruitment needs, competition, challenges facing the company, preferred communication channels, and expectations. Gain deep understanding of student populations and curricular highlights to be able to market Kogod student and alumni talent. Listen to what employers want and key obstacles or barriers to success. Attend networking functions as appropriate to develop employer contacts while promoting university and college objectives.

  • Build and Maintain Relationships: Create, cultivate, and maintain external relationships to ensure active engagement; establish personal connections with employer representatives. Regularly communicate with employers to stay updated on their recruitment needs, upcoming opportunities, and feedback on student candidates. Maintain communication to ensure awareness and create a regular cadence for outreach. Foster long-term relationships by providing value added services and meeting needs.

  • Develop Targeted Engagement Strategy: Prioritize employers based on their potential to offer valuable opportunities to students and their willingness to engage with Kogod. Create a plan for outreach and engagement tailored to the specific needs of the employer. Conduct business development, both virtually and in person, within industries including outreach to new companies and increasing the Kogod hiring footprint across companies where relationships currently exist. Understand the unique recruitment challenges and objectives of each employer and tailor services accordingly. Understand recruiting timelines to ensure deliverables meet expectations. Promote ethical standards such as interviewing protocols.

2.) Collaboration with Career Coaches, Faculty and Staff

  • Meet regularly with career coaches to share information about employer events, recruiting opportunities, application deadlines, etc. Work with career coaches to identify students for key opportunities and inclusion in curated resume books.

  • Collaborate with UG, MBA, and specialty master’s program faculty to better understand curriculum and share insights into how curriculum can support employer needs. Share information with faculty and program leadership about specific opportunities, events, and application deadlines. Share industry and recruiting insights with faculty and program leadership.

3.) Special Programming

  • Participate in the design and plan of strategic engagements such as career fairs, networking events, etc. for Kogod and American University.

  • Offer Customized Solutions: Provide solutions such as fairs, networking events, employer panels, and industry-specific workshops etc. to facilitate interactions between students and employers. Partner with student clubs to deliver targeted engagements and enhance connectivity. Provide customized recruitment solutions such as career sessions, coffee chats, in class presentations, skills sessions, site visits, 1:1 or group engagements – both in-person and virtual.

  • Partnerships: Partners with departments and other academic units to identify relevant and appropriate on-campus professional development opportunities, including class speakers, panelists, and career mentoring opportunities; works with event staff to ensure positive experience for students and guests.

4.) Communication, Databases, and Reporting

  • Contribute to and maintain a database of active employers and alumni and reports on engagement activities, their success, and recommendations for future opportunities.

  • Communication: Create content on appropriate media channels to maximize visibility of opportunities both to promote beforehand and report on afterwards.

  • CRM: Maintain accurate notes on employer outreach and engagement; prepare correspondence, reports, and presentations regarding outreach activities and events; track communication to ensure successful activities and events are documented.

  • Evaluate Effort: Utilize key performance indicators (KPIs) as established by leadership to measure effectiveness of employer engagement efforts. Regularly assess the impact of engagement activities on student outcomes, employer satisfaction, and overall career services objectives. Participate in semester and year end debrief meetings as well and contribute to reporting. Use feedback from employers and students to continuously improve engagement strategies and services offered.

  • Outcomes: Collaborate with data team to collect and track student outcomes from employers and maintain knowledge of applicable reporting standards.

  • Stay Informed: Stay updated on industry trends, participate in professional development workshops, conferences, and training sessions, and implement new strategies or techniques learned.

5.) Industry-Specific Guidance and Other Duties

  • Training: Share industry trends, recruiting timelines, and other best practices with coaching teams and staff to inform student preparation. Participate in development of student resources related to industry trends and hiring timelines.

  • Other duties as assigned: Facilitate special projects, serve on committees, etc. as needed.

Competencies:

  • Serving Customers.

  • Displaying Creativity.

  • Prioritizing and Organizing.

  • Acquiring and Analyzing Information.

  • Supporting Coworkers.

Position Type/Expected Hours of Work:

  • Full-time.

  • 35 hours per week.

  • The schedule is 9AM - 5PM, Monday - Friday with some evening/weekend hours.

Salary Range:

  • $75,000.00 - $85,000.00 annually.

Required Education and Experience:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent.

  • 4 - 6 years of relevant experience.

Preferred Education and Experience:

  • Master's degree or equivalent.

  • 5 - 8 years of relevant experience.

Travel Required:

  • Position requires domestic and international travel.

Additional Eligibility Qualifications:

1.) Values and Approach

  • Team Orientation: Collaborate effectively and communicate transparently while welcoming diverse viewpoints.

  • Quality Focus: Consistently produce accurate and exceptional work in dynamic environment.

  • Initiative and Ingenuity: Generate innovative ways to create and implement ideas.

  • Continuous Learning: Maintain an optimistic outlook and adaptable approach to work.

  • Inclusive Leadership: Inspire and motivate others to meet goals while providing clarity and empathy.

2.) Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Proficient communication skill.

  • Experience and knowledge of, or demonstrated interest in, business careers.

  • Demonstrated knowledge of relationship management databases.

  • High proficiency in MS Office, including Excel and PowerPoint along with demonstrated in-depth experience using LinkedIn and other professional social networking sites.

  • Experience in University career services, recruiting, staffing, human resources or business development.

3.) Preferred Skills

  • Broad understanding of the value of a business school education, particularly MBA and specialty master's programs and the international visa process.

  • Experience in or knowledge of working within industry specific areas.

title: Employé logistique H/F
description:
At ALS, we encourage you to dream big.

When you join us, you’ll be part of a global team harnessing the power of scientific testing and data-driven insights to build a healthier future.

Chez ALS France, nous mettons notre expertise au service de la qualité, de la sécurité et de la protection de l’environnement grâce à un portefeuille complet d’analyses dans les domaines de l’environnement, des produits, de l’alimentation et de la cosmétique.

En intégrant ALS, vous rejoignez un leader mondial du contrôle et des tests, présent dans plus de 70 pays et fort de plus de 22 000 collaborateurs engagés à faire avancer la science au service de la société.

Nos trois sites français — Lyon, Paris et Lille — rassemblent des équipes passionnées qui œuvrent chaque jour dans des laboratoires modernes et spécialisés, de l’analyse des sols et de l’eau à la microbiologie alimentaire et cosmétique.

Dans ce contexte, nous recherchons un·e Employé Logistique H/F pour renforcer notre équipe logistique et garantir un service d’excellence dans la préparation, l’expédition et le contrôle des échantillons.

Vos missions

Préparation de commandes

· Gérer le matériel et les stocks logistiques : réception, contrôle, remise en état et rangement du matériel d’expédition.

· Assurer la réception et la remise en conformité des boxes : nettoyage, tri, scan et vérification de l’état des équipements.

· Préparer et expédier le matériel de conditionnement selon les demandes (flaconnage, matériel associé, documents).

· Organiser le retour et la réexpédition des échantillons auprès des différents laboratoires.

· Contribuer au respect des procédures qualité, hygiène et sécurité en vigueur dans l’entreprise.

Livraison

· Livrer les flacons auprès de nos clients avec notre véhicule léger en alternance avec les membres de l'équipe. Conduite dans Lyon et ses alentours. (véhicule avec boîte automatique)

Votre profil

· Vous êtes titulaire d’une formation de niveau Bac.

· Une expérience en logistique serait un véritable atout pour réussir sur ce poste.

· Vous faites preuve de rigueur, d’organisation, de réactivité et avez un sens du service développé.

· Vous êtes à l’aise avec l’utilisation d’outils de scan et de numérisation.

Informations complémentaires

Vos avantages chez ALS France

· Horaires en journée

· Week‑ends libres

· 6 semaines de congés + 7 RTT (année pleine)

Working at ALS

The ALS team is a diverse and dedicated community united by our passion to make a difference in the world.

Our values are important to us, and shape how we work, how we treat each other and how we recognise excellence.

At ALS, you’ll be supported to develop new skills and reach your full potential. We invest in our people with programs and opportunities that help you build a diverse career with us.

We want everyone to have a safe, flexible and rewarding career that makes a positive impact on our people, the planet and our communities.
