title: Psykiatrinen sairaanhoitaja
description:
Haemme psykiatrista sairaanhoitajaa YTHS:n Joensuun palvelupisteeseen. Tehtävä on kokoaikainen ja vakituinen alkaen sopimuksen mukaan lokakuussa 2026.

Tavoitteemme on tarjota korkeakouluopiskelijoille sama opiskeluterveydenhuollon palveluvalikoima opiskelupaikkakunnasta riippumatta. Palvelemme opiskelijoita lähivastaanottojen, etävastaanottojen ja valtakunnallisten digitaalisten palvelujen muodossa. Asiakas- ja potilastietojärjestelmänä meillä on käytössä Acute. Digitaalinen asiointialustamme on BeeHealthyn YTHSDigi.

Asiakaskuntamme on mukavaa ja hoitoonsa sitoutunutta. Työllämme vaikutamme korkeakouluopiskelijoiden tulevaisuuteen ja olemme oleellinen linkki opiskelukyvyn turvaamisessa.

Psykiatrinen sairaanhoitaja toimii työssään perusterveydenhuollon psykiatrisen hoitotyön tukena mielenterveys- ja päihdeasioissa sekä opiskelijoiden psyykkisen terveyden, toiminta- sekä opiskelukyvyn ja elämänhallinnan tukena. Psykiatrinen sairaanhoitaja tekee lyhyitä hoitojaksoja ohjaten asiakkaita tarvittaessa jatkohoitoon YTHS:n prosessien mukaisesti. Työnkuvaan kuuluu ensivaiheen tukea, neuropsykiatrista arviota, ohjattua omahoitoa ja ryhmien ohjaamista. Tehtävänkuvaasi lisäksi sisältyy työskentelyä digitaalisen asiointialustan parissa.

Tarjoamme uudelle työkaverillemme:

  • Huolellisen perehdytyksen

  • Säännöllistä koulutusta osaamisen kehittämiseksi, koulutamme työntekijöitämme mm. Terapiat etulinjaan -toimintamallin mukaiseen ohjatun omahoidon toteuttamiseen

  • Joustoa työaikaan: kokonaistyöaika on 38h 35min/vko, ja käytössämme on vuosityöaika

  • Osittaisen etätyömahdollisuuden

  • Työhyvinvointia tukevia etuja, kuten ePassi-virike-etuuden ja palvelupisteillä järjestettäviä hyvinvointitapahtumia

  • Kattavat työterveyspalvelut

Odotamme sinulta terveydenhoitajan tai sairaanhoitajan tutkintoa, ja kokemusta psykiatrisesta hoitotyöstä. Toivomme myös kokemusta itsenäisen hoitajavastaanoton pitämisestä mielenterveystyössä ja psykiatristen diagnostisten haastatteluiden tuntemusta. Katsomme eduksi esim. IPC- ja/tai KLT-koulutuksen sekä suomen kielen lisäksi riittävän englannin/ruotsin kielen taidon. Edellytämme tartuntatautilain mukaista rokotussuojaa. Olemme YTHS:llä sitoutuneet edistämään monimuotoisuutta sekä tasa-arvoa ja kannustamme kaikkia päteviä hakijoita hakemaan tehtävää.

Palkkauksen ja työehtojen suhteen noudatamme YTHS työehtosopimusta (YTHS TES) ja siltä osin kuin siinä ei ole kirjattu, Terveyspalvelualan työehtosopimusta (TPTES). Tehtäväkohtainen palkka muodostuu vaativuusryhmän mukaisesta peruspalkasta ja mahdollisista erityistekijälisistä. Lisäksi maksamme henkilökohtaista palkanosaa, johon sisältyy vuosisidonnainen takuu (enintään 11 % tehtäväkohtaisesta palkasta). Hoitajan kokoaikaisessa (38h 35min/vko) tehtävässä (VR4) palkka on osaamisesta ja kokemuksesta riippuen 2841-3154 euroa kuukaudessa.

Heräsikö kysyttävää? Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa tiimipäällikkö Mervi Toivanen, mervi.toivanen@yths.fi tai p. 046 876 9221. Puhelimitse tavoitettavissa parhaiten 10.9. klo 12-15 sekä 15.9. klo 12-14.

Jos kiinnostuit tehtävästä, jätä hakemuksesi meille viimeistään 20.9.2026. Haastatteluja toteutetaan jo hakuaikana ja tarvittaessa etäyhteyksin.

Me YTHS:llä tarjoamme opiskeluterveydenhuollon palveluja ja teemme terveyden ja hyvinvoinnin edistämistyötä välittävällä ja yhdenvertaisella otteella. Takaamme laadukkaat, tasavertaiset ja saavutettavat terveydenhuoltopalvelut osaavien ammattilaisten, kohdennetun palveluvalikoiman ja digitaalisten palvelujen avulla. Huolehdimme noin 300 000 korkeakouluopiskelijan terveydestä, hyvinvoinnista ja opiskelukyvystä yli tuhannen ammattilaisen voimin 23:lla omalla palvelupisteellä eri puolilla Suomea. Tavoitteemme on rakentaa inhimillisempää työelämää ja yhteiskuntaa. Autamme jokaista onnistumaan ja saavuttamaan tavoitteensa, niin opinnoissa kuin työssäkin. title: Category Performance Executive - THG Nutrition | Myprotein
description:
About THG

We are THG, a global ecommerce group on a mission to be the global online leader in beauty and sports nutrition.

Our portfolio of leading retailers and brands such as LOOKFANTASTIC, Myprotein, ESPA, Perricone MD, and Cult Beauty form our two core businesses: THG Beauty and THG Nutrition.

From Manchester to New York, we’re powered by a team of over 2500 people who work together, lead by example, and think BIG.

With us, you’ll go further, faster. What are you waiting for?

Life at THG Nutrition

THG Nutrition is home to some of the world’s most trusted and best-loved wellbeing and nutrition brands, including Myprotein, the world’s largest online sports nutrition brand, alongside Myvegan, Myvitamins and MP Activewear.

Our brands and people exist to break boundaries — to power and empower those who want more. We move fast, challenge convention, and back ourselves to win. These values shape how we work every day.

Role Overview:

As a Category Performance Executive, you’ll play a key role in supporting the growth and optimisation of multiple product categories within the Myprotein portfolio — including, Vitamins, Bars, Foods, Snacks (BFS), Hydration, and Core Nutrition.

You’ll work closely with the Ecommerce Category Manager to monitor performance, deliver actionable insights, and help implement trading strategies that drive sales, engagement, and profitability across global markets.

As a Category Performance Executive You'll:

Category Performance & Analysis

  • Support the Category Manager in tracking and analysing category performance across key markets.
  • Monitor sales data, pricing trends, and site metrics to identify growth opportunities and trading risks.
  • Assist with the creation and execution of category plans to maximise sales and conversion.
  • Conduct regular website audits to ensure category visibility, accuracy, and optimal customer experience (CX).

Market & Competitor Insights

  • Research competitor activity, product launches, and pricing to support category strategy decisions.
  • Report on market trends and emerging opportunities to inform marketing and product plans.
  • Collaborate with Brand and Marketing teams to ensure alignment between category positioning and consumer demand.

Pricing & Promotions

  • Help manage day-to-day pricing updates and promotional activity across Myprotein sites.
  • Support the execution of promotional campaigns, ensuring timely implementation and accurate tracking.
  • Work with regional teams to ensure promotional activity meets both growth and margin targets.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Liaise with supply chain and trading teams to maintain stock availability and support new product launches.
  • Work with procurement, logistics, and finance teams to support cost efficiency and margin improvement.
  • Partner with customer service and marketing teams to share insights and ensure a consistent customer experience.

Performance Reporting

  • Maintain and update dashboards and reports to track performance by product category and region.
  • Present key insights to internal stakeholders to inform weekly and monthly trading reviews.
  • Support senior team members with ad hoc analysis and reporting requests.

What we are looking for:

  • Around 1-2 years of experience in Ecommerce, Category Management, or Digital Trading — ideally in retail, FMCG, or nutrition.
  • Strong analytical mindset with the ability to draw insights from data and report trends clearly.
  • Commercial awareness and basic understanding of pricing, promotions, and profit margins.
  • Good collaboration and communication skills with experience working cross-functionally.
  • Highly organised, detail-oriented, and proactive in identifying opportunities for improvement.
  • Comfortable using analytics tools (e.g., Google Analytics, Tableau, Excel, or similar).

What’s in it for me?

Career Development

  • Access bespoke development programmes that have been designed and developed by our in-house L&D team.
  • Continued development through our upskilling programme that is delivered in partnership with an industry-leading training provider.

Enhanced Leave

  • 25 days annual leave plus bank holidays.
  • Don’t want to work on your birthday? We don’t either! Enjoy your day off on us!
  • Enhanced maternity and paternity pay, depending on length of service.
  • Up to 10 days compassionate leave.
  • Buy back up to 3 days each year.

title: Projects Assistant - Africa Marine Programme
description:
Application deadline: Thursday 24 September 2026 – 23:59
Location: Dakar, Senegal

Full-time : 40 hours per week
Contract: 1 year fixed-term contract

Salary: Gross monthly salary: EURO 800 – 1,079

We’re BirdLife International, the only global Partnership conserving birds and all life on our planet. We exist to give one voice to nature, and to unite and strengthen conservation across borders.

We are seeking a dedicated Projects Assistant who will contribute to the implementation of projects within BirdLife International’s Africa Marine Programme, with a strong focus on seabird conservation and fisheries engagement, bycatch mitigation, fisheries governance and data collection systems in West Africa. The Projects Assistant will provide technical and coordination support to fisheries-related components of key projects, including direct collaboration with observer programmes, fishing communities, and regional stakeholders. The role involves coordinating and delivering field-based activities, including training delivery, community engagement, and monitoring of fisheries interactions with marine biodiversity, and contributing to strengthening science–policy linkages, fisheries data systems, and stakeholder engagement across the region..

How you will do this:

Fisheries Engagement & Field Support

  • Engage with fisheries stakeholders, including authorities, observer programmes, and fishing communities.

  • Build and maintain relationships with local partners and stakeholders to support project activities and data collection.

  • Collect, collate and synthesise information on fisheries practices, including gear types and bycatch issues.

Data Collection, Monitoring & Training

  • Conduct data collection and analysis related to fisheries and bycatch, and contribute to reporting on findings.

  • Coordinate and implement observer programmes and monitoring activities.

  • Plan and deliver trainings and capacity-building activities with fisheries stakeholders.

Project Implementation

  • Coordinate and deliver project activities, including workshops, meetings, and fieldwork.

  • Manage coordination between partners and stakeholders, ensuring timely delivery of project outputs.

  • Produce project documentation, reports, and maintain organised project records.

Field Activities

  • Assist in preparing financial analyses and management reports.

  • Coordinate activities with fishing communities, including trainings and monitoring with fishers.

  • Manage community engagement and data collection in the field.

This role will require 4-6 weeks of travel per year within West and North Africa.

What we are looking for:

The successful candidate will hold an MSc or equivalent postgraduate qualification in marine science, fisheries science, environmental management, or a related field, with 6–12 months of relevant professional experience in fisheries, marine conservation, or coastal community work in West Africa. They will have a good understanding of fisheries systems, bycatch and marine conservation, with familiarity with the West African fisheries sector and established stakeholder networks considered a strong advantage. The role requires excellent organisational, coordination and interpersonal skills, including the ability to manage multiple deadlines, build effective partner relationships, and plan and deliver workshops, training and stakeholder engagement activities. Candidates should demonstrate strong analytical and reporting skills, experience with fisheries monitoring and applied conservation, and the ability to work independently, take initiative and solve problems proactively. Strong MS Word, Excel and PowerPoint skills are essential, while proficiency in statistical software and/or GIS is desirable. Excellent English working proficiency and fluency in French are required, along with the ability to work effectively across diverse nationalities and cultural backgrounds.

See the full job description here.

Commensurate with experience and qualifications and in accordance with BirdLife International, Africa Division terms and conditions.

title: Big Data Engineer
description:
Job Summary

We are looking for an experienced Big Data Administrator / Big Data Engineer - L3 to support and maintain enterprise Big Data infrastructure in a production environment.

The successful candidate will be responsible for the availability, reliability, performance and stability of Big Data platforms , with a strong focus on Hadoop ecosystem administration, Linux infrastructure, HDFS, YARN, Kafka and related technologies.

This is an L3 technical role requiring strong troubleshooting capabilities, hands‑on experience with large Hadoop clusters, production incident management, performance tuning, capacity planning and infrastructure improvements.

The role will also involve working closely with architects, developers, project teams, service managers and other technical teams to support technology roadmaps, transformation projects and continuous service improvement.

Key Responsibilities

Big Data Platform Administration

  • Build, configure and maintain enterprise Hadoop cluster infrastructure .
  • Perform Hadoop installation, upgrades, patches and version migrations.
  • Administer large-scale Hadoop clusters and associated ecosystem components.
  • Manage HDFS, YARN and MapReduce environments.
  • Perform cluster maintenance, deployment and node addition/removal activities.
  • Monitor cluster health, availability, capacity and performance.
  • Perform HDFS backup and restoration activities.
  • Manage file systems, storage capacity and cluster resources.
  • Review Hadoop logs and monitoring alerts to identify and resolve issues.
  • Ensure Hadoop clusters are properly configured, secured and optimized.
  • Perform capacity planning and recommend infrastructure improvements.
  • Tune cluster and MapReduce workloads for optimal performance.
  • Configure and monitor cluster jobs and workloads.

Security & Access Management

  • Manage Hadoop users and access permissions.
  • Support Linux user administration related to Hadoop environments.
  • Configure and support Kerberos authentication .
  • Support PAM and other access‑control mechanisms.
  • Monitor Hadoop cluster connectivity and security.
  • Apply security patches and infrastructure hardening practices.
  • Ensure security and operational procedures are followed.

Kafka & Data Platform Operations

  • Perform Kafka administration and operational support .
  • Monitor Kafka infrastructure and troubleshoot operational issues.
  • Support availability and reliability of data‑streaming services.
  • Work with development and architecture teams to resolve platform issues.
  • Support data‑quality and data‑availability requirements across technology teams.

Linux & Infrastructure Administration

  • Perform Linux system administration activities supporting Big Data platforms.
  • Manage system monitoring, storage capacity and performance.
  • Support OS‑level patches and infrastructure changes.
  • Coordinate rolling OS changes with cluster administration tools.
  • Automate software and application installation/configuration where applicable.
  • Troubleshoot system and infrastructure issues using operating‑system and application logs.
  • Support network and system administration activities within large‑scale data‑centre environments.

Scripting & Automation

  • Develop and maintain automation scripts using Shell, Python or Perl .
  • Debug existing scripts and automation processes.
  • Automate installation, configuration and operational activities.
  • Identify opportunities to improve operational efficiency through automation.

Production Support & Incident Management

  • Provide L3 technical support for Big Data production environments.
  • Lead the technical investigation of complex and high‑severity incidents.
  • Perform root‑cause analysis and drive issues through to resolution.
  • Proactively identify potential risks and service‑impacting issues.
  • Support incident, problem and change‑management activities.
  • Maintain system availability and reliability in accordance with agreed SLAs.
  • Review technology changes and assess potential operational risks.
  • Provide technical guidance to L1/L2 teams and partner resources.

Project & Technology Transformation

  • Support Big Data infrastructure projects and transformation initiatives.
  • Work with architects, developers, project teams and service managers on technology roadmaps.
  • Ensure new solutions are production‑ready before operational handover.
  • Support technical validation and readiness activities for new projects.
  • Evaluate new technologies and identify opportunities for service improvement.
  • Recommend improvements to Big Data infrastructure, processes and operational practices.
  • Maintain technical documentation, SOPs, knowledge articles and best practices.
  • Share technical knowledge and coach other team members where required.

Required Technical Skills

Critical Skills

  • Linux Administration
  • Hadoop Administration
  • HDFS
  • YARN
  • MapReduce
  • Hadoop ecosystem components
  • Hortonworks Data Platform (HDP)
  • Shell / Perl / Python scripting
  • PAM
  • Kerberos
  • Access control and security mechanisms

Essential Skills

  • Kafk

IT Administrator

📍 Vejle, Denmark

We’re looking for a new colleague to join us as our new IT Administrator and ensure AutoProff’s day-to-day IT is running smoothly – helping colleagues with their everyday IT needs while taking care of our devices, systems, networks and security.

You’ll take ownership of IT operations at AutoProff while working closely with the AutoScout24 Employee Tech team in Munich.

Based at our headquarters in Vejle, Denmark, you’ll be the primary IT point of contact for AutoProff and lead IT Operations and support with a fully dedicated focus on providing an amazing IT Support experience to our employees with a human touch.

It’s a broad, hands-on role covering daily IT operations and support, as well as migration projects and improvements to our IT setup.

We’re always looking for better ways of doing things, so simplifying processes, automating recurring tasks and fixing issues at their root cause will also be part of the job.

What you’ll be doing

  • Lead daily IT operation activities and provide user support with incidents and change requests
  • Administrate and support of state-of-the-art IT ecosystems (End-user devices, SaaS and on-premises applications, unified communication, meeting rooms, network equipment etc.
  • End-to-end responsible for managing the lifecycle of every IT asset (procurement strategy, budget, device setup and decommissioning) while maintaining up to date our software & hardware asset management systems
  • Implementing security protocols and procedures to prevent potential threats
  • Upgrading, installing, and configuring new hardware and software to meet our objectives
  • Performing diagnostic tests and debugging procedures to optimize computer systems
  • Documenting processes, as well as backing up and archiving data

Some limited travel to other company locations and AutoScout24’s HQ in Munich should be expected.

What we’re looking for

  • A relevant IT education or vocational/apprenticeship background.
  • 4+ years of experience in IT administration, support or a similar role.
  • Solid experience with IT systems, networks, system security and IT administration.
  • Experience supporting Windows and macOS in an enterprise environment.

  • Knowledge of network technologies including routers, VPN and Wi-Fi, ideally with Cisco.

  • Strong problem-solving and communication skills.
  • Fluency in Danish and English.

We’re looking for someone who enjoys working across many different types of tasks and projects and comfortable working in an informal, dynamic and agile environment, and you combine a strong service mindset with the ability to take ownership and prioritise your work independently.

You’re also someone who stays calm when something goes wrong, and you combine a strong service mindset with the ability to take ownership and prioritise your work independently.

Why join AutoProff?

At AutoProff, you’ll become part of an international company that is changing the way used cars are traded across Europe.

You’ll work with colleagues across countries and functions in an environment where there is room to take ownership, share ideas and influence how we do things. We move quickly, work closely together and value people who are comfortable taking responsibility while also asking for input when needed.

As part of AutoScout24 Group, we combine the pace and hands-on environment of AutoProff with the opportunities and international reach of one of Europe’s leading automotive marketplaces.

Ready to join us?

If this sounds like an opportunity you’d like to explore, we’d like to hear from you.

We review applications on an ongoing basis and may close the position once we have found the right candidate.

About AutoProff

AutoProff was founded in Denmark in 2013 with one goal: to make B2B used-car trading simpler and more efficient through digital solutions.

Today, AutoProff provides online B2B used-car trading solutions for professional car dealers across Europe, with more than 150,000 vehicles traded through our platforms annually.

In August 2022, AutoScout24, one of Europe’s leading online automotive marketplaces, acquired a majority stake in AutoProff. Together, we are working towards creating a fully integrated C2B-B2B-B2C solution for used cars across Europe.

Our ambition is simple: to be the home of B2B car trading for European car dealers.

title: Full Stack Developer (Co-op/Contract)
description:
About Remote Robotic Systems

Help build advanced systems operating at the intersection of aerospace, robotics, and defence technology.

Remote Robotic Systems (RRS) is a Canadian robotics and defence-tech company helping organizations deploy enterprise-grade drones, uncrewed aircraft, robotic platforms, sensors, payloads, and remote operations technologies for mission‑critical applications. Our solutions support customers across defence, public safety, security, industrial, infrastructure, energy, and government sectors.

Through our AirMetal team, we develop advanced aerospace, communications, and autonomous systems designed for demanding real‑world environments.

We’re a small, fast‑moving engineering team that values ownership, technical depth, practical problem solving, and the ability to turn ambitious ideas into working systems. Team members have the opportunity to contribute directly to product decisions and see their work move quickly from concept to deployment.

The Role

AirMetal is looking for a Full Stack Developer to help build a web platform that provides access to a tactical drone simulator and its training material. The first release is planned for September 2026, with a substantial roadmap beyond the initial launch.

You will work directly alongside our technical lead and contribute to decisions about the architecture, data model, and security approach. We expect you to bring forward your own proposals, question assumptions, and speak up when you see a better solution. You will then help build the agreed approach across the frontend, backend, database, and deployment environment.

This role is a strong fit for a student or independent developer who wants to write a meaningful amount of code on a real production system, contribute to how the system is designed, and see their work reach users quickly.

What You Will Work On

Full‑Stack Development

  • Build polished, responsive, accessible frontend pages based on designs supplied by our marketing team.
  • Build the backend supporting those pages, including forms, validation, business logic, file handling, and administrative screens used by internal staff.
  • Design the database schema with our technical lead, then implement the schema and supporting queries.
  • Write tests and help run the release process.

Infrastructure & Security

  • Help set up and maintain the servers that host the platform. We install and operate our own stack on Linux virtual machines.
  • Help design and implement security controls, including input validation, access control, rate limiting, and audit logging.
  • Contribute to deployment, monitoring, backup, and change practices appropriate for a live system.

User Support & Documentation

  • Support platform users in person, on calls, and in writing.
  • Write clear technical and operational documentation as you build.
  • Communicate technical trade‑offs and implementation decisions clearly to both technical and non‑technical stakeholders.

Core Requirements

  • Currently enrolled in computer science, software engineering, computer engineering, information technology, or a related program, or working as an independent developer with equivalent demonstrated experience.
  • Experience building a complete web application from frontend to backend, with comfort working across more than one layer of the stack.
  • Experience with at least one web application framework.
  • Working knowledge of SQL and relational database fundamentals.
  • Working knowledge of HTML and CSS, with enough JavaScript to contribute productively within an existing codebase.
  • Experience using Git and working from the Linux command line.
  • A careful approach to live systems, including testing changes, maintaining backups, and documenting work.
  • Ability to turn a requirement into a design, explain technical trade‑offs, and ask effective questions when requirements are unclear.
  • A curious, methodical, and persistent approach to debugging.
  • Comfort supporting and communicating with people who are not technical.

Nice to Have

  • Backend experience with Node.js and TypeScript, Fastify or Express, ASP.NET Core, Django, Rails, or Go.
  • Experience with PostgreSQL, an ORM such as Prisma or Entity Framework, and writing correct database transactions.
  • Experience with server‑rendered templates, modern CSS, and web accessibility standards such as WCAG.
  • Experience with Docker, Nginx or Caddy, TLS certificates, or Linux server administration.
  • Experience with S3‑compatible object storage, DNS, SPF, DKIM, or DMARC.
  • Experience supporting a live system with real users.
  • Previous work with a government or defence customer.

What You Will Gain

  • Production experience on a live platform with real users, from initial development through launch.
  • Exposure across the full stack, including user interface, application logic, database, and infrastructure.
  • Hands‑on infrastructure experience that is not available in many web‑development roles.
  • Direct exposure to a defence customer and the operating requirements of the industry.
  • The opportunity to contribute ideas and influence technical decisions while working directly with the technical lead.

Employment Details

Type: Co‑op or fixed‑term contract. This posting is for an existing, open vacancy.

Term: To be confirmed based on the selected engagement structure and candidate availability.

Location: Kanata, ON

Compensation: $25.00-$35.00 CAD per hour, based on experience and fit for the role.

Security clearance: The successful candidate may be required to obtain and maintain a security clearance appropriate to the work.

Use of AI in hiring: We may use AI tools to help with parts of our hiring process, such as reviewing applications, screening resumes, and evaluating candidate responses. These tools support our team, but people make all hiring decisions. AI is used to assist, not replace, human judgment.

Remote Robotic Systems is an equal opportunity employer. If you require accommodation during the recruitment process, please let us know.

title: Estimator (Leeds)
description:
CML are looking for an experienced Estimator to join our Commercial Team, based from our Head Office in Leeds.

Are you looking for a new challenge, within a company that has spent over 4 decades developing its expert craft and ingenuity in Civil Engineering? If so, we'd love to hear from you! With projects ranging in value from, £50k to £12 million, and bigger contracts in the pipeline, you will be involved with a portfolio of works of differing scale, complexity and scope.

As an Estimator at CML you will provide feasibility advice on new tenders, and produce appropriate documentation for inclusion that meet client and industry accepted standards. This will include preparing information and bill of quantities / schedule of rates for tender applications.

Your Responsibilities

The main duties of the role include:

  • Preparation of detailed cost estimates and tender submissions for Civil Engineering, Rail, Infrastructure, Marine, and multidisciplinary construction projects.

  • Development of estimates using first principles and bottom-up estimating methodologies including labour, plant, material, subcontract, logistics, and productivity outputs.

  • Preparation and derivation of Schedule of Rates (SoR) based upon resource build-ups, productivity analysis, and construction methodologies.

  • Undertake detailed quantity take-offs from drawings, specifications, and technical documentation using manual and digital measurement techniques.

  • Review and interpret engineering drawings, specifications, contracts, bills of quantities, schedules, and scope documentation.

  • Assist in the development of construction methodologies, sequencing, possession strategies, access arrangements, and temporary works considerations.

  • Obtain and evaluate quotations from subcontractors, suppliers, and specialist providers to support competitive tender submissions.

  • Identify commercial, technical, operational, and programme-related risks and contribute towards tender risk assessments and mitigation strategies.

  • Prepare tender adjudication documents, clarifications, assumptions, qualifications, and supporting commercial information.

  • Collaborate with operational, engineering, planning, and commercial teams to ensure estimates are practical, buildable, and aligned with project delivery requirements.

  • Assist in the maintenance and development of estimating databases, benchmark rates, historical cost data, and pricing libraries.

  • Support value engineering exercises and alternative construction proposals to improve project efficiency and competitiveness.

  • Develop a working understanding of NEC contracts, framework requirements, and client-specific commercial arrangements.

  • Participate in tender review meetings, handover meetings, and post-tender negotiations where required.

  • Ensure compliance with company Integrated Management Systems, quality procedures, and relevant industry standards.

  • Maintain a proactive approach towards continuous professional development and technical improvement within the estimating function.

Person Specification

Our ideal candidate will have:

QUALIFICATIONS

HNC / HND / Degree in Civil Engineering, Construction Management, Quantity Surveying or related discipline, or equivalent practical estimating experience

SKILLS / COMPETENCIES

Strong numerical and analytical capability. Ability to prepare first principles and bottom-up estimates. Competent in Microsoft Excel and estimating software. Good communication and organisational skills

EXPERIENCE / KNOWLEDGE

Understanding of Civil Engineering and/or Rail construction methodologies. Ability to interpret engineering drawings and specifications. Knowledge of resource-based estimating principles

The Package

  • Competitive Pay

  • A collaborative and friendly working culture, focussed on investing in people

  • Up to 25 days holiday + Statutory Bank Holidays

  • Hybrid working, depending on business needs (after probation)

  • Company Sick Pay

  • Annual professional subscription costs

  • Excellent training & development opportunities, provided by our award nominated in house Training team

  • Paid Volunteering days and Charity events

  • Annual Flu Jabs

  • Employee Assistance Programmes for advice and counselling

  • Access to a committed Mental Health First Aider team

  • Company Pension and Death in Service scheme of 2x annual salary

  • A generous Employee Referral scheme of £1000 per successful hire

At CML we are committed to creating a diverse workforce and an inclusive culture where everyone can be themselves and reach their full potential, not only because this is the right thing to do, but because it makes us a better business.

We welcome candidates from all backgrounds and experiences and all applicants will be considered purely on their merits and potential, regardless of where they are from, their age or gender, their lifestyle choices , their beliefs or what disability they may have.

We’re also striving to be a Disability Confident employer and we’ll try our best to adapt the process and offer a reasonable alternative to help support people with disabilities apply and interview for roles.

Job Title: Full Stack Developer

Location: Dubai, UAE


ROLE SUMMARY

We are looking for a Full Stack Developer to build and maintain modern, responsive web applications and the Node.js services that power them. You will work across the stack from React components built to our design system through to APIs, business logic and data access as part of an Agile delivery team. You will collaborate closely with product owners, business analysts, UX designers and QA to turn requirements into well‑tested, secure and performant features. Experience in trading, capital markets or fintech is a strong advantage.


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Front End Development

* Develop responsive, accessible and performant user interfaces using ReactJS and TypeScript, applying modern patterns (functional components, hooks, context, and state

* Translate UX designs from Figma into pixel‑accurate, reusable components that comply with the organisation's design system, component library, theming and accessibility guidelines.

* Support bilingual interfaces including right‑to‑left (RTL) layouts, localisation, and locale‑aware number, date and currency formatting.

* Optimise front‑end performance bundle size, code splitting, lazy loading, rendering efficiency and Core Web Vitals.

* Build interfaces that handle real‑time data updates via WebSockets or server‑sent events without degrading responsiveness.

Back End Development

* Design, build and maintain Node.js services and APIs using frameworks such as Express, NestJS or Fastify.

* Design and document RESTful and/or GraphQL APIs with sound contracts, versioning, error handling, pagination and validation.

* Integrate with internal and third‑party systems, message queues and streaming data sources.

* Model, query and optimise relational and NoSQL data stores; write efficient queries, indexes and migrations.

* Implement authentication and authorisation, input validation, and secure coding practices aligned to the OWASP Top 10.

Quality, Delivery & Collaboration

  • Write and maintain unit, integration and end‑to‑end tests (for example Jest, React Testing Library, Playwright or Cypress) and keep the build green.
  • Participate actively in code reviews both giving and receiving and uphold agreed coding standards and Git workflow.
  • Contribute to CI/CD pipelines, containerised builds, environment configuration and deployment automation.
  • Work with product owners and business analysts to clarify requirements, refine user stories and define acceptance criteria.
  • Participate in Agile ceremonies: sprint planning, daily stand‑ups, backlog refinement, reviews and retrospectives.
  • Provide production support: monitor, triage, debug and resolve defects and incidents, including root‑cause analysis.
  • Produce clear technical documentation for the solutions you build.
  • Use AI‑assisted development tooling responsibly and effectively to accelerate delivery while retaining full accountability for merged code.

REQUIRED SKILLS & EXPERIENCE

  • Minimum 4 years of professional full stack web development experience.
  • Strong hands‑on ReactJS experience with modern JavaScript (ES6+) and TypeScript.
  • Strong hands‑on Node.js experience building production backend services and APIs.
  • Solid understanding of REST and/or GraphQL API design, integration and consumption.
  • Practical database experience with at least one relational database (PostgreSQL, MySQL or MS SQL Server) and familiarity with NoSQL or in‑memory stores (MongoDB, Redis).
  • Strong HTML5, CSS3 and responsive/cross‑browser development skills; experience with a component library or utility framework (Material UI, Ant Design, Tailwind CSS or similar).
  • Demonstrated ability to work to a design system and design guidelines, consuming Figma handoffs and applying accessibility standards (WCAG).
  • Experience with real‑time web technologies such as WebSockets or server‑sent events.
  • Proficiency with Git and collaborative branching workflows; experience participating in code reviews.
  • Automated testing experience across front end and back end.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and at least basic containerisation (Docker).
  • Understanding of web application security fundamentals (OWASP Top 10, XSS, CSRF, injection, secure session and token handling).
  • Experience working in an Agile / Scrum delivery team.
  • Good written and verbal English communication skills.

QUALIFICATIONS & EDUCATION

  • Bachelors degree in computer science, Software Engineering, Information Technology or a related discipline, or equivalent demonstrable experience.
  • Relevant cloud or framework certifications are advantageous.

KEY COMPETENCIES

  • Ownership of features from requirement through to production.
  • Problem‑solving and structured debugging.
  • Attention to detail in UI fidelity, data accuracy and edge‑case handling.
  • Collaborative working style and openness to feedback.
  • Willingness to learn new technologies and domains quickly.

Preferred candidate profile

  • Arabic language proficiency (spoken and written) — preferred.
  • Experience in trading, brokerage, exchange, banking or fintech applications.
  • Domain understanding of trading concepts: market data, order entry and order management, portfolios and positions, watchlists, and settlement or post‑trade views.
  • Experience with financial data visualisation and charting libraries (TradingView, Highcharts, D3, ECharts or similar).
  • Experience with Next.js or server‑side rendering.
  • Cloud platform experience (AWS or Azure) and familiarity with Kubernetes or serverless deployment.
  • Experience with message brokers or streaming platforms (Kafka, RabbitMQ).
  • Exposure to micro‑frontends or monorepo tooling (Nx, Turborepo).
  • Exposure to mobile development (React Native or Flutter).
  • Experience with observability tooling — logging, metrics, tracing and alerting.

title: Digital Media Specialist
description:
About the Role and Team:

As a Digital Media Specialist, you will be responsible for supporting clients across campaign setup, troubleshooting, optimization and platform-related requests. You will work closely with clients and internal stakeholders to resolve issues, identify opportunities for improvement and ensure campaigns are delivered effectively.

This is a role for someone who is comfortable taking ownership, asking questions, sharing their perspective and finding solutions rather than simply following instructions. You will have the opportunity to deepen your digital advertising expertise while developing your consulting, communication and stakeholder management skills.

We hope you are ready to change the game! Be ready to:

  • Own client requests from end-to-end, ensuring questions, issues and escalations are handled effectively, efficiently and with a strong customer focus.

  • Set up, manage and optimize digital advertising campaigns in the Adform platform, ensuring campaign configurations align with client objectives and KPIs.

  • Troubleshoot campaign and platform issues, investigate root causes, gather the information required for efficient resolution and collaborate with the relevant technical or product teams when needed.

  • Provide guidance and consultancy to clients, helping them understand Adform functionality, campaign setup options, targeting, tracking, reporting and optimization opportunities.

  • Apply data-driven thinking when analyzing campaign performance, identifying delivery or performance issues and recommending appropriate optimizations.

  • Work effectively with stakeholders across the organization, understanding responsibilities and ownership and ensuring the right people are involved at the right time.

  • Communicate clearly and confidently with clients and internal stakeholders, including explaining technical topics in a simple and actionable way.

  • Contribute to a culture of knowledge sharing, proactively sharing useful case resolutions, learnings and ideas with the wider team.

  • Identify opportunities to improve processes and ways of working, and take initiative to help implement practical improvements.

  • Prioritize and manage your workload independently, balancing client support, campaign management and other responsibilities while meeting agreed deadlines and KPIs.

Attitude First. Everything else will follow. We can grow together faster if you have:

  • Have 1–2+ years of relevant experience in digital advertising, ad operations, campaign management, technical support, customer success or a similar role.

  • Have a good understanding of digital advertising and programmatic concepts, and be genuinely interested in how digital media technology works.

  • Have strong analytical and problem-solving skills and enjoy investigating issues rather than stopping at the first apparent answer.

  • Be accountable for your work and comfortable taking ownership of tasks, decisions and outcomes.

  • Have a growth mindset - you are curious, willing to learn and comfortable stepping outside your current area of expertise.

  • Be a confident communicator who is comfortable speaking up, sharing your thoughts and challenging ideas constructively.

  • Have strong stakeholder management skills and the ability to understand different perspectives, manage expectations and build effective working relationships.

  • Have a customer-centric mindset and care about delivering a high-quality experience, not just closing a ticket.

  • Be highly organized, able to prioritize competing requests and manage your time effectively.

  • Be a collaborative team player who is willing to support others and contribute to the success of the wider team.

  • Be fluent in English, both written and spoken.

Stand out by having:

  • Previous experience working with a DSP, ad server, SSP or other digital advertising technology platform.

  • Hands-on experience with campaign trafficking, campaign optimization or digital media operations.

  • Familiarity with concepts such as impressions, clicks, conversions, CTR, CPM, CPA, tracking pixels, tags and programmatic buying.

  • Experience working with ticketing/help desk systems or other structured support environments.

  • Experience analyzing campaign performance through reporting and data analysis tools, including spreadsheets.

  • Experience working with multiple stakeholders across technical, commercial, product or customer-facing teams.

Our promise to you:

  • A dynamic, inspiring, and international environment filled with ambitious and caring colleagues

  • Premium health insurance with ₹10,00,000 coverage for you and your family

  • 24 paid vacation days to enjoy life outside of work

  • Paid maternity (6 months) and paternity (2 weeks)

  • Annual learning budget to help you grow your skills and support continuous learning

  • Rewarding referral program for helping us grow

  • Global perks such as birthday gifts, work anniversaries, and company events to connect with colleagues and have fun

  • And much more – join us to explore the full experience

Diversity & Inclusion @Adform:

Adform is an equal opportunity employer with a global perspective. We remain committed to creating an environment that not only respects different backgrounds but celebrates them too. We believe that diversity in all its forms enhances our teams’ creativity, innovation, and effectiveness, and therefore we value different backgrounds, perspectives, and skills.

We are committed to creating a work environment where Adform employees feel valued for who they are and what they can contribute, free from any type of discrimination.

title: Catalog & Content Operations Lead
description:
Catalog & Content Operations Lead

About the job

Fresh Prints is about to go through the biggest catalog shift in company history. We've always sold custom apparel to groups - chapters, teams, clubs. That's changing: we're building a catalog where every product and design has its own shoppable page, so anyone can browse and buy directly, the way you'd shop at any other ecommerce store. Over the next year, our catalog will grow roughly 100x, from a few hundred listings to tens of thousands of individual product pages.

Someone has to build what makes that catalog possible: the publishing pipeline, the QA process, and a team of three that can run it well without you standing over their shoulder. This isn't a maintenance job. Nobody here has run a catalog at this scale before, so a lot of what you build in the first few months won't have a template to follow — you'd be building the foundation for a 100x scale-up from close to day one, and a year from now, you'll have a genuinely rare story to tell about what you built and when.

We're looking for someone who can lead a small team, own a production calendar, and hold a real quality bar under pressure, who also happens to be technical enough to get hands-on with a CMS when something needs fixing. If building the system behind a company's next stage of growth sounds like the kind of problem you want to solve, please apply.

You'll own our product catalog, our QA process, and the team of three that grows with it. Build the systems now, and a year from now your team is running most of it without you, while you're already onto the next big problem.

What You'll Own

Team Leadership & Coaching

  • Manage and mentor a team of three, setting clear expectations for quality, pace, and ownership
  • Delegate real ownership to your team rather than staying the single point of failure for every workflow
  • Know the difference between a capacity problem, a process problem, and a performance problem, and address each the right way

Project & Production Management

  • Own the production calendar across launches, campaigns, catalog updates, and ad hoc requests
  • Turn incoming requests into scope, owners, deadlines, and QA checkpoints
  • Forecast your team's capacity, flag conflicts before a deadline is at risk, and negotiate scope when priorities collide instead of letting the team silently absorb an impossible workload

Asset & Catalog Quality

  • Own product publishing across every product line, with accurate metadata and imagery before anything goes live
  • Design and scale the QA process that catches errors before they reach the live site as the catalog grows toward tens of thousands of listings
  • Document workflows clearly enough that the team doesn't depend on any one person's memory

Cross-Functional Coordination

  • Be the one who keeps product work moving across departments on schedule, with risk flagged early and a clear path forward whenever something's blocked

Who You Are

  • You love building systems. You can turn an ad hoc process into something documented and repeatable that the whole team can run.
  • You're scrappy under pressure. You'll sketch out a tracker on the spot or jump into the work yourself rather than let something slip while you wait for the perfect tool.
  • You understand product data at a deep level — comfortable enough inside a CMS to know when a field is derived from somewhere else, and enough of a craft eye to know what's actually wrong with an asset.
  • You can hold five moving projects and competing deadlines in your head at once without one quietly slipping through the cracks.
  • You're direct. When a teammate is falling short, you say so the same day, not weeks later. When you're the one falling behind, you say that too.
  • You're curious about where the catalog is breaking. You'll notice the colorway that's slightly off before a customer ever does.

Requirements

  • 3+ years of relevant experience
  • Fluent in English with excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Prior experience leading or co-leading a team, with genuine ownership of people and their output
  • A track record of managing projects against hard deadlines with multiple contributors
  • A track record of building or scaling a QA process for content or product output at high volume
  • Hands-on fluency with a content management system (CMS) or product information management (PIM) platform. You understand the underlying data structure, not just the interface
  • Working knowledge of Adobe Photoshop (Illustrator is a plus)

Strong differentiator, not required: scripted or automated production workflows in Photoshop, or comfort building lightweight tools using AI, no-code platforms, or basic scripting.

Compensation

  • Between $900 - $1,000 (adjusted for experience), with $40 night shift allowance

Working Hours:

  • 3 PM - 12 AM Philippine Time.

Location:

  • Work from Home/Remote

At Fresh Prints, we deeply value the long-term contributions of our team. To recognize and celebrate that commitment, we offer a 2-month paid Sabbatical to eligible employees.

Fresh Prints is an equal employment opportunity employer and promotes diversity, actively encouraging people of all backgrounds, ages, LGBTQ+, and those with disabilities to apply.

title: Senior Software Engineer (Full Stack | React Native Expert)
description:
Senior Software Engineer (Full Stack | React Native Expert)

Location: Karachi (Hybrid)

Employment Type: Full-time

About Lumida

Lumida is a venture-backed, AI-native wealth advisor for modern investors seeking institutional-caliber access across public markets, private deals, and alternative investments.

Backed by investors and board leaders from companies including SoFi, Circle, and Coinbase, Lumida brings venture-scale ambition to an industry overdue for reinvention.

As a client’s Wealth Architect, Lumida integrates investment management, trust and estate planning, tax mitigation, and differentiated opportunities into one coordinated wealth strategy.

Our clients are founders, builders, and independent thinkers. We built Lumida with the same mindset: curious, original, and unwilling to accept the conventional.

We help clients build, protect, and transfer wealth — and invest beyond the ordinary.

The Role: Architecting the Mobile Edge

We are looking for a High-Intensity Full Stack Engineer with a React Native DNA. You understand that mobile engineering is a game of constraints—memory, CPU, and bridge latency.

You are the type of engineer who hates jank, obsesses over 60 FPS animations, and understands that "frontend" extends into how the API is structured for mobile consumption.

You aren't just building screens; you are building the standards that ensure our mobile performance never degrades.

Key Responsibilities

  • Mobile Orchestration: Lead the architecture of our React Native ecosystem. Implement patterns for robust offline-first capabilities, complex state persistence, and real-time data synchronization.
  • Full Stack Ownership: Bridge the gap by designing and optimizing Python (FastAPI/Django) backend services. You ensure that APIs are tailored for mobile efficiency (minimized payloads, efficient polling, and WebSocket integration).
  • Performance Engineering: Own the "Frame Budget." You are responsible for identifying and fixing render bottlenecks, memory leaks, and excessive bridge traffic. You ensure the app feels "Native" at all times.
  • Code Governance: Act as the final line of defense in code reviews. Establish strict linting, TypeScript patterns, and automated testing (Detox/Jest) to prevent technical debt from entering the mobile codebase.
  • Agentic AI Integration: Architect seamless mobile interfaces for interacting with AI stock agents, ensuring complex data science looks simple and responds instantly on a 6-inch screen.
  • Native Integration: Oversee or implement Native Modules (Swift/Kotlin) when the JavaScript bridge isn't enough to meet our performance standards.

Ideal Candidate Profile

  • Experience: 5–10 years of professional engineering. You must have shipped and maintained at least one high-traffic, complex React Native app from 0 to 1 in the App Store/Play Store.
  • The "Mobile Architect" Mindset: You don't just "write code"—you think about battery life, background tasks, and atomic state updates. You prioritize Reliability and Type Safety over quick-and-dirty hacks.
  • Technical Stack:
    • Expert: React Native, TypeScript, React Navigation, and Reanimated.
    • Solid: Python (FastAPI/Django), PostgreSQL, and caching strategies (Redis).
    • Infrastructure: Deep understanding of the mobile release cycle (App Store Connect, Play Console, Fastlane).
  • Academic Excellence: Degree in CS from a top-tier university (GPA 3.7+ preferred).
  • High Intensity: You have a track record of shipping. You treat the company’s product quality as a personal reflection of your craft.

Why Lumida?

  • High-Intensity Environment: We move fast, but we value the craft of mobile engineering.
  • Complex Problem Solving: You’ll be translating institutional-grade stock market analytics into intuitive mobile interactions.
  • Ownership: We want partners, not employees. You will have a seat at the table in defining our technical roadmap for the Karachi engineering hub.

title: AI Backend Engineer
description:
Shine is the financial copilot for entrepreneurs and small business owners.

Founded by serial entrepreneurs Rico Andersen and Martin Hegelund, Shine is a leading European fintech unicorn on a mission to restore the joy of running a business, by ending wasted time on financial admin. Shine offers a connected solution for invoicing, accounting, payroll, business accounts, payments, and financing, meaning business owners can focus their energy on growing a healthy business, not held back by manual admin.

Part of something bigger
Today we're part of Cegid, a European leader in cloud software for finance and accounting. Together we're building Europe's leading financial copilot for small businesses and their accountants.
Shine already supports more than 400,000 small businesses. As part of Cegid, we now reach over one million small businesses and 15,000 accountants across Europe.
We're a multicultural team working from France, Germany, Denmark and the Netherlands, Spain,Portugal.

Your hiring experience matters

Just as we respect our customers' time, we respect yours. Your experience with Shine and Cegid should feel simple, transparent and genuinely supportive.

If this sounds like somewhere you want to grow, we'd love to hear from you.

The Advisor Production team at Shine

The Advisor Production team is building AI systems that automate accounting production for accounting professionals. Today, our agentic pipeline is already live in production: it analyzes invoices and proposes double-entry accounting entries for CPA validation. Every proposal is reviewed by a human accountant, making correctness, reliability, and traceability more important than raw speed.

We're now expanding the platform to additional countries, starting with Denmark. Our engineering culture values strong conventions, high ownership, and production-grade AI engineering. Our codebase is a TypeScript/NestJS Nx monorepo with rigorous error handling, structured LLM outputs, and an evaluation framework that ensures every change is measurable.

Your role as an AI Backend Engineer

Automate accounting production for Advisors by turning source documents into proper bookkeeping.

As an AI Backend Engineer, you'll own and improve production AI agents that solve real accounting problems. You'll work across the full stack of agent development—from prompt engineering and evaluation to backend services, orchestration, and production observability.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Building and maintaining AI agents for document parsing, VAT resolution, account selection, and other accounting workflows using structured outputs and clear contracts.

  • Designing and operating production-grade AI workflows with robust orchestration, tool calling, retries, and failure handling.

  • Integrating LLM APIs with typed schemas while optimizing for quality, latency, and token cost.

  • Writing integration tests and evaluation suites to continuously measure and improve agent performance.

  • Instrumenting the production pipeline with traces, structured logs, and monitoring to quickly diagnose issues.

  • Extending our multi-country accounting logic without duplicating business rules.

  • Collaborating closely with Product Managers and CPAs to understand accounting edge cases and continuously improve agent quality.

  • Contributing to the CPA feedback loop by transforming manual corrections into reusable rules and smarter automation.

  • Helping shape the architecture of our AI platform as we expand across Europe.

📍 Job located in Berlin, Copenhagen or Amsterdam with the possibility of working remotely up to two days per week.

About you

  • You have 4+ years of experience building and operating production backend systems.

  • You're a strong backend engineer with TypeScript / Node.js (NestJS is a strong plus).

  • You've built or operated AI agent workflows in production—including orchestration, tool calling, structured outputs, retries, and error handling—not just LLM prototypes.

  • You have hands-on experience integrating LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, or similar) and think carefully about schemas, latency, costs, and failure modes.

  • You care deeply about software quality through testing, observability, and evaluation frameworks.

  • You write rigorous, strongly typed code with disciplined error handling.

  • You're comfortable moving between prompt engineering, backend services, queues, databases, and infrastructure without relying on handoffs.

  • You have strong ownership, excellent written communication, and enjoy collaborating with engineers, product managers, and accounting experts.

  • You're curious but skeptical about LLMs—you see them as probabilistic systems that must be constrained, measured, and continuously improved.

  • You're detail-oriented and understand that in accounting, correctness matters.

Nice to have

  • Experience with event-driven architectures (SQS or equivalent).

  • PostgreSQL and pgvector.

  • Nx monorepos.

  • Datadog, Langfuse, or similar observability platforms.

  • Fintech or accounting domain experience.

  • Experience designing LLM evaluation methodologies and prompt regression testing.

Language requirements

  • Professionally fluent in English.

Our stack

TypeScript, NestJS, Nx monorepo, PostgreSQL + pgvector, TypeORM, SQS, OpenAI APIs, Langfuse, Datadog, neverthrow, structured LLM outputs, integration testing, and an evaluation harness.

Equal Opportunity Employer

We follow the principle of equal treatment to consider all job applicants and do not discriminate based on their gender, sexual orientation, color, racial or ethnic origin, religion, disability, etc. as per applicable law.

Our recruitment process

1️⃣ Recruiter interview: A first conversation to get to know each other and answer your questions.

2️⃣ Hiring Manager interview: A deeper discussion about your experience, technical approach, and the role.

3️⃣ Technical case study: A practical exercise followed by a discussion of your solution and thought process.

4️⃣ Personality assessment: A short assessment to help us understand how you work and collaborate.

title: Myyntineuvottelija
description:
Löytyykö sinulta myynnin nälkää ja kiinnostusta tekniikkaa kohtaan? Haemme nyt JISsille Pirkkalaan

Myyntineuvottelijaa

asiakassuhteiden hallintaan. Sinun ei tarvitse olla vielä myynnin ammattilainen tai tekniikan asiantuntija, vaan etsimme nyt joukkoomme nimenomaan aktiivista ja oppimishaluista tyyppiä!

Tehtävä

Myyntineuvottelijana autat meitä pitämään huolen siitä, etteivät hyvät myyntimahdollisuudet jää pöydälle odottamaan. Olet yhteydessä sekä uusiin että nykyisiin asiakkaisiimme, selvität heidän tarpeitaan ja viet keskusteluja eteenpäin kohti mahdollista kauppaa.

Työpäivääsi kuuluu muun muassa asiakkaiden kontaktointia, asiakassuhteiden ylläpitoa ja tapaamisten sopimista kokeneemmille myyjillemme. Yhteyttä pidät pääasiassa puhelimitse, sähköpostitse, LinkedInin tai muiden kanavien kautta.

Koulutamme sinut tehtävääsi, ja saat tukea tekemiseen kokeneemmilta myyjiltämme. Samalla pääset sukeltamaan rakennusautomaation maailmaan. Osaamisesi karttuessa sinulla on mahdollisuus päästä mukaan myös muihin myyntitehtäviin.

Sinusta

Tämä rooli sopii hyvin uransa alkuvaiheessa olevalle henkilölle, joka haluaa päästä oppimaan lisää myynnistä. Toivomme sinulta ennen kaikkea aktiivista ja oma-aloitteista työskentelyotetta, myynnillistä ajattelutapaa ja hyviä vuorovaikutustaitoja. Sinulle on luonnollista tarttua puhelimeen, ja viihdyt hyvin ihmisten parissa.

Koulutuksesi voi olla esimerkiksi kaupalliselta alalta, ja katsomme eduksi kiinnostuksen tai harrastuneisuuden tekniikkaa kohtaan. Työskentelykielemme on suomi.

Meistä

JISsin tarina alkoi vuonna 2001 miehen ja pakun voimin. Kun firman perustajat 25 vuotta sitten kiersivät ympäri Suomea asennuskeikoilla, heille oli jo silloin tärkeää, että vaikka töitä tehdään tosissaan, töissä pitää olla myös kivaa. Näitä arvoja on vaalittu tähän päivään asti, ja yritys on kasvanut yhdeksi Suomen suurimmista rakennusautomaatiotaloista. Nykyään meillä työskentelee jo yli 300 sähkö- ja automaatioalan huippuammattilaista, ja taistelu älyttömyyttä vastaan jatkuu!

Meidät erottaa muista JIS-henkisyys, mistä pidämme tiukasti kiinni. Meille on tärkeää, että jaat arvomaailmamme: "peräämme ei tarvitse soitella", "tehdään porukalla ja jeesataan kaveria" sekä "toimii ja järjestyy". Teemme sen, mitä lupaamme, ja aina ammattiylpeydellä. Meillä yhteishenki on huippuluokkaa ja asiantuntemus talossa käsittämättömän korkealla tasolla. Kollegat ovat auttavaisia ja helposti lähestyttäviä – meillä ketään ei jätetä yksin.

Lisätiedot ja hakuohjeet

Kuulostaako tämä sinulta? Jos tunnistat itsessäsi JIS-henkeä ja haluat mukaan huippujengiin, hae tehtävää viimeistään 17.9.2026 lähettämällä hakemuksesi alla olevan linkin kautta. Käsittelemme hakemuksia jo hakuaikana ja täytämme tehtävän heti sopivan henkilön löydyttyä.

Lisätietoja tehtävästä ja JISsistä työpaikkana antaa mielellään rekrytointiasiantuntija Laura Käräjämies, puh. 050 502 1668.

title: Senior Business Analyst
description:
At Curriculum Associates, we believe in the potential of every child and are changing the face of education technology with award-winning learning programs like i-Ready that serve a third of the nation’s K–8 students. For more than 50 years, our commitment to making classrooms better places, serving educators, and supporting accessible learning experiences for all students has driven the continuous improvement of our innovative programs. Our team of more than 2,500 employees is composed of lifelong learners who stand behind this mission, working tirelessly to serve the educational community with world-class programs and support every day.

Summary:

Senior Business Analysts are trusted partners to the business functions they serve. Their credibility as advisors

rests on expertise they actively build and apply: deep knowledge of CA’s organizational ecosystem, fluency in how

peers and the broader industry tackle the same challenges, and command of the functional discipline itself -- the

frameworks, standards, and emerging practices that define what good looks like. This combination is what allows

them to bring recommendations grounded in both CA’s context and a wider reference point. Sr. BAs shape how

problems are framed, not just how requirements are structured. They anticipate downstream impacts before

anyone asks. They are present in the operating rhythm of the business, not just the project lifecycle. Senior BAs

also invest in the broader BA team -- mentoring peers, raising the quality bar through their own work, and

contributing to the standards and methods that define how the function operates.

Essential Duties/Responsibilities:

Business Partnership & Stakeholder Engagement

· Serve as a trusted advisor to business within the assigned domain -- present and accessible in the

business’s operating rhythm, not just project ceremonies.

· Build and maintain relationships with senior stakeholders; understand their priorities, constraints, and

context well enough to anticipate needs before they’re articulated.

· Lead discovery for complex, multi-team initiatives; facilitate workshops and alignment sessions that

produce decisions, not just documentation.

· Drive cross-functional alignment across competing priorities; resolve independently where possible, and

know when to bring in IT Business Partnering leadership or peer domain BAs to reach the right outcome.

· Mentor peers on discovery, stakeholder engagement, and requirements quality; contribute patterns and

examples to the broader BA practice.

Requirements & Problem Definition

· Shape and reframe problem statements; challenge assumptions and identify root causes that stakeholders

may not have fully surfaced.

· Structure complex, ambiguous business needs into clear, actionable requirements for high-complexity

solutions -- with minimal rework from QA or development.

· Anticipate downstream technical and business impacts; surface risks before they become blockers.

· Connect individual initiative requirements to broader domain and organizational priorities -- visible in

every piece of work, not just strategic conversations.

Delivery Collaboration

· Actively shape refinement and sprint planning across complex, multi-team initiatives.

· Hold accountability for requirements quality across the full initiative; QA and UAT surface few surprises

attributable to gaps.

· Lead UAT coordination: own coverage, quality, and completeness across multiple teams and workstreams. · Drive post-deployment validation and change management; track adoption, surface issues before they compound, and stay present until solutions are working as intended. Domain Knowledge & Documentation · Own the accuracy, currency, and depth of process maps and documentation across the entire assigned domain -- beyond individual project cycles. · Build and apply contextual experience within the assigned domain: understanding why current processes and rules exist, what’s been tried before and what happened, where the recurring pain points are, and how the domain has evolved. · Recognize patterns that come with domain experience -- downstream impacts that aren’t obvious without context, approaches that were tried and didn’t work, trends that signal where the domain is heading -- and use that recognition to sharpen requirements and surface risks early. Knowledge Engineering & AI Enablement · Own the domain-level knowledge base: business rules, process maps, and entity definitions structured for reuse by both human practitioners and AI tools. · Design multi-step AI-assisted workflows for domain-level tasks; define the sequencing, inputs, outputs, and validation checkpoints for each. · Set validation standards for the domain -- documented criteria for what ’good enough’ looks like for AI-assisted outputs on each class of task (stories, epics, test cases, etc.). · Build and maintain a domain-level agent-readiness map: which tasks are agent-assisted, which require human judgment, and why -- reviewed quarterly. · Conduct periodic agent accuracy reviews; diagnose systematic errors at the root cause -- missing context, rule gaps, prompt quality -- not just surface symptoms. Strategic Contribution · Proactively identify functional-level gaps and opportunities; bring recommendations with supporting rationale, not just observations. · Drive improvements to BA team standards, templates, and toolkits; identify gaps and propose enhancements to the practice. · Contribute to BA hiring, onboarding, and community of practice as an active participant and knowledge contributor. Success Measures & Expectations · Senior business partners describe the Sr. BA as a trusted advisor, not just a project resource -- evidenced by proactive outreach, inclusion in planning conversations, and first-call behavior when something goes wrong. · Requirements for complex initiatives are complete, root-cause-driven, and traceable to delivered solutions; rework attributable to requirements gaps is rare and declining. · Domain KE artifacts (rule sets, process maps, entity definitions) are complete, SME-validated, and current; coverage of the domain is measurable and tracked. · Agent accuracy within the domain is measurable and trending positively quarter over quarter; root causes of systematic errors are documented and addressed. · BAs mentored by this Sr. BA show measurable improvement in requirements quality and delivery confidence over a 6-month period. · Domain documentation passes review without significant revision; industry and functional context is visibly incorporated into recommendations.

· Business partners at the director level and above report high satisfaction with communication, alignment, and outcomes. What This Role Is Not · Not a project manager. Sr. BAs shape delivery by ensuring requirements are clear, decisions are made, and stakeholders are aligned -- not by owning timelines or resource plans. · Not a technical architect. Sr. BAs define what solutions must do and why; how they do it belongs to the technical team. · Not the default UAT execution owner. Sr. BAs set UAT strategy and ensure coverage; test execution and sign-off belong to QA and business stakeholders. · Not a domain validator for areas outside their assignment. Cross-domain knowledge is an asset; accountability for domains they don’t own isn’t theirs to carry. · Not an unsupervised AI operator. Sr. BAs design and govern agent workflows -- they do not deploy agent outputs without documented human review. · Not a catch-all for delivery gaps. Being a trusted partner means being an active presence -- not the person who absorbs whatever falls through the cracks. Required Job Skills and Abilities: Required: · 5+ years of experience in business analysis, Sales Operations, data analysis, or a related field. · 5+ years of experience in cross-functional project leadership and communication. · 3+ years of experience in requirement gathering and documenting user stories. · 3+ years of Business Analyst or SME expertise in CRM and data platforms (Salesforce, Snowflake, etc.). · High proficiency in process mapping tools (Visio, Lucidchart, Miro) and a solid understanding of SDLC (Agile/Waterfall). We’d also like to see: · Business Analyst certifications such as CBAP, CCBA. · Salesforce or data tool certifications. · Experience in EdTech or Publishing. Required Education and Experience: Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Information Systems, or a related field required; advanced degree preferred; or equivalent on the job experience.

Travel: Travel may include office visits, trainings, and conferences. We are estimating that average travel should be

once per quarter.

Benefits and Pay Range:

Pay Range – This role’s range is $81,500 - $139,500. The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that Curriculum Associates considers in making compensation decisions based on our Compensation Philosophy. Actual base pay within that range will vary based upon several factors including, but not limited to, prior experience and relevant skill sets. At Curriculum Associates, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances for each case. This role is also eligible to participate in the company bonus plan. The Company recognizes that minimum wage varies by location and will ensure all compensation decisions comply with applicable state and local laws.

Benefits – Benefit eligible employees (and their families) are covered by medical, dental, vision, and basic life insurance. Employees can enroll in our company’s 401k plan and receive an employer match. Employees have access to a flexible vacation and sick policy in addition to twelve paid holidays and a winter office closure between Christmas and New Year's, as well as a number of additional perks and benefits.

Working Environment: Office environment; standard working conditions.

title: Product Manager – Credit Cards and Consumer Lending (Taguig)
description:
Location: Taguig,Metro Manila,Philippines

Trusting Social is an AI Fintech pioneer that's revolutionizing credit access in emerging markets. Our mission is "Advancing AI to Meet the Financial Needs of Everyday Consumers with Empathy." We've assessed over 1 billion consumers across four countries, and we're on a mission to provide 100 million credit lines using the power of AI and Big Data.

How You'll Make an Impact

Based in Taguig (Metro Manila), you'll own our consumer lending and credit card products in the Philippines end-to-end, from business case and P&L to launch and optimization - across credit cards, co-lending, personal loans, and cash loans. As we move through licensing toward launch, you'll turn market, partner, and regulatory inputs into profitable products customers love.

A hands-on builder role: you experiment at pace, work closely with Risk, Finance, Engineering, and Partnerships, and balance customer value, commercial return, and responsible lending.

What You'll Do

Product Strategy & Roadmap

  • Own the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for assigned credit card and lending products
  • Translate market opportunities, partner needs, and competitive insights into a prioritized product backlog
  • Define product positioning, target customer segments, and value propositions across on-us, co-branded, co-lending, and personal/cash loan products
  • Balance short-term partner requirements with long-term product sustainability and scalability

Financial Modeling and P&L Ownership

  • Build and own detailed financial models, unit economics analyses, and P&L forecasts for each product
  • Define pricing, fee structures, and reward frameworks grounded in data-informed decisions
  • Synthesize signals from market, partner, and customer data into actionable product recommendations
  • Track performance metrics and act on early signals to optimize profitability and risk-adjusted returns

Product Development & Launch

  • Own end-to-end product specification: from concept and business case through technical requirements, UAT, and go-live
  • Coordinate across Risk, Engineering, Operations, Compliance, and external partners to deliver on schedule
  • Define and maintain the product governance framework—ensuring every launch is documented, compliant, and audit-ready
  • Run structured launch reviews to assess performance against targets and drive continuous improvement

Partner & Stakeholder Management

  • Serve as the primary product interface with banking partners, platform partners, and regulators
  • Translate partner requirements and regulatory constraints into well-defined product specs and technical briefs
  • Build trust through consistent delivery and intentional communication; stay aware of downstream impact on partner operations
  • Represent product to senior leadership with evidence-backed recommendations

AI-Powered Product Operations

  • Use AI tools actively—craft precise prompts, critically evaluate outputs, and apply AI to accelerate analysis, documentation, and roadmap communication
  • Experiment proactively with AI-powered workflows to expand what you can deliver without expanding headcount
  • Build feedback loops that capture customer and partner signals for ongoing product refinement

What We're Looking For

Experience & Background

  • 5+ years of product management experience, with at least 3 years in financial products (credit cards, consumer loans, or co-lending)
  • Deep familiarity with Philippine banking regulations, BSP requirements, and consumer lending frameworks
  • Experience building financial models, P&L structures, and unit economics analyses from scratch
  • Background in fintech, digital banking, or credit-driven consumer products; startup or high-growth tech background is a strong plus

How You Work

  • Insights & AI Readiness — You synthesize data and AI tool outputs into product decisions; you craft precise prompts, evaluate results critically, and apply AI to deliver more with less
  • Bias for Action — You move quickly from analysis to decision and produce tangible results without waiting for a full mandate
  • Cross-domain Competence — You connect product, risk, finance, and technology thinking naturally, coordinating across functions to unlock pace
  • Growth Mindset — You treat every launch—successful or not—as a learning signal, actively raise your own bar, and bring others along

Skills & Competencies

  • Business Owner — You make calls without waiting for central approval; you own outcomes end-to-end, not just tasks
  • Product Architect — You prototype product flows and decision logic; you read metrics before acting and build from evidence
  • Domain Expert — You can break down credit product mechanics for any audience and know which edge cases to cover and document
  • AI Operator — You keep product documentation, workflows, and AI-assisted outputs above quality threshold; you catch drift early
  • Strong English communication skills (spoken and written — professional fluency required)
  • High adaptability and comfort operating in fast-paced, ambiguous environments

What We Offer

Join our vibrant team and enjoy:

  • Competitive compensation package, including yearly performance bonus.
  • HMO coverage for employee + 2 dependents.
  • Hybrid work setup (2 days onsite / 3 days WFH).
  • AI productivity tools (Claude Cowork).
  • Onsite lunch with multiple options, including vegetarian.
  • Grab for work allowance and fully equipped workstations.
  • Generous leave policies, including annual leave, sick leave, and flexible work hours.

  • Work alongside talented colleagues across multiple countries: the US, Mexico, Singapore, Vietnam, India, Indonesia, and the Philippines.
  • Be part of a high-growth fintech at an exciting stage of expansion — with real ownership from day one.
