At Trusting Social, we live by ownership, integrity, and agility in execution. We believe in doing what's right, what's best, and what's innovative. If you're smart, driven, and want to make a difference in the world with the most advanced and fascinating technology, come join our team. We offer the runway to truly make an impact.

title: Product Manager, In-Person Giving
description:
Highlights:

Location: Serbia

Language: Fluent in Russian and English (C1+)

About Fundraise Up

We’re Fundraise Up - a global fundraising platform built to make donating to nonprofits fast, seamless, and accessible to all. Every month, our technology powers tens of millions of dollars in donations across the globe. We focus on innovation that directly impacts results: faster load times, higher conversion rates, global payment support, and accessibility-first design.

Our platform is trusted by many of the world’s leading nonprofits, including UNICEF, the Alzheimer’s Association, and a wide range of global NGOs. With a 4.9/5 rating across top software review platforms, we’re recognized not just for our impact - but for the quality of the product we deliver.

A Truly Global Product

We operate in the enterprise segment, serving nonprofit organizations across North America, the United Kingdom, Australia, and Europe.

We’re building a large and complex product ecosystem that serves nonprofits, donors, and partners around the world. The platform includes a modern checkout experience and customizable widgets (each a standalone SPA), donor, organization, and partner portals, admin tools, and several internal apps.

The Team

We are a distributed team of 160+ product professionals. Our team members are mainly based across Spain, Poland, Portugal, Georgia, Armenia, Serbia, Turkey, and Cyprus.

Despite our scale, we operate like a focused team - where every task matters and every voice is heard. We value thoughtful collaboration, strong engineering practices, and a product mindset. You’ll be joining a team where quality, mentorship, and mutual respect come first.

About In-Person Giving at Fundraise Up

In-Person Giving brings the quality and connected data of Fundraise Up’s online donation experience into physical fundraising moments.

The product begins with Tap to Donate and Giving Station: staff-led and self-service experiences that let nonprofits accept contactless donations at events, in public spaces, and through other offline workflows. Every transaction should connect to the same campaigns, donor records, reporting, CRM integrations, and operational controls used across Fundraise Up.

The next product direction is Events & Commerce. It includes ticket sales, check-in, merchandise and food purchases, symbolic purchases, auctions, paddle raises, and additional donations before and during an event. These capabilities must work as one connected fundraising system rather than another isolated event tool.

About the Role

We are hiring a Product Manager to own Events & Commerce within the broader In-Person Giving product line.

This is a hands-on software product role covering discovery, definition, delivery, launch, and iteration. You will turn a large category into a focused product direction grounded in customer workflows, live usage, and commercial evidence.

You will work closely with the PM responsible for the broader In-Person Giving area so that event commerce builds on the same payment, campaign, donor-data, reporting, mobile, and operational foundations as Tap to Donate and Giving Station. You will also partner with the Peer-to-Peer team where ticketing and event capabilities should be shared rather than rebuilt separately.

This is not an event-planning, sales, or internal project-coordination role.

What You’ll Own

Define the product direction

  • Turn customer research, market evidence, and business context into a clear Events & Commerce product thesis and sequenced roadmap.
  • Choose a focused target segment and event scenario rather than trying to replace every event platform at once.
  • Decide which capabilities belong in the shared In-Person Giving foundation and which require an Events-specific model.
  • Make explicit decisions about what Fundraise Up should build, integrate, partner on, or deliberately exclude.
  • Keep assumptions, success metrics, scope, risks, and product decisions visible.

Lead discovery and product definition

  • Work directly with nonprofit fundraising teams, event operators, finance teams, volunteers, attendees, donors, design partners, and internal GTM teams.
  • Map the complete workflow before, during, and after an event—including purchase, donation, check-in, fulfillment, reconciliation, reporting, and follow-up.
  • Validate decisions through interviews, workflow observation, prototypes, and live product usage.
  • Separate true adoption blockers from feature requests and expectations created by incumbent event platforms.
  • Shape problems such as ticket sales, QR-based check-in, guest management, commerce catalogues, FMV and receipts, on-site purchases, auctions, paddle raises, refunds, attribution, reporting, and integrations. These are examples—not a pre-committed feature checklist.

Shape and deliver the product

  • Own the product from problem definition through requirements, delivery, launch, and iteration.
  • Write clear requirements, acceptance criteria, edge cases, state transitions, and decision records.
  • Make day-to-day scope and trade-off decisions with Engineering, Design, Analytics, Research, QA, and GTM partners.
  • Design for real event conditions: staff and volunteer operators, self-service flows, mobile devices, optional hardware, unreliable connectivity, high-volume moments, and operational recovery.
  • Ensure that event capabilities reuse Fundraise Up’s existing payments, campaign, donor, reporting, CRM, and identity infrastructure wherever possible.
  • Keep delivery predictable by surfacing dependencies, risks, and unresolved decisions early.

Launch, learn, and drive outcomes

  • Launch through EAPs with clear entry criteria, target workflows, success measures, readiness requirements, and out-of-scope areas.
  • Understand whether organizations can configure and run the target event workflows without heavy manual work or disconnected tools.
  • Measure whether attendees can purchase, check in, donate, and receive the right confirmation or receipt through a clear experience.
  • Partner with Product Marketing, Sales, CSM, Support, Finance, Legal, and Operations on positioning, commitments, enablement, and launch readiness.
  • Connect product evidence to activation, adoption, event completion, GPV, expansion, pipeline, retention, and operational cost.
  • Turn evidence into explicit recommendations: iterate, expand, change direction, partner, or stop.

Work AI-native

  • Use AI for research synthesis, workflow analysis, prototyping, specification quality, data exploration, and operational automation.
  • Build testable artifacts quickly without outsourcing product judgment.

Requirements

  • 4–7 years of Product Management or Product Ownership experience in a software product company.
  • End-to-end ownership of a customer-facing product area with Engineering and Design.
  • Strong judgment in reducing a large problem space to a focused release and explaining the trade-offs.
  • Experience turning customer evidence and product data into decisions.
  • Clear written communication across requirements, edge cases, metrics, and decision records.
  • Ability to work with transactional, multi-actor workflows involving permissions, states, money, and data relationships.
  • High ownership and independence, with fluent written and spoken English.

Strong plus

  • Experience with ticketing, event technology, commerce, POS, payments, marketplaces, registration, auctions, or other transaction-heavy products.
  • Experience with mobile applications, contactless payments, physical devices, or hardware-enabled workflows.
  • Experience with B2B SaaS, fundraising, nonprofits, or other operationally complex customer environments.
  • Experience launching a new product area through beta or EAP.
  • Knowledge of CRM integrations, financial reconciliation, reporting, transaction attribution, analytics, or SQL.
  • Practical use of AI for research, prototyping, analysis, or product operations.

This Role May Not Be a Fit If

  • You are looking for an event-planning or internal project-management role rather than software product ownership.
  • You prefer to receive a fully defined roadmap and requirements instead of helping determine what should be built.
  • You want to work only on strategy and avoid specifications, QA, delivery details, or post-launch iteration.
  • You treat every customer request as a roadmap commitment.
  • You need stable scope and certainty before moving forward.
  • You measure progress mainly by features shipped rather than customer and business outcomes.

Why work with us

  • Build a new product direction from research through live customer use.
  • Work in a large, proven fundraising category with clear customer demand and meaningful commercial potential.
  • Shape ticketing and event commerce as part of a broader fundraising platform rather than an isolated event tool.
  • Work with real nonprofit customers, rich product evidence, and experienced cross-functional partners.
  • Join a small team where product managers have meaningful ownership and direct access to Product leadership.
  • Help define an AI-native approach to product management in practice.
  • Build technology that helps nonprofits engage more supporters and raise more money for their missions.

Compensation

  • The compensation range for this role is DIN597,500 - DIN632,500 gross.
  • Final compensation will be determined based on relevant experience, skills, qualifications, alignment with the role’s requirements and location.

Benefits

  • Private medical insurance for the employee and their family
  • 20 paid vacation days per year
  • 15 paid public holidays per year
  • 5 company-paid sick leave days
  • English learning courses
  • Relevant professional education
  • Gym or swimming pool
  • Home Office Setup Assistance: the company offers assistance with purchasing furniture (office chair, office desk, monitor) and other items to create a comfortable workspace
  • Co-working
  • Remote working

**Please note: All official correspondence from Fundraise Up will exclusively originate from the @fundraiseup.com domain. Exercise caution and ensure the authenticity of emails claiming to be from our company.

We are an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, national origin, disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law in the countries where we operate.

title: Owner Experience Team Leader
description:
Are you a people-focused leader who enjoys coaching teams, improving performance and creating brilliant customer experiences? We’re looking for an Owner Experience Team Leader to help our Owner Experience team deliver consistently high-quality support to the homeowners who choose Awaze to manage their holiday properties.

Your mission

As our Owner Experience Team Leader, your mission is to ensure our owners receive a consistently high-quality experience whenever they contact us. You’ll lead the day-to-day performance of the team, coach and develop colleagues, monitor key performance indicators and help make sure our Owner Service and Retention operations run smoothly and efficiently.

You’ll combine hands-on people leadership with a strong focus on service, performance and continuous improvement, creating an environment where colleagues feel supported, recognised and accountable for delivering great results.

You’ll be someone who stays calm when things get busy, enjoys solving problems and is always looking for practical ways to make things better.

We’re looking for someone who brings:

  • Knowledge of contact centre operations, performance management and service delivery.

  • Strong people-management skills, with the ability to coach, mentor and motivate a team.

  • Confidence handling complaints, escalations and difficult conversations.

  • A structured, hands-on approach to problem solving and continuous improvement.

  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to listen actively and communicate clearly and empathetically.

  • Comfort using technology and systems to improve efficiency and service.

  • The ability to adapt quickly and perform effectively in a dynamic and changing environment.

  • A collaborative approach, building strong relationships across teams to achieve shared goals.

How you'll make an impact

Your success will be seen in both the experience our owners receive and the performance and engagement of your team. You’ll:

  • Build an engaged, motivated team where colleagues feel supported, recognised and accountable.

  • Improve owner experience by coaching behaviours that reduce repeat contact and increase first-time resolution.

  • Deliver strong performance against service, quality, productivity and engagement measures.

  • Use owner feedback, frontline insight and performance data to identify opportunities for coaching and service improvement.

  • Create greater consistency in ways of working by embedding agreed processes and standards across the function.

  • Balance service quality with operational efficiency, understanding how team performance affects cost, productivity and owner retention.

We’re a people-first business - and we know that our success starts with our teams. Here’s a glimpse of what you’ll enjoy:

  • Flexible hybrid working – with the autonomy to work how you work best

  • Real opportunities to grow, learn and shape your role as well as careers progression vertically or horizontally, cross countries and responsibilities.

About Awaze

At Awaze, we bring holidays to life. With over 110,000 holiday homes across 25 countries, we’re Europe’s largest holiday rentals company. Our purpose is simple – to delight our guests and homeowners while building an inspiring place to work for our people.

Awaze is part of Europe’s leading provider of holiday homes. The company operates more than 25 historical brands, including , NOVASOL, and Hoseasons.

You will be employed by Awaze A/S and work with the NOVASOL brand, which has the largest selection of holiday homes in Denmark and over 50,000 holiday homes across Europe.

Worth knowing

This position is full-time, 12 months FTC and based fully out of our Lowestoft office (Trinity House, Riverside Road, NR33 0SW).

What’s next?

Du vill arbeta på en arbetsplats där du tillsammans med ditt team kan göra skillnad och ert engagemang uppskattas. Meriterande:

  • Erfarenhet av liknande arbete?

Attendo är en trygg arbetsgivare som kan erbjuda dig som vill goda möjligheter att ta mer ansvar eller att gå vidare till nya roller. Tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdag så vänta inte med din ansökan!

Attendo är ett av Nordens största omsorgsföretag och startades 1985. Vi är verksamma inom äldreboende och hemtjänst.

Våra värderingar omtanke, engagemang och kompetens vägleder oss dagligen i vårt arbete för att alla ska uppleva trivsel, delaktighet, gemenskap och arbetsglädje.

Välkommen med din ansökan – Tillsammans för framtidens omsorg!

Malin Lindgren på malin.lindgren1@attendo.se

title: DevOps/DevSecOps Lead
description:

Location: Central

Salary: Up to $10,000 + AWS + VB

We are seeking a hands-on DevOps / DevSecOps Lead to lead the design, implementation and continuous improvement of secure, scalable and highly available platforms hosted on Amazon Web Services (AWS).

You will provide technical leadership across AWS infrastructure, CI/CD, Infrastructure-as-Code, security automation, observability and production operations. You will work closely with software engineers, security teams, architects and product stakeholders to embed security and operational resilience throughout the software development lifecycle.

Key Responsibilities

AWS Cloud and Platform Engineering

  • Lead the design, implementation and management of secure, scalable and highly available AWS cloud environments.
  • Design AWS solutions using services such as EC2, ECS, EKS, Lambda, RDS, S3, CloudFront, Route 53, API Gateway and Elastic Load Balancing.
  • Establish and maintain multi-account AWS environments using AWS Organizations, Control Tower and Service Control Policies.
  • Develop reusable Infrastructure-as-Code modules using Terraform, OpenTofu, CloudFormation or AWS CDK.
  • Manage containerised applications and workloads using Docker, Amazon ECS and Amazon EKS.
  • Implement effective networking architectures using VPCs, subnets, Transit Gateway, NAT Gateway, VPC endpoints, security groups and network ACLs.
  • Drive cloud optimisation initiatives covering performance, resilience, scalability and AWS cost management.

CI/CD and Automation

  • Lead the design and implementation of CI/CD pipelines for application build, testing, security scanning and deployment.
  • Implement deployment automation using AWS CodePipeline, CodeBuild, CodeDeploy, Jenkins, GitLab CI/CD or GitHub Actions.
  • Establish automated release controls, approval workflows, rollback mechanisms and environment standardisation.
  • Develop automation scripts using Python, Bash, PowerShell or a similar scripting language.
  • Apply GitOps and DevSecOps practices to improve deployment speed, consistency and security.
  • Identify and automate repetitive operational processes to minimise downtime and human error.

AWS Security and DevSecOps

  • Embed security controls and automated security testing throughout the software development lifecycle.
  • Integrate SAST, DAST, Software Composition Analysis, container scanning, secrets detection and Infrastructure-as-Code scanning into CI/CD pipelines.
  • Implement identity and access controls using AWS IAM, IAM Identity Center, permission boundaries, Service Control Policies and role-based access.
  • Manage encryption and secrets using AWS KMS, Secrets Manager and Systems Manager Parameter Store.
  • Implement security monitoring and threat-detection capabilities using AWS Security Hub, GuardDuty, Inspector, Config and CloudTrail.
  • Protect applications and infrastructure using AWS WAF, Shield, Network Firewall and appropriate security controls.
  • Establish vulnerability-identification, prioritisation, remediation and reporting processes.
  • Support security reviews, threat modelling, penetration testing, risk assessments and audit-remediation activities.
  • Ensure AWS environments comply with organisational security policies, regulatory requirements and cloud security best practices.

Reliability and Production Operations

  • Lead production-support activities, including monitoring, incident response, problem management and root-cause analysis.
  • Implement full-stack monitoring and observability using Amazon CloudWatch, CloudTrail, X-Ray, OpenSearch and relevant Application Performance Management tools.
  • Establish operational dashboards, alerts, service-level indicators and service-level objectives.
  • Develop backup, disaster-recovery and business-continuity strategies using AWS Backup, RDS snapshots, S3 replication and multi-region architectures.
  • Improve application and infrastructure resilience through automated recovery, scaling and failover mechanisms.
  • Lead major incident response and coordinate timely resolution across internal teams and external vendors.
  • Oversee production deployments and on-call support arrangements.

Technical Leadership

  • Lead and mentor DevOps, DevSecOps and AWS cloud engineers.
  • Provide technical direction and review AWS architectures, Infrastructure-as-Code, pipeline configurations and security controls.
  • Establish DevOps, cloud security and production-operations standards.
  • Create reusable AWS platform components, automation templates and engineering guidelines.
  • Coordinate with application, architecture, security and product teams to deliver cloud initiatives.
  • Manage external vendors and AWS service providers where required.
  • Communicate technical risks, operational performance and improvement plans to stakeholders and senior management.
  • Maintain documentation covering architecture, configurations, deployment procedures, incident response and disaster recovery.

Requirements

  • Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering or a related discipline.
  • At least 7 years of experience in DevOps, DevSecOps, AWS cloud engineering, platform engineering or production operations.
  • Demonstrated experience leading DevOps, cloud or platform-engineering teams.
  • Strong hands-on experience designing, deploying and operating production workloads on AWS.
  • Strong understanding of AWS networking, compute, storage, databases, containers, IAM and security services.
  • Experience building CI/CD pipelines using AWS CodePipeline, CodeBuild, CodeDeploy, Jenkins, GitLab CI/CD or GitHub Actions.
  • Strong experience with Terraform, OpenTofu, CloudFormation, AWS CDK or Ansible.
  • Experience with Docker, Amazon ECS or Amazon EKS.
  • Proficiency in Python, Bash, PowerShell or a similar scripting language.

title: US People and Talent Business Partner
description:
We’re Summize, an ambitious legal tech scale-up based in the US and UK, working with businesses all over the globe. Our mission is simple, to get entire businesses working faster and smarter with contracts. We’re a growing team making big things happen out of HQs in Manchester, UK, Boston and San Diego, US and we’re not stopping! Following our recent $50 Million Series B investment we’re looking for forward-thinkers, innovators and problem solvers to join our dynamic team as we enter our next growth phase.

The Role

As we scale our US presence across our HQs in Boston and San Diego, we're looking for a commercially minded US People and Talent Business Partner professional to be the heartbeat of our People operations stateside based out of our Seaport based office.You'll be the go-to People person for our US employees, owning everything from day-to-day HR admin, advisory and business partnering to supporting our Lead Talent Acquisition Manager with recruitment campaigns. You'll work closely with our UK-based People team and report into the Chief Finance Officer, playing a critical part in making sure our US team feels supported, engaged and set up to do their best work.

What You'll Do
HR & People Operations

  • Serve as the first point of contact for all US employees on all HR matters, providing pragmatic, empathetic advice grounded in employment law.

  • Manage employee relations cases end-to-end. Including performance management, disciplinaries, grievances and absence escalating complex matters appropriately.

  • Regularly provide support and advice and guidance to US people managers

  • Maintain working knowledge of US federal, Massachusetts and California state employment law, ensuring Summize policies and practices remain compliant. Producing videos and in person training materials on policies updates or changes.

  • Processing and overseeing US payroll via our payroll system. As well as the administering and managing US Employee benefits for example; health insurance and 401K

  • Support the annual people cycle: performance reviews, compensation benchmarking, benefits renewals and engagement surveys.

  • Own US onboarding and offboarding processes, partnering with IT, Finance and hiring managers to deliver a seamless experience.

  • Contribute to the development and localization of People policies, handbooks and process documentation for a US context.

  • Provide HR data and insights to support decision-making, using our HRIS to keep records accurate and up to date.

Talent & Recruiting

  • Occasionally support the Lead Talent Acquisition Manager on recruitment for US-based recruitment campaigns across commercial and operational functions.

  • Partner with the Lead Talent Acquisition Manager and hiring managers in the US to build clear role profiles, development of market salary benchmarking data and support interview processes.

  • Champion a positive candidate experience at every touchpoint, representing Summize's brand and culture with care.

  • Support employer branding initiatives in the US market, contributing ideas to grow Summize's profile as a great place to work.

What we’re looking for

  • 3+ years of professional experience in an HR generalist, HR Business Partner or combined HR/TA role ideally within a tech, SaaS or scale-up environment.

  • Solid, working knowledge of US employment law particularly Massachusetts and California state law, FLSA, FMLA and at-will employment principles.

  • Hands-on experience managing ER cases independently, with good judgment about when to escalate.

  • Previous experience managing and overseeing payroll processes

  • Proficient in US employee benefits including health insurance, 401K etc.

  • Previous experience supporting recruitment campaigns across a range of functions and levels.

  • A collaborative working style and comfort operating in a small team where you'll need to be both strategic and hands-on.

  • Experience working with HRIS, Payroll and ATS systems (Experience with HiBob, Teamtailor and PrismHR preferred but not essential)

  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills. You'll be advising employees and managers on sensitive matters regularly so being able to communicate appropriately and use discretion is essential.

Nice to have

  • Experience working within a UK-headquartered company and navigating time differences and distributed teams

  • Familiarity with B2B SaaS businesses.

  • SHRM-CP or PHR certification (or working towards one).

What We Offer

  • 26 days PTO including US public holidays. Increasing by 1 day every year up to 30 days

  • Healthcare insurance plan for all employees including dental and vision

  • A 401(k) plan for all employees

  • Access to discounts on things like travel, electronics, fashion, fitness and more

  • Rich learning and development opportunities supported through our Growth Mindset Fund

  • Work from anywhere policy applicable after one year of employment

  • Employee share option scheme

  • Regular social activities and events

  • Opportunity to be a part of one of Legal Tech's hottest scale-ups

Base salary range listed represents what Summize reasonably expects to pay for this position at the time of posting. Final compensation will be determined based on a number of factors including skills, experience and location. Total compensation may also include performance-based bonus/commission, equity and a comprehensive benefits package.

We understand the value of having a diversity of identities, backgrounds and thinking within our company so we’re open to hearing from applicants who don’t yet tick all the boxes. If that’s you, please accompany your application with short summary explaining how you’d close the gap on the skills you don’t yet have.

Looking for a role where you can really make a difference? We’d love to hear from you and tell you more about this exciting opportunity at Summize.

title: Member Experience Guide
description:
Founded in 1977 as the Senior Care Action Network, SCAN began with a simple but radical idea: that older adults deserve to stay healthy and independent. That belief was championed by a group of community activists we still honor today as the “12 Angry Seniors.” Their mission continues to guide everything we do.

Today, SCAN is a nonprofit health organization serving more than 500,000 people across Arizona, California, Nevada, New Mexico, Texas, and Washington, with over $8 billion in annual revenue. With nearly five decades of experience, we have built a distinctive, values-driven platform dedicated to improving care for older adults.

Our work spans Medicare Advantage, fully integrated care models, primary care, care for the most medically and socially complex populations, and next-generation care delivery models. Across all of this, we are united by a shared commitment: combining compassion with discipline, innovation with stewardship, and growth with integrity.

At SCAN, we believe scale should strengthen—not dilute—our mission. We are building the future of care for older adults, grounded in purpose, accountability, and respect for the people and communities we serve.

Member Experience Guide

Remote Locations (AZ, NV, TX, WA)

Start Date: 10/19/2026

7 weeks mandator training

Shift TBD after training

Base Hourly Pay Rate: $20.00

The job

The Member Experience Guide serves as a trusted partner to our members, owning each interaction from inquiry to resolution with empathy, clarity, and accountability. Guided by a deep sense of Member Obsession, this role puts members first in every decision, ensuring their needs are understood, prioritized, and resolved with urgency and care. Member Experience Guides embrace a Champion’s Mindset, welcoming challenges and persevering until the best possible outcome is achieved. Through courageous problem-solving and a commitment to excellence, this role reduces member effort, strengthens trust, and delivers meaningful experiences that build long-term loyalty.

You will

  • Connect with empathy and member-first focus: Build trust through active listening, acknowledging emotions, and demonstrating Member Obsession by prioritizing the member’s needs in every interaction.
  • Own the end-of-end experience: Take full accountability for resolving inquiries, requests, and concerns, navigating systems and teams with a Champion’s Mindset to achieve first-call resolution whenever possible.
  • Deliver “path to yes” solutions: Apply critical thinking and Courageous Challenge by seeking solutions beyond the obvious and addressing barriers directly to meet member needs.
  • Navigate complexity with clarity and confidence: Translate benefits, claims, and processes into simple, actionable guidance, ensuring members feel supported and informed.
  • Demonstrate tenacity and perseverance: Persist through complex or ambiguous situations, exhausting available resources before escalating and maintaining focus until resolution is achieved.
  • Provide clear next steps and follow-through: Take ownership with Resolve, set expectations and ensure closure through proactive communication and follow-up.
  • Challenge for better outcomes: Use Courageous Challenge to raise concerns, identify process gaps, and advocate for improvements that enhance the member experience.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement: Embrace Responsible Disruption by identifying opportunities to improve workflows, reduce friction, and enhance service delivery.
  • Uphold service excellence standards: Demonstrate Relentless Leadership in everyday actions by consistently delivering high-quality, empathetic, and effective service.

Your Qualifications

High School Diploma or Equivalent Experience


1+ years of customer service experience in a contact center, healthcare, hospitality, or service-oriented environment

Experience resolving customer issues, managing multiple systems, and handling high-volume interactions

Required: English (Read, Write, Spoken)

Skills/Abilities
Empathy – Demonstrates the ability to recognize and validate member emotions, ensuring every interaction feels personal, respectful, and understood.

Compassion – Transforms empathy into action by proactively working to ease member concerns and improve outcomes.

Tenacity – Displays persistence and determination, embracing a Champion’s Mindset to resolve even the most complex challenges.

Resolve – Owns outcomes fully, ensuring issues are driven to closure with clear communication and follow-through.

Experience Preferred:

Medicare Advantage, Medicaid, or healthcare experience

Experience in a provider office, medical group, hospital, or health plan

Hospitality or high-touch service experience

Caregiving experience demonstrating compassion and advocacy

Preferred: Fluency in one or more of the following languages in addition to English:

o Spanish

o Cantonese

o Mandarin

o Korean

o Vietnamese

We seek Rebels who are curious about AI and its power to transform how we operate and serve our members.

What's in it for you?

  • Work mode: Remote
  • A quarterly employee bonus program
  • Robust Wellness Program
  • Generous paid-time-off (PTO)- 8 paid holidays per year, 1 floating holiday, birthday off, and 2 volunteer days
  • Excellent 401(k) Retirement Saving Plan with employer match
  • Robust employee recognition program
  • Tuition reimbursement
  • An opportunity to become part of a team that makes a difference to our members and our community every day!

We're always looking for talented people to join our team! Qualified applicants are encouraged to apply now!

We are committed to creating a workforce that reflects our community through inclusive programs and initiatives such as equal pay, employee resource groups, inclusive benefits, and more.

title: Senior Incident Response Consultant, Mandiant (Weekend team)
description:
In this role, you will use your deep understanding of both existing and emerging threat actors, experience identifying rapidly changing tools, tactics and procedures of attackers, and strong computer forensics response knowledge and skills. You must be able to see the big picture, understand evolving attacker behavior and motivations, participate and manage large client-facing projects, and train and mentor other security consultants.

You will be responsible for providing expert support under tight deadlines to clients during critical security incidents, possess strong business acumen, and have the ability to lead, train, and mentor other consultants.

Part of Google Cloud, Mandiant is a recognized leader in dynamic cyber defense, threat intelligence and incident response services. Mandiant's cybersecurity expertise has earned the trust of security professionals and company executives around the world. Our unique combination of renowned frontline experience responding to some of the most complex breaches, nation-state grade threat intelligence, machine intelligence, and the industry's best security validation ensures that Mandiant knows more about today's advanced threats than anyone.
  • Lead large and complex, client-facing incident response engagements, examine cloud, endpoint, and network-based sources of evidence.
  • Recognize and codify attacker tools, tactics, and procedures (TTPs) and indicators of compromise (IOCs) that can be applied to current and future investigations.
  • Build scripts, tools, or methodologies to enhance Mandiant’s incident investigation processes.
  • Develop and present comprehensive and accurate reports, trainings, and presentations for both technical and executive audiences.
  • Conduct host forensics, network forensics, log analysis, and malware triage in support of incident response investigations.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Cybersecurity, related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 5 years of investigative experience with network forensics, malware triage analysis, cloud forensics, or disk and memory forensics.
  • 5 years of experience working end-to-end incident response investigations, analysis, or containment actions.
  • Experience in Linux or Unix.
  • Ability to travel up to 30% of the time.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Certifications in cloud platforms and GCFA, GCFE, GNFA, GCIA, GREM, GCIH, GX-FA or equivalent.
  • Experience in security competitions, capture the flags (CTFs) or testing platforms such as Hack the Box, TryHackMe, Overthewire, etc.
  • Ability to communicate investigative findings and strategies to technical staff, executive leadership, legal counsel, and internal and external clients.
  • Excellent communication skills, with an ability to communicate findings and new initiatives to executive leaders.
  • Effective time management skills to balance time among multiple tasks and mentor junior consultants as needed.

title: Client Services Lead
description:
CLIENT SERVICES LEAD

Reports to: Registered Manager
Hours: 37.5 hours per week
Salary: £30,225 per annum (£15.50 per hour)
Location: Office and Community Based
On Call: Participation in the on-call rota where required (including evenings and weekends)

COMPANY BACKGROUND
Radfield Home Care is an award-winning, family-owned home care provider dedicated to helping people live independently in their own homes. We pride ourselves on delivering high-quality, person-centred care that enables people to remain connected to the things that matter most.

We believe exceptional care starts with exceptional people. Our reputation has been built on professionalism, compassion, strong leadership and a commitment to continuously improving the experience of our clients, families and care professionals.

The Client Services Lead plays a pivotal role in ensuring the delivery of safe, high-quality, person-centred care. As a senior member of the management team, they are responsible for leading the client journey from consultation through to ongoing review, providing professional oversight of client care and supporting the Field Care Supervisor team to deliver consistently excellent outcomes.

This role is fundamental to maintaining our reputation for quality, regulatory compliance and an exceptional client experience.

PURPOSE OF THE ROLE
To lead the delivery of high-quality, person-centred client services by overseeing care consultations, care planning, risk management, client reviews and ongoing quality assurance.

The Client Services Lead provides professional oversight of client care, ensuring services remain safe, responsive and tailored to each client's individual needs whilst providing professional leadership and guidance to the Field Care Supervisor team.

Working closely with the Registered Manager, Duty Care Manager and wider office team, the Client Services Lead plays a key role in maintaining quality standards, managing client risk, supporting professional practice and ensuring effective communication regarding client needs, risks and ongoing care.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIESCare Planning & Documentation

  • Create and maintain comprehensive person-centred care plans that accurately reflect each client's individual needs, preferences and desired outcomes.

  • Complete and review client risk assessments in line with regulatory requirements, safeguarding responsibilities and organisational policies.

  • Complete Mental Capacity Assessments and Best Interest Decisions where required, ensuring appropriate documentation and review.

  • Create, review and oversee Medication Administration Records (MAR) and medication documentation to ensure accuracy and safe delivery of care.

  • Review care documentation, body maps, incident reports and associated records to ensure concerns are identified, documented appropriately and escalated where required.

  • Ensure all client documentation remains accurate, up to date, audit-ready and compliant with regulatory and organisational requirements.

Client Reviews & Consultations

  • Conduct care consultations with prospective clients and their families, ensuring a professional, person-centred assessment process.

  • Complete and oversee scheduled client reviews, ensuring services remain responsive to changing needs and client outcomes.

  • Lead the development and review of care plans following consultations, reviews, incidents or significant changes in client needs.

  • Oversee all aspects of Live-in Care packages, ensuring they remain safe, effective and appropriate to client needs.

Quality, Risk & Compliance

  • Provide professional oversight of client care, ensuring changes in clients' needs, risks or outcomes are identified promptly and appropriate action is taken to maintain safe, high-quality care.

  • Oversee the Client Risk Register, ensuring high-risk clients are identified, monitored and reviewed appropriately.

  • Ensure agreed actions relating to identified client risks are progressed within agreed timescales and escalated where appropriate.

  • Monitor client incidents, safeguarding concerns and quality issues, ensuring appropriate follow-up, learning and continuous improvement.

  • Ensure significant client risks, safeguarding concerns and changes in client needs are communicated effectively to the Field Care Supervisor team and relevant members of the management team, ensuring appropriate action is taken.

  • Support the Registered Manager and Duty Care Manager in maintaining compliance with regulatory requirements and quality assurance processes.

  • Ensure client records remain inspection-ready and support continuous improvement across the service.

Client Experience & Quality

  • Promote consistently high standards of person-centred care throughout the client journey.

  • Encourage and obtain client feedback through Google Reviews, and other appropriate channels to support continuous improvement and reputation.

  • Monitor client feedback, compliments and complaints to identify trends, share learning and improve the overall client experience.

Professional Leadership & Team Development

  • Provide professional leadership, guidance and support to the Field Care Supervisor team, promoting consistently high standards of client care, care planning, reviews, risk management and documentation.

  • Act as the first point of professional support for the Field Care Supervisor team regarding client care, assessments, reviews, risk management and care planning queries.

  • Ensure effective two-way communication with the Field Care Supervisor team so that changes in client needs, identified risks, incidents and quality concerns are shared promptly and acted upon appropriately.

  • Work closely with the Field Care Supervisor team to ensure client reviews, care plans and risk assessments are completed to the required standard and within agreed timescales.

  • Provide coaching and support to develop the knowledge, confidence and competence of the Field Care Supervisor team in relation to client quality and professional practice.

  • Work collaboratively with the Duty Care Manager, Care Coordinators and wider office team to ensure seamless service delivery and effective communication across the service.

  • Provide office staff annual leave and absence cover where required to ensure continuity of service.

  • Participate in the on-call rota where required, including evenings and weekends.

  • Undertake any other duties reasonably required to support the effective running of the service and achievement of business objectives.

Induction & Training

  • Participate in the induction and training of new Care Professionals, ensuring they understand client care plans, risk assessments, documentation requirements and person-centred care delivery.

PERSON SPECIFICATION Essential

  • Previous experience within a senior role in domiciliary care (Field Care Supervisor, Senior Field Care Supervisor, Client Lead or similar).

  • Level 3 Diploma in Adult Care (or equivalent).

  • Good working knowledge of CQC regulations, safeguarding responsibilities and care sector legislation.

  • Excellent understanding of care planning, risk assessment and person-centred care.

  • Experience completing care consultations and client reviews.

  • Excellent communication and relationship-building skills.

  • Strong organisational skills with excellent attention to detail.

  • Good IT skills and confidence using electronic care management systems.

  • Full UK driving licence and access to your own vehicle.

  • Enhanced DBS disclosure.

Desirable

  • Level 5 Diploma in Leadership for Adult Care (or willingness to work towards).

  • Experience supporting or coaching Field Care Supervisors.

  • Experience of Live-in Care.

  • Experience leading quality improvement initiatives.

PERSONAL ATTRIBUTES

  • Passionate about delivering exceptional person-centred care.

  • Professional, approachable and compassionate.

  • Calm under pressure and able to prioritise effectively.

  • Positive, proactive and solutions-focused.

  • Excellent attention to detail.

  • Committed to continuous improvement.

  • Able to build strong working relationships whilst maintaining high professional standards.

  • A role model for professionalism, quality and client-focused care.

BENEFITS

  • Salary of £30,225 per annum (£15.50 per hour).

  • Pension scheme.

  • Company Sick Pay Scheme.

  • Opportunity to participate in future discretionary performance-related bonus schemes (subject to business performance and role requirements).

  • Annual Awards & Recognition Programme.

  • Blue Light Card membership.

  • Vehicle maintenance support scheme.

  • Paid training and ongoing professional development.

  • Clear progression opportunities within the business.

  • Supportive, well-managed and award-winning team environment.

Välkommen till Syntronic!

Bakgrundskontroller kan förekomma.

Av kommunikation- och kvalitetssäkringsskäl ber vi dig att skicka in din ansökan digitalt via vårt system och inte via e-post.

Vi kan använda AI och automatiserade verktyg som stöd i vår rekryteringsprocess. Alla beslut om urval och anställning fattas alltid av människor.

title: People Administrator
description:
People Administrator

Vacancy Reference: CLA- 437

Position: Full-time

Location: Salisbury, Wiltshire, UK

Salary: £28,000 - £30,000

At Callen-Lenz, we are expanding the limits of what is possible. We specialise in crewed and uncrewed aircraft operations and technology and having recently received investment into the business we are going through a period of rapid growth and development and are looking for key roles to assist with these changes. Callen-Lenz offers innovative and customer-focused UAS solutions through our 4 key business strands: technical services, products, platforms and operational services. We are looking for individuals to help drive forward our expansion, placing you at forefront of UAS development in the UK.

title: Project Cost Controller
description:
Studies show that women and underrepresented groups often hesitate to apply unless they meet every requirement. At Stegra, we’re building an impact-driven, sustainable company - and we need a diverse, inclusive team to make it happen.

If you share our passion but don’t meet every qualification, we encourage you to apply anyway. You might be the perfect fit for this role, or another as we grow.

At Stegra, we’re not just building a plant, we’re proving that sustainable industry is possible. And to do that, we need people like you.

Join a team where safety comes first. Where we support each other, learn as we go, and make space for everyone to grow and contribute. This is your chance to be part of something big - while being closer to nature and leading a balanced, purposeful life.

Type of employment: Temporary 12-24 months.
Placement: Boden

What you’ll do

Right now, we are looking for a Project Cost Controller for our Project Controls team. In this role you will sit within our Project Delivery function and support cost control activities within an assigned project area.

As Project Cost Controller, you will work closely with Project Managers, Area Managers, EPCM partners, Finance, Procurement, Planning, and the wider Project Controls team. You will help ensure that project costs are accurately tracked, forecast, and reported, providing reliable financial information to support project execution and decision-making.

Specific to this role, the day-to-day tasks will include the following but as we are a growing company with very little silos between teams, other tasks might be included as well.

  • Support cost control activities within an assigned project area, ensuring alignment with approved budgets and project objectives

  • Review and analyze cost reports, forecasts, commitments, accruals, and change orders from EPCM contractors and suppliers

  • Prepare cost forecasts, variance analyses, cash flow information, and monthly reporting

  • Monitor project cost performance and identify trends, risks, opportunities, and deviations

  • Work with Project Managers, Area Managers, Finance, Procurement, Planning, and EPCM partners to ensure accurate cost information

  • Support change management activities and assess the cost impact of project changes

  • Maintain project cost reports, dashboards, and supporting cost control documentation

  • Contribute to reliable and transparent project reporting throughout the execution phase

What you’ll bring

You’re curious and believe that real progress happens when we work together. You’re not afraid to challenge old ways of thinking and you treat others with respect while doing it. At Stegra, we value people who take initiative, build trust, and help create a workplace where everyone can do their best.

Specific to this role, we would like to see that you can tick off a fair amount of the boxes below

  • 3+ years of relevant experience in project cost control, project controls, commercial project support, or a similar role

  • Experience from industrial, construction, infrastructure, or EPCM project environments is considered an advantage

  • Relevant degree in Finance, Economics, Engineering, Project Controls, Construction Management, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience

  • Good understanding of project budgets, forecasting, cost reporting, and change management

  • Strong analytical and numerical skills with the ability to identify trends, risks, and deviations in project cost data

  • Experience using Excel, cost control systems, reporting tools, or similar project controls software

  • Good understanding of project delivery processes across engineering, procurement, and construction

  • Strong communication and collaboration skills with fluency in English; Swedish is considered an advantage

Benefits at Stegra

At Stegra, you’ll join a company where your work has real impact on the climate, the industry, and future generations. We’re building a culture rooted in safety, trust, and inclusion, where people feel supported to grow and thrive.

You’ll receive fair, competitive compensation aligned with collective agreements, along with benefits like up to 30 days of paid vacation, occupational pension, parental benefits, and insurance. If you need support with relocation or immigration, our relocation department will help guide you through the process, whether it’s permits, housing or other practical matters. You can also enjoy perks like subsidized gym memberships and bike leases, plus the everyday benefits of life closer to nature.

Read more about Benefits at Stegra here.

This is Stegra

Stegra is on a mission to change the global steel industry by producing green hydrogen, iron, and steel - with the goal of eliminating CO₂ emissions. Instead of coal, we use green hydrogen and fossil-free electricity, meaning our primary emissions will be water and heat.

By 2030, our ambition is to produce 5 million tonnes of green steel annually in our fully integrated, digitized, and sustainable plant in Boden, Northern Sweden - currently under construction. But this is just the beginning. Our expertise in green hydrogen will enable us to decarbonize industries beyond steel, paving the way for a cleaner future.

Our Boden Site

Our Boden site is located just west of Boden City, right in the heart of a growing green industrial hub in Northern Sweden. It’s where we’re building one of the world’s most modern, sustainable steel plants—designed with safety, efficiency, and people in mind. With just a 10-minute commute from town, you'll be close to both cutting-edge technology and the everyday convenience of living near nature, schools, and community life.

Boden Video

title: Agent Engineer
description:
Elliptic is building AI-powered tools that enable the business to scale faster and with greater confidence. Our operations team is at the centre of that work — designing the backend systems and AI integrations behind Elliptic's agentic transformation. This transformation is all about rethinking existing business processes – from workflows to ticket queues to decisions – and enabling our workforce to take the next great leap forward in productivity.

We're looking for a full-stack Agent Engineer to help us design and build agent fleets, AI integrations, APIs, workflows, UIs and services that make this possible.

The impact you will have:

As Agent Engineer on the Operations team, you will help design and deliver scalable, reliable services that power Elliptic’s internal business systems, focusing on building our agent fleets to automate core business processes.

You’ll partner with the Head of Business Transformation and VP of Operations, to turn complex internal processes into intelligent, user‑friendly experiences that help teams around the business perform their jobs with greater speed and confidence. Your work will make a tangible and immediate impact on team productivity, and you will work iterative directly with your users to forge solutions that meet their needs.

Working collaboratively across disciplines, you’ll contribute to impactful features and continuously improve quality, reliability, and usability across our internal platforms. Through this work, you’ll play an essential role in advancing Elliptic’s mission to make crypto markets safer, more transparent, and more efficient.

What you will do:

  • Lead the development of agent fleets to model complex business processes in Langchain.

  • Develop APIs and workflows that integrate AI and LLM frameworks with business systems.

  • Design, optimise, and query data models across relational and NoSQL databases.

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver an agentic platform from concept through to production.

  • Take part in technical design reviews, planning sessions, and code reviews to continuously improve system quality.

  • Contribute to infrastructure and observability practices alongside the Engineering team — you won't own this alone, but you'll be expected to care about how your services run in production.

What You'll Bring

  • Minimum 5 years of engineering experience, preferably including Python..

  • 1 year of experience with LangSmith or other comparable LLM/AI frameworks — this is an essential component of the vision for our agentic platform, and hands-on experience is required..

  • Solid API design skills — you've built and maintained production APIs and know how to integrate with external systems.

  • Cloud experience — you've worked with AWS services (e.g., Lambda, ECS, S3) in a production environment. Experience with helm charts and Kubernetes is a must.

  • Database proficiency — you're comfortable with SQL (Postgres or similar) and have some exposure to NoSQL stores.

  • A structured approach to problem-solving — you think clearly about system design and trade-offs.

  • Strong collaboration skills — you communicate well across engineering, product, and design.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with Node.js frameworks like NestJS or Express.

  • Hands-on experience with Terraform, or infrastructure-as-code tooling.

  • Experience with observability platforms like Datadog (metrics, tracing, alerting).

  • Exposure to DynamoDB or other NoSQL databases at scale.

  • Experience with distributed or event-driven architectures (SNS, SQS, etc.).

  • Interest in cryptocurrency, blockchain technology, or compliance — though we're happy to bring you up to speed.

Don't Meet Every Requirement?

If this role excites you but your experience doesn't perfectly match every bullet point, we'd still love to hear from you. We value curiosity, willingness to learn, and diverse perspectives just as much as specific tool experience.

Ensuring that people of all backgrounds, identities, and experiences feel welcome at Elliptic is an ongoing priority for us. We believe diverse thinking enables us to solve problems in new ways — benefiting both our team and our customers.

title: Head of Digital Advice & Discretionary Portfolio Management (DPM)
description:

In this role, you will collaborate closely with a dedicated tech team to bring our next-generation advisory and DPM capabilities to market across the Nordics.

As the Advice & DPM business expands, you will have the opportunity to take on formal managerial responsibility, shaping both the operational roadmap and the leadership structure of the department.

  • Drive Business Ownership: Take overall ownership of commercial strategy, positioning, product development, and P&L outcomes for Advice & DPM, and initiatives.

  • Lead & Build the Department: Provide daily functional direction to cross-functional teams now, while preparing to recruit and managerially lead the Advice & DPM team in the next phase.

  • Ensure Regulatory Compliance: Collaborate with Legal, Risk, and Compliance teams to maintain alignment with MiFID II advisory standards, suitability rules, and local Nordic frameworks.

  • Deliver Growth & Impact: Deliver on customer performance by launching digital-first tools that increase net savings, capture external wallet share, and boost overall engagement.

  • Solid experience as a Business Owner, Commercial Lead, or Senior Product Manager within wealth management, fintech, or digital banking.

  • Strong background working alongside cross-functional tech teams, product owners, and executive leadership.

  • Deep understanding of MiFID II advisory regulations, DPM frameworks, and investment compliance.

  • Commercial and analytical mindset with a strong focus on driving revenue, customer growth, and product adoption.

We offer

Nordnet started from a passionate belief that changing the hierarchical financial world was possible. We became part of redefining the industry when we gave the customers power over their savings. To be leading in IT is pivotal for that journey and you will work with colleagues who have a great passion for that goal.

description:

Working at Illumina means being part of something bigger than yourself. Every person, in every role, has the opportunity to make a difference. Surrounded by extraordinary people, inspiring leaders, and world changing projects, you will do more and become more than you ever thought possible.

title: Lead Electroncis Engineer - Sensors
location: Singapore - St James Power Station Headquarters
description:
Role Summary

As Lead Electronics Engineer – Sensors, you will provide technical leadership in the development of advanced sensing technologies, sensing platforms and associated algorithms for Dyson products. The role focuses on Air Quality sensing, LiDAR, Vision Systems, position and displacement sensor and other sensing technologies that enable intelligent product features across multiple categories.

About the Role

The Lead Electronics Engineer – Sensors will be part of the SEA Hardware Electronics team and will work across R&D programmes to develop, integrate and mature sensing systems for Dyson products. This is a hands-on technical leadership role requiring strong engineering judgement, system-level thinking and the ability to collaborate effectively with internal teams and external technology partners. You will help define sensing solutions from early concept through to validation, product integration and production readiness.

  • Lead the development and delivery of sensing technology platforms for Air Quality sensing, LiDAR, Vision Systems, position and displacement sensor and other sensing technologies across Dyson product categories.
  • Translate product and system requirements into clear sensing architectures, technical requirements, data collection plans and validation approaches.
  • Define, develop and validate sensing algorithms, including data collection, data analysis, signal conditioning, signal processing, algorithm tuning and performance assessment using Matlab or Python where appropriate.
  • Collaborate with Hardware, Software, Mechanical, Test, Manufacturing, Product and Quality teams to integrate sensing systems into Dyson products and ensure product requirements are met.
  • Provide technical leadership from proof of concept through development, verification, validation and production readiness.
  • Engage key suppliers and technology partners to evaluate sensing technologies, influence supplier roadmaps and identify scalable hardware platforms suitable for Dyson products.
  • Prepare clear technical documentation, design review materials, analysis reports and recommendations to support decision making across projects.

What You’ll Achieve in Your First Year

  • Establish a clear understanding of the current Air Quality sensing, LiDAR and Vision System technology landscape, supplier ecosystem and Dyson product needs.
  • Work with cross-functional teams to develop and integrate robust sensing solutions into Dyson products, balancing performance, cost, manufacturability and product requirements.
  • Work with product owners and engineering stakeholders to capture sensing requirements, define data collection needs, and select appropriate sensing technologies and algorithms.
  • Develop, tune and validate sensing algorithms using simulation and measured data, Matlab or Python analysis, and appropriate signal processing methods.
  • Provide technical coaching and mentoring to engineers, helping to build capability in sensing hardware, data analysis, signal processing and algorithm development.

About You

You are an experienced sensing or electronics engineer with strong technical depth, practical product development experience and the confidence to lead complex technical work. You are comfortable working across disciplines, using data to make decisions, and influencing suppliers and stakeholders to deliver robust engineering outcomes.

Essential Skills and Experience

  • Degree qualified in Electronics Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Physics, Robotics, Computer Engineering or a related technical discipline.
  • Typically, 5+ years of experience in sensing system design, implementation, testing, analysis and characterisation, preferably with exposure to Air Quality sensing, LiDAR, Vision Systems, optical sensing, environmental sensing or related technologies. Additional knowledge on optics and optical simulation is advantageous.
  • Solid understanding of how key sensing technologies work, including sensor physics, sensing architecture, interface requirements, calibration needs, limitations and practical product integration considerations.
  • Strong experience with quantitative and statistical data analysis for sensing algorithm development; Matlab coding is expected and Python experience is advantageous.
  • Good knowledge of analogue signal conditioning, digital signal processing, filtering, noise analysis and sensor data interpretation.
  • Experience defining test methods, collecting representative data, analysing performance and translating findings into algorithm or hardware improvements.
  • Experience working with suppliers or technology partners to evaluate sensing modules, define technical requirements, review performance data and influence future technology roadmaps.
  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting and system-level problem-solving skills, with the ability to make evidence-based technical recommendations.
  • Experience with hardware lab equipment, prototype bring-up, system validation, calibration approach and end-of-line test considerations.
  • Good understanding of product development, quality engineering processes, design reviews, validation planning and documentation discipline.

Desirable Skills and Behaviours

  • Confident communicator with the ability to explain complex technical topics clearly to engineering teams, suppliers and senior stakeholders.
  • Demonstrates technical leadership, curiosity, collaboration and a pragmatic approach to solving complex engineering problems.
  • Able to work independently, prioritise effectively and deliver high-quality outcomes within challenging project timelines.

title: Eligibility Technician Lead
description:
About Our Job

Eligibility Technician Lead

With competitive pay, great benefits, and endless opportunities, working for the City and County of Denver means seeing yourself working with purpose — for you, and those who benefit from your passion, skills and expertise. Join our diverse, inclusive and talented workforce of more than 11,000 team members who are at the heart of what makes Denver, Denver.

What We Offer

The City and County of Denver offers a competitive salary commensurate with education and experience. The salary range for this position is $25.30 - $31.63. We also offer generous benefits for full-time employees which include but are not limited to:

  • A guaranteed life-long monthly pension, once vested after 5 years of service
  • 457B Retirement Plan
  • 140 hours of PTO earned within first year + 11 paid holidays, 1 personal holiday and 1 volunteer day per year
  • Competitive medical, dental and vision plans effective within 1 month of start date

Location

The City and County of Denver supports a hybrid workplace model. Employees work where needed, at a job site several days a week and off-site as needed. In this position you can expect to work from the Richard T. Castro Human Services Center located at 1200 Federal Blvd. Denver CO 80204 three (3) days per week, and off site/work from home two (2) days per week. Based on business needs, the selected candidate may occasionally be required to report to the Taylor or East office for training, operational support, or team collaboration. Employees must work within the state of Colorado on their off-site days.

What You’ll Do

At Denver Human Services (DHS), we envision a healthy community where people are connected, supported, safe, and well. One in three people in Denver turn to DHS for support at all stages of life. Our employees help children, older adults, families, and individuals navigate social and economic pressures by connecting them to services and experts who support their overall well-being.

The Family and Adult Division (FAAD) of Denver Human Services is seeking out a flexible, adaptable, and detail-oriented individual to serve as an Application/EE Cells Lead. In this role, you will be tasked with working in the Application/EE Cells team and conduct various aspects of document management operations. This team within FAAD processes will process all incoming PEAK and Paper applications, redeterminations, changes and verifications in Denver County from clients who are applying for public assistance programs (Food Assistance, Financial, Medical Assistance, and TANF). Duties for this role; routinely assumes leadership responsibilities overseeing document management technicians, offering on-the-job training and technical support, supervising tasks & answering questions from staff, ensuring precise application initiation, assisting Supervisors with management tasks as needed, and pinpointing opportunities for process improvement to bolster the Application/EE Cells team.

Duties may also include application initiation in Colorado Benefits Management System (CBMS), tracking production on various excel and other Microsoft worksheets, occasional client contact via phone and determining program needs such as redetermination or new application processing and creating tasks for eligibility workers to determine eligibility.

Specifically, as an Eligibility Technician Lead you will:

Intercounty Transfer (ICT) Management

  • Ensure timely submission of PEAK/Paper InterCounty Transfers
  • Address incoming PEAK requests and incoming ICT related requests within a 24-hour timeframe.
  • Send clear-text emails containing PEAK tracking numbers to the relevant county, explaining the intent of document transmission.
  • Forward received PEAK ICTs to staff and respond to the county, indicating that the document is under processing.
  • Exchange encrypted and unencrypted emails with other counties concerning Inter-County transfer requests.

Quality Assurance (QA)

  • Conduct QA as frequently as possible to meet the annual goal.
  • Promptly address questions from staff and external collaborators.
  • Collaborate with the staff to enhance performance and address any errors or quality issues as necessary.

CBMS HD Tickets Management

  • Manage CBMS HD Tickets for the team.
  • Submit tickets on the same day an error occurs.
  • Maintain the HD Tickets log with up-to-date information on submitted and closed errors.

Daily Reporting

  • Ensure the timely completion and maintenance of all required daily reports and tracking logs, QA Log, in-office attendance tracking, and other operational logs used to monitor team performance and workload.

Administrative Tasks

  • Ensure the timely completion and maintenance of all required daily reports and tracking logs, QA Log, in-office attendance tracking, and other operational logs used to monitor team performance and workload.
  • Process documents based on work on hand for all document types when time permits.

Staff Training

  • Conduct training sessions for both new and current staff members on new processes or changes in existing processes.

Goals and Initiatives

  • Collaborate and support staff innovations

What You’ll Bring

We value diversity of ethnicity, race, socioeconomic status, sexual identity, gender, religion, language, ability, and experience and exemplify this through the makeup of our team at all levels. You'll be right at home here if you cultivate strong relationships and push yourself, your work, the people around you and Denver to the next level.

Our ideal candidate has some or all the following experience, skills, and characteristics:

Leadership Skills:

  • Ability to guide and motivate team members effectively.
  • Demonstrated capability to lead by example.

Communication Proficiency:

  • Strong verbal and written communication skills.
  • Ability to convey information clearly and concisely.

Team Collaboration:

  • Adept at fostering a collaborative and cohesive team environment.
  • Ability to work harmoniously with diverse team members.

Problem-Solving Aptitude:

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to make sound decisions under pressure.

Organizational Skills:

  • Exceptional organizational abilities to manage tasks efficiently.
  • Capability to prioritize and delegate responsibilities.

Adaptability:

  • Flexibility to adapt to changing priorities and circumstances.
  • Willingness to take on new challenges.

Technical Competence:

  • Proficiency in relevant tools, systems, and processes.
  • Capability to provide technical guidance to the team.

Mentorship and Training:

  • Experience in providing training and mentorship to team members.
  • Commitment to the professional development of the team.

Initiative and Proactivity:

  • Self-motivated with a proactive approach to problem-solving.
  • Willingness to take the initiative to improve processes.

Interpersonal Skills:

  • Strong interpersonal skills to build positive relationships with team members and other staff/management.
  • Ability to handle conflicts diplomatically.

Time Management:

  • Effective time management skills to meet deadlines and ensure team productivity.
  • Ability to balance multiple tasks simultaneously.

Accountability:

  • Demonstrated sense of responsibility and accountability for team outcomes.
  • Willingness to take ownership of tasks and projects.

Continuous Improvement:

  • Commitment to fostering a culture of continuous improvement.
  • Willingness to identify and implement enhancements to existing processes.

Knowledge Transfer:

  • Ability to share knowledge and expertise with team members.
  • Facilitation of learning and knowledge transfer within the team.

Customer Focus:

  • Understanding and commitment to meeting the needs of internal and external customers.
  • Focus on delivering high-quality services or products.

Required Minimum Qualifications

Education requirement: Graduation from high school or the possession of a GED, HiSET or TASC Certificate.

Experience Requirement: Three (3) years of experience determining eligibility for a variety of public assistance programs.

Education/Experience Equivalency: Additional appropriate education may be substituted for the minimum experience requirement.

License/Certifications: None

Application Deadline

This position is expected to stay open until September 7. Please submit your application as soon as possible and no later than September 7 at 11:59pm to ensure consideration.

title: Business Technology Consultant  /  ServiceNow Consultant
description:
Do you have deeper knowledge and experience in any of these domains: HR, CRM, AI, security, infrastructure, service management, or ServiceNow?

Bring your particular expertise, and help us build what comes next!

We are now looking for Business Technology Consultants / ServiceNow Consultants to strengthen our growing teams across Northern and Central Europe.

In this role, you will help customers and our teams build and improve ServiceNow-based solutions that support real business needs and stand the test of time, usage, and change. We do not require you to know ServiceNow necessarily yet, but we do want you to be passionate to learn about it.

What you will do

You will work as a trusted expert in customer engagements as part of a team that supports each other closely. Your work may include modernising existing platform environments, building new business-driven solutions, reducing technical debt, supporting integrations enabling AI and automation or developing governance and operating models.

Our work is not limited to ITSM. It often involves customer service, HR, finance, risk management, supplier management, integrations, or other business workflows.

What we are looking for

There is more than one way to join us. ServiceNow experience is always an advantage, but it is not the only way in. If one of the profiles below sounds like you, we want to hear from you.

You might be one of us if…

· ITOM & Infrastructure — You know ServiceNow ITOM, or you have a strong technical background in infrastructure, data centers, hardware and service management. You understand how technology environments fit together and are interested in taking that expertise further on the ServiceNow platform.

· HR & Employee Workflows — You may already be a ServiceNow HR expert, or you bring strong HR domain experience and get genuinely excited about technology and better employee workflows. You are curious and ready to learn the ServiceNow platform.

· AI & Automation — For you, AI is more than ChatGPT or Claude. You understand how AI capabilities can become part of automated and agentic workflows that solve real business problems, and how those workflows can genuinely modernise the way people work.

· CRM — You live and breathe CRM. Your background might be in Salesforce, Microsoft Dynamics or another leading CRM platform. You understand sales, customer service and customer-facing processes, and you are excited to learn what ServiceNow CRM can bring to the table.

· Security & IRM — You may already work with security, risk or compliance, or you bring strong experience from governance, controls, assurance or related domains. You understand the importance of secure, well-governed and resilient ways of working, and you are interested in how ServiceNow can support that better.

ServiceNow certifications are a plus, but not a requirement for every profile. What matters most is relevant expertise, curiosity, the ability to think in systems, and a willingness to learn and make good choices together with customers and colleagues.

How you work

We value people who are willing to challenge ideas constructively, both customer assumptions and our own. The best solution is not always the one the customer asks for first.

You will do well in this role if you naturally ask “why” before deciding “how”. You want to understand the real problem, and you are able to make alternatives, risks, and trade-offs visible.

Why Sofigate?

Sofigate has been helping build the ServiceNow market in Northern Europe from the start. We are a ServiceNow Elite partner and have delivered more than 1,000 ServiceNow projects, with deep expertise sitting within our teams.

You will join a team with deep ServiceNow expertise and people who genuinely help each other. You will work on demanding and meaningful customer engagements, grow as a specialist, use AI and automation in practice, and help shape what ServiceNow can do next.

And while we take our customers and our work seriously, we do not think work needs to be serious all the time. Great colleagues, laughter, events, shared experiences and simply having fun together are part of working at Sofigate too - in suitable doses, of course.

How we work

At Sofigate, we are involved in cutting-edge projects that are shaping the future. We have an international, vibrant, and fun culture with great openness and flexibility. We value every Sofigator and strive to build a diverse, equal, and inclusive workplace, where everyone’s voice is heard, and where everyone can become the best versions of themselves. We value a healthy work-life balance and support you in maintaining it.

Growth is not just a corporate thing for us, it is personal. There is so much to explore and learn within our community, and together with our customers, that having a bit of fun is unavoidable.

Why join us

  • Challenging customer assignment opportunities, environment varying from large internationally operating companies to purposeful public organizations.

  • Opportunities for professional growth and development.

  • Full 2.5 days/month of vacation accrual starting from the beginning of your employment

  • Shareholder program, which allows you to be a part owner in Sofigate

  • Extended healthcare insurance and a wellness program that is available for all employees

Interested?

Tell us what you are great at, what you have built, improved or transformed, and what you would like to learn next. If you recognized yourself in one of the profiles above, send us your CV by 20.9.2026. We would like to hear from you even if ServiceNow is not yet the biggest part of your CV.

You can be based in Helsinki, Tampere, or Oulu. We work in a hybrid model, giving you the flexibility to choose where you work best.

For additional information, you can reach out to Business Executive, Enterprise Solutions Joakim Kockberg on Wednesday 9th September, 14:00–15:00 (EEST) or Tuesday 15th September, 13:00-14:00, Tel +358 40 194 9417.

Support data governance practices across domains and teams.
