title: Revenue Analyst
description:
About us

At Trainline, our purpose is to empower greener travel choices, connecting people and places. Trainline enables millions of travellers to find and book the best value tickets across carriers, fares, and journey options through our highly rated mobile app, website, and B2B partner channels.

Great journeys start with Trainline 🚄

We’re Europe’s leading independent rail platform, helping millions of travellers find and book the best-value rail and coach journeys across our app, website and partner channels.

Our job is to make the green travel choice the best choice. By building a better train travel experience, we help more people choose rail - creating a positive impact for customers, our business and the planet.

We’re a team of more than 1,000 Trainliners from over 50 nationalities, working across London, Paris, Barcelona, Milan, Edinburgh and Madrid. Now is a brilliant time to join us and help shape the future of travel.

Introducing the Trainline Finance Team 👋

At Trainline, our Finance team sits at the heart of the business, partnering across Commercial, Data, and Operations to ensure our revenue is recognised accurately, our billing processes run smoothly, and our financial insight supports confident decision-making. We're a collaborative, detail-driven team that values curiosity, rigour, and a genuine appetite for doing things better.

This Revenue Analyst role plays a central part in how we manage billing across Trainline's diverse and growing revenue streams, including advertising and partnerships. You'll act as a key connector across Commercial, Billing, and Finance, bringing clarity and structure to complex processes. As we invest in scalable, automated solutions, this is a role with real scope to shape how we operate and leave a lasting mark on our financial foundations.

In this role as the Revenue Analyst, you will...🚄

  • Manage and coordinate the end-to-end billing workflow across all non-rail revenue streams, acting as the primary interface between Commercial and Billing teams to ensure accurate processing from initial setup through to reconciliation and monthly billing

  • Maintain billing registers and supporting documentation across advertising, partnerships, and other revenue streams, and prepare monthly accruals and billing summary data for Management Accounts

  • Extract, validate, and analyse advertising impression data from Google Ad Manager and other platforms, performing monthly reconciliations between campaign delivery, insertion orders, and invoiced amounts

  • Collaborate with Ad Operations to track campaign progress, monitor the advertising pipeline, and ensure accurate billing of bespoke and international trading activity including kickbacks and commissions

  • Review commercial contracts for billing requirements, communicate relevant terms to the billing team, and support debt recovery and the resolution of client billing queries

  • Coordinate and facilitate billing reconciliations across revenue streams, liaising between teams to resolve discrepancies and maintain financial accuracy

  • Standardise billing inputs, pipeline visibility, and workflows across Commercial teams, identifying and driving operational efficiencies across Finance and Commercial Finance functions

  • Partner with the Billing, Credit and Accounts Receivable Manager and Finance Transformation team to develop and implement scalable, automated billing solutions that replace manual and fragmented processes

We'd love to hear from you if you have...🔍

  • A solid background in revenue operations, billing, finance operations, or a closely related field, with a strong track record of accuracy and ownership across financial processes

  • Excellent cross-functional communication and stakeholder management skills, with the confidence to work effectively across Commercial, Finance, and operational teams

  • Intermediate to strong Excel skills, including lookups, pivot tables, reconciliations, and data analysis

  • A sharp eye for detail and strong organisational skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities independently in a fast-paced environment

  • A curious, improvement-focused mindset and a proactive approach to problem-solving and process optimisation

  • Ideally, experience with Google Ad Manager or similar ad revenue platforms, and familiarity with Salesforce or a comparable CRM tool

  • It would be helpful if you have experience supporting billing automation, Finance Ops, or revenue transformation projects

  • Ideally, some familiarity with AI tools such as ChatGPT or Claude, and a genuine interest in using them to improve efficiency and data workflows

More information:

Enjoy fantastic perks like private healthcare & dental insurance, a generous work from abroad policy, 2-for-1 share purchase plans, an EV Scheme to further reduce carbon emissions, extra festive time off, and excellent family-friendly benefits.

We prioritise career growth with clear career paths, transparent pay bands, personal learning budgets, and regular learning days. Jump on board and supercharge your career from day one!

We're operating a hybrid model and ask that Trainliners work from the office a minimum of 60% of their time over a 12-week period. We also have a 28-day Work from Abroad policy.

Our values represent the things that matter most to us and what we live and breathe everyday, in everything we do:

  • 💭 Think Big - We're building the future of rail

  • ✔️ Own It - We focus on every customer, partner and journey

  • 🤝 Travel Together - We're one team

  • ♻️ Do Good - We make a positive impact

We know that having a diverse team makes us better and helps us succeed. And we mean all forms of diversity - gender, ethnicity, sexuality, disability, nationality and diversity of thought. That's why we're committed to creating inclusive places to work, where everyone belongs and differences are valued and celebrated.

Interested in finding out more about what it's like to work at Trainline? Why not check us out on LinkedIn, Instagram and Glassdoor!

title: Site HR Superintendent
description:
Site HR Superintendent

About the company:

The mining industry has steadily become worse at finding new ore deposits, requiring >10X more capital to make discoveries compared to 30 years ago. The easy-to-find, near-surface deposits have largely been found, and the industry has chronically under-invested in new exploration technology, relying on the manual techniques of yesteryear – even as demand accelerates for copper, lithium, and other metals to build electric vehicles, renewable energy, and data centers.

KoBold builds AI models for mineral exploration and deploys those models—alongside our novel sensors—to guide decisions on KoBold-owned-and-operated exploration programs. In the six years since founding, KoBold has become by far both the largest independent mineral exploration company and the largest exploration technology developer. Our data scientists and software engineers, who come from leading technology companies, jointly lead exploration programs with our renowned exploration geologists.

KoBold has proven its first discovery with materially less capital than the industry average and found one of the best copper deposits ever discovered: the copper is far more concentrated than the global average of copper mines, and this asset alone is expected to generate meaningful revenue for decades. KoBold has a portfolio of more than 60 other projects, each of which has the potential for another high-quality discovery.

KoBold is privately held; investors include institutional asset managers T. Rowe Price and Canada Pension Plan Investments; technology venture capitalists Andreessen Horowitz, Breakthrough Energy Ventures, BOND Capital, and Standard Investments; and natural resources companies Equinor, BHP, and Mitsubishi.

About The Role:

We are seeking a Site HR Superintendent to provide hands-on people support at our Mingomba Project in Chililabombwe. The successful candidate will bring proven experience in shaping and implementing the organization’s Reward, Payroll, Performance Management, Talent Management, Employee Engagement, and Wellbeing strategies. The strategy and execution must thoughtfully account for KoBold’s ethos, the diverse cultural backgrounds of our team and responsibilities of the people who work at KoBold.

To be successful, you must first establish a deep understanding of the science and business along with how we work together. There are no shortcuts to learning KoBold. To be effective in this role, you must be genuinely curious and eager to learn about the wide range of activities, disciplines, and pursuits that drive our work. The ideal candidate is highly engaged, relationship-oriented, and motivated to understand what enables both our people and our business to thrive.

Responsibilities:

  • Serve as the first point of contact for all employee relations and people-related matters at the site.
  • Support payroll administration and ensure accurate and timely statutory remittances.
  • Coordinate performance management processes with line managers and provide guidance and support to employees on performance-related matters.
  • Support Workday administration and adoption, including compliance, time and attendance, data management, and user support.
  • Maintain accurate employee records and promote disciplined, efficient use of HR systems and processes.
  • Identify training and development needs and coordinate learning initiatives at the site.
  • Foster and maintain a positive industrial relations environment, managing disciplinary, grievance, and dispute resolution processes in accordance with Zambian labour legislation.
  • Contribute to the design, implementation, and continuous improvement of core People programs, including compensation, performance management, onboarding, and employee development.
  • Support organizational change initiatives through effective communication, stakeholder engagement, and transition planning.
  • Identify opportunities to streamline and automate HR processes, reducing manual administrative work and improving efficiency.
  • Analyze HR data and metrics to generate actionable insights and support informed decision-making.
  • Drive initiatives that enhance employee experience, engagement, and learning culture.
  • Partner with site leaders to proactively address people and management challenges and implement effective solutions.
  • Ensure HR practices remain compliant with company policies, legal requirements, and industry best practices.

Qualifications:

  • 7+ years in HR Operations, preferably in mining, exploration and other science-based environments.
  • Member of the Zambia Institute of Human Resource Management (ZIHRM).
  • Strong knowledge of Zambian labour laws.
  • First-principles thinker who can reference best practices without defaulting to them.
  • Intellectual curiosity and eagerness to learn about all aspects of mineral exploration, particularly in the geology domain.
  • Excitement about joining a fast-growing early-stage company, comfort with a dynamic work environment, and eagerness to take on an evolving range of responsibilities
  • Nice to have: Hands-on Workday experience

KoBold Metals is an equal opportunity workplace and an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunities for people of any race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, marital status, national origin, age, citizenship, disability, or veteran status.

This position is a full-time contract.

At this time, we are only accepting applications from Zambian nationals.

Job Description:

Summary:

The Part-Time Project Coordinator (PC) will provide day-to-day operational and administrative support for a portfolio of externally funded projects. Working under the direction of the IIE Director, the PC supports effective management of each project by scheduling and documenting meetings, tracking coach participation and payment, maintaining project files and records, ordering resources for project participants, supporting communications, supporting event planning, including an annual conference, and assisting with the recruitment and enrollment of in-service-teachers for the graduate certificate program in Reading and Language Development. This position is well suited to someone early in a career in education, research administration, nonprofit operations, or program management. The PC will gain direct exposure to grant-funded research-practice partnerships in an active university research center.

Essential Functions:

1.) Meeting and Project Coordination

  • Schedule recurring and ad hoc meetings across internal teams, university partners, and external collaborators; manage calendar invitations, room reservations, and virtual meeting logistics.

  • Draft and circulate meeting agendas in advance; assemble supporting materials.

  • Take accurate notes during meetings, capture action items and owners, and distribute summaries promptly

  • Track follow-up tasks and deadlines and flag items to their supervisor.

  • Maintain shared project calendars, timelines, and task trackers.

2.) Coach Tracking and Payment Support

  • Monitor a coaching log completed by cohort of approximately 19 coaches; review submissions for completeness, accuracy, and timeliness.

  • Follow up with coaches on missing, late, or inconsistent entries in a professional and service-oriented manner.

  • Reconcile logged hours against project records and prepare summaries for supervisor review.

  • Coordinate with [department administrator / payroll / accounts payable] to ensure coach payments are submitted, processed, and issued on schedule; track payment status and resolve discrepancies.

  • Maintain accurate, audit-ready documentation of coach participation and payment history.

3.) Event Planning Support

  • Provide logistical support for project events including the annual Heritage Language Community Schools conference, convenings, workshops, coach trainings, information sessions, and partner meetings.

  • Assist with venue and room reservations, room setup, audiovisual and technology needs, parking, and accessibility accommodations.

  • Coordinate catering orders within university guidelines and applicable grant allowability rules; track headcounts, dietary restrictions, and delivery timing.

  • Manage event registration, including monitoring registration forms, maintaining attendee lists, and sending confirmations and reminders.

  • Prepare and assemble event materials such as agendas, name badges, sign-in sheets, folders, and printed handouts.

  • Communicate logistics to speakers, facilitators, and guests; assist with travel and honorarium paperwork in coordination with [department administrator].

  • Provide day-of support, including setup, check-in, and breakdown; serve as an on-site point of contact for routine questions.

  • Collect and compile post-event feedback and attendance records and maintain event documentation for project reporting.

4.) Communications and Social Media

  • Draft social media posts and short promotional content for project and center accounts, consistent with university brand and communications guidelines about IIE programs.

  • Maintain a basic content calendar and gather photos, quotes, and updates from project activities.

  • Assist with newsletters, flyers, one-pagers, and website updates as needed.

5.) Research Data, Records, and File Management

  • Support graduate students with research data collection and secure file storage.

  • Organize and maintain project files in [SharePoint / Google Drive / DropBox], applying consistent naming conventions, folder structures, and version control.

  • Maintain rosters, contact lists, and participant records with attention to accuracy and confidentiality.

  • Support routine data entry and help prepare documentation needed for project reporting.

6.) Procurement and Resource Support

  • Order project supplies, materials, and resources through university purchasing systems; track orders through delivery.

  • Maintain inventory of project materials and coordinate distribution to project sites and participants.

  • Submit receipts, invoices, and documentation to the appropriate administrative staff. (This position does not carry independent budget authority).

title: Content Producer
description:
About Eucalyptus

We're on a mission to make good health last a lifetime. More than 1 billion people live with obesity worldwide, driving preventable chronic conditions. We're here to build better long-term care.

Eucalyptus is now part of Hims & Hers, the global leader in personalised health and wellness.

Euc is the company behind Juniper, one of the world's largest weight-management programs combining GLP-1 medication with personalised nutrition, movement support, and clinician-led care from prescribers, nurses, health coaches, pharmacists, and dietitians. Our published clinical research shows that our combined clinical and behavioural approach helps patients lose significantly more weight during their treatment with Juniper by four times.

Our Growth Story:

  • Supporting patients living with obesity across our 5 markets
  • Received selective NICE endorsement to provide services to the NHS
  • Tailored our offering to thousands of patients in Australia, the UK, Germany, Japan and Canada.

The role

We're looking for a Creative Producer with a strong Art Director streak. You own the make end-to-end — concept, look, shoot, edit — but the emphasis here is on craft and visual direction: you're the person who decides how the work looks and feels, sets the bar, and makes sure every asset that leaves the studio is something we're proud to put spend behind.
You'll concept and art-direct performance creative that beats the agency benchmark, then produce it — running the shoot, directing talent and the bench, and steering the edit. Your masters become the "gold standard" the rest of the pipeline expands into hundreds of variations, so the quality of your output sets the ceiling for everything.
This is a hands-on, high-output role for a swiss-army-knife operator: equal parts taste, ideas and get-it-done.
What you'll do
  • Own the visual craft and direction of Weight Loss creative — art-direct the look, feel, and quality bar across video and static.
  • Concept performance-led ideas rooted in what actually works — hooks, angles, formats — not just what looks nice.
  • Produce end-to-end: plan and run shoots, direct talent and our on-camera bench, and steer edits to a finished standard.
  • Set the "gold standard" masters that the Manila team and AI iterate and expand from — and keep raising that bar.
  • Partner with strategists (who own the why and what) and our designers/editors to turn ideas into finished, on-brand assets fast.
  • Work at pace and volume without letting craft slip — you're comfortable shipping a lot and keeping it sharp.
  • Help shape the studio's visual identity and creative standards as we scale.

What you'll bring

  • A strong portfolio of performance and/or brand creative — with a clear eye for art direction, composition, type and visual craft.
  • Real production experience: you can plan and run a shoot, direct talent, and take something from idea to finished asset yourself.
  • Hands-on editing/design ability — enough to set the standard, jump in, and unblock others (Premiere/After Effects, Figma/Adobe CS or similar).
  • A performance instinct: you understand social-native, direct-response creative and what makes an ad actually convert, not just look good.
  • A bias for output and iteration — you ship, learn and ship again, without being precious.
  • Comfortable directing people (talent, crew, the bench) and collaborating closely with strategists and editors.

Why join Eucalyptus?

Euc is also behind a growing family of digital healthcare clinics (Pilot, Kin, Software) across men’s health and well-being, fertility, and skincare.

Here’s what makes joining Euc unique:

  • What’s next - Our goal for the next three years is to support 1 million patients globally to live better for longer. We’re launching into new conditions, demographics, and geographies as we build a truly preventive healthcare ecosystem.
  • Build something world-changing - We’re on the path to becoming the world’s largest international digital healthcare company. It will be challenging, fast-paced, and deeply rewarding.
  • Make real impact - You will deliver work that directly shapes patient outcomes and scales evidence-based care across markets.

title: Senior Backend Engineer (TypeScript / Web3)
description:
Senior Backend Engineer (TypeScript / Web3) at Undisclosed

Job Posted on Aug 6, 2026

About the Company

A well-funded, English-operating Web3 company building consumer-facing blockchain products and the infrastructure behind them. The team is distributed across several international offices and works to a high engineering standard, with significant institutional backing behind the business.

The Role

We’re hiring a Senior Backend Engineer to take end-to-end ownership of the backend systems behind our consumer products.

This is a hands-on senior position for someone comfortable owning complex systems in full: designing services and APIs, building data pipelines, running databases, wiring up blockchain infrastructure, and keeping production healthy under real traffic.

The work shifts with what the product needs. One month might be user-facing API work; the next could be designing an on-chain indexer, tuning database performance, hardening reliability, or standing up a new service from scratch. We’re looking for someone who finds that variety energising rather than unsettling.

What matters most is that you’ve done this before at scale. We want engineers who have built and operated systems serving real users in volume, and who know first-hand what high traffic, large datasets, and production incidents actually feel like.

You’ll be trusted with live systems within your first few weeks. This role assumes existing hands-on Web3 backend experience. It isn’t a position where you’ll pick up the blockchain side as you go.

Because our products sit close to wallets and on-chain finance, we place real weight on engineers who understand how decentralised applications behave in practice, not just protocol mechanics but how users actually interact with wallets, DeFi protocols, and on-chain financial systems.

You’ll work alongside product, infrastructure, and protocol teams to deliver systems that feel seamless to users across both conventional and blockchain-based applications.

What You’ll Do

  • Own backend architecture and implementation across multiple products.
  • Design, build, and maintain production APIs and services powering customer-facing applications.
  • Build and run distributed systems that stay reliable at high volume.
  • Architect for scalability, fault tolerance, and long-term maintainability.
  • Build data pipelines, background workers, async processing, and event-driven systems.
  • Build and maintain blockchain integrations and indexing systems that ingest, process, and serve on-chain data.
  • Design database schemas, optimise complex queries, and plan for data growth.
  • Bridge Web2 and Web3 infrastructure, connecting conventional backends to blockchain protocols.
  • Debug production issues, performance bottlenecks, and scaling problems.
  • Build strong observability, monitoring, alerting, and operational tooling.
  • Improve architecture, deployment pipelines, and engineering practice over time.
  • Move fast, decide independently, and ship production-ready work.

Requirements

Core Backend Engineering

  • Substantial experience building and running production backend systems.
  • Strong TypeScript skills and fluency with modern backend frameworks (NestJS, Fastify, Express, or comparable).
  • Solid grounding in API design, service-oriented architecture, and distributed systems.
  • Able to design and deliver complex systems with minimal supervision.

Scale

  • A track record of building and operating backends serving large user bases in production.
  • Experience designing for high traffic and heavy workloads.
  • Strong grasp of performance tuning, concurrency, fault tolerance, and reliability.
  • Experience where uptime and consistency directly affect end users.
  • An operational mindset. You’ve handled incidents and scaling problems on live systems.

Data & Infrastructure

  • Deep PostgreSQL expertise: schema design, indexing, query optimisation, migrations, production operations.
  • Experience processing large volumes of structured or event-driven data.
  • Strong understanding of observability, logging, and service health.

Web2 + Web3

  • Experience building backends for modern consumer applications.
  • Experience integrating blockchain infrastructure, node APIs, smart contracts, or decentralised protocols.
  • Hands-on work with blockchain indexing, event processing pipelines, or other on-chain data infrastructure (The Graph, Subsquid, or custom indexers).
  • Good working knowledge of wallet architecture, transaction lifecycle, signing flows, and on-chain data models.
  • Experience building or integrating backends that talk to DeFi protocols.

Nice to Have

  • Backend experience in Go.
  • Kafka, NATS, RabbitMQ, or similar messaging systems.
  • Docker and modern CI/CD.
  • Open-source contributions to backend, infrastructure, or blockchain tooling.
  • Genuine familiarity with the DeFi ecosystem: DEXs, lending protocols, staking, bridges, or similar.

What We Value

Specific technologies matter less to us than engineers who can:

  • Own hard technical problems from design through to production.
  • Move between parts of the stack as the product demands.
  • Build systems that hold up under scale and pressure.
  • Make pragmatic calls in a fast-moving environment.
  • Get productive in an existing codebase quickly and ship within weeks.
  • Pick up unfamiliar technology fast.

Why Join

  • Build core infrastructure for products with real users.
  • Work on genuinely hard problems across backend engineering, distributed systems, and Web3 infrastructure.
  • Join a highly technical team where engineers have real ownership and visible product impact.
  • Work with strong engineers on ambitious infrastructure.
  • Competitive compensation, ownership opportunities, and a direct hand in shaping the product.

New York, USA; Full Time; USD 180k-250k / year + Equity

title: Senior CPU HW Performance Architect
description:
About Huawei Research and Development UK Limited

Founded in 1987, Huawei is a leading global provider of information and communications technology (ICT) infrastructure and smart devices. We have 207,000 employees and operate in over 170 countries and regions, serving more than three billion people around the world.

Our vision and mission is to bring digital to every person, home and organization for a fully connected, intelligent world. To this end, we will drive ubiquitous connectivity and promote equal access to networks; bring cloud and artificial intelligence to all four corners of the earth to provide superior computing power where you need it, when you need it; build digital platforms to help all industries and organizations become more agile, efficient, and dynamic; redefine user experience with AI, making it more personalized for people in all aspects of their life, whether they’re at home, in the office, or on the go.

This spirit of innovation has led Huawei to work in close partnership with leading academic institutions in the UK to develop and refine the latest technologies. With a shared commitment to innovation and progress, both parties have worked together to achieve common goals and establish a strong partnership. The partnership between UK and Huawei help to develop the technologies of the future that will transform the way we all communicate, work and live.

For the past 30 years we have maintained an unwavering focus, rejecting shortcuts and easy opportunities that don't align with our core business. With a practical approach to everything we do, we concentrate our efforts and invest patiently to drive technological breakthroughs.

This strategic focus is a reflection of our core values:

  • Staying customer-centric,

  • Inspiring dedication,

  • Persevering,

  • Growing by reflection.

Huawei Research and Development UK Limited Overview

Huawei’s vision is a fully connected, intelligent world. To achieve this, we work to inspire passion for basic research around the world. Our combined passion drives development across the global innovation value chain. Huawei has the largest Research and Development organization in the world with 96,000+ employees in research centers around the globe. In the UK, we already have design centers in Cambridge, London, Edinburgh and Ipswich. We continue to explore and define new research directions and new services. We have expanded our collaborations with academic researchers; researched new network architectures, integration of communications and key enabling technologies; and developed the fundamental theories of these technologies. We invite you to join us on this exciting journey and drive your career forward.

Key Responsibilities:

Drive next-generation high-performance CPU core development as a key member of the CPU Performance team. You will lead performance modeling, workload analysis, and microarchitectural exploration to guide critical design trade-offs across performance, power, and area (PPA).

· Microarchitecture Definition: Define next-generation CPU microarchitecture and high-level specifications in close partnership with cross-functional hardware and software teams.

· Performance Modeling & Simulation: Build and refine cycle-accurate and functional simulators to evaluate emerging microarchitectural concepts.

· Architecture Exploration & Trade-offs: Propose novel microarchitectural features and quantify PPA impacts to drive balanced design decisions.

· Workload & Sensitivity Analysis: Profile target workloads, analyze bottlenecks, and identify architectural sensitivities to steer core optimization.

This job description is only an outline of the tasks, responsibilities and outcomes required of the role. The jobholder will carry out any other duties as may be reasonably required by his/her line manager. The job description and personal specification may be reviewed on an ongoing basis in accordance with the changing needs of Huawei Research and Development UK Limited.

Required:

· BS/MS in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or related field with 5+ years of relevant experience, or a PhD.

· Deep knowledge of CPU microarchitecture, focusing on areas such as fetch/decode, branch prediction, rename/dispatch, out-of-order execution, execution units, load/store, prefetching, or memory hierarchies.

· Solid understanding of performance, power, and area (PPA) trade-offs within high-performance CPU microarchitectures.

· Proficiency in advanced software engineering practices, performance profiling methodologies, and multi-language development (e.g., modern C++, Python).

title: Deployment Engineer

About Menlo
Menlo Research is an Applied R&D lab building Asimov, an open-source humanoid robot platform, and the full software stack that powers it. Our mission is to make humanoid labor economically viable, turning software into physical labor at scale. We build across the full stack: hardware architecture, locomotion, autonomy, simulation, and infrastructure. We move fast, ship to real robots, and open-source everything we can. If you want your work to matter beyond a paper or a demo, this is the place.

The Role
The hard problem in robotics is not building a compelling prototype. It is making robotic systems deployable, repeatable, and economically useful in the real world. You will work directly on real customer problems, but you will not stop at integration or customization. You will use deployment pressure to uncover missing capabilities, design evaluations, collect data, adapt models, and turn one-off field learnings into reusable product and research improvements.
This is not a support role. It is not solutions engineering. It is a deployment-native R&D role for people who want to stay close to reality and build the abstractions that make the next deployment easier.

What You'll Do

  • Own real customer and deployment problems end to end, from understanding the workflow to diagnosing failures in the field

  • Work directly with robotic systems in commercial and industrial environments where variability, ambiguity, and operational constraints are the norm

  • Translate deployment friction into research and product questions: what capability is missing, what data is needed, what evaluation should exist, what part of the stack must improve

  • Build and adapt systems across the deployment loop, including data collection, task-specific fine-tuning, and evaluation design

  • Collaborate closely with core research and platform teams so field learnings become reusable capabilities instead of one-off fixes

  • Contribute domain expertise to a broader forward deployment practice where knowledge is shared across deployments and specializations

  • Help define the operating model for how humanoid systems are deployed, improved, and scaled


What We're Looking For

  • Experience collecting, cleaning, or curating deployment data for model improvement

  • Experience designing evaluations or benchmarks for systems that interact with real-world environments

  • Able to explain complex technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences

  • Energized by ambiguity, motivated by ownership, and wants to see work survive contact with the real world


Nice to Have

  • Evidence of building trust with users while maintaining a strong technical point of view

  • Prior experience in a forward deployed or customer-facing technical role at a fast-moving company

title: Relationships Specialist
description:
Do you love building strong relationships and delivering a genuinely personal service? We’re looking for a Relationship Specialist to support our prestigious James Collection Studio in Dartmouth, becoming a trusted partner to our holiday homeowners and helping their properties perform at their very best.

Your mission

As our Relationship Specialist, your mission is to build trusted, long-term relationships with a portfolio of property owners, delivering the highly personalised, relationship-led service they expect.

With a visible local presence in Dartmouth, you’ll combine exceptional service with commercial insight to strengthen owner loyalty, protect the reputation of the James Collection and support the continued growth of the Awaze portfolio.

What you'll be doing

  • Build strong, trusted relationships with property owners, tailoring your communication and support to their individual needs.

  • Provide premium customer service to our guests and owners

  • Develop an in-depth understanding of each property and regularly visit homes to identify opportunities to enhance presentation, guest appeal and commercial performance.

  • Use market insight, pricing data and your local knowledge to make proactive recommendations that help owners get the best from their properties.

  • Protect and champion the prestige of the James Collection through every owner interaction.

  • Maintain accurate CRM records and prioritise activity, manage follow-ups and support effective portfolio management.

  • Identify opportunities for referrals, testimonials and advocacy, helping strengthen the James Collection brand and local reputation.

  • Support portfolio growth by identifying prospective owners and working closely with Business Development to create a seamless, premium experience.

  • Act as the voice of our owners within the business, sharing feedback and insights that help improve our services.

Who we’re looking for

You’ll thrive in this role if you’re naturally relationship-focused and take pride in delivering an exceptional level of service. You’ll be comfortable getting to know owners and guests, spotting opportunities and turning insight into practical recommendations.

We’re looking for someone who brings:

  • Experience delivering exceptional customer, owner or client service in a premium environment.

  • Excellent relationship-building, communication and stakeholder management skills.

  • Excellent organisation and attention to detail, with the ability to prioritise effectively.

  • A professional and solutions-focused approach, with the confidence to handle sensitive or complex queries with care.

  • A collaborative mindset and the ability to work effectively across operational, commercial and service teams.

  • Knowledge of the Dartmouth or wider Devon holiday letting market would be an advantage.

How you'll make an impact

  • Help improve revenue, occupancy and commercial performance through proactive recommendations and effective follow-up.

  • Help grow the James Collection portfolio through local relationships, referrals and prospective owner introductions.

  • Consistently deliver premium service standards across owner communications, property visits and issue resolution.

  • Become a trusted adviser to owners, adding measurable commercial value while developing lasting relationships.

  • Use accurate CRM data and owner insights to focus activity where it will have the greatest impact.

  • Generate positive owner feedback, testimonials and referrals where appropriate.

  • Work collaboratively across Awaze to deliver outstanding outcomes for our owners and guests.

Why you’ll want to work at Awaze

We offer a versatile position in a strong professional and social environment - one you’ll have the opportunity to influence and help shape. You’ll be part of an international company that invests in the future, and join a dynamic, fast-paced department with skilled and committed colleagues who support each other.

We’re a people-first business - and we know that our success starts with our teams. Here’s a glimpse of what you’ll enjoy:

  • Generous discounts on holidays across our brands

  • Real opportunities to grow, learn and shape your role as well as careers progression vertically or horizontally, cross countries and responsibilities.

About Awaze
Our mission is clear - to create amazing holidays with Europe’s widest choice of holiday homes.

With more than 110,000 properties across Europe, we are the largest managed vacation rentals business in the region. Our ambition is not only to be the biggest, but the best provider of holiday homes in Europe.

As travel continues to evolve, we are focused on what comes next. We will keep strengthening our relationships with guests and homeowners, continuously improving the way we work, and delivering strong performance. By making things simpler and smarter, we are building a business that is ready for what’s next - powered by proud, passionate and inclusive people.

Worth knowing

This role is full-time, permanent, and based fully in our brand new Dartmouth studio. We are open Monday-Saturday, so flexibility to work weekends is essential for this role. We also require the successful candidate to have a full, clean driving license.

What’s next?

If this sounds like the right next step for you, hit “Apply” and follow the instructions to submit your application. We tailor our recruitment process to each role to give both you and our hiring teams the best possible chance to assess whether this could be the start of a successful collaboration. You’ll hear from us shortly after we’ve reviewed your application.

We’re committed to running an inclusive and accessible recruitment process. All applicants will receive equal consideration for employment, and if you have any specific requirements or adjustments needed for the interview, just let us know when you accept your invitation - we’re happy to accommodate.

title: Cyber Data Engineer, Associate
company: MORGAN STANLEY MANAGEMENT SERVICE (SINGAPORE) PTE. LTD.
description:
Our globally distributed cyber data engineering squad is responsible for designing, engineering, and maintaining large-scale security analytics platforms using Splunk, Elasticsearch, and associated data pipeline technologies. These platforms underpin critical cyber capabilities across security response, threat hunting, investigations, insider threat, and wider technology risk functions.

We are seeking a Cyber Data Engineer to strengthen APAC cyber engineering coverage from Singapore, with a focus on hands‑on platform engineering, automation, data onboarding, troubleshooting, and operational resilience. The successful candidate will work on complex cyber data platforms that ingest, transform, store, and expose security event data for detection, investigation, and response use cases.

Role Profile:

  • > Engineering and maintaining large-scale cyber analytics platforms, including Splunk, Elasticsearch, and associated data ingestion and storage components.
  • > Onboarding new cyber data sources, validating event quality, developing field extractions, and ensuring data is usable for detection, investigation, and response teams.
  • > Designing, building, and supporting data pipelines that collect, transform, route, and transmit cyber event data from cloud and on-premises sources.
  • > Developing automation tools that integrate with internal APIs, configuration management frameworks, CI/CD pipelines, and infrastructure services.
  • > Improving platform reliability, scalability, monitoring, alerting, recovery, and operational resilience across APAC and global cyber engineering environments.
  • > Investigating and resolving complex technical issues across application, infrastructure, network, operating system, data, and integration layers.
  • > Acting as an escalation point for difficult platform, ingestion, search, performance, and data availability issues.
  • > Identifying and implementing tuning opportunities to improve platform performance, reduce operational toil, and increase engineering efficiency.
  • > Partnering with cyber stakeholders across threat hunting, detection engineering, incident response, investigations, insider threat, and technology risk to deliver fit‑for‑purpose engineering solutions.

Candidate Profile:

The ideal candidate is a hands‑on cyber engineer who enjoys solving complex technical problems across data, platforms, infrastructure, and automation. They should be comfortable working across coding, troubleshooting, and stakeholder engagement.

The candidate should be able to operate independently, learn quickly, and maintain reliable cyber platforms at scale in a fast‑moving environment.

Required Skills:

  • > Experience engineering, deploying, supporting, or operating large-scale security analytics platforms such as Elasticsearch or Splunk.
  • > Strong understanding of cyber event data, including log ingestion, parsing, field extraction, normalization, enrichment, routing, and data quality validation.
  • > Experience with data pipeline or dataflow technologies such as Logstash, Cribl, Kafka, Apache NiFi, syslog, or equivalent enterprise data transport tooling.
  • > Strong automation and integration experience, ideally using Python and tools such as Ansible, Terraform, or similar technologies.
  • > Experience integrating cyber platforms with cloud and on-premises environments (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud).
  • > Solid understanding of Linux/Unix, networking, HTTP, TLS, DNS, load balancing, authentication.
  • > Good understanding of DevOps practices (Git, Jenkins, Jira, CI/CD).
  • > Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills.
  • > Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

Desired Skills:

  • > Certifications in Splunk, Elasticsearch, or cloud platforms.
  • > Experience supporting detection engineering, threat hunting, or incident response.
  • > Experience with field extraction and parsing using regex.
  • > Familiarity with security telemetry and detection frameworks.
  • > Experience improving observability, resilience, and performance tuning.

title: Sr. Software Developer
description:
OPENTEXT - THE INFORMATION COMPANY

OpenText is a global leader in information management, where innovation, creativity, and collaboration are the key components of our corporate culture. As a member of our team, you will have the opportunity to partner with the most highly regarded companies in the world, tackle complex issues, and contribute to projects that shape the future of digital transformation.

AI-First. Future-Driven. Human-Centered.

At OpenText, AI is at the heart of everything we do—powering innovation, transforming work, and empowering digital knowledge workers. We are hiring talent AI can't replace to help us shape the future of information management. Join us.


The Content Services business unit provides content platforms used by thousands of organizations to manage business content on-premise, in public cloud and private cloud, across a diverse portfolio of mature and emerging products.

We are looking for a Senior Software Developer to design and build the integration layer between OpenText Content Management and the Microsoft ecosystem, including Microsoft Teams, SharePoint, Outlook, and Microsoft 365 productivity services. You will develop SharePoint Framework (SPFx) solutions, Office add-ins, and Microsoft Graph and REST API integrations that enable thousands of enterprise users to seamlessly access, manage, and govern content directly within the applications they use every day.

This is a hands-on senior individual contributor role on a small, high-impact team with significant visibility across the organization. You will own features end-to-end, from architecture and design through implementation, testing, release, and post-production support. Working closely with Product Management, QA, Support, and Cloud Operations teams across multiple geographies, you will help deliver reliable, scalable, and intuitive integrations that are critical to our clients' daily workflows.

Your Impact:

The integrations you build are often the first experience clients have with our platform. When a records manager can securely file an email to a governed repository without leaving Outlook, or a project team can access controlled content directly within a Microsoft Teams channel, that experience is the result of your work.

You will solve complex challenges that span two large enterprise ecosystems: OpenText and Microsoft. Success often requires going beyond the documentation, analyzing protocol traces, understanding authentication and token flows, and collaborating directly with clients to diagnose and reproduce issues. This is a role for a developer who enjoys tackling difficult integration problems, navigating ambiguity, and delivering solutions that have a direct impact on client productivity and adoption.

What the Role Offers:

  • Design, build, and maintain SharePoint Framework (SPFx) web parts and extensions, Microsoft Teams applications, and Outlook add-ins that bring Content Management capabilities directly into the Microsoft 365 experience.
  • Develop and maintain integrations with Microsoft Graph and REST APIs across SharePoint, Teams, Exchange/Outlook, and related Microsoft 365 services, including bidirectional synchronization of content and metadata.
  • Build cloud-native back-end services on Azure using Azure Functions, Storage, Service Bus, and API Management, leveraging event-driven architectures and asynchronous messaging patterns to deliver scalable and resilient integrations.
  • Implement, secure, and troubleshoot end-to-end authentication and authorization solutions, including Microsoft Entra ID app registrations, OAuth 2.0 and OpenID Connect flows, JWT validation, consent and permission management, credential rotation, and cross-tenant single sign-on.
  • Design relational data models and develop high-performance SQL Server solutions, including schema design, indexing strategies, query tuning, and optimization for large-scale workloads.
  • Diagnose and resolve complex integration challenges across Microsoft 365, Azure, browsers, and third-party platforms, including CORS restrictions, throttling behavior, tenant configuration differences, dependency failures, and platform version changes.
  • Partner with Support and Professional Services teams to investigate client escalations, reproduce reported issues, communicate actionable findings, and translate root-cause analysis into product and operational improvements.
  • Contribute to technical design discussions and architecture reviews, maintain high-quality technical documentation, and elevate engineering excellence through code reviews, knowledge sharing, and mentorship.
  • Collaborate with an Agile development team alongside Product Management and Quality Assurance to refine requirements, estimate work, and deliver high-quality releases on schedule.

What You Need to Succeed:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, with 6+ years of professional software development experience.
  • Strong object-oriented development expertise in C# and .NET, with a solid understanding of design patterns, SOLID principles, and software engineering best practices for building clean, maintainable, and testable code.
  • Strong front-end development skills using TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML, and CSS, with hands-on experience developing SharePoint Framework (SPFx) solutions.
  • Demonstrated experience integrating with Microsoft Graph and REST APIs across Microsoft 365 services, including SharePoint, Teams, Outlook, and related workloads.
  • Hands-on experience designing, building, and operating cloud-native solutions on Microsoft Azure, including Azure Functions, Storage, Service Bus, and API Management, in production environments.
  • Practical experience implementing modern identity and access management solutions using Microsoft Entra ID, OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, JWT and Single Sign-On (SSO), including application registration, consent management, and delegated versus application permission models.
  • Strong SQL and relational database design skills, with experience developing and optimizing solutions on Microsoft SQL Server or equivalent RDBMS platforms.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts effectively to clients, support teams, and software developers at the appropriate level of detail.
  • Experience working within Agile development teams in cross-functional, geographically distributed environments.
  • Experience with Enterprise Content Management (ECM), Content Services, or Information Management platforms, including concepts such as records management, retention policies, information governance, classification, and compliance.
  • Familiarity with modern containerization and orchestration technologies, including Docker and Kubernetes, as well as scripting and automation using PowerShell, Python, or Bash.
  • Demonstrated proficiency with AI-assisted development tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Claude Code), including the judgment to critically review, validate, test, and maintain generated code before production deployment.

One Last Thing:

OpenText is more than a corporation—it’s a global community built on trust, character, and purpose. Here, we act ethically, care deeply about people, and always put our clients first. We help teams succeed through collaboration, tackle challenges with resilience, and innovate with intention.

Join us on our mission to drive positive change through privacy, technology, and teamwork. At OpenText, we don’t just have a culture—we live our values. Choose us because you want to be part of a company that empowers you to make a meaningful impact.


OpenText's commitment to diversity and inclusion surpasses legal requirements, evident in our Equal Employment Opportunity Statement of Policy which promotes a respectful and empowering environment for employees of all backgrounds, culture, national origin, race, color, gender, gender identification, sexual orientation, family status, age, veteran status, disability, religion, or other basis protected by applicable laws.

If you need assistance and/or a reasonable accommodation due to a disability during the application or recruiting process, please submit a ticket at Ask HR. Our proactive approach fosters collaboration, innovation, and personal growth, enriching OpenText's vibrant workplace.

Compensation:

At OpenText, we offer a thoughtfully designed benefits package that supports your physical, emotional, and financial wellbeing. As you move through the hiring process, we’re happy to provide more details about our compensation programs, including variable and commission compensation opportunities for eligible roles, vacation entitlement, and paid time off.

Salary Range:

$98,080.00 - $147,120.00; Depending on the candidate’s education, experience, skills, geographical location, and alignment with internal equity and external market, actual salary may vary and be higher or lower than the range posted.

AI Usage Disclosure:

As part of our commitment to transparency, we use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to assist in various stages of our recruitment process, including resume screening, candidate matching, interview scheduling, and communications. These tools are designed to improve efficiency, reduce bias, and enhance candidate experience. All decisions regarding hiring are made by qualified human professionals, and we continuously monitor our AI systems to ensure fairness and compliance with applicable regulations.

title: Arbetsterapeut till rehabteam i Göteborgsområdet
description:

Trivs du med att handleda omvårdnadspersonal och önskar möjlighet till att hålla i utbildningar? Låter det intressant med varierande dagar och kontinuitet? Då söker vi dig som är arbetsterapeut till vårt mobila rehabteam i Göteborgsområdet!

Klara Rehab består idag av ett team på ca 30 fysio-och arbetsterapeuter som arbetar konsultativt mot äldreomsorg, LSS samt utbildar inom vård och omsorg runt om i Sverige. Du återkommer ofta till samma enheter och får kontinuitet i ditt arbete. Som stöd har du din närmaste chef som är arbetsterapeut eller fysioterapeut, ett stort team med härliga, kompetenta kollegor samt tydliga arbetssätt och rutiner att följa.

Klara rehab finns idag i flera olika orter i Sverige, från söder till norr.

  • Arbeta i ett stabilt och växande team med över 30 kompetenta kollegor.

  • Möjlighet att påverka din arbetssituation.

  • Restid delvis på arbetstid och ersättning för vissa resekostnader

  • Vi satsar på din kompetensutveckling med utbildningar och handledning

  • Trygg anställning med kollektivavtal, tjänstepension och goda villkor.

  • Utvecklande arbetsplats där vi uppmuntrar förbättringar och nya tankesätt

  • En arbetsgivare som är såväl kvalitets- som miljöcertifierad (ISO9001/14001)

Vem är Du?

  • En engagerad arbetsterapeut som vill göra skillnad.

  • Flexibel och lösningsorienterad – du trivs med att anpassa dig till olika arbetsmiljöer.

  • Trygg i din kompetens, men öppen för att utvecklas och lära nytt.

  • Du värdesätter laganda, men trivs också med att arbeta självständigt.

  • Skriver och talar flytande svenska

Om du känner lika starkt som vi gör för vår vision Vi gör världen lite bättre, en människa i taget - Då kommer du trivas bra hos oss på Klara rehab!

Om tjänsten

Tjänsten är en tidsbegränsad anställning i 4 månader med 80 % tjänstgöringsgrad. Eventuell möjlighet till förlängning.

Aktuella arbetsorter är Varberg och Alingsås, där tre dagar/vecka förläggs i Alingsås och 1 dag/vecka i Varberg.

Arbetstid dagtid vardagar 07:30-16:00.

Låter detta som något för dig? Vi ser fram emot att höra från dig! Mejla oss gärna om du har frågor, eller skicka in din ansökan direkt – vi rekryterar löpande!

Tjänsten tillträds enligt överenskommelse.

Har du frågor om tjänsten, mejla kontaktrehab@klarakompetens.se.

Vi är Klara och vi förser våra kunder med rätt kompetens i rätt tid och på rätt plats – sjuksköterskor, rehabpersonal, leg personal inom elevhälsa samt logopeder.

Klara ingår i företagsgruppen Ambea som är ett av Nordens ledande omsorgsföretag. Inom vår företagsgrupp erbjuder vi boende, stöd, utbildning och bemanning inom vård och omsorg. Ambea bedriver i Sverige sin verksamhet inom Ambea Sweden Group där Vardaga, Nytida, Lära samt Klara är verksamhetsområden.

title: Product Manager, In-Person Giving
description:
Highlights:

Location: Armenia

Language: Fluent in Russian and English (C1+)

About Fundraise Up

We’re Fundraise Up - a global fundraising platform built to make donating to nonprofits fast, seamless, and accessible to all. Every month, our technology powers tens of millions of dollars in donations across the globe. We focus on innovation that directly impacts results: faster load times, higher conversion rates, global payment support, and accessibility-first design.

Our platform is trusted by many of the world’s leading nonprofits, including UNICEF, the Alzheimer’s Association, and a wide range of global NGOs. With a 4.9/5 rating across top software review platforms, we’re recognized not just for our impact - but for the quality of the product we deliver.

A Truly Global Product

We operate in the enterprise segment, serving nonprofit organizations across North America, the United Kingdom, Australia, and Europe.

We’re building a large and complex product ecosystem that serves nonprofits, donors, and partners around the world. The platform includes a modern checkout experience and customizable widgets (each a standalone SPA), donor, organization, and partner portals, admin tools, and several internal apps.

The Team

We are a distributed team of 160+ product professionals. Our team members are mainly based across Spain, Poland, Portugal, Georgia, Armenia, Serbia, Turkey, and Cyprus.

Despite our scale, we operate like a focused team - where every task matters and every voice is heard. We value thoughtful collaboration, strong engineering practices, and a product mindset. You’ll be joining a team where quality, mentorship, and mutual respect come first.

About In-Person Giving at Fundraise Up

In-Person Giving brings the quality and connected data of Fundraise Up’s online donation experience into physical fundraising moments.

The product begins with Tap to Donate and Giving Station: staff-led and self-service experiences that let nonprofits accept contactless donations at events, in public spaces, and through other offline workflows. Every transaction should connect to the same campaigns, donor records, reporting, CRM integrations, and operational controls used across Fundraise Up.

The next product direction is Events & Commerce. It includes ticket sales, check-in, merchandise and food purchases, symbolic purchases, auctions, paddle raises, and additional donations before and during an event. These capabilities must work as one connected fundraising system rather than another isolated event tool.

About the Role

We are hiring a Product Manager to own Events & Commerce within the broader In-Person Giving product line.

This is a hands-on software product role covering discovery, definition, delivery, launch, and iteration. You will turn a large category into a focused product direction grounded in customer workflows, live usage, and commercial evidence.

You will work closely with the PM responsible for the broader In-Person Giving area so that event commerce builds on the same payment, campaign, donor-data, reporting, mobile, and operational foundations as Tap to Donate and Giving Station. You will also partner with the Peer-to-Peer team where ticketing and event capabilities should be shared rather than rebuilt separately.

This is not an event-planning, sales, or internal project-coordination role.

What You’ll Own

Define the product direction

  • Turn customer research, market evidence, and business context into a clear Events & Commerce product thesis and sequenced roadmap.
  • Choose a focused target segment and event scenario rather than trying to replace every event platform at once.
  • Decide which capabilities belong in the shared In-Person Giving foundation and which require an Events-specific model.
  • Make explicit decisions about what Fundraise Up should build, integrate, partner on, or deliberately exclude.
  • Keep assumptions, success metrics, scope, risks, and product decisions visible.

Lead discovery and product definition

  • Work directly with nonprofit fundraising teams, event operators, finance teams, volunteers, attendees, donors, design partners, and internal GTM teams.
  • Map the complete workflow before, during, and after an event—including purchase, donation, check-in, fulfillment, reconciliation, reporting, and follow-up.
  • Validate decisions through interviews, workflow observation, prototypes, and live product usage.
  • Separate true adoption blockers from feature requests and expectations created by incumbent event platforms.
  • Shape problems such as ticket sales, QR-based check-in, guest management, commerce catalogues, FMV and receipts, on-site purchases, auctions, paddle raises, refunds, attribution, reporting, and integrations. These are examples—not a pre-committed feature checklist.

Shape and deliver the product

  • Own the product from problem definition through requirements, delivery, launch, and iteration.
  • Write clear requirements, acceptance criteria, edge cases, state transitions, and decision records.
  • Make day-to-day scope and trade-off decisions with Engineering, Design, Analytics, Research, QA, and GTM partners.
  • Design for real event conditions: staff and volunteer operators, self-service flows, mobile devices, optional hardware, unreliable connectivity, high-volume moments, and operational recovery.
  • Ensure that event capabilities reuse Fundraise Up’s existing payments, campaign, donor, reporting, CRM, and identity infrastructure wherever possible.
  • Keep delivery predictable by surfacing dependencies, risks, and unresolved decisions early.

Launch, learn, and drive outcomes

  • Launch through EAPs with clear entry criteria, target workflows, success measures, readiness requirements, and out-of-scope areas.
  • Understand whether organizations can configure and run the target event workflows without heavy manual work or disconnected tools.
  • Measure whether attendees can purchase, check in, donate, and receive the right confirmation or receipt through a clear experience.
  • Partner with Product Marketing, Sales, CSM, Support, Finance, Legal, and Operations on positioning, commitments, enablement, and launch readiness.
  • Connect product evidence to activation, adoption, event completion, GPV, expansion, pipeline, retention, and operational cost.
  • Turn evidence into explicit recommendations: iterate, expand, change direction, partner, or stop.

Work AI-native

  • Use AI for research synthesis, workflow analysis, prototyping, specification quality, data exploration, and operational automation.
  • Build testable artifacts quickly without outsourcing product judgment.

Requirements

  • 4–7 years of Product Management or Product Ownership experience in a software product company.
  • End-to-end ownership of a customer-facing product area with Engineering and Design.
  • Strong judgment in reducing a large problem space to a focused release and explaining the trade-offs.
  • Experience turning customer evidence and product data into decisions.
  • Clear written communication across requirements, edge cases, metrics, and decision records.
  • Ability to work with transactional, multi-actor workflows involving permissions, states, money, and data relationships.
  • High ownership and independence, with fluent written and spoken English.

Strong plus

  • Experience with ticketing, event technology, commerce, POS, payments, marketplaces, registration, auctions, or other transaction-heavy products.
  • Experience with mobile applications, contactless payments, physical devices, or hardware-enabled workflows.
  • Experience with B2B SaaS, fundraising, nonprofits, or other operationally complex customer environments.
  • Experience launching a new product area through beta or EAP.
  • Knowledge of CRM integrations, financial reconciliation, reporting, transaction attribution, analytics, or SQL.
  • Practical use of AI for research, prototyping, analysis, or product operations.

This Role May Not Be a Fit If

  • You are looking for an event-planning or internal project-management role rather than software product ownership.
  • You prefer to receive a fully defined roadmap and requirements instead of helping determine what should be built.
  • You want to work only on strategy and avoid specifications, QA, delivery details, or post-launch iteration.
  • You treat every customer request as a roadmap commitment.
  • You need stable scope and certainty before moving forward.
  • You measure progress mainly by features shipped rather than customer and business outcomes.

Why work with us

  • Build a new product direction from research through live customer use.
  • Work in a large, proven fundraising category with clear customer demand and meaningful commercial potential.
  • Shape ticketing and event commerce as part of a broader fundraising platform rather than an isolated event tool.
  • Work with real nonprofit customers, rich product evidence, and experienced cross-functional partners.
  • Join a small team where product managers have meaningful ownership and direct access to Product leadership.
  • Help define an AI-native approach to product management in practice.
  • Build technology that helps nonprofits engage more supporters and raise more money for their missions.

Compensation

  • The compensation range for this role is $4,600 - $5,000 gross.
  • Final compensation will be determined based on relevant experience, skills, qualifications, alignment with the role’s requirements and location.

Benefits

  • 31 days off
  • 100% paid telemedicine plan
  • Home Office Setup Assistance: the company offers assistance with purchasing furniture (office chair, office desk, monitor) and other items to create a comfortable workspace.
  • English learning courses
  • Relevant professional education
  • Gym or swimming pool
  • Co-working
  • Remote working

We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, national origin, disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law in the countries where we operate.

title: Specialistläkare till Aleris ASIH Huddinge och Botkyrka
description:
Vill du arbeta med avancerad sjukvård i hemmet i en verksamhet där du får tid för patienten, nära samarbete med andra specialister och möjlighet att påverka?

Vi söker nu två specialistläkare – en till ASIH Huddinge och en till ASIH Botkyrka. Hos oss får du ett självständigt och varierat läkararbete samtidigt som du alltid har nära till erfarna kollegor och ett engagerat multiprofessionellt team.

Om oss

Aleris ASIH Huddinge och ASIH Botkyrka är två väletablerade och växande team som arbetar på uppdrag av Region Stockholm. Vi vårdar patienter med komplexa medicinska behov i hemmet, ofta i palliativa skeden, och kombinerar avancerad medicinsk behandling med personcentrerad och palliativ vård.

Båda teamen har sina lokaler i Tullinge centrum. I respektive team arbetar redan två specialistläkare, vilket innebär att du får flera läkarkollegor att samarbeta, diskutera patientfall och utveckla verksamheten tillsammans med.

Du arbetar nära sjuksköterskor, undersköterskor, arbetsterapeut, fysioterapeut, dietist och kurator. Tillsammans skapar vi en trygg och sammanhållen vård utifrån patientens behov och önskemål.

Din roll

Som specialistläkare inom ASIH har du ett medicinskt helhetsansvar för dina patienter. Specialistläkarna utgör tillsammans med enhetschefen teamets ledning, vilket ger dig goda möjligheter att påverka både det dagliga arbetet och verksamhetens fortsatta utveckling.

I rollen får du bland annat:

· bedriva avancerad medicinsk och palliativ vård i patientens hem

· arbeta nära andra specialistläkare och ett erfaret multiprofessionellt team

· planera och följa patientens vård tillsammans med patient, närstående och team

· arbeta med symtom- och smärtlindring samt samtal med patienter och närstående

· handleda och vägleda kollegor och läkare under utbildning

· bidra till utveckling av arbetssätt, kvalitet och patientsäkerhet.

Det här erbjuder vi dig

Vi vill skapa goda förutsättningar för att du ska kunna trivas, utvecklas och ha en hållbar arbetsvardag. Därför erbjuder vi både stöd i din professionella utveckling och möjlighet till en god balans mellan arbete och fritid.

Hos oss får du:

· strukturerad introduktion och individuellt mentorskap för en trygg start

· nära stöd och samarbete med erfarna specialistläkarkollegor

· förkortad arbetstid

· individuellt anpassat jour- och beredskapsschema

· ett välfungerande multiprofessionellt team med hög kompetens

· möjlighet att påverka och utveckla både teamet och vården

· kontinuerlig kompetensutveckling

· möjlighet att vidareutbilda dig inom palliativ medicin

· kollektivavtal, försäkringar och Aleris övriga personalförmåner.

Vem söker vi?

Vi söker dig som är specialistläkare inom exempelvis geriatrik, onkologi, internmedicin, allmänmedicin eller annan relevant specialitet.

Du behöver inte vara specialist i palliativ medicin när du börjar hos oss. Det viktigaste är att du har ett genuint intresse för avancerad sjukvård i hemmet och palliativ vård och vill fortsätta utvecklas inom området.

Vi tror att du:

· trivs med att arbeta i team och uppskattar nära samarbete med andra professioner

· är trygg och självständig i din läkarroll

· har ett varmt och professionellt bemötande av patienter och närstående

· är engagerad, flexibel och lösningsorienterad

· uppskattar att dela kunskap och samtidigt lära av andra.

Har du erfarenhet av ASIH eller palliativ vård, eller är specialist i palliativ medicin, är det meriterande.

Anställning

Placering: ASIH Huddinge eller ASIH Botkyrka Anställningsform: Tillsvidareanställning, inledningsvis sex månaders provanställning Omfattning: Heltid Tillträde: Enligt överenskommelse Lön: Individuell lönesättning

Välkommen med din ansökan!

Vill du veta mer om hur det är att arbeta som specialistläkare hos oss? Du är varmt välkommen att höra av dig – vi berättar gärna mer om teamen, arbetssättet och tjänsten.

Thays Alé Gonzalez Läkarchef och medicinskt ansvarig läkare 08-606 40 38 / 070-484 51 79 thays.ale.gonzalez@aleris.se

Urval och intervjuer sker löpande – varmt välkommen med din ansökan!

title: Senior Data Engineer (Python/ AWS)
description:

Preferred Skills

title: Manažér / manažérka servisu a popredajnej starostlivosti Mercedes-Benz
description:
V Hedin Automotive Slovakia (Nitra) pracujeme na budovaní jedinečnej zákazníckej skúsenosti a vytvárame príležitosť viesť a riadiť servisný tím, ktorý v spolupráci s ďalšími kolegami na rôznych oddeleniach bude nielen plniť, ale aj prekračovať očakávania našich zákazníkov značky Mercedes-Benz. Radi medzi nás privítame skúseného manažéra, ktorý dokáže s ľuďmi nastaviť vysokú úroveň služieb a starostlivosti o našich zákazníkov.

Ak máte aspoň 4 roky skúsenosti s riadením tímov v popredajných službách a láka Vás pracovať v stabilnej obchodnej spoločnosti v Automotive s atraktívnymi značkami ako je Mercedes-Benz, príďte sa dozvedieť viac o tejto pracovnej príležitosti.

Na pozícii Vedúceho / manažéra servisu by ste :

  • riadili celý chod servisu osobných motorových vozidiel

  • nastavovali prostredie pre váš tím, aby sa čo najlepšie postarali o zákazníka a dostali jeho vozidlo čo najskôr na vozovku

  • viedli, organizovali a zjednocovali spoluprácu medzi tímami

  • vyhodnocovali dôležité ukazovatele spokojnosti zákazníkov a zamestnancov

  • spolupracovali s importérom pri zvyšovaní úrovne štandardov starostlivosti

  • zlepšovali systém práce, aby sme sa aj vďaka vašim návrhom ďalej rozvíjali

K pozícii budete potrebovať osobnostné predpoklady a zručnosti :

  • min. 4 roky manažérsku skúsenosť s riadením tímov v službách v predaji, podpore predaja, popredajnej alebo zákazníckej starostlivosti

  • poctivý a zodpovedný prístup orientovaný na zákazníka

  • schopnosť riešiť zákaznícke podnety a špecifické požiadavky, predchádzajúca prax prijímacieho technika je výhodou

  • dôslednosť, chuť a schopnosť vzdelávať sa v obore

  • inovatívnosť a znalosť technológie opráv automobilov

  • skúsenosť s predajom alebo servisom vozidiel výhodou

  • znalosť práce s produkčnými systémami je výhodou

  • skúsenosť s plánovaním, rozpočtami, reportingom

Ponúkneme Vám zaujímavé zamestnanecké výhody a benefity :

  • moderné pracovné prostredie

  • osobnostný a kariérny rozvoj, vzdelávanie v odbore

  • atraktívne a reprezentatívne služobné motorové vozidlo

  • príspevok na doplnkové dôchodkové sporenie

  • Multisport karta a jej výhody

  • a hlavne skvelý kolektív kolegov s ktorými sa nikdy nenudíte :-)


Informácie o výberovom konaní

Ďakujeme, že ste si náš inzerát prečítali a pokiaľ sme vás zaujali a v pozícii sa "vidíte", radi vás spoznáme aj osobne. Pošlite nám váš životopis prostredníctvom tejto aplikácie a my sa s vami radi spojíme.

Radi by sme zároveň upozornili kandidátov, že aj napriek tomu, že si vážime každého uchádzača, ktorý prejaví záujem o pozíciu, na osobný pohovor budeme pozývať len kandidátov, ktorými svojimi skúsenosťami a predpokladmi spĺňajú kritéria pre túto pozíciu.

description:

  • Collaborate with network engineers and implementation teams to plan hardware upgrades or enhancements to components of the network infrastructure.

  • Ability to create clear and concise presentations for management, stakeholders and executives
