업무내용

  • 쿠팡이츠 배달 서비스 전반의 Customer Experience(CX) 품질을 실시간으로 모니터링하고, 고객 경험에 영향을 미치는 이슈를 조기에 감지·대응할 수 있는 운영 체계를 구축합니다.
  • 주문 퍼널(App 진입 → 검색 → 장바구니 → 결제 → 주문 완료) 전반의 핵심 지표를 관리하며, 이상 징후를 탐지하기 위한 모니터링 프레임워크 및 Detection Logic을 설계합니다.
  • 인시던트 발생 시 SOP(Standard Operating Procedure) 준수 여부를 모니터링하고, 표준화된 대응 프로세스를 고도화합니다.
  • SOP가 정의되지 않은 신규 이슈 발생 시 Strategy, Product, Engineering, Operations, Merchant 등 주요 Stakeholder 및 Leadership Team과 협업하여 대응 체계를 수립하고 신속하게 에스컬레이션합니다.
  • 자동 Alert 시스템, 운영 대시보드(Control Panel), 비즈니스 자동화 솔루션을 기획 및 구축하여 운영 효율성과 문제 탐지 정확도를 향상시킵니다.
  • 실시간 데이터 기반으로 서비스 이상 징후를 분석하고, 전사 영향도 및 Root Cause를 파악하여 개선 과제를 도출합니다.
  • 고객 경험 개선, 비용 효율화(Cost Efficiency), 고객 리텐션 향상을 위한 운영 전략 및 서비스 로드맵을 수립합니다.
  • AI 기반 운영 도구 및 Workflow Automation을 활용하여 운영 프로세스를 지속적으로 개선하고 확장합니다.
  • VP 및 Director 레벨을 포함한 전사 리더십과 협업하며 주요 운영 지표, 인시던트, 프로젝트 성과를 공유하고 의사결정을 지원합니다.
  • 한국 및 일본 시장을 포함한 글로벌 운영 환경에서 Cross-functional 프로젝트를 리딩합니다.

자격 요건

  • 총 10년 이상의 경력을 보유하신 분
  • Program Management, Product Management, Business Operations, Strategy, Process Improvement, Service Operations 분야 중 하나 이상의 경험을 보유하신 분
  • 데이터 기반으로 문제를 정의하고 해결 방안을 도출한 경험이 있는 분
  • 서비스 모니터링 체계, 운영 프로세스 또는 Incident Management 프로세스를 구축하거나 개선한 경험이 있는 분
  • 다양한 이해관계자(Product, Engineering, Strategy, Operations 등)와 협업하며 프로젝트를 성공적으로 리드한 경험이 있는 분
  • 복잡한 문제를 구조화하고 우선순위를 설정하여 실행할 수 있는 역량을 보유하신 분
  • Senior Leadership(VP, Director급) 대상 커뮤니케이션 및 의사결정 지원 경험이 있는 분
  • 비즈니스 수준의 영어 커뮤니케이션이 가능한 분

우대 사항

  • 배달, 커머스, 모빌리티, 플랫폼 서비스 등 대규모 운영 환경에서의 경험을 보유하신 분
  • Customer Experience(CX) 개선 또는 Customer Journey Optimization 경험이 있는 분
  • Incident Management, Emergency Response Team(ERT), Site Reliability, Service Operations 관련 경험이 있는 분
  • KPI 모니터링, 이상 징후 탐지, Alerting System 구축 경험이 있는 분
  • SQL, Python 등을 활용한 데이터 분석 경험을 보유하신 분
  • Airflow, Workflow Automation, API 연동, ETL Pipeline 등 비즈니스 자동화 구축 경험이 있는 분
  • Tableau, Looker, Power BI 등 Dashboard 및 Monitoring System 구축 경험이 있는 분
  • AI 기반 운영 자동화 또는 AI Tool 활용 경험이 있는 분
  • 일본어 커뮤니케이션이 가능하신 분
  • 빠르게 변화하는 환경에서 높은 수준의 Ownership을 가지고 문제를 해결한 경험이 있는 분

전형 절차 및 안내 사항

  • 전형절차
    • 서류전형 - 전화면접 - 화상면접 – 최종 합격
    • 전형절차는 직무별로 다르게 운영될 수 있으며, 일정 및 상황에 따라 변동될 수 있습니다.
    • 전형 일정 및 결과는 지원서에 등록하신 이메일로 개별 안내 드립니다.
  • 참고사항
    • 본 공고는 모집 완료 시 조기 마감될 수 있습니다.
    • 지원서 내용 중 허위사실이 있는 경우에는 합격이 취소될 수 있습니다.
    • 취업 보호 대상자(보훈대상자, 장애인 등)는 관련 법률에 따라 채용우대를 받을 수 있습니다.
    • 직급과 담당 업무 범위는 후보자의 전반적인 경력과 경험 등 제반사정을 고려하여 변경될 수 있습니다. 이러한 변경이 필요할 경우, 최종 합격 통지 전 적절한 시기에 후보자와 커뮤니케이션 될 예정입니다.
    • 채용 및 업무 수행과 관련하여 요구되는 법령상 자격이 갖추어지지 않은 경우 채용이 제한될 수 있습니다.
    • 고용형태는 정규직으로 수습기간 12 주를 포함합니다. 단, 업무상 필요한 경우에는 상기 수습기간을 적용하지 않거나 단축 또는 연장할 수 있습니다.

개인정보 처리방침

  • 쿠팡 그룹은 입사지원자 개인정보 처리방침(아래 링크)에 따라 귀하의 개인정보를 수집하여 처리합니다.

서류 반환 정책

  1. 본 고지는 『채용절차의공정화에관한법률』 제11조제6항에 따른 것 입니다.
  2. 당사 채용에 응시한 구직자 중 최종 합격이 되지 못한 구직자는 『채용절차의 공정화에 관한 법률』에 따라 제출한 채용서류의 반환을 청구할 수 있음을 알려 드립니다. 다만, 홈페이지 또는 전자우편으로 제출된 경우나 구직자가 당사의 요구 없이 자발적으로 제출한 경우에는 그러하지 아니하며, 천재지변이나 그 밖에 당사에게 책임 없는 사유로 채용서류가 멸실된 경우에는 반환한 것으로 봅니다.
  3. 위2항 본문에 따라 채용 서류 반환 청구를 하는 구직자는 채용 서류 반환 청구서 [채용절차의 공정화에 관한 법률 시행규칙 별지 제 3 호 서식]를 작성하여 이메일 (recruitingops@coupang.com) 로 제출하면, 제출이 확인된 날로부터 14 일 이내에 지정한 주소지로 등기우편을 통하여 발송해 드립니다. 이 경우 등기우편요금은 수신자 부담으로 하게 되오니 유념하시기 바랍니다.
  4. 당사는 위2항 본문에 따른 구직자의 반환 청구에 대비하여 채용 여부가 확정된 날로부터 180 일간 구직자가 제출한 채용서류 원본을 보관하게 되며, 그때까지 채용서류의 반환을 청구하지 아니할 경우에는 『개인정보 보호법』에 따라 지체 없이 채용서류 일체를 파기할 예정입니다.
  5. 단, 위 1항 내지 4항의 내용은 대한민국의 노동 관계 법령이 적용되는 경우에만 적용됩니다. 그 이외의 경우에는 적용되지 않습니다.

title: Software Engineer (Golang)
description:
About Capgemini

Capgemini is an AI-powered global business and technology transformation partner, delivering tangible business value. We imagine the future of organizations and make it real with AI, technology and people. With our strong heritage of nearly 60 years, we are a responsible and diverse group of over 420,000 team members in more than 50 countries. We deliver end-to-end services and solutions with our deep industry expertise and strong partner ecosystem, leveraging our capabilities across strategy, technology, design, engineering and business operations. The Group reported 2025 global revenues of €22.5 billion.

Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with a cross-functional team of developers and designers to create services for the public sector.
  • Participate in various Agile ceremonies, such as Planning, Review and Retrospective
  • Work across the frontend and backend to develop solutions that focus on the distribution of physical and virtual goods.
  • Iterate and collaborate closely with other team members to craft elegant solutions.
  • Deliver high-quality, secure, maintainable and testable code.
  • Be an independent and impactful contributor to the team.
  • Build and maintain high performance and secure APIs accessible through mobile applications, web portals and partner services.
  • Develop user experiences for citizens, partners and members of the team.
  • Maintain continuous integration and deployment pipelines to bring value to our users iteratively.
  • Monitor the health of deployed services and provide L2 and L3 support when disruptions occur.

Requirements

  • You enjoy collaborating closely with a passionate and high-performing team.
  • You thrive working in a fast-paced environment.
  • You enjoy coming up with numerous solutions for a wide range of technical problems.
  • You have a strong foundation in software architecture and design patterns.
  • You place a keen emphasis on testing across the entire stack — unit, integration and E2E (end to end).
  • You are experienced with javascript and backend languages, preferably Typescript and Go. We use both Typescript and Go across products and systems.
  • You are able to communicate and work with stakeholders (both technical and non technical) and lead tracks when required
  • You have good communication skills
  • Experience with containers or AWS (Amazon Web Services) is a bonus.

Let’s talk about what’s in it for you!

Passionate people are Capgemini's Ace of Spades - join us to discover a career that will challenge, support and inspire you. Working at Capgemini you'll find the rewards are more than just financial. You will work alongside some very smart and inspiring people on exciting projects and you will also enjoy incredible benefits. We offer flexible work practices and 40 hours of self-development every year with a huge selection of learning opportunities to choose from.

As "Architects of Positive Futures", Capgemini actively supports the community in 3 ways:

Diversity and Inclusion

we believe diversity of thought fuels excellence and innovation, which is why we positively encourage applications from suitably qualified candidates regardless of their gender identity, ethnicity, sexual orientation, religion, ability, intersex status or age. To support our commitment to diversity and inclusion, we celebrate special events and days of significance that are important to our employees such as Diwali, Bastille Day, Pride, IDAHOBIT, IWD and International day of people with Disabilities. Our Employee Resource Groups Women@Capgemini and OutFront support the grassroots passion of employees to drive our diversity agenda and effect change.

Digital inclusion

at Capgemini we are using our skills to drive social impact initiatives focusing on helping society address the impact of the digital and automation revolution. We also provide employees with opportunities to give back to the community through charity projects and volunteer days.

Environmental Sustainability

Capgemini joined the CDP's (Carbon Disclosure Project) prestigious "A list" for its commitment to the Net-Zero economy. We are focusing on helping our clients transform towards more sustainable business models and committing to reduce our own carbon emissions (GHG) by 20% per employee by 2020.

Recognized by Ethisphere as one of the World's Most Ethical Companies for the last 8 years in a row, ethics and values are at the heart of Capgemini's corporate culture and business.

Embedded in our DNA, our seven values - Honesty, Boldness, Trust, Team Spirit, Freedom, Fun and Modesty - have remained the same since company inception in 1967.

Come join us, bring your whole self to work, create new possibilities for you, your customers and your community and help us to be Architects of Positive Futures.

title: Work Order Write Up Assistant
description:
At ALS, we encourage you to dream big.

When you join us, you’ll be part of a global team harnessing the power of scientific testing and data-driven insights to build a healthier future.

The role

ALS Geochemistry in Orange a reliable and detail-oriented Work Order Write Up Assistant to support the operations of a fast-paced minerals preparation and analytical laboratory.

The primary responsibility of this part-time role is to accurately enter work order information into the company’s Laboratory Information Management System (LIMS). The successful applicant may also be required to perform additional duties, as directed and within their capabilities, to support the efficient operation of the laboratory.

We are seeking someone who is available to work the following day shift roster:

  • Tuesday: 7:00 am – 3:00 pm

  • Wednesday: 7:00 am – 3:00 pm

  • Thursday: 7:00 am – 3:00 pm

​

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Filing, archiving and updating all records as required.

  • Screening phone calls and escalating them to appropriate personnel.

  • Creating Client Profile Templates (CPTs), work orders, and client codes for Technical Clerical Officers.

  • Inputting analytical methods and relevant information into GEMS.

  • Assigning method codes and correcting invoices and credits.

  • Ensuring pricing is correct for active and new work orders.

  • Liaising with management to obtain turnaround times and ETA’s.

  • Other duties as directed by the Section Supervisor/Manager.

​

Hands-on training will be provided in various areas of the laboratory and preparation sections to gain an understanding of the operations of the facilities.

The essentials

  • Good alphanumeric skills

  • Strong language skills, with the ability to communicate effectively with internal and external clients

  • Computer literacy and experience using Excel, Word, and OneNote

  • Strong attention to detail, with a proven ability to collect, interpret, and manage data efficiently and accurately

  • Experience working in a laboratory environment would be advantageous and is highly regarded, but is not essential

  • Qualifications in Geology, Chemistry, Earth Science, or a related discipline would be desirable, but are not essential

  • A professional presentation and friendly, team-oriented manner

  • The ability to meet deadlines and work effectively as part of a team

  • An open and positive attitude towards receiving feedback, with a willingness to learn from mistakes and continuously improve

Working at ALS

The ALS team is a diverse and dedicated community united by our passion to make a difference in the world.

Our values are important to us, and shape how we work, how we treat each other and how we recognise excellence.

At ALS, you’ll be supported to develop new skills and reach your full potential. We invest in our people with programs and opportunities that help you build a diverse career with us.

We want everyone to have a safe, flexible and rewarding career that makes a positive impact on our people, the planet and our communities.

Everyone Matters

ALS is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and is committed to fostering an inclusive work environment where the strengths and perspectives of each employee are both recognised and valued.

ALS also welcomes applications from people with all levels of ability. Reasonable adjustments to support candidates throughout the recruitment process are available upon request.

Eligibility
To be eligible to work at ALS you must be a Citizen or Permanent Resident of the country you are applying for, or either hold or be able to obtain, a valid working visa.

How to apply
Please apply on-line and provide a resume & cover letter that best demonstrate your motivation and ability to meet the requirements of this role.

title: Software Engineer - ETL & Data Warehousing
description:
Job Summary

We are seeking an experienced Software Engineer with strong expertise in ETL development, data integration, data warehousing and banking applications . The role involves designing, developing, testing, deploying and supporting software solutions for enterprise data-processing and banking applications. The successful candidate will work with IBM DataStage, Informatica, Oracle PL/SQL, SQL, UNIX/Shell Scripting, Control-M and CI/CD tools to develop and maintain reliable data-processing solutions. Experience with Moody's RCO, RAY and RFO and banking regulatory processes such as LCR, ALM and IRRBB will support the delivery of banking technology solutions.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop and maintain software solutions for data integration and processing.
  • Develop ETL workflows using IBM DataStage and Informatica .
  • Develop SQL and PL/SQL programs for data processing and database integration.
  • Develop UNIX/Shell scripts for automation and data processing.
  • Configure and automate job scheduling using Control-M .
  • Perform software testing, troubleshooting, debugging and performance tuning.
  • Prepare technical design documents and unit test cases.
  • Deploy software and ETL components across development, testing and production environments.
  • Review code and ensure compliance with development and coding standards.
  • Support banking applications and investigate technical issues related to data and processing.
  • Provide technical support for Moody's RCO, RAY and RFO applications.
  • Support data-processing requirements related to banking risk and regulatory processes.
  • Collaborate with testing, BI and business teams to resolve technical issues.
  • Support CI/CD activities using Jenkins, Git and Bitbucket .
  • Analyze large datasets and support data-driven business and reporting requirements.

title: Staff Software Engineer
description:
Why Sony Interactive Entertainment?

Sony Interactive Entertainment isn’t just the Best Place to Play — it’s also the Best Place to Work. Sony Interactive Entertainment (SIE) is the company behind the PlayStation brand. As a subsidiary of Sony Group Corporation, we’re part of a proud legacy of innovation and excellence. SIE is a dynamic technology company, delivering cutting-edge hardware and network services to more than 100 million people and an entertainment leader, home to some of the most beloved and recognizable intellectual properties (IP) in the world. Our role at SIE is to create and nurture the experiences under the PlayStation brand, a name synonymous with entertainment excellence and creativity.

Staff Software Engineer, Adaptive Experiences Platform

Waterloo, ON

About the Role

The DTIS Nurture organization is building the next generation of adaptive experiences for PlayStation. Our vision is to make every customer touchpoint more relevant, useful, and joyful by combining reusable experience capabilities with personalization, merchandising, experimentation, and intelligent decisioning.

We are looking for a Staff Software Engineer to help lead the evolution of our Dynamic Experience Management, allowing teams to create and optimize experiences without requiring bespoke implementation for every client or a client release for every layout change.

You will be a hands-on technical leader working across the experience stack. You will also shape the architecture needed to extend capabilities beyond PS5, across web, mobile, and other PlayStation devices. This is an opportunity to define foundational technology that will change how PlayStation builds, delivers, experiments with, and learns from customer experiences at scale.

Responsibilities

  • Define and drive the technical direction for our experiances SDK, translating the adaptive-experiences vision into an incremental, production-ready architecture.
  • Lead the modernization of the PS5 Store experience runtime, including migration from legacy EMS SDK and client-specific rendering paths to schema-driven DXM experiences rendered through Content SDK.
  • Design and evolve the platform-independent composition layer, public TypeScript APIs, versioned schemas, content adapters, component model, data bindings, and platform renderer contracts.
  • Build reusable experience primitives and native rendering capabilities that support responsive layouts, personalization, experimentation, telemetry, accessibility, localization, and platform-specific interaction models.
  • Establish safe coexistence and migration patterns, including backward compatibility, capability negotiation, validation, feature flags, fallbacks, rollback, and observability.
  • Profile and optimize bundle size, startup and time-to-interactive performance, memory usage, rendering behavior, and runtime reliability on resource-constrained client platforms.
  • Improve developer experience through clear interfaces, reference integrations, test harnesses, preview and debugging tools, automated compatibility testing, and high-quality documentation.
  • Help establish governed, agent-assisted authoring and validation workflows that can translate design and business intent into trusted artifacts, supported by policy checks and evaluation suites.
  • Partner with client, design system, merchandising, content, personalization, experimentation, and platform service teams to align contracts and deliver end-to-end capabilities.
  • Provide technical leadership across team boundaries, mentor engineers, make sound trade-offs in ambiguous problem spaces, and communicate architecture and decisions to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 8+ years of professional software engineering experience, including significant experience designing and delivering production client platforms, SDKs, frameworks, or shared libraries.
  • Expert-level proficiency with TypeScript or JavaScript and strong experience with React, React Native, or a comparable component-based client framework.
  • Strong software architecture and API design skills, including modularity, dependency management, versioning, backward compatibility, and incremental migration of large production systems.
  • Experience building data-driven or server-driven user interfaces, reusable component systems, or runtime composition frameworks.
  • Demonstrated ability to diagnose and improve client performance and reliability using profiling, telemetry, automated testing, and production observability.
  • Experience designing for more than one client environment, such as console, mobile, web, TV, or embedded platforms, with a practical understanding of platform-specific constraints.
  • Proven track record of solving ambiguous, cross-functional problems with minimal direction and driving alignment without relying on formal authority.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to document architecture and explain complex technical decisions clearly.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with console development, living-room interfaces, focus-based navigation, or performance-constrained native clients.
  • Experience with schema-backed declarative UI, domain-specific languages, JSON Schema, component expansion, data binding, hydration, or client-side rendering engines.
  • Experience building or integrating client SDKs, content management or merchandising systems, personalization platforms, experimentation frameworks, or design systems.
  • Experience migrating a large client application away from a legacy rendering or content-delivery framework using staged rollout, compatibility layers, and measurable exit criteria.
  • Experience developing platform adapters or renderers for iOS, Android, web, or other native client environments.
  • Familiarity with content and layout separation, runtime content sources, telemetry provenance, accessibility, localization, and safe fallback behavior.
  • Experience with developer tooling, visual preview systems, contract testing, schema validation, or automated cross-platform regression testing.
  • Experience applying generative AI or agentic workflows to software or content creation, including evaluation, governance, and deterministic output constraints.
  • A track record of technical leadership and mentoring across multiple teams.

Additional Skills

  • Motivated self-starter who combines long-term architectural thinking with pragmatic, incremental delivery.
  • Customer-focused and attentive to developer experience, operational usability, and measurable product outcomes.
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, collaborative environment with partners across product, design, engineering, and operations.
